verses.textZh: 提阿非罗先生：我已经写了前书，叙述耶稣开始所行所教的一切，
verses.textZhCnvs: 提阿非罗先生：我已经写了前书，叙述耶稣开始所行所教的一切，
verses.textZhCuv: 提阿非罗啊，我已经作了前书，论到耶稣开头一切所行所教训的，
verses.textEnNiv: In my former book, Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach
verses.textEnEsv: In the first book, O Theophilus, I have dealt with all that Jesus began to do and teach,
verses.textEnNkjv: The former account I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
verses.textEnNlt: In my first book I told you, Theophilus, about everything Jesus began to do and teach
verses.textEnNasb: The first account I composed, Theophilus, about all that Jesus began to do and teach,
verses.textEn: In my former book, Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach

verses.textZh: 一直到他借着圣灵吩咐所拣选的使徒之后，被接上升的日子为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一直到他借着圣灵吩咐所拣选的使徒之后，被接上升的日子为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 直到他藉着圣灵吩咐所拣选的使徒，以后被接上升的日子为止。
verses.textEnNiv: until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles he had chosen.
verses.textEnEsv: until the day when he was taken up, after he had given commands through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.
verses.textEnNkjv: until the day in which He was taken up, after He through the Holy Spirit had given commandments to the apostles whom He had chosen,
verses.textEnNlt: until the day he was taken up to heaven after giving his chosen apostles further instructions through the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: until the day when He was taken up to heaven, after He had given orders by the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom He had chosen.
verses.textEn: until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles he had chosen.

verses.textZh: 他受难以后，用许多凭据向使徒显示自己是活着的。他向使徒显现，并且讲论神的国的事，有四十天之久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他受难以后，用许多凭据向使徒显示自己是活着的。他向使徒显现，并且讲论神的国的事，有四十天之久。
verses.textZhCuv: 他受害之后，用许多的凭据将自己活活地显给使徒看，四十天之久向他们显现，讲说神国的事。
verses.textEnNiv: After his suffering, he presented himself to them and gave many convincing proofs that he was alive. He appeared to them over a period of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnEsv: He presented himself alive to them after his suffering by many proofs, appearing to them during forty days and speaking about the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: to whom He also presented Himself alive after His suffering by many infallible proofs, being seen by them during forty days and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNlt: During the forty days after he suffered and died, he appeared to the apostles from time to time, and he proved to them in many ways that he was actually alive. And he talked to them about the Kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNasb: To these He also presented Himself alive after His suffering, by many convincing proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking of things regarding the kingdom of God.
verses.textEn: After his suffering, he presented himself to them and gave many convincing proofs that he was alive. He appeared to them over a period of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.

verses.textZh: 耶稣和他们一同吃饭的时候，吩咐他们不要离开耶路撒冷，说："<red>你们要等候父的应许，就是你们听我讲过的，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣和他们一同吃饭的时候，吩咐他们不要离开耶路撒冷，说："<red>你们要等候父的应许，就是你们听我讲过的，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣和他们聚集的时候，嘱咐他们说：「不要离开耶路撒冷，要等候父所应许的，就是你们听见我说过的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: On one occasion, while he was eating with them, he gave them this command: <red>“Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift my Father promised, which you have heard me speak about.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And while staying with them he ordered them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to wait for the promise of the Father, which, he said, "you heard from me;
verses.textEnNkjv: And being assembled together with them, He commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to wait for the Promise of the Father, "which,"Hesaid,"you have heard from Me;
verses.textEnNlt: Once when he was eating with them, he commanded them, "Do not leave Jerusalem until the Father sends you the gift he promised, as I told you before.
verses.textEnNasb: Gathering them together, He commanded them not to leave Jerusalem, but to wait for what the Father had promised, "Which,"He said,"you heard of from Me;
verses.textEn: On one occasion, while he was eating with them, he gave them this command: <red>“Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift my Father promised, which you have heard me speak about.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>约翰是用水施洗，但再过几天，你们要受圣灵的洗。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>约翰是用水施洗，但再过几天，你们要受圣灵的洗。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>约翰是用水施洗，但不多几日，你们要受圣灵的洗。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days from now."
verses.textEnNkjv: for John truly baptized with water, but you shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days from now."
verses.textEnNlt: John baptized with water, but in just a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNasb: for John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days from now."
verses.textEn: <red>For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”</red>

verses.textZh: 他们聚集的时候，问耶稣说："主啊，你要在这时候使以色列复国吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们聚集的时候，问耶稣说："主啊，你要在这时候使以色列复国吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们聚集的时候，问耶稣说：「主啊，你复兴以色列国就在这时候吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they gathered around him and asked him, "Lord, are you at this time going to restore the kingdom to Israel?"
verses.textEnEsv: So when they had come together, they asked him, "Lord, will you at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked Him, saying, "Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?"
verses.textEnNlt: So when the apostles were with Jesus, they kept asking him, "Lord, has the time come for you to free Israel and restore our kingdom?"
verses.textEnNasb: So, when they had come together, they began asking Him, saying, "Lord, is it at this time that You are restoring the kingdom to Israel?"
verses.textEn: Then they gathered around him and asked him, "Lord, are you at this time going to restore the kingdom to Israel?"

verses.textZh: 耶稣说："<red>父凭着自己的权柄所定的时间或日期，你们不必知道。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣说："<red>父凭着自己的权柄所定的时间或日期，你们不必知道。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>耶稣对他们说：「父凭着自己的权柄所定的时候、日期，不是你们可以知道的。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them: <red>“It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by his own authority.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to them, "It is not for you to know times or seasons which the Father has put in His own authority.
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "The Father alone has the authority to set those dates and times, and they are not for you to know.
verses.textEnNasb: But He said to them, "It is not for you to know periods of time or appointed times which the Father has set by His own authority;
verses.textEn: He said to them: <red>“It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>可是圣灵降临在你们身上，你们就必领受能力，并且要在耶路撒冷、犹太全地、撒玛利亚，直到地极，作我的见证人。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>可是圣灵降临在你们身上，你们就必领受能力，并且要在耶路撒冷、犹太全地、撒玛利亚，直到地极，作我的见证人。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>但圣灵降临在你们身上，你们就必得着能力，并要在耶路撒冷、犹太全地，和撒马利亚，直到地极，作我的见证。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you, and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: But you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you; and you shall be witnesses to Me in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you. And you will be my witnesses, telling people about me everywhere—in Jerusalem, throughout Judea, in Samaria, and to the ends of the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: but you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you; and you shall be My witnesses both in Jerusalem and in all Judea, and Samaria, and as far as the remotest part of the earth."
verses.textEn: <red>But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”</red>

verses.textZh: 说完了这话，他们还在看的时候，他被接上升，有一朵云把他接去，就看不见他了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说完了这话，他们还在看的时候，他被接上升，有一朵云把他接去，就看不见他了。
verses.textZhCuv: 说了这话，他们正看的时候，他就被取上升，有一朵云彩把他接去，便看不见他了。
verses.textEnNiv: After he said this, he was taken up before their very eyes, and a cloud hid him from their sight.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had said these things, as they were looking on, he was lifted up, and a cloud took him out of their sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He had spoken these things, while they watched, He was taken up, and a cloud received Him out of their sight.
verses.textEnNlt: After saying this, he was taken up into a cloud while they were watching, and they could no longer see him.
verses.textEnNasb: And after He had said these things, He was lifted up while they were watching, and a cloud took Him up, out of their sight.
verses.textEn: After he said this, he was taken up before their very eyes, and a cloud hid him from their sight.

verses.textZh: 当他往上升，他们定睛望天的时候，忽然有两个人，身穿白衣，站在他们旁边，
verses.textZhCnvs: 当他往上升，他们定睛望天的时候，忽然有两个人，身穿白衣，站在他们旁边，
verses.textZhCuv: 当他往上去，他们定睛望天的时候，忽然有两个人身穿白衣，站在旁边，说：
verses.textEnNiv: They were looking intently up into the sky as he was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.
verses.textEnEsv: And while they were gazing into heaven as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white robes,
verses.textEnNkjv: And while they looked steadfastly toward heaven as He went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel,
verses.textEnNlt: As they strained to see him rising into heaven, two white-robed men suddenly stood among them.
verses.textEnNasb: And as they were gazing intently into the sky while He was going, then behold, two men in white clothing stood beside them,
verses.textEn: They were looking intently up into the sky as he was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.

verses.textZh: 说："加利利人哪，为甚么站着望天呢？这位被接升天离开你们的耶稣，你们看见他怎样往天上去，他也要怎样回来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："加利利人哪，为甚么站着望天呢？这位被接升天离开你们的耶稣，你们看见他怎样往天上去，他也要怎样回来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「加利利人哪，你们为什么站着望天呢？这离开你们被接升天的耶稣，你们见他怎样往天上去，他还要怎样来。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Men of Galilee," they said, "why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen him go into heaven."
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "Men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into heaven? This Jesus, who was taken up from you into heaven, will come in the same way as you saw him go into heaven."
verses.textEnNkjv: who also said, "Men of Galilee, why do you stand gazing up into heaven? This same Jesus, who was taken up from you into heaven, will so come in like manner as you saw Him go into heaven."
verses.textEnNlt: "Men of Galilee," they said, "why are you standing here staring into heaven? Jesus has been taken from you into heaven, but someday he will return from heaven in the same way you saw him go!"
verses.textEnNasb: and they said, "Men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who has been taken up from you into heaven, will come in the same way as you have watched Him go into heaven."
verses.textEn: "Men of Galilee," they said, "why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen him go into heaven."

verses.textZh: 后来，他们从橄榄山回到耶路撒冷。那山靠近耶路撒冷，有一安息日可走的路程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，他们从橄榄山回到耶路撒冷。那山靠近耶路撒冷，有一安息日可走的路程。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一座山，名叫橄榄山，离耶路撒冷不远，约有安息日可走的路程。当下，门徒从那里回耶路撒冷去，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the apostles returned to Jerusalem from the hill called the Mount of Olives, a Sabbath day’s walk from the city.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the apostles returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, a distance of half a mile.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
verses.textEn: Then the apostles returned to Jerusalem from the hill called the Mount of Olives, a Sabbath day’s walk from the city.

verses.textZh: 他们进了城，上了一间楼房，就是彼得、约翰、雅各、安得烈、腓力、多马、巴多罗迈、马太、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、激进派的西门、雅各的儿子犹大等人所住的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们进了城，上了一间楼房，就是彼得、约翰、雅各、安得烈、腓力、多马、巴多罗迈、马太、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、激进派的西门、雅各的儿子犹大等人所住的。
verses.textZhCuv: 进了城，就上了所住的一间楼房；在那里有彼得、约翰、雅各、安得烈、腓力、多马、巴多罗买、马太、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、奋锐党的西门，和雅各的儿子 犹大。
verses.textEnNiv: When they arrived, they went upstairs to the room where they were staying. Those present were Peter, John, James and Andrew; Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew; James son of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had entered, they went up to the upper room, where they were staying, Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot and Judas the son of James.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had entered, they went up into the upper room where they were staying: Peter, James, John, and Andrew; Philip and Thomas; Bartholomew and Matthew; James theson of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot; and Judas theson of James.
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived, they went to the upstairs room of the house where they were staying. Here are the names of those who were present: Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James (son of Alphaeus), Simon (the zealot), and Judas (son of James).
verses.textEnNasb: When they had entered the city, they went up to the upstairs room where they were staying, that is, Peter, John, James, and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
verses.textEn: When they arrived, they went upstairs to the room where they were staying. Those present were Peter, John, James and Andrew; Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew; James son of Alphaeus and Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.

verses.textZh: 这些人和几个妇女，耶稣的母亲马利亚，还有他的兄弟们，都在一起，同心地恒切祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人和几个妇女，耶稣的母亲马利亚，还有他的兄弟们，都在一起，同心地恒切祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人同着几个妇人和耶稣的母亲马利亚，并耶稣的弟兄，都同心合意地恒切祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: They all joined together constantly in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: All these with one accord were devoting themselves to prayer, together with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: They all met together and were constantly united in prayer, along with Mary the mother of Jesus, several other women, and the brothers of Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: All these were continually devoting themselves with one mind to prayer, along with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
verses.textEn: They all joined together constantly in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

verses.textZh: 那时，约有一百二十人聚会，彼得在众弟兄中间站起来说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，约有一百二十人聚会，彼得在众弟兄中间站起来说：
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，有许多人聚会，约有一百二十名，彼得就在弟兄中间站起来，
verses.textEnNiv: In those days Peter stood up among the believers (a group numbering about a hundred and twenty)
verses.textEnEsv: In those days Peter stood up among the brothers (the company of persons was in all about 120) and said,
verses.textEnNkjv: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples (altogether the number of names was about a hundred and twenty), and said,
verses.textEnNlt: During this time, when about 120 believers were together in one place, Peter stood up and addressed them.
verses.textEnNasb: At this time Peter stood up among the brothers and sisters (a group of about 120 people was there together), and said,
verses.textEn: In those days Peter stood up among the believers (a group numbering about a hundred and twenty)

verses.textZh: "弟兄们，经上的话，就是圣灵借着大卫的口，预言那领人捉拿耶稣的犹大的事，是一定会应验的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "弟兄们，经上的话，就是圣灵借着大卫的口，预言那领人捉拿耶稣的犹大的事，是一定会应验的。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「弟兄们！圣灵藉大卫的口，在圣经上预言领人捉拿耶稣的犹大，这话是必须应验的。
verses.textEnNiv: and said, "Brothers and sisters, the Scripture had to be fulfilled in which the Holy Spirit spoke long ago through David concerning Judas, who served as guide for those who arrested Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: "Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke beforehand by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide to those who arrested Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Men and brethren, this Scripture had to be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide to those who arrested Jesus;
verses.textEnNlt: "Brothers," he said, "the Scriptures had to be fulfilled concerning Judas, who guided those who arrested Jesus. This was predicted long ago by the Holy Spirit, speaking through King David.
verses.textEnNasb: " Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit foretold by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide to those who arrested Jesus.
verses.textEn: and said, "Brothers and sisters, the Scripture had to be fulfilled in which the Holy Spirit spoke long ago through David concerning Judas, who served as guide for those who arrested Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他本是我们中间的一个，一同领受了这职分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他本是我们中间的一个，一同领受了这职分。
verses.textZhCuv: 他本来列在我们数中，并且在使徒的职任上得了一分。
verses.textEnNiv: He was one of our number and shared in our ministry."
verses.textEnEsv: For he was numbered among us and was allotted his share in this ministry."
verses.textEnNkjv: for he was numbered with us and obtained a part in this ministry."
verses.textEnNlt: Judas was one of us and shared in the ministry with us."
verses.textEnNasb: For he was counted among us and received his share in this ministry."
verses.textEn: He was one of our number and shared in our ministry."

verses.textZh: 他用不义的酬劳买了一块田，结果倒头栽了下去，腹破肠流。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用不义的酬劳买了一块田，结果倒头栽了下去，腹破肠流。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人用他作恶的工价买了一块田，以后身子仆倒，肚腹崩裂，肠子都流出来。
verses.textEnNiv: (With the payment he received for his wickedness, Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines spilled out.
verses.textEnEsv: (Now this man acquired a field with the reward of his wickedness, and falling headlong he burst open in the middle and all his bowels gushed out.
verses.textEnNkjv: (Now this man purchased a field with the wages of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst open in the middle and all his entrails gushed out.
verses.textEnNlt: (Judas had bought a field with the money he received for his treachery. Falling headfirst there, his body split open, spilling out all his intestines.
verses.textEnNasb: (Now this man acquired a field with the price of his wickedness, and falling headlong, he burst open in the middle and all his intestines gushed out.
verses.textEn: (With the payment he received for his wickedness, Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines spilled out.

verses.textZh: 这事住在耶路撒冷的人全都知道，所以按当地的话，那块地称为亚革大马，意思就是‘血田’。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事住在耶路撒冷的人全都知道，所以按当地的话，那块地称为亚革大马，意思就是‘血田’。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在耶路撒冷的众人都知道这事，所以按着他们那里的话给那块田起名叫亚革大马，就是「血田」的意思。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone in Jerusalem heard about this, so they called that field in their language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
