verses.textZhCuv: 彼得和十一个使徒站起，高声说：「犹太人和一切住在耶路撒冷的人哪，这件事你们当知道，也当侧耳听我的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice and addressed the crowd: "Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, let me explain this to you; listen carefully to what I say.
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter, standing with the eleven, lifted up his voice and addressed them: "Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and give ear to my words.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, raised his voice and said to them, "Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and heed my words.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Peter stepped forward with the eleven other apostles and shouted to the crowd, "Listen carefully, all of you, fellow Jews and residents of Jerusalem! Make no mistake about this.
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter, taking his stand with the other eleven, raised his voice and declared to them: "Men of Judea and all you who live in Jerusalem, know this, and pay attention to my words.
verses.textEn: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice and addressed the crowd: "Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, let me explain this to you; listen carefully to what I say.

verses.textZh: 这些人并不是照你们所想的喝醉了，现在不过是上午九点钟罢了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人并不是照你们所想的喝醉了，现在不过是上午九点钟罢了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们想这些人是醉了；其实不是醉了，因为时候刚到巳初。
verses.textEnNiv: These people are not drunk, as you suppose. It’s only nine in the morning!
verses.textEnEsv: For these people are not drunk, as you suppose, since it is only the third hour of the day.
verses.textEnNkjv: For these are not drunk, as you suppose, since it is only the third hour of the day.
verses.textEnNlt: These people are not drunk, as some of you are assuming. Nine o’clock in the morning is much too early for that.
verses.textEnNasb: For these people are not drunk, as you assume, since it is only the third hour of the day;
verses.textEn: These people are not drunk, as you suppose. It’s only nine in the morning!

verses.textZh: 这正是约珥先知所说的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 这正是约珥先知所说的：
verses.textZhCuv: 这正是先知约珥所说的：
verses.textEnNiv: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
verses.textEnEsv: But this is what was uttered through the prophet Joel:
verses.textEnNkjv: But this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
verses.textEnNlt: No, what you see was predicted long ago by the prophet Joel:
verses.textEnNasb: but this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:
verses.textEn: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:

verses.textZh: ‘神说：在末后的日子， 我要把我的灵浇灌所有的人， 你们的儿女要说预言， 你们的青年人要见异象， 你们的老年人要作异梦。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘神说：在末后的日子， 我要把我的灵浇灌所有的人， 你们的儿女要说预言， 你们的青年人要见异象， 你们的老年人要作异梦。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：在末后的日子， 我要将我的灵浇灌凡有血气的。 你们的儿女要说预言； 你们的少年人要见异象； 老年人要做异梦。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
verses.textEnEsv: "‘And in the last days it shall be, God declares, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh, and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams;
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And it shall come to pass in the last days, says God, That I will pour out of My Spirit on all flesh; Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your young men shall see visions, Your old men shall dream dreams.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘In the last days,’ God says, ‘I will pour out my Spirit upon all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will dream dreams.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And it shall be in the last days,’ God says, ‘That I will pour out My Spirit on all mankind; And your sons and your daughters will prophesy, And your young men will see visions, And your old men will have dreams;
verses.textEn: " ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.

verses.textZh: 在那些日子， 我也要把我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女，他们就要说预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子， 我也要把我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女，他们就要说预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那些日子， 我要将我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女， 他们就要说预言。
verses.textEnNiv: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
verses.textEnEsv: even on my male servants and female servants in those days I will pour out my Spirit, and they shall prophesy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on My menservants and on My maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days; And they shall prophesy.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days I will pour out my Spirit even on my servants—men and women alike— and they will prophesy.
verses.textEnNasb: And even on My male and female servants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, And they will prophesy.
verses.textEn: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.

verses.textZh: 我要在天上显出奇事， 在地上显出神迹， 有血、有火、有烟雾；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在天上显出奇事， 在地上显出神迹， 有血、有火、有烟雾；
verses.textZhCuv: 在天上，我要显出奇事； 在地下，我要显出神迹； 有血，有火，有烟雾。
verses.textEnNiv: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood, and fire, and vapor of smoke;
verses.textEnNkjv: I will show wonders in heaven above And signs in the earth beneath: Blood and fire and vapor of smoke.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will cause wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below— blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And I will display wonders in the sky above And signs on the earth below, Blood, fire, and vapor of smoke.
verses.textEn: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.

verses.textZh: 太阳将变为黑暗， 月亮将变为血红， 在主伟大显赫的日子临到以前，这一切都要发生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 太阳将变为黑暗， 月亮将变为血红， 在主伟大显赫的日子临到以前，这一切都要发生。
verses.textZhCuv: 日头要变为黑暗， 月亮要变为血； 这都在主大而明显的日子未到以前。
verses.textEnNiv: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and glorious day of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: the sun shall be turned to darkness and the moon to blood, before the day of the Lord comes, the great and magnificent day.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the coming of the great and awesome day of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The sun will become dark, and the moon will turn blood red before that great and glorious day of the Lord arrives.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The sun will be turned into darkness And the moon into blood, Before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.
verses.textEn: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and glorious day of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 那时，凡求告主名的，都必得救。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，凡求告主名的，都必得救。’
verses.textZhCuv: 到那时候， 凡求告主名的，就必得救。
verses.textEnNiv: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall come to pass that everyone who calls upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass That whoever calls on the name of the Lord Shall be saved.’
verses.textEnNlt: But everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And it shall be that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
verses.textEn: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

verses.textZh: "以色列人哪，请听听这几句话：正如你们所知道的，神已经借着拿撒勒人耶稣在你们中间施行了大能、奇事、神迹，向你们证明他是神所立的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列人哪，请听听这几句话：正如你们所知道的，神已经借着拿撒勒人耶稣在你们中间施行了大能、奇事、神迹，向你们证明他是神所立的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列人哪，请听我的话：神藉着拿撒勒人耶稣在你们中间施行异能、奇事、神迹，将他证明出来，这是你们自己知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Fellow Israelites, listen to this: Jesus of Nazareth was a man accredited by God to you by miracles, wonders and signs, which God did among you through him, as you yourselves know.
verses.textEnEsv: "Men of Israel, hear these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a man attested to you by God with mighty works and wonders and signs that God did through him in your midst, as you yourselves know—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Men of Israel, hear these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a Man attested by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs which God did through Him in your midst, as you yourselves also know—
verses.textEnNlt: "People of Israel, listen! God publicly endorsed Jesus the Nazarene by doing powerful miracles, wonders, and signs through him, as you well know.
verses.textEnNasb: "Men of Israel, listen to these words: Jesus the Nazarene, a Man attested to you by God with miracles and wonders and signs which God performed through Him in your midst, just as you yourselves know—
verses.textEn: "Fellow Israelites, listen to this: Jesus of Nazareth was a man accredited by God to you by miracles, wonders and signs, which God did among you through him, as you yourselves know.

verses.textZh: 他照着神的定旨和预知被交了出去，你们就藉不法之徒的手，把他钉死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他照着神的定旨和预知被交了出去，你们就藉不法之徒的手，把他钉死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他既按着神的定旨先见被交与人，你们就藉着无法之人的手，把他钉在十字架上，杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: This man was handed over to you by God’s deliberate plan and foreknowledge; and you, with the help of wicked men, put him to death by nailing him to the cross.
verses.textEnEsv: this Jesus, delivered up according to the definite plan and foreknowledge of God, you crucified and killed by the hands of lawless men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Him, being delivered by the determined purpose and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by lawless hands, have crucified, and put to death;
verses.textEnNlt: But God knew what would happen, and his prearranged plan was carried out when Jesus was betrayed. With the help of lawless Gentiles, you nailed him to a cross and killed him.
verses.textEnNasb: this Man, delivered over by the predetermined plan and foreknowledge of God, you nailed to a cross by the hands of godless men and put Him to death.
verses.textEn: This man was handed over to you by God’s deliberate plan and foreknowledge; and you, with the help of wicked men, put him to death by nailing him to the cross.

verses.textZh: 神却把死的痛苦解除，使他复活了，因为他不能被死亡拘禁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神却把死的痛苦解除，使他复活了，因为他不能被死亡拘禁。
verses.textZhCuv: 神却将死的痛苦解释了，叫他复活，因为他原不能被死拘禁。
verses.textEnNiv: But God raised him from the dead, freeing him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep its hold on him.
verses.textEnEsv: God raised him up, loosing the pangs of death, because it was not possible for him to be held by it.
verses.textEnNkjv: whom God raised up, having loosed the pains of death, because it was not possible that He should be held by it.
verses.textEnNlt: But God released him from the horrors of death and raised him back to life, for death could not keep him in its grip.
verses.textEnNasb: But God raised Him from the dead, putting an end to the agony of death, since it was impossible for Him to be held in its power.
verses.textEn: But God raised him from the dead, freeing him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep its hold on him.

verses.textZh: 大卫指着他说： ‘我时常看见主在我面前， 因他在我右边，我必不会动摇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫指着他说： ‘我时常看见主在我面前， 因他在我右边，我必不会动摇。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫指着他说： 我看见主常在我眼前； 他在我右边，叫我不至于摇动。
verses.textEnNiv: David said about him: " ‘I saw the Lord always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
verses.textEnEsv: For David says concerning him, "‘I saw the Lord always before me, for he is at my right hand that I may not be shaken;
verses.textEnNkjv: For David says concerning Him: ‘I foresaw the Lord always before my face, For He is at my right hand, that I may not be shaken.
verses.textEnNlt: King David said this about him: ‘I see that the Lord is always with me. I will not be shaken, for he is right beside me.
verses.textEnNasb: For David says of Him, ‘I saw the Lord continually before me, Because He is at my right hand, so that I will not be shaken.
verses.textEn: David said about him: " ‘I saw the Lord always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

verses.textZh: 为此我的心快乐，我的口舌欢呼， 我的肉身也要安居在盼望中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为此我的心快乐，我的口舌欢呼， 我的肉身也要安居在盼望中。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我心里欢喜， 我的灵 快乐； 并且我的肉身要安居在指望中。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest in hope,
verses.textEnEsv: therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced; my flesh also will dwell in hope.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore my heart rejoiced, and my tongue was glad; Moreover my flesh also will rest in hope.
verses.textEnNlt: No wonder my heart is glad, and my tongue shouts his praises! My body rests in hope.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Therefore my heart was glad and my tongue was overjoyed; Moreover my flesh also will live in hope;
verses.textEn: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest in hope,

verses.textZh: 因你必不把我的灵魂撇在阴间， 也必不容你的圣者见朽坏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你必不把我的灵魂撇在阴间， 也必不容你的圣者见朽坏。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间， 也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。
verses.textEnNiv: because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, you will not let your holy one see decay.
verses.textEnEsv: For you will not abandon my soul to Hades, or let your Holy One see corruption.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You will not leave my soul in Hades, Nor will You allow Your Holy One to see corruption.
verses.textEnNlt: For you will not leave my soul among the dead or allow your Holy One to rot in the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: For You will not abandon my soul to Hades, Nor will You allow Your Holy One to undergo decay.
verses.textEn: because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, you will not let your holy one see decay.

verses.textZh: 你已经把生命之路指示了我， 必使我在你面前有满足的喜乐。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你已经把生命之路指示了我， 必使我在你面前有满足的喜乐。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你已将生命的道路指示我， 必叫我因见你的面 得着满足的快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: You have made known to me the paths of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence.’
verses.textEnEsv: You have made known to me the paths of life; you will make me full of gladness with your presence.’
verses.textEnNkjv: You have made known to me the ways of life; You will make me full of joy in Your presence.’
verses.textEnNlt: You have shown me the way of life, and you will fill me with the joy of your presence.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You have made known to me the ways of life; You will make me full of gladness with Your presence.’
verses.textEn: You have made known to me the paths of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence.’

verses.textZh: "弟兄们，关于祖先大卫的事，我不妨坦白告诉你们，他死了，葬了，直到今日他的坟墓还在我们这里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "弟兄们，关于祖先大卫的事，我不妨坦白告诉你们，他死了，葬了，直到今日他的坟墓还在我们这里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「弟兄们！先祖大卫的事，我可以明明地对你们说：他死了，也葬埋了，并且他的坟墓直到今日还在我们这里。
verses.textEnNiv: "Fellow Israelites, I can tell you confidently that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is here to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: "Brothers, I may say to you with confidence about the patriarch David that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Men and brethren, let me speak freely to you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: "Dear brothers, think about this! You can be sure that the patriarch David wasn’t referring to himself, for he died and was buried, and his tomb is still here among us.
verses.textEnNasb: " Brothers, I may confidently say to you regarding the patriarch David that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
verses.textEn: "Fellow Israelites, I can tell you confidently that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is here to this day.

verses.textZh: 他是先知，既然知道神向他起过誓，要从他的后裔中立一位，坐在他的宝座上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是先知，既然知道神向他起过誓，要从他的后裔中立一位，坐在他的宝座上，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫既是先知，又晓得神曾向他起誓，要从他的后裔中立一位坐在他的宝座上，
verses.textEnNiv: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that he would place one of his descendants on his throne.
verses.textEnEsv: Being therefore a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that he would set one of his descendants on his throne,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, He would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
verses.textEnNlt: But he was a prophet, and he knew God had promised with an oath that one of David’s own descendants would sit on his throne.
verses.textEnNasb: So because he was a prophet and knew that God had sworn to him with an oath to seat one of his descendants on his throne,
verses.textEn: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that he would place one of his descendants on his throne.

verses.textZh: 又预先看见了这事，就讲论基督的复活说： ‘他不会被撇在阴间， 他的肉身也不见朽坏。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 又预先看见了这事，就讲论基督的复活说： ‘他不会被撇在阴间， 他的肉身也不见朽坏。’
verses.textZhCuv: 就预先看明这事，讲论基督复活说： 他的灵魂不撇在阴间； 他的肉身也不见朽坏。
verses.textEnNiv: Seeing what was to come, he spoke of the resurrection of the Messiah, that he was not abandoned to the realm of the dead, nor did his body see decay.
verses.textEnEsv: he foresaw and spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that he was not abandoned to Hades, nor did his flesh see corruption.
verses.textEnNkjv: he, foreseeing this, spoke concerning the resurrection of the Christ, that His soul was not left in Hades, nor did His flesh see corruption.
verses.textEnNlt: David was looking into the future and speaking of the Messiah’s resurrection. He was saying that God would not leave him among the dead or allow his body to rot in the grave.
verses.textEnNasb: he looked ahead and spoke of the resurrection of the Christ, that He was neither abandoned to Hades, nor did His flesh suffer decay.
verses.textEn: Seeing what was to come, he spoke of the resurrection of the Messiah, that he was not abandoned to the realm of the dead, nor did his body see decay.

verses.textZh: 这位耶稣，神已经使他复活了，我们都是这事的见证人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这位耶稣，神已经使他复活了，我们都是这事的见证人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这耶稣，神已经叫他复活了，我们都为这事作见证。
verses.textEnNiv: God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of it.
verses.textEnEsv: This Jesus God raised up, and of that we all are witnesses.
verses.textEnNkjv: This Jesus God has raised up, of which we are all witnesses.
verses.textEnNlt: "God raised Jesus from the dead, and we are all witnesses of this.
verses.textEnNasb: It is this Jesus whom God raised up, a fact to which we are all witnesses.
verses.textEn: God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of it.

verses.textZh: 他既然被高举到神的右边，从父领受了所应许的圣灵，就把他浇灌下来，这就是你们所看见所听见的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他既然被高举到神的右边，从父领受了所应许的圣灵，就把他浇灌下来，这就是你们所看见所听见的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他既被神的右手高举 ，又从父受了所应许的圣灵，就把你们所看见所听见的，浇灌下来。
verses.textEnNiv: Exalted to the right hand of God, he has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.
verses.textEnEsv: Being therefore exalted at the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this that you yourselves are seeing and hearing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore being exalted to the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, He poured out this which you now see and hear.
verses.textEnNlt: Now he is exalted to the place of highest honor in heaven, at God’s right hand. And the Father, as he had promised, gave him the Holy Spirit to pour out upon us, just as you see and hear today.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, since He has been exalted at the right hand of God, and has received the promise of the Holy Spirit from the Father, He has poured out this which you both see and hear.
verses.textEn: Exalted to the right hand of God, he has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.

verses.textZh: 大卫并没有升到天上，他却说： ‘主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫并没有升到天上，他却说： ‘主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫并没有升到天上，但自己说： 主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边，
verses.textEnNiv: For David did not ascend to heaven, and yet he said, " ‘The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand
verses.textEnEsv: For David did not ascend into the heavens, but he himself says, "‘The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For David did not ascend into the heavens, but he says himself: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand,
verses.textEnNlt: For David himself never ascended into heaven, yet he said, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit in the place of honor at my right hand
verses.textEnNasb: For it was not David who ascended into heaven, but he himself says: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand,
verses.textEn: For David did not ascend to heaven, and yet he said, " ‘The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand

verses.textZh: 等我使你的仇敌作你的脚凳。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 等我使你的仇敌作你的脚凳。’
verses.textZhCuv: 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。
verses.textEnNiv: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet." ’
verses.textEnEsv: until I make your enemies your footstool."’
verses.textEnNkjv: Till I make Your enemies Your footstool." ’
verses.textEnNlt: until I humble your enemies, making them a footstool under your feet."’
verses.textEnNasb: Until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet." ’
verses.textEn: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet." ’

verses.textZh: 因此，以色列全家应当确实知道，你们钉在十字架上的这位耶稣，神已经立他为主为基督了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，以色列全家应当确实知道，你们钉在十字架上的这位耶稣，神已经立他为主为基督了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「故此，以色列全家当确实地知道，你们钉在十字架上的这位耶稣，神已经立他为主，为基督了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore let all Israel be assured of this: God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Messiah."
verses.textEnEsv: Let all the house of Israel therefore know for certain that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ."
verses.textEnNlt: "So let everyone in Israel know for certain that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, to be both Lord and Messiah!"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore let all the house of Israel know for certain that God has made Him both Lord and Christ—this Jesus whom you crucified."
verses.textEn: "Therefore let all Israel be assured of this: God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Messiah."

verses.textZh: 他们听了以后，觉得扎心，就对彼得和其余的使徒说："弟兄们，我们应当作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听了以后，觉得扎心，就对彼得和其余的使徒说："弟兄们，我们应当作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人听见这话，觉得扎心，就对彼得和其余的使徒说：「弟兄们，我们当怎样行？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and said to Peter and the other apostles, "Brothers, what shall we do?"
verses.textEnEsv: Now when they heard this they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, "Brothers, what shall we do?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, "Men and brethren, what shall we do?"
verses.textEnNlt: Peter’s words pierced their hearts, and they said to him and to the other apostles, "Brothers, what should we do?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they heard this, they were pierced to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, " Brothers, what are we to do?"
verses.textEn: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and said to Peter and the other apostles, "Brothers, what shall we do?"

verses.textZh: 彼得说："你们应当悔改，并且每一个人都要奉耶稣基督的名受洗，使你们的罪得赦，就必领受圣灵，那白白的恩典。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得说："你们应当悔改，并且每一个人都要奉耶稣基督的名受洗，使你们的罪得赦，就必领受圣灵，那白白的恩典。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「你们各人要悔改，奉耶稣基督的名受洗，叫你们的罪得赦，就必领受所赐的圣灵；
verses.textEnNiv: Peter replied, "Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter said to them, "Repent and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter said to them, "Repent, and let every one of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins; and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Peter replied, "Each of you must repent of your sins and turn to God, and be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. Then you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Peter said to them, "Repent, and each of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins; and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: Peter replied, "Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 这应许原是给你们和你们的儿女，以及所有在远方的人，就是给凡是我们主神召来归他的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这应许原是给你们和你们的儿女，以及所有在远方的人，就是给凡是我们主神召来归他的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这应许是给你们和你们的儿女，并一切在远方的人，就是主－我们神所召来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The promise is for you and your children and for all who are far off—for all whom the Lord our God will call."
verses.textEnEsv: For the promise is for you and for your children and for all who are far off, everyone whom the Lord our God calls to himself."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are afar off, as many as the Lord our God will call."
verses.textEnNlt: This promise is to you, to your children, and to those far away —all who have been called by the Lord our God."
verses.textEnNasb: For the promise is for you and your children and for all who are far away, as many as the Lord our God will call to Himself."
verses.textEn: The promise is for you and your children and for all who are far off—for all whom the Lord our God will call."

verses.textZh: 彼得还用许多别的话，郑重作证，并且劝勉他们，说："你们应当救自己脱离这弯曲的世代！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得还用许多别的话，郑重作证，并且劝勉他们，说："你们应当救自己脱离这弯曲的世代！"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得还用许多话作见证，劝勉他们说：「你们当救自己脱离这弯曲的世代。」
verses.textEnNiv: With many other words he warned them; and he pleaded with them, "Save yourselves from this corrupt generation."
verses.textEnEsv: And with many other words he bore witness and continued to exhort them, saying, "Save yourselves from this crooked generation."
verses.textEnNkjv: And with many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, "Be saved from this perverse generation."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Peter continued preaching for a long time, strongly urging all his listeners, "Save yourselves from this crooked generation!"
verses.textEnNasb: And with many other words he solemnly testified and kept on urging them, saying, " Be saved from this perverse generation!"
verses.textEn: With many other words he warned them; and he pleaded with them, "Save yourselves from this corrupt generation."

verses.textZh: 于是接受他话的人都受了洗，那一天门徒增加了约三千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是接受他话的人都受了洗，那一天门徒增加了约三千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是领受他话的人就受了洗。那一天，门徒约添了三千人，
verses.textEnNiv: Those who accepted his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to their number that day.
verses.textEnEsv: So those who received his word were baptized, and there were added that day about three thousand souls.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized; and that day about three thousand souls were added tothem.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who believed what Peter said were baptized and added to the church that day—about 3,000 in all.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, those who had received his word were baptized; and that day there were added about three thousand souls.
verses.textEn: Those who accepted his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to their number that day.

verses.textZh: 他们恒心遵守使徒的教训，彼此相通、擘饼和祈祷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们恒心遵守使徒的教训，彼此相通、擘饼和祈祷。
verses.textZhCuv: 都恒心遵守使徒的教训，彼此交接，擘饼，祈祷。
verses.textEnNiv: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: And they devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and the prayers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they continued steadfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and in prayers.
verses.textEnNlt: All the believers devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching, and to fellowship, and to sharing in meals (including the Lord’s Supper ), and to prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: They were continually devoting themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
verses.textEn: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.

verses.textZh: 使徒行了许多奇事神迹，众人就都惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒行了许多奇事神迹，众人就都惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人都惧怕；使徒又行了许多奇事神迹。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone was filled with awe at the many wonders and signs performed by the apostles.
verses.textEnEsv: And awe came upon every soul, and many wonders and signs were being done through the apostles.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then fear came upon every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
verses.textEnNlt: A deep sense of awe came over them all, and the apostles performed many miraculous signs and wonders.
verses.textEnNasb: Everyone kept feeling a sense of awe; and many wonders and signs were taking place through the apostles.
verses.textEn: Everyone was filled with awe at the many wonders and signs performed by the apostles.

verses.textZh: 所有信的人都在一起，凡物公用，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有信的人都在一起，凡物公用，
verses.textZhCuv: 信的人都在一处，凡物公用，
verses.textEnNiv: All the believers were together and had everything in common.
verses.textEnEsv: And all who believed were together and had all things in common.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all who believed were together, and had all things in common,
verses.textEnNlt: And all the believers met together in one place and shared everything they had.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the believers were together and had all things in common;
verses.textEn: All the believers were together and had everything in common.

verses.textZh: 并且变卖产业和财物，按照各人的需要分给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且变卖产业和财物，按照各人的需要分给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且卖了田产、家业，照各人所需用的分给各人。
verses.textEnNiv: They sold property and possessions to give to anyone who had need.
verses.textEnEsv: And they were selling their possessions and belongings and distributing the proceeds to all, as any had need.
verses.textEnNkjv: and sold their possessions and goods, and divided them among all, as anyone had need.
verses.textEnNlt: They sold their property and possessions and shared the money with those in need.
verses.textEnNasb: and they would sell their property and possessions and share them with all, to the extent that anyone had need.
verses.textEn: They sold property and possessions to give to anyone who had need.

verses.textZh: 他们天天同心在殿里恒切地聚集，一家一家地擘饼，存着欢乐和诚恳的心用饭，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们天天同心在殿里恒切地聚集，一家一家地擘饼，存着欢乐和诚恳的心用饭，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们天天同心合意恒切地在殿里，且在家中擘饼，存着欢喜、诚实的心用饭，
verses.textEnNiv: Every day they continued to meet together in the temple courts. They broke bread in their homes and ate together with glad and sincere hearts,
verses.textEnEsv: And day by day, attending the temple together and breaking bread in their homes, they received their food with glad and generous hearts,
verses.textEnNkjv: So continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, they ate their food with gladness and simplicity of heart,
verses.textEnNlt: They worshiped together at the Temple each day, met in homes for the Lord’s Supper, and shared their meals with great joy and generosity —
verses.textEnNasb: Day by day continuing with one mind in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, they were taking their meals together with gladness and sincerity of heart,
verses.textEn: Every day they continued to meet together in the temple courts. They broke bread in their homes and ate together with glad and sincere hearts,

verses.textZh: 又赞美神，并且得到全民的喜爱。主将得救的人，天天加给教会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又赞美神，并且得到全民的喜爱。主将得救的人，天天加给教会。
verses.textZhCuv: 赞美神，得众民的喜爱。主将得救的人天天加给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
verses.textEnEsv: praising God and having favor with all the people. And the Lord added to their number day by day those who were being saved.
verses.textEnNkjv: praising God and having favor with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily those who were being saved.
verses.textEnNlt: all the while praising God and enjoying the goodwill of all the people. And each day the Lord added to their fellowship those who were being saved.
verses.textEnNasb: praising God and having favor with all the people. And the Lord was adding to their number day by day those who were being saved.
verses.textEn: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.

verses.textZh: 在下午三点祷告的时辰，彼得和约翰上圣殿去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在下午三点祷告的时辰，彼得和约翰上圣殿去。
verses.textZhCuv: 申初祷告的时候，彼得、约翰上圣殿去。
verses.textEnNiv: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the time of prayer—at three in the afternoon.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Peter and John went up together to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
verses.textEnNlt: Peter and John went to the Temple one afternoon to take part in the three o’clock prayer service.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Peter and John were going up to the temple at the ninth hour, the hour of prayer.
verses.textEn: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the time of prayer—at three in the afternoon.

verses.textZh: 有一个生来瘸腿的人被人抬来。他们天天把他放在那名叫美门的殿门口，让他好向进殿的人讨饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个生来瘸腿的人被人抬来。他们天天把他放在那名叫美门的殿门口，让他好向进殿的人讨饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人，生来是瘸腿的，天天被人抬来，放在殿的一个门口（那门名叫美门），要求进殿的人周济。
verses.textEnNiv: Now a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those going into the temple courts.
verses.textEnEsv: And a man lame from birth was being carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple that is called the Beautiful Gate to ask alms of those entering the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a certain man lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms from those who entered the temple;
verses.textEnNlt: As they approached the Temple, a man lame from birth was being carried in. Each day he was put beside the Temple gate, the one called the Beautiful Gate, so he could beg from the people going into the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And a man who had been unable to walk from birth was being carried, whom they used to set down every day at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, in order for him to beg for charitable gifts from those entering the temple grounds.
verses.textEn: Now a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those going into the temple courts.

verses.textZh: 他看见彼得和约翰将要进殿，就向他们讨饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他看见彼得和约翰将要进殿，就向他们讨饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他看见彼得、约翰将要进殿，就求他们周济。
verses.textEnNiv: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
verses.textEnEsv: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive alms.
verses.textEnNkjv: who, seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, asked for alms.
verses.textEnNlt: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for some money.
verses.textEnNasb: When he saw Peter and John about to go into the temple grounds, he began asking to receive a charitable gift.
verses.textEn: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.

verses.textZh: 彼得和约翰定睛看着他，彼得说："你看我们！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得和约翰定睛看着他，彼得说："你看我们！"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得、约翰定睛看他；彼得说：「你看我们！」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter looked straight at him, as did John. Then Peter said, "Look at us!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter directed his gaze at him, as did John, and said, "Look at us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And fixing his eyes on him, with John, Peter said, "Look at us."
verses.textEnNlt: Peter and John looked at him intently, and Peter said, "Look at us!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter, along with John, looked at him intently and said, "Look at us!"
verses.textEn: Peter looked straight at him, as did John. Then Peter said, "Look at us!"

verses.textZh: 那人就留意看着他们，希望从他们得些甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人就留意看着他们，希望从他们得些甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人就留意看他们，指望得着什么。
verses.textEnNiv: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to get something from them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he fixed his attention on them, expecting to receive something from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them.
verses.textEnNlt: The lame man looked at them eagerly, expecting some money.
verses.textEnNasb: And he gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them.
verses.textEn: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to get something from them.

verses.textZh: 彼得却说："金银我都没有，只把我有的给你：我奉拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名，吩咐你行走！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得却说："金银我都没有，只把我有的给你：我奉拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名，吩咐你行走！"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「金银我都没有，只把我所有的给你：我奉拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名，叫你起来行走！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Peter said, "Silver or gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk."
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter said, "I have no silver and gold, but what I do have I give to you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter said, "Silver and gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk."
verses.textEnNlt: But Peter said, "I don’t have any silver or gold for you. But I’ll give you what I have. In the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, get up and walk!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter said, "I do not have silver and gold, but what I do have I give to you: In the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene, walk!"
verses.textEn: Then Peter said, "Silver or gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk."

verses.textZh: 于是拉着他的右手，扶他起来；他的脚和踝骨立刻强壮有力，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是拉着他的右手，扶他起来；他的脚和踝骨立刻强壮有力，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是拉着他的右手，扶他起来；他的脚和踝子骨立刻健壮了，
verses.textEnNiv: Taking him by the right hand, he helped him up, and instantly the man’s feet and ankles became strong.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took him by the right hand and raised him up, and immediately his feet and ankles were made strong.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took him by the right hand and lifted him up, and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Peter took the lame man by the right hand and helped him up. And as he did, the man’s feet and ankles were instantly healed and strengthened.
verses.textEnNasb: And grasping him by the right hand, he raised him up; and immediately his feet and his ankles were strengthened.
verses.textEn: Taking him by the right hand, he helped him up, and instantly the man’s feet and ankles became strong.

verses.textZh: 他一跳就站了起来，并且行走。他连走带跳，赞美神，同他们进入殿中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一跳就站了起来，并且行走。他连走带跳，赞美神，同他们进入殿中。
verses.textZhCuv: 就跳起来，站着，又行走，同他们进了殿，走着，跳着，赞美神。
verses.textEnNiv: He jumped to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and jumping, and praising God.
verses.textEnEsv: And leaping up, he stood and began to walk, and entered the temple with them, walking and leaping and praising God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he, leaping up, stood and walked and entered the temple with them—walking, leaping, and praising God.
verses.textEnNlt: He jumped up, stood on his feet, and began to walk! Then, walking, leaping, and praising God, he went into the Temple with them.
verses.textEnNasb: And leaping up, he stood and began to walk; and he entered the temple with them, walking and leaping and praising God.
verses.textEn: He jumped to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and jumping, and praising God.

verses.textZh: 群众看见他一边走一边赞美神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众看见他一边走一边赞美神；
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓都看见他行走，赞美神；
verses.textEnNiv: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people saw him walking and praising God,
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people saw him walking and praising God.
verses.textEnNlt: All the people saw him walking and heard him praising God.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people saw him walking and praising God;
verses.textEn: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,

verses.textZh: 他们一认出他就是那平时坐在圣殿美门口讨饭的，就因他所经历的事，满心希奇，惊讶不已。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们一认出他就是那平时坐在圣殿美门口讨饭的，就因他所经历的事，满心希奇，惊讶不已。
verses.textZhCuv: 认得他是那素常坐在殿的美门口求周济的，就因他所遇着的事满心希奇、惊讶。
verses.textEnNiv: they recognized him as the same man who used to sit begging at the temple gate called Beautiful, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
verses.textEnEsv: and recognized him as the one who sat at the Beautiful Gate of the temple, asking for alms. And they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they knew that it was he who sat begging alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple; and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
verses.textEnNlt: When they realized he was the lame beggar they had seen so often at the Beautiful Gate, they were absolutely astounded!
verses.textEnNasb: and they recognized him as being the very one who used to sit at the Beautiful Gate of the temple to beg for charitable gifts, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
verses.textEn: they recognized him as the same man who used to sit begging at the temple gate called Beautiful, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

verses.textZh: 那人拉着彼得和约翰的时候，群众都很惊奇，跑到他们那里，就是所罗门廊的下面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人拉着彼得和约翰的时候，群众都很惊奇，跑到他们那里，就是所罗门廊的下面。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人正在称为所罗门的廊下，拉着彼得、约翰；众百姓一齐跑到他们那里，很觉希奇。
verses.textEnNiv: While the man held on to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and came running to them in the place called Solomon’s Colonnade.
verses.textEnEsv: While he clung to Peter and John, all the people, utterly astounded, ran together to them in the portico called Solomon’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch which is called Solomon’s, greatly amazed.
verses.textEnNlt: They all rushed out in amazement to Solomon’s Colonnade, where the man was holding tightly to Peter and John.
verses.textEnNasb: While he was clinging to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them at the portico named Solomon’s, completely astonished.
verses.textEn: While the man held on to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and came running to them in the place called Solomon’s Colonnade.

verses.textZh: 彼得看见了，就对群众说："以色列人哪，为甚么因这事希奇呢？为甚么瞪着我们，好象我们是凭着自己的能力和虔诚，使这人行走呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得看见了，就对群众说："以色列人哪，为甚么因这事希奇呢？为甚么瞪着我们，好象我们是凭着自己的能力和虔诚，使这人行走呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得看见，就对百姓说：「以色列人哪，为什么把这事当作希奇呢？为什么定睛看我们，以为我们凭自己的能力和虔诚使这人行走呢？
verses.textEnNiv: When Peter saw this, he said to them: "Fellow Israelites, why does this surprise you? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
verses.textEnEsv: And when Peter saw it he addressed the people: "Men of Israel, why do you wonder at this, or why do you stare at us, as though by our own power or piety we have made him walk?
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Peter saw it, he responded to the people: "Men of Israel, why do you marvel at this? Or why look so intently at us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
verses.textEnNlt: Peter saw his opportunity and addressed the crowd. "People of Israel," he said, "what is so surprising about this? And why stare at us as though we had made this man walk by our own power or godliness?
verses.textEnNasb: But when Peter saw this, he replied to the people, "Men of Israel, why are you amazed at this, or why are you staring at us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?
verses.textEn: When Peter saw this, he said to them: "Fellow Israelites, why does this surprise you? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的神，就是我们祖宗的神，荣耀了他的仆人耶稣。这位耶稣，你们把他送交官府。彼拉多本来定意要放他，你们却当着彼拉多的面拒绝他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的神，就是我们祖宗的神，荣耀了他的仆人耶稣。这位耶稣，你们把他送交官府。彼拉多本来定意要放他，你们却当着彼拉多的面拒绝他。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的神，就是我们列祖的神，已经荣耀了他的仆人 耶稣；你们却把他交付彼拉多。彼拉多定意要释放他，你们竟在彼拉多面前弃绝了他。
verses.textEnNiv: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus. You handed him over to be killed, and you disowned him before Pilate, though he had decided to let him go.
verses.textEnEsv: The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, the God of our fathers, glorified his servant Jesus, whom you delivered over and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had decided to release him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, glorified His Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let Him go.
verses.textEnNlt: For it is the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the God of all our ancestors—who has brought glory to his servant Jesus by doing this. This is the same Jesus whom you handed over and rejected before Pilate, despite Pilate’s decision to release him.
verses.textEnNasb: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified His Servant Jesus, the one whom you handed over and disowned in the presence of Pilate, when he had decided to release Him.
verses.textEn: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus. You handed him over to be killed, and you disowned him before Pilate, though he had decided to let him go.

verses.textZh: 你们把那圣者义者拒绝了，反而要求给你们释放一个杀人犯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们把那圣者义者拒绝了，反而要求给你们释放一个杀人犯。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们弃绝了那圣洁公义者，反求着释放一个凶手给你们。
verses.textEnNiv: You disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
verses.textEnEsv: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
verses.textEnNkjv: But you denied the Holy One and the Just, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
verses.textEnNlt: You rejected this holy, righteous one and instead demanded the release of a murderer.
verses.textEnNasb: But you disowned the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
verses.textEn: You disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.

verses.textZh: 你们杀了那‘生命的创始者’，神却使他从死人中复活。我们就是这件事的见证人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们杀了那‘生命的创始者’，神却使他从死人中复活。我们就是这件事的见证人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们杀了那生命的主，神却叫他从死里复活了；我们都是为这事作见证。
verses.textEnNiv: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.
verses.textEnEsv: and you killed the Author of life, whom God raised from the dead. To this we are witnesses.
verses.textEnNkjv: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, of which we are witnesses.
verses.textEnNlt: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. And we are witnesses of this fact!
verses.textEnNasb: but put to death the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, a fact to which we are witnesses.
verses.textEn: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.

verses.textZh: 是他的名—因信他的名—使你们所看见所认识的这个人强壮了。这从耶稣而来的信心，当着你们众人面前，把他完全医好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是他的名—因信他的名—使你们所看见所认识的这个人强壮了。这从耶稣而来的信心，当着你们众人面前，把他完全医好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们因信他的名，他的名便叫你们所看见所认识的这人健壮了；正是他所赐的信心，叫这人在你们众人面前全然好了。
verses.textEnNiv: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know was made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through him that has completely healed him, as you can all see.
verses.textEnEsv: And his name—by faith in his name—has made this man strong whom you see and know, and the faith that is through Jesus has given the man this perfect health in the presence of you all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And His name, through faith in His name, has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which comes through Him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
verses.textEnNlt: "Through faith in the name of Jesus, this man was healed—and you know how crippled he was before. Faith in Jesus’ name has healed him before your very eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: And on the basis of faith in His name, it is the name of Jesus which has strengthened this man whom you see and know; and the faith which comes through Him has given him this perfect health in the presence of you all.
verses.textEn: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know was made strong. It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through him that has completely healed him, as you can all see.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我知道你们所作的，是出于无知，你们的官长也是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我知道你们所作的，是出于无知，你们的官长也是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我晓得你们做这事是出于不知，你们的官长也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now, fellow Israelites, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.
verses.textEnEsv: "And now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet now, brethren, I know that you did it in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
verses.textEnNlt: "Friends, I realize that what you and your leaders did to Jesus was done in ignorance.
verses.textEnNasb: "And now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, just as your rulers also did.
verses.textEn: "Now, fellow Israelites, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.

verses.textZh: 但神曾经借着众先知的口，预先宣告他所立的基督将要受害的事，就这样应验了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但神曾经借着众先知的口，预先宣告他所立的基督将要受害的事，就这样应验了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但神曾藉众先知的口，预言基督将要受害，就这样应验了。
verses.textEnNiv: But this is how God fulfilled what he had foretold through all the prophets, saying that his Messiah would suffer.
verses.textEnEsv: But what God foretold by the mouth of all the prophets, that his Christ would suffer, he thus fulfilled.
verses.textEnNkjv: But those things which God foretold by the mouth of all His prophets, that the Christ would suffer, He has thus fulfilled.
verses.textEnNlt: But God was fulfilling what all the prophets had foretold about the Messiah—that he must suffer these things.
verses.textEnNasb: But the things which God previously announced by the mouths of all the prophets, that His Christ would suffer, He has fulfilled in this way.
verses.textEn: But this is how God fulfilled what he had foretold through all the prophets, saying that his Messiah would suffer.

verses.textZh: 所以你们应当悔改归正，使你们的罪得着涂抹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们应当悔改归正，使你们的罪得着涂抹。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们当悔改归正，使你们的罪得以涂抹，
verses.textEnNiv: Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord,
verses.textEnEsv: Repent therefore, and turn back, that your sins may be blotted out,
verses.textEnNkjv: Repent therefore and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, so that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: Now repent of your sins and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped away.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore repent and return, so that your sins may be wiped away, in order that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord;
verses.textEn: Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord,

verses.textZh: 这样，那安乐的日子，必从主面前来到，并且他必把为你们预先选定的基督 差来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，那安乐的日子，必从主面前来到，并且他必把为你们预先选定的基督 差来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，那安舒的日子就必从主面前来到；主也必差遣所预定给你们的基督（耶稣）降临。
verses.textEnNiv: and that he may send the Messiah, who has been appointed for you—even Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord, and that he may send the Christ appointed for you, Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: and that He may send Jesus Christ, who was preached to you before,
verses.textEnNlt: Then times of refreshment will come from the presence of the Lord, and he will again send you Jesus, your appointed Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: and that He may send Jesus, the Christ appointed for you,
verses.textEn: and that he may send the Messiah, who has been appointed for you—even Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他必留在天上，直到万物复兴的时候，就是神自古借着圣先知的口所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必留在天上，直到万物复兴的时候，就是神自古借着圣先知的口所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 天必留他，等到万物复兴的时候，就是神从创世以来、藉着圣先知的口所说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Heaven must receive him until the time comes for God to restore everything, as he promised long ago through his holy prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: whom heaven must receive until the time for restoring all the things about which God spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets long ago.
verses.textEnNkjv: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God has spoken by the mouth of all His holy prophets since the world began.
verses.textEnNlt: For he must remain in heaven until the time for the final restoration of all things, as God promised long ago through his holy prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: whom heaven must receive until the period of restoration of all things, about which God spoke by the mouths of His holy prophets from ancient times.
verses.textEn: Heaven must receive him until the time comes for God to restore everything, as he promised long ago through his holy prophets.

verses.textZh: 摩西曾说：‘你们的主神要从你们弟兄中间，给你们兴起一位先知像我；无论他对你们说甚么，你们都应当听从。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西曾说：‘你们的主神要从你们弟兄中间，给你们兴起一位先知像我；无论他对你们说甚么，你们都应当听从。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西曾说：『主－神要从你们弟兄中间给你们兴起一位先知像我，凡他向你们所说的，你们都要听从。
verses.textEnNiv: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses said, ‘The Lord God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your brothers. You shall listen to him in whatever he tells you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Moses truly said to the fathers, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from your brethren. Him you shall hear in all things, whatever He says to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from among your own people. Listen carefully to everything he tells you.’
verses.textEnNasb: Moses said, ‘The Lord God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your countrymen; to Him you shall listen regarding everything He says to you.
verses.textEn: For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.

verses.textZh: 无论谁不听从那位先知，必定从民中灭绝。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论谁不听从那位先知，必定从民中灭绝。’
verses.textZhCuv: 凡不听从那先知的，必要从民中全然灭绝。』
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from their people.’
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall be that every soul who does not listen to that prophet shall be destroyed from the people.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be that every soul who will not hear that Prophet shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then Moses said, ‘Anyone who will not listen to that Prophet will be completely cut off from God’s people.’
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be that every soul that does not listen to that prophet shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
verses.textEn: Anyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from their people.’

verses.textZh: 所有从撒母耳起，以及相继兴起来讲话的先知，都曾经宣告这些日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有从撒母耳起，以及相继兴起来讲话的先知，都曾经宣告这些日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 从撒母耳以来的众先知，凡说预言的，也都说到这些日子。
verses.textEnNiv: "Indeed, beginning with Samuel, all the prophets who have spoken have foretold these days.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the prophets who have spoken, from Samuel and those who came after him, also proclaimed these days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, and all the prophets, from Samuel and those who follow, as many as have spoken, have also foretold these days.
verses.textEnNlt: "Starting with Samuel, every prophet spoke about what is happening today.
verses.textEnNasb: And likewise, all the prophets who have spoken from Samuel and his successors onward, have also announced these days.
verses.textEn: "Indeed, beginning with Samuel, all the prophets who have spoken have foretold these days.

verses.textZh: 你们是先知的子孙，也是承受神向你们祖先所立之约的人。神曾经对亚伯拉罕说：‘地上万族，都要因你的后裔得福。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们是先知的子孙，也是承受神向你们祖先所立之约的人。神曾经对亚伯拉罕说：‘地上万族，都要因你的后裔得福。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们是先知的子孙，也承受神与你们祖宗所立的约，就是对亚伯拉罕说：『地上万族都要因你的后裔得福。』
verses.textEnNiv: And you are heirs of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers. He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all peoples on earth will be blessed.’
verses.textEnEsv: You are the sons of the prophets and of the covenant that God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘And in your offspring shall all the families of the earth be blessed.’
verses.textEnNkjv: You are sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘And in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.’
verses.textEnNlt: You are the children of those prophets, and you are included in the covenant God promised to your ancestors. For God said to Abraham, ‘Through your descendants all the families on earth will be blessed.’
verses.textEnNasb: It is you who are the sons of the prophets and of the covenant which God ordained with your fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘And in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.’
verses.textEn: And you are heirs of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers. He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all peoples on earth will be blessed.’

verses.textZh: 神先给你们兴起他的仆人，差他来祝福你们，使你们各人回转，离开邪恶。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神先给你们兴起他的仆人，差他来祝福你们，使你们各人回转，离开邪恶。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神既兴起他的仆人 ，就先差他到你们这里来，赐福给你们，叫你们各人回转，离开罪恶。」
verses.textEnNiv: When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways."
verses.textEnEsv: God, having raised up his servant, sent him to you first, to bless you by turning every one of you from your wickedness."
verses.textEnNkjv: To you first, God, having raised up His Servant Jesus, sent Him to bless you, in turning away every one ofyou from your iniquities."
verses.textEnNlt: When God raised up his servant, Jesus, he sent him first to you people of Israel, to bless you by turning each of you back from your sinful ways."
verses.textEnNasb: God raised up His Servant for you first, and sent Him to bless you by turning every one of you from your wicked ways."
verses.textEn: When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways."

verses.textZh: 使徒们正对群众讲话的时候，祭司、圣殿的守卫长，和撒都该人来到他们那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒们正对群众讲话的时候，祭司、圣殿的守卫长，和撒都该人来到他们那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒对百姓说话的时候，祭司们和守殿官，并撒都该人忽然来了。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to Peter and John while they were speaking to the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they spoke to the people, the priests, the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees came upon them,
verses.textEnNlt: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, they were confronted by the priests, the captain of the Temple guard, and some of the Sadducees.
verses.textEnNasb: As they were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to them,
verses.textEn: The priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to Peter and John while they were speaking to the people.

verses.textZh: 因为使徒教训群众，并且传扬耶稣从死人中复活，他们就非常恼怒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为使徒教训群众，并且传扬耶稣从死人中复活，他们就非常恼怒，
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们教训百姓，本着耶稣，传说死人复活，就很烦恼，
verses.textEnNiv: They were greatly disturbed because the apostles were teaching the people, proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: greatly annoyed because they were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: being greatly disturbed that they taught the people and preached in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: These leaders were very disturbed that Peter and John were teaching the people that through Jesus there is a resurrection of the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: being greatly disturbed because they were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
verses.textEn: They were greatly disturbed because the apostles were teaching the people, proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.

verses.textZh: 于是下手拿住使徒。那时天已经晚了，就把他们拘留到第二天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是下手拿住使徒。那时天已经晚了，就把他们拘留到第二天。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是下手拿住他们；因为天已经晚了，就把他们押到第二天。
verses.textEnNiv: They seized Peter and John and, because it was evening, they put them in jail until the next day.
verses.textEnEsv: And they arrested them and put them in custody until the next day, for it was already evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was already evening.
verses.textEnNlt: They arrested them and, since it was already evening, put them in jail until morning.
verses.textEnNasb: And they laid hands on them and put them in prison until the next day, for it was already evening.
verses.textEn: They seized Peter and John and, because it was evening, they put them in jail until the next day.

verses.textZh: 然而有许多听道的人信了，男人的数目，约有五千。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而有许多听道的人信了，男人的数目，约有五千。
verses.textZhCuv: 但听道之人有许多信的，男丁数目约到五千。
verses.textEnNiv: But many who heard the message believed; so the number of men who believed grew to about five thousand.
verses.textEnEsv: But many of those who had heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to about five thousand.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, many of those who heard the word believed; and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: But many of the people who heard their message believed it, so the number of men who believed now totaled about 5,000.
verses.textEnNasb: But many of those who had heard the message believed; and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
verses.textEn: But many who heard the message believed; so the number of men who believed grew to about five thousand.

verses.textZh: 那么，你们各位和以色列全民都应当知道，站在你们面前这人好了，是因拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名。这位耶稣基督，你们把他钉死在十字架上，神却使他从死人中复活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，你们各位和以色列全民都应当知道，站在你们面前这人好了，是因拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名。这位耶稣基督，你们把他钉死在十字架上，神却使他从死人中复活。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们众人和以色列百姓都当知道，站在你们面前的这人得痊愈是因你们所钉十字架、神叫他从死里复活的拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名。
verses.textEnNiv: then know this, you and all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
verses.textEnEsv: let it be known to all of you and to all the people of Israel that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead—by him this man is standing before you well.

verses.textEn: then know this, you and all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.

verses.textZhCnvs: 他们看见彼得和约翰的胆量，也知道这两个人是没有学问的平民，就很惊奇；同时认出他们是跟耶稣一伙的，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们见彼得、约翰的胆量，又看出他们原是没有学问的小民，就希奇，认明他们是跟过耶稣的；
verses.textEnNiv: When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated, common men, they were astonished. And they recognized that they had been with Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated and untrained men, they marveled. And they realized that they had been with Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: The members of the council were amazed when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, for they could see that they were ordinary men with no special training in the Scriptures. They also recognized them as men who had been with Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as they observed the confidence of Peter and John and understood that they were uneducated and untrained men, they were amazed, and began to recognize them as having been with Jesus.
verses.textEn: When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.

verses.textZh: 又看见那医好了的人，和他们一同站着，就没有话可辩驳。

verses.textZh: 说："对这些人我们应该怎么办呢？因为有一件人所共知的神迹，借着他们行了出来，所有住在耶路撒冷的人都知道，我们也无法否认。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："对这些人我们应该怎么办呢？因为有一件人所共知的神迹，借着他们行了出来，所有住在耶路撒冷的人都知道，我们也无法否认。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我们当怎样办这两个人呢？因为他们诚然行了一件明显的神迹，凡住耶路撒冷的人都知道，我们也不能说没有。
verses.textEnNiv: "What are we going to do with these men?" they asked. "Everyone living in Jerusalem knows they have performed a notable sign, and we cannot deny it.
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "What shall we do with these men? For that a notable sign has been performed through them is evident to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and we cannot deny it.
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "What shall we do to these men? For, indeed, that a notable miracle has been done through them is evident to all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we cannot deny it.
verses.textEnNlt: "What should we do with these men?" they asked each other. "We can’t deny that they have performed a miraculous sign, and everybody in Jerusalem knows about it.
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "What are we to do with these men? For the fact that a noteworthy miracle has taken place through them is apparent to all who live in Jerusalem, and we cannot deny it.
verses.textEn: "What are we going to do with these men?" they asked. "Everyone living in Jerusalem knows they have performed a notable sign, and we cannot deny it.

verses.textEnNiv: As for us, we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard."

verses.textZh: 众人因着所发生的事，都颂赞神，于是公议会为了群众的缘故，也因为找不到借口惩罚他们，就恐吓一番，把他们放了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人因着所发生的事，都颂赞神，于是公议会为了群众的缘故，也因为找不到借口惩罚他们，就恐吓一番，把他们放了。
verses.textZhCuv: 官长为百姓的缘故，想不出法子刑罚他们，又恐吓一番，把他们释放了。这是因众人为所行的奇事都归荣耀与神。
verses.textEnNiv: After further threats they let them go. They could not decide how to punish them, because all the people were praising God for what had happened.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people, for all were praising God for what had happened.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way of punishing them, because of the people, since they all glorified God for what had been done.

verses.textEnNasb: When they had threatened them further, they let them go (finding no basis on which to punish them) on account of the people, because they were all glorifying God for what had happened;
verses.textEn: After further threats they let them go. They could not decide how to punish them, because all the people were praising God for what had happened.

verses.textZh: 你曾以圣灵借着你仆人我们祖先大卫的口说： ‘列国为甚么骚动？ 万民为甚么空谋妄想？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾以圣灵借着你仆人我们祖先大卫的口说： ‘列国为甚么骚动？ 万民为甚么空谋妄想？
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾藉着圣灵，托你仆人－我们祖宗大卫的口，说： 外邦为什么争闹？ 万民为什么谋算虚妄的事？
verses.textEnNiv: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant, our father David: " ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
verses.textEnEsv: who through the mouth of our father David, your servant, said by the Holy Spirit, "‘Why did the Gentiles rage, and the peoples plot in vain?
verses.textEnNkjv: who by the mouth of Your servant David have said: ‘Why did the nations rage, And the people plot vain things?
verses.textEnNlt: you spoke long ago by the Holy Spirit through our ancestor David, your servant, saying, ‘Why were the nations so angry? Why did they waste their time with futile plans?
verses.textEnNasb: who by the Holy Spirit, through the mouth of our father David Your servant, said, ‘Why were the nations insolent, And the peoples plotting in vain?
verses.textEn: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant, our father David: " ‘Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?

verses.textZh: 地上的君王都起来， 首领聚在一起， 敌对主和他的受膏者。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上的君王都起来， 首领聚在一起， 敌对主和他的受膏者。’
verses.textZhCuv: 世上的君王一齐起来， 臣宰也聚集， 要敌挡主， 并主的受膏者 。
verses.textEnNiv: The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed one. ’
verses.textEnEsv: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers were gathered together, against the Lord and against his Anointed’ —
verses.textEnNkjv: The kings of the earth took their stand, And the rulers were gathered together Against the Lord and against His Christ.’
verses.textEnNlt: The kings of the earth prepared for battle; the rulers gathered together against the Lord and against his Messiah.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The kings of the earth took their stand, And the rulers were gathered together Against the Lord and against His Christ.’
verses.textEn: The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed one. ’

verses.textZh: 希律和本丢．彼拉多，外族人和以色列民，真的在这城里聚集，反对你所膏立的圣仆耶稣，
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律和本丢．彼拉多，外族人和以色列民，真的在这城里聚集，反对你所膏立的圣仆耶稣，
verses.textZhCuv: 希律和本丢‧彼拉多，外邦人和以色列民，果然在这城里聚集，要攻打你所膏的圣仆 耶稣，
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed Herod and Pontius Pilate met together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel in this city to conspire against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.
verses.textEnEsv: for truly in this city there were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, along with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For truly against Your holy Servant Jesus, whom You anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together
verses.textEnNlt: "In fact, this has happened here in this very city! For Herod Antipas, Pontius Pilate the governor, the Gentiles, and the people of Israel were all united against Jesus, your holy servant, whom you anointed.
verses.textEnNasb: For truly in this city there were gathered together against Your holy Servant Jesus, whom You anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, along with the Gentiles and the peoples of Israel,
verses.textEn: Indeed Herod and Pontius Pilate met together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel in this city to conspire against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.

verses.textZh: 行了你手和你旨意所预定要成就的一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行了你手和你旨意所预定要成就的一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 成就你手和你意旨所预定必有的事。
verses.textEnNiv: They did what your power and will had decided beforehand should happen.
verses.textEnEsv: to do whatever your hand and your plan had predestined to take place.
verses.textEnNkjv: to do whatever Your hand and Your purpose determined before to be done.
verses.textEnNlt: But everything they did was determined beforehand according to your will.
verses.textEnNasb: to do whatever Your hand and purpose predestined to occur.
verses.textEn: They did what your power and will had decided beforehand should happen.

verses.textZh: 主啊，他们恐吓我们，现在求你鉴察，也赐你仆人们大有胆量，传讲你的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊，他们恐吓我们，现在求你鉴察，也赐你仆人们大有胆量，传讲你的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 祷告完了，聚会的地方震动，他们就都被圣灵充满，放胆讲论神的道。
verses.textEnNiv: Now, Lord, consider their threats and enable your servants to speak your word with great boldness.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, Lord, look upon their threats and grant to your servants to continue to speak your word with all boldness,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now, Lord, look on their threats, and grant to Your servants that with all boldness they may speak Your word,
verses.textEnNlt: And now, O Lord, hear their threats, and give us, your servants, great boldness in preaching your word.
verses.textEnNasb: And now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant it to Your bond-servants to speak Your word with all confidence,
verses.textEn: Now, Lord, consider their threats and enable your servants to speak your word with great boldness.

verses.textZh: 求你伸手医治，借着你圣仆耶稣的名，大行神迹奇事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你伸手医治，借着你圣仆耶稣的名，大行神迹奇事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那许多信的人都是一心一意的，没有一人说他的东西有一样是自己的，都是大家公用。
verses.textEnNiv: Stretch out your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of your holy servant Jesus."
verses.textEnEsv: while you stretch out your hand to heal, and signs and wonders are performed through the name of your holy servant Jesus."
verses.textEnNkjv: by stretching out Your hand to heal, and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of Your holy Servant Jesus."
verses.textEnNlt: Stretch out your hand with healing power; may miraculous signs and wonders be done through the name of your holy servant Jesus."
verses.textEnNasb: while You extend Your hand to heal, and signs and wonders take place through the name of Your holy Servant Jesus."
verses.textEn: Stretch out your hand to heal and perform signs and wonders through the name of your holy servant Jesus."

verses.textZh: 他们祷告完了，聚会的地方震动起来，他们都被圣灵充满，放胆传讲神的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们祷告完了，聚会的地方震动起来，他们都被圣灵充满，放胆传讲神的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒大有能力，见证主耶稣复活；众人也都蒙大恩。
verses.textEnNiv: After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had prayed, the place in which they were gathered together was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and continued to speak the word of God with boldness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had prayed, the place where they were assembled together was shaken; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
verses.textEnNlt: After this prayer, the meeting place shook, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they preached the word of God with boldness.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they had prayed, the place where they had gathered together was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak the word of God with boldness.
verses.textEn: After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.

verses.textZh: 全体信徒一心一意，没有一个人说自己的财物是自己的，他们凡物公用。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体信徒一心一意，没有一个人说自己的财物是自己的，他们凡物公用。
verses.textZhCuv: 内中也没有一个缺乏的；因为人人将田产房屋都卖了，把所卖的价银拿来，
verses.textEnNiv: All the believers were one in heart and mind. No one claimed that any of their possessions was their own, but they shared everything they had.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the full number of those who believed were of one heart and soul, and no one said that any of the things that belonged to him was his own, but they had everything in common.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the multitude of those who believed were of one heart and one soul; neither did anyone say that any of the things he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
verses.textEnNlt: All the believers were united in heart and mind. And they felt that what they owned was not their own, so they shared everything they had.
verses.textEnNasb: And the congregation of those who believed were of one heart and soul; and not one of them claimed that anything belonging to him was his own, but all things were common property to them.
verses.textEn: All the believers were one in heart and mind. No one claimed that any of their possessions was their own, but they shared everything they had.

verses.textZh: 使徒大有能力，为主耶稣的复活作见证，众人都蒙了大恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒大有能力，为主耶稣的复活作见证，众人都蒙了大恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 放在使徒脚前，照各人所需用的，分给各人。
verses.textEnNiv: With great power the apostles continued to testify to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And God’s grace was so powerfully at work in them all
verses.textEnEsv: And with great power the apostles were giving their testimony to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and great grace was upon them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And with great power the apostles gave witness to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And great grace was upon them all.
verses.textEnNlt: The apostles testified powerfully to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and God’s great blessing was upon them all.
verses.textEnNasb: And with great power the apostles were giving testimony to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and abundant grace was upon them all.
verses.textEn: With great power the apostles continued to testify to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And God’s grace was so powerfully at work in them all

verses.textZh: 他们中间没有一个有缺乏的，因为凡有田产房屋的都卖了，把得到的钱拿来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间没有一个有缺乏的，因为凡有田产房屋的都卖了，把得到的钱拿来，
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个利未人，生在塞浦路斯，名叫约瑟，使徒称他为巴拿巴（巴拿巴翻出来就是劝慰子）。
verses.textEnNiv: that there were no needy persons among them. For from time to time those who owned land or houses sold them, brought the money from the sales
verses.textEnEsv: There was not a needy person among them, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them and brought the proceeds of what was sold
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor was there anyone among them who lacked; for all who were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,
verses.textEnNlt: There were no needy people among them, because those who owned land or houses would sell them
verses.textEnNasb: For there was not a needy person among them, for all who were owners of land or houses would sell them and bring the proceeds of the sales
verses.textEn: that there were no needy persons among them. For from time to time those who owned land or houses sold them, brought the money from the sales

verses.textZh: 放在使徒脚前，照着各人的需要来分配。
verses.textZhCnvs: 放在使徒脚前，照着各人的需要来分配。
verses.textZhCuv: 他有田地，也卖了，把价银拿来，放在使徒脚前。
verses.textEnNiv: and put it at the apostles’ feet, and it was distributed to anyone who had need.
verses.textEnEsv: and laid it at the apostles’ feet, and it was distributed to each as any had need.
verses.textEnNkjv: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and they distributed to each as anyone had need.
verses.textEnNlt: and bring the money to the apostles to give to those in need.
verses.textEnNasb: and lay them at the apostles’ feet, and they would be distributed to each to the extent that any had need.
verses.textEn: and put it at the apostles’ feet, and it was distributed to anyone who had need.

verses.textZh: 有一个人名叫约瑟，使徒称他为巴拿巴，就是"安慰者"的意思，他是个利未人，生在塞浦路斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人名叫约瑟，使徒称他为巴拿巴，就是"安慰者"的意思，他是个利未人，生在塞浦路斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人名叫约瑟，使徒称他为巴拿巴，就是"安慰者"的意思，他是个利未人，生在塞浦路斯。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (which means "son of encouragement"),
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Joseph, who was also called by the apostles Barnabas (which means son of encouragement), a Levite, a native of Cyprus,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joses, who was also named Barnabas by the apostles (which is translated Son of Encouragement), a Levite of the country of Cyprus,
verses.textEnNlt: For instance, there was Joseph, the one the apostles nicknamed Barnabas (which means "Son of Encouragement"). He was from the tribe of Levi and came from the island of Cyprus.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joseph, a Levite of Cyprian birth, who was also called Barnabas by the apostles (which translated means Son of Encouragement),
verses.textEn: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (which means "son of encouragement"),

verses.textZh: 他卖掉了自己的田地，把钱拿来，放在使徒的脚前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他卖掉了自己的田地，把钱拿来，放在使徒的脚前。
verses.textZhCuv: 他卖掉了自己的田地，把钱拿来，放在使徒的脚前。
verses.textEnNiv: sold a field he owned and brought the money and put it at the apostles’ feet.
