verses.textEnEsv: sold a field that belonged to him and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: having land, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.textEnNlt: He sold a field he owned and brought the money to the apostles.
verses.textEnNasb: owned a tract of land. So he sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.textEn: sold a field he owned and brought the money and put it at the apostles’ feet.

verses.textZh: 有一个人名叫亚拿尼亚，同他妻子撒非拉，把田产卖了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人名叫亚拿尼亚，同他妻子撒非拉，把田产卖了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，同他的妻子撒非喇卖了田产，
verses.textEnNiv: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.
verses.textEnEsv: But a man named Ananias, with his wife Sapphira, sold a piece of property,
verses.textEnNkjv: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession.
verses.textEnNlt: But there was a certain man named Ananias who, with his wife, Sapphira, sold some property.
verses.textEnNasb: But a man named Ananias, with his wife Sapphira, sold a piece of property,
verses.textEn: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.

verses.textZh: 他私底下把钱留了一部分，妻子也知道这件事。他把其余的一部分带来，放在使徒的脚前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他私底下把钱留了一部分，妻子也知道这件事。他把其余的一部分带来，放在使徒的脚前。
verses.textZhCuv: 把价银私自留下几分，他的妻子也知道，其余的几分拿来放在使徒脚前。
verses.textEnNiv: With his wife’s full knowledge he kept back part of the money for himself, but brought the rest and put it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.textEnEsv: and with his wife’s knowledge he kept back for himself some of the proceeds and brought only a part of it and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he kept back part of the proceeds, his wife also being aware ofit, and brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.textEnNlt: He brought part of the money to the apostles, claiming it was the full amount. With his wife’s consent, he kept the rest.
verses.textEnNasb: and kept back some of the proceeds for himself, with his wife’s full knowledge, and bringing a portion of it, he laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.textEn: With his wife’s full knowledge he kept back part of the money for himself, but brought the rest and put it at the apostles’ feet.

verses.textZh: 彼得说："亚拿尼亚，为甚么撒但充满了你的心，使你欺骗圣灵，私底下把卖地的钱留了一部分呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得说："亚拿尼亚，为甚么撒但充满了你的心，使你欺骗圣灵，私底下把卖地的钱留了一部分呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「亚拿尼亚！为什么撒但充满了你的心，叫你欺哄圣灵，把田地的价银私自留下几分呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then Peter said, "Ananias, how is it that Satan has so filled your heart that you have lied to the Holy Spirit and have kept for yourself some of the money you received for the land?
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter said, "Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back for yourself part of the proceeds of the land?
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter said, "Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and keep back part of the price of the land for yourself?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Peter said, "Ananias, why have you let Satan fill your heart? You lied to the Holy Spirit, and you kept some of the money for yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter said, "Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back some of the proceeds of the land?
verses.textEn: Then Peter said, "Ananias, how is it that Satan has so filled your heart that you have lied to the Holy Spirit and have kept for yourself some of the money you received for the land?

verses.textZh: 田地还没有卖，不是你自己的吗？既然卖了，所得的钱不是由你作主吗？你为甚么存心这样作呢？你这不是欺骗人，而是欺骗神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 田地还没有卖，不是你自己的吗？既然卖了，所得的钱不是由你作主吗？你为甚么存心这样作呢？你这不是欺骗人，而是欺骗神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 田地还没有卖，不是你自己的吗？既卖了，价银不是你作主吗？你怎么心里起这意念呢？你不是欺哄人，是欺哄神了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Didn’t it belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, wasn’t the money at your disposal? What made you think of doing such a thing? You have not lied just to human beings but to God."
verses.textEnEsv: While it remained unsold, did it not remain your own? And after it was sold, was it not at your disposal? Why is it that you have contrived this deed in your heart? You have not lied to man but to God."
verses.textEnNkjv: While it remained, was it not your own? And after it was sold, was it not in your own control? Why have you conceived this thing in your heart? You have not lied to men but to God."
verses.textEnNlt: The property was yours to sell or not sell, as you wished. And after selling it, the money was also yours to give away. How could you do a thing like this? You weren’t lying to us but to God!"
verses.textEnNasb: While it remained unsold, did it not remain your own? And after it was sold, was it not under your control? Why is it that you have conceived this deed in your heart? You have not lied to men, but to God."
verses.textEn: Didn’t it belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, wasn’t the money at your disposal? What made you think of doing such a thing? You have not lied just to human beings but to God."

verses.textZh: 亚拿尼亚一听见这话，就仆倒断了气。所有听见的人都十分害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚拿尼亚一听见这话，就仆倒断了气。所有听见的人都十分害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚拿尼亚听见这话，就仆倒，断了气；听见的人都甚惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard what had happened.
verses.textEnEsv: When Ananias heard these words, he fell down and breathed his last. And great fear came upon all who heard of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and breathed his last. So great fear came upon all those who heard these things.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as Ananias heard these words, he fell to the floor and died. Everyone who heard about it was terrified.
verses.textEnNasb: And as he heard these words, Ananias collapsed and died; and great fear came over all who heard about it.
verses.textEn: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard what had happened.

verses.textZh: 有几个青年人来把他包好，抬出去埋了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有几个青年人来把他包好，抬出去埋了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有些少年人起来，把他包裹，抬出去埋葬了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then some young men came forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.
verses.textEnEsv: The young men rose and wrapped him up and carried him out and buried him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the young men arose and wrapped him up, carried him out, and buried him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then some young men got up, wrapped him in a sheet, and took him out and buried him.
verses.textEnNasb: The young men got up and covered him up, and after carrying him out, they buried him.
verses.textEn: Then some young men came forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.

verses.textZh: 大约三小时之后，亚拿尼亚的妻子进来，还不知道发生了甚么事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大约三小时之后，亚拿尼亚的妻子进来，还不知道发生了甚么事。
verses.textZhCuv: 约过了三小时，他的妻子进来，还不知道这事。
verses.textEnNiv: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
verses.textEnEsv: After an interval of about three hours his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was about three hours later when his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
verses.textEnNlt: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: Now an interval of about three hours elapsed, and his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
verses.textEn: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.

verses.textZh: 彼得问她："你告诉我，你们卖田地的钱，就是这么多吗？"她说："是的，就是这么多。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得问她："你告诉我，你们卖田地的钱，就是这么多吗？"她说："是的，就是这么多。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得对她说：「你告诉我，你们卖田地的价银就是这些吗？」她说：「就是这些。」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter asked her, "Tell me, is this the price you and Ananias got for the land?" "Yes," she said, "that is the price."
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter said to her, "Tell me whether you sold the land for so much." And she said, "Yes, for so much."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Peter answered her, "Tell me whether you sold the land for so much?" She said, "Yes, for so much."
verses.textEnNlt: Peter asked her, "Was this the price you and your husband received for your land?" "Yes," she replied, "that was the price."
verses.textEnNasb: And Peter responded to her, "Tell me whether you sold the land for this price?" And she said, "Yes, for that price."
verses.textEn: Peter asked her, "Tell me, is this the price you and Ananias got for the land?" "Yes," she said, "that is the price."

verses.textZh: 彼得说："你们为甚么串同试探主的灵呢？你看，埋你丈夫的人的脚，已经到了门口，他们也要把你抬出去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得说："你们为甚么串同试探主的灵呢？你看，埋你丈夫的人的脚，已经到了门口，他们也要把你抬出去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「你们为什么同心试探主的灵呢？埋葬你丈夫之人的脚已到门口，他们也要把你抬出去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter said to her, "How could you conspire to test the Spirit of the Lord? Listen! The feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also."
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter said to her, "How is it that you have agreed together to test the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter said to her, "How is it that you have agreed together to test the Spirit of the Lord? Look, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out."
verses.textEnNlt: And Peter said, "How could the two of you even think of conspiring to test the Spirit of the Lord like this? The young men who buried your husband are just outside the door, and they will carry you out, too."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Peter said to her, "Why is it that you have agreed together to put the Spirit of the Lord to the test? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out as well."
verses.textEn: Peter said to her, "How could you conspire to test the Spirit of the Lord? Listen! The feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also."

verses.textZh: 她立刻就仆倒在彼得脚前，断了气。那些青年人进来，发现她死了，把她也抬出去，埋在她丈夫旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她立刻就仆倒在彼得脚前，断了气。那些青年人进来，发现她死了，把她也抬出去，埋在她丈夫旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人立刻仆倒在彼得脚前，断了气。那些少年人进来，见她已经死了，就抬出去，埋在她丈夫旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: At that moment she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
verses.textEnEsv: Immediately she fell down at his feet and breathed her last. When the young men came in they found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then immediately she fell down at his feet and breathed her last. And the young men came in and found her dead, and carrying her out, buried her by her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: Instantly, she fell to the floor and died. When the young men came in and saw that she was dead, they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately she collapsed at his feet and died; and the young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
verses.textEn: At that moment she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

verses.textZh: 全体会众和所有听见这事的人，都很害怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体会众和所有听见这事的人，都很害怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 全教会和听见这事的人都甚惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: Great fear seized the whole church and all who heard about these events.
verses.textEnEsv: And great fear came upon the whole church and upon all who heard of these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: So great fear came upon all the church and upon all who heard these things.
verses.textEnNlt: Great fear gripped the entire church and everyone else who heard what had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: And great fear came over the whole church, and over all who heard about these things.
verses.textEn: Great fear seized the whole church and all who heard about these events.

verses.textZh: 主借着使徒的手，在民间行了许多神迹奇事。他们都同心聚集在所罗门廊下，
verses.textZhCnvs: 主借着使徒的手，在民间行了许多神迹奇事。他们都同心聚集在所罗门廊下，
verses.textZhCuv: 主藉使徒的手在民间行了许多神迹奇事；他们 都同心合意地在所罗门的廊下。
verses.textEnNiv: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers used to meet together in Solomon’s Colonnade.
verses.textEnEsv: Now many signs and wonders were regularly done among the people by the hands of the apostles. And they were all together in Solomon’s Portico.
verses.textEnNkjv: And through the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. And they were all with one accord in Solomon’s Porch.
verses.textEnNlt: The apostles were performing many miraculous signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers were meeting regularly at the Temple in the area known as Solomon’s Colonnade.
verses.textEnNasb: At the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were taking place among the people; and they were all together in Solomon’s portico.
verses.textEn: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers used to meet together in Solomon’s Colonnade.

verses.textZh: 其余的人，没有一个敢接近他们，可是民众都很敬重他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的人，没有一个敢接近他们，可是民众都很敬重他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的人没有一个敢贴近他们，百姓却尊重他们。
verses.textEnNiv: No one else dared join them, even though they were highly regarded by the people.
verses.textEnEsv: None of the rest dared join them, but the people held them in high esteem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet none of the rest dared join them, but the people esteemed them highly.
verses.textEnNlt: But no one else dared to join them, even though all the people had high regard for them.
verses.textEnNasb: But none of the rest dared to associate with them; however, the people held them in high esteem.
verses.textEn: No one else dared join them, even though they were highly regarded by the people.

verses.textZh: 信主的男男女女越来越多，
verses.textZhCnvs: 信主的男男女女越来越多，
verses.textZhCuv: 信而归主的人越发增添，连男带女很多。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, more and more men and women believed in the Lord and were added to their number.
verses.textEnEsv: And more than ever believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women,
verses.textEnNkjv: And believers were increasingly added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women,
verses.textEnNlt: Yet more and more people believed and were brought to the Lord—crowds of both men and women.
verses.textEnNasb: And increasingly believers in the Lord, large numbers of men and women, were being added to their number,
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, more and more men and women believed in the Lord and were added to their number.

verses.textZh: 甚至有人把病人抬到街上，放在小床和褥子上，好让彼得经过时，至少他的身影可以落在一些人身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚至有人把病人抬到街上，放在小床和褥子上，好让彼得经过时，至少他的身影可以落在一些人身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至有人将病人抬到街上，放在床上或褥子上，指望彼得过来的时候，或者得他的影儿照在什么人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.
verses.textEnEsv: so that they even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mats, that as Peter came by at least his shadow might fall on some of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that they brought the sick out into the streets and laid them on beds and couches, that at least the shadow of Peter passing by might fall on some of them.
verses.textEnNlt: As a result of the apostles’ work, sick people were brought out into the streets on beds and mats so that Peter’s shadow might fall across some of them as he went by.
verses.textEnNasb: to such an extent that they even carried the sick out into the streets and laid them on cots and pallets, so that when Peter came by at least his shadow might fall on any of them.
verses.textEn: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats so that at least Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷周围城市的人，也带着病人和受污灵缠扰的，蜂拥而来，结果病人全都医好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷周围城市的人，也带着病人和受污灵缠扰的，蜂拥而来，结果病人全都医好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有许多人带着病人和被污鬼缠磨的，从耶路撒冷四围的城邑来，全都得了医治。
verses.textEnNiv: Crowds gathered also from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those tormented by impure spirits, and all of them were healed.
verses.textEnEsv: The people also gathered from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing the sick and those afflicted with unclean spirits, and they were all healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also a multitude gathered from the surrounding cities to Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits, and they were all healed.
verses.textEnNlt: Crowds came from the villages around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those possessed by evil spirits, and they were all healed.
verses.textEnNasb: The people from the cities in the vicinity of Jerusalem were coming together as well, bringing people who were sick or tormented with unclean spirits, and they were all being healed.
verses.textEn: Crowds gathered also from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those tormented by impure spirits, and all of them were healed.

verses.textZh: 大祭司和他的同党撒都该人都起来，满心忌恨，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大祭司和他的同党撒都该人都起来，满心忌恨，
verses.textZhCuv: 大祭司和他的一切同人，就是撒都该教门的人，都起来，满心忌恨，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the high priest and all his associates, who were members of the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.
verses.textEnEsv: But the high priest rose up, and all who were with him (that is, the party of the Sadducees), and filled with jealousy
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with indignation,
verses.textEnNlt: The high priest and his officials, who were Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.
verses.textEnNasb: But the high priest stood up, along with all his associates (that is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy.
verses.textEn: Then the high priest and all his associates, who were members of the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.

verses.textZh: 于是下手拿住使徒，把他们押在公共拘留所里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是下手拿住使徒，把他们押在公共拘留所里。
verses.textZhCuv: 就下手拿住使徒，收在外监。
verses.textEnNiv: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.
verses.textEnEsv: they arrested the apostles and put them in the public prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: and laid their hands on the apostles and put them in the common prison.
verses.textEnNlt: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.
verses.textEnNasb: They laid hands on the apostles and put them in a public prison.
verses.textEn: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.

verses.textZh: 夜间有一位天使，打开监门，把他们领出来，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 夜间有一位天使，打开监门，把他们领出来，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 但主的使者夜间开了监门，领他们出来，
verses.textEnNiv: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out.
verses.textEnEsv: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors and brought them out, and said,
verses.textEnNkjv: But at night an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors and brought them out, and said,
verses.textEnNlt: But an angel of the Lord came at night, opened the gates of the jail, and brought them out. Then he told them,
verses.textEnNasb: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the gates of the prison, and leading them out, he said,
verses.textEn: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out.

verses.textZh: "你们去，站在殿里，把一切有关这生命的话，都讲给众民听。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们去，站在殿里，把一切有关这生命的话，都讲给众民听。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「你们去站在殿里，把这生命的道都讲给百姓听。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go, stand in the temple courts," he said, "and tell the people all about this new life."
verses.textEnEsv: "Go and stand in the temple and speak to the people all the words of this Life."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go, stand in the temple and speak to the people all the words of this life."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go to the Temple and give the people this message of life!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Go, stand and speak to the people in the temple area the whole message of this Life."
verses.textEn: "Go, stand in the temple courts," he said, "and tell the people all about this new life."

verses.textZh: 使徒听完了，就在黎明的时候，进到殿里去教导。大祭司和他的同党来到了，就召集了公议会和以色列人的众长老，派人到监牢去带使徒出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒听完了，就在黎明的时候，进到殿里去教导。大祭司和他的同党来到了，就召集了公议会和以色列人的众长老，派人到监牢去带使徒出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒听了这话，天将亮的时候就进殿里去教训人。大祭司和他的同人来了，叫齐公会的人和以色列族的众长老，就差人到监里去，要把使徒提出来。
verses.textEnNiv: At daybreak they entered the temple courts, as they had been told, and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they called together the Sanhedrin—the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they heard this, they entered the temple at daybreak and began to teach. Now when the high priest came, and those who were with him, they called together the council, all the senate of the people of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they heard that, they entered the temple early in the morning and taught. But the high priest and those with him came and called the council together, with all the elders of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
verses.textEnNlt: So at daybreak the apostles entered the Temple, as they were told, and immediately began teaching. When the high priest and his officials arrived, they convened the high council —the full assembly of the elders of Israel. Then they sent for the apostles to be brought from the jail for trial.
verses.textEnNasb: Upon hearing this, they entered into the temple area about daybreak and began to teach. Now when the high priest and his associates came, they called the Council together, that is, all the Senate of the sons of Israel, and sent orders to the prison for them to be brought.
verses.textEn: At daybreak they entered the temple courts, as they had been told, and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they called together the Sanhedrin—the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.

verses.textZh: 差役到了监里，找不到他们，回来报告说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 差役到了监里，找不到他们，回来报告说：
verses.textZhCuv: 但差役到了，不见他们在监里，就回来禀报说：
verses.textEnNiv: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they went back and reported,
verses.textEnEsv: But when the officers came, they did not find them in the prison, so they returned and reported,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the officers came and did not find them in the prison, they returned and reported,
verses.textEnNlt: But when the Temple guards went to the jail, the men were gone. So they returned to the council and reported,
verses.textEnNasb: But the officers who came did not find them in the prison; and they returned and reported,
verses.textEn: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they went back and reported,

verses.textZh: "我们发现监门紧闭，狱卒也守在门外；等到开了门，里面连一个人也找不到。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们发现监门紧闭，狱卒也守在门外；等到开了门，里面连一个人也找不到。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「我们看见监牢关得极妥当，看守的人也站在门外；及至开了门，里面一个人都不见。」
verses.textEnNiv: "We found the jail securely locked, with the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside."
verses.textEnEsv: "We found the prison securely locked and the guards standing at the doors, but when we opened them we found no one inside."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Indeed we found the prison shut securely, and the guards standing outside before the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside!"
verses.textEnNlt: "The jail was securely locked, with the guards standing outside, but when we opened the gates, no one was there!"
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "We found the prison locked quite securely and the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside."
verses.textEn: "We found the jail securely locked, with the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside."

verses.textZh: 圣殿的守卫长和祭司长听了这些话，觉得很困惑，不知道这件事将来会怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣殿的守卫长和祭司长听了这些话，觉得很困惑，不知道这件事将来会怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 守殿官和祭司长听见这话，心里犯难，不知这事将来如何。
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing this report, the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests were at a loss, wondering what this might lead to.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were greatly perplexed about them, wondering what this would come to.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these things, they wondered what the outcome would be.
verses.textEnNlt: When the captain of the Temple guard and the leading priests heard this, they were perplexed, wondering where it would all end.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests heard these words, they were greatly perplexed about them as to what would come of this.
verses.textEn: On hearing this report, the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests were at a loss, wondering what this might lead to.

verses.textZh: 忽然有人来报告说："你们押在监里的那些人，正站在殿里教导众民呢！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然有人来报告说："你们押在监里的那些人，正站在殿里教导众民呢！"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人来禀报说：「你们收在监里的人，现在站在殿里教训百姓。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then someone came and said, "Look! The men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people."
verses.textEnEsv: And someone came and told them, "Look! The men whom you put in prison are standing in the temple and teaching the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: So one came and told them, saying, "Look, the men whom you put in prison are standing in the temple and teaching the people!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then someone arrived with startling news: "The men you put in jail are standing in the Temple, teaching the people!"
verses.textEnNasb: But someone came and reported to them, "The men whom you put in prison are standing in the temple area and teaching the people!"
verses.textEn: Then someone came and said, "Look! The men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people."

verses.textZh: 于是守卫长和差役去带使徒来，不过没有用暴力，因为怕众民用石头打他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是守卫长和差役去带使徒来，不过没有用暴力，因为怕众民用石头打他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是守殿官和差役去带使徒来，并没有用强暴，因为怕百姓用石头打他们。
verses.textEnNiv: At that, the captain went with his officers and brought the apostles. They did not use force, because they feared that the people would stone them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the captain with the officers went and brought them, but not by force, for they were afraid of being stoned by the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the captain went with the officers and brought them without violence, for they feared the people, lest they should be stoned.
verses.textEnNlt: The captain went with his Temple guards and arrested the apostles, but without violence, for they were afraid the people would stone them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the captain went along with the officers and proceeded to bring them back without violence (for they were afraid of the people, that they might be stoned).
verses.textEn: At that, the captain went with his officers and brought the apostles. They did not use force, because they feared that the people would stone them.

verses.textZh: 既然带来了，就叫他们站在公议会前。大祭司问他们：
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然带来了，就叫他们站在公议会前。大祭司问他们：
verses.textZhCuv: 带到了，便叫使徒站在公会前；大祭司问他们说：
verses.textEnNiv: The apostles were brought in and made to appear before the Sanhedrin to be questioned by the high priest.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council. And the high priest questioned them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council. And the high priest asked them,
verses.textEnNlt: Then they brought the apostles before the high council, where the high priest confronted them.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had brought them, they had them stand before the Council. The high priest interrogated them,
verses.textEn: The apostles were brought in and made to appear before the Sanhedrin to be questioned by the high priest.

verses.textZh: "我们严厉地吩咐过你们，不准再奉这名教导。看，你们却把你们的道理传遍了耶路撒冷，想要把流这人的血的责任推到我们身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们严厉地吩咐过你们，不准再奉这名教导。看，你们却把你们的道理传遍了耶路撒冷，想要把流这人的血的责任推到我们身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「我们不是严严地禁止你们，不可奉这名教训人吗？你们倒把你们的道理充满了耶路撒冷，想要叫这人的血归到我们身上！」
verses.textEnNiv: "We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name," he said. "Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us guilty of this man’s blood."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "We strictly charged you not to teach in this name, yet here you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and you intend to bring this man’s blood upon us."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Did we not strictly command you not to teach in this name? And look, you have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this Man’s blood on us!"
verses.textEnNlt: "We gave you strict orders never again to teach in this man’s name!" he said. "Instead, you have filled all Jerusalem with your teaching about him, and you want to make us responsible for his death!"
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "We gave you strict orders not to continue teaching in this name, and yet, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and intend to bring this Man’s blood upon us."
verses.textEn: "We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name," he said. "Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us guilty of this man’s blood."

verses.textZh: 彼得和众使徒回答："服从神过于服从人，是应当的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得和众使徒回答："服从神过于服从人，是应当的。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得和众使徒回答说：「顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。
verses.textEnNiv: Peter and the other apostles replied: "We must obey God rather than human beings!
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter and the apostles answered, "We must obey God rather than men.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter and the other apostles answered and said: "We ought to obey God rather than men.
verses.textEnNlt: But Peter and the apostles replied, "We must obey God rather than any human authority.
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter and the apostles answered, "We must obey God rather than men.
verses.textEn: Peter and the other apostles replied: "We must obey God rather than human beings!

verses.textZh: 你们挂在木头上亲手杀害的耶稣，我们祖先的神已经使他复活了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们挂在木头上亲手杀害的耶稣，我们祖先的神已经使他复活了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们挂在木头上杀害的耶稣，我们祖宗的神已经叫他复活。
verses.textEnNiv: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead—whom you killed by hanging him on a cross.
verses.textEnEsv: The God of our fathers raised Jesus, whom you killed by hanging him on a tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus whom you murdered by hanging on a tree.
verses.textEnNlt: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead after you killed him by hanging him on a cross.
verses.textEnNasb: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you put to death by hanging Him on a cross.
verses.textEn: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead—whom you killed by hanging him on a cross.

verses.textZh: 神把他高举在自己的右边，作元首作救主，把悔改的心赐给了以色列人，使他们罪得赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神把他高举在自己的右边，作元首作救主，把悔改的心赐给了以色列人，使他们罪得赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 神且用右手将他高举 ，叫他作君王，作救主，将悔改的心和赦罪的恩赐给以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: God exalted him to his own right hand as Prince and Savior that he might bring Israel to repentance and forgive their sins.
verses.textEnEsv: God exalted him at his right hand as Leader and Savior, to give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: Him God has exalted to His right hand tobe Prince and Savior, to give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God put him in the place of honor at his right hand as Prince and Savior. He did this so the people of Israel would repent of their sins and be forgiven.
verses.textEnNasb: He is the One whom God exalted to His right hand as a Prince and a Savior, to grant repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEn: God exalted him to his own right hand as Prince and Savior that he might bring Israel to repentance and forgive their sins.

verses.textZh: 我们为这些事作证，神赐给顺从的人的圣灵也为这些事作证。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们为这些事作证，神赐给顺从的人的圣灵也为这些事作证。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们为这事作见证；神赐给顺从之人的圣灵也为这事作见证。」
verses.textEnNiv: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him."
verses.textEnEsv: And we are witnesses to these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And we are His witnesses to these things, and so also is the Holy Spirit whom God has given to those who obey Him."
verses.textEnNlt: We are witnesses of these things and so is the Holy Spirit, who is given by God to those who obey him."
verses.textEnNasb: And we are witnesses of these things; and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him."
verses.textEn: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him."

verses.textZh: 公议会的人听了，非常恼怒，就想要杀他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 公议会的人听了，非常恼怒，就想要杀他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 公会的人听见就极其恼怒，想要杀他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard this, they were furious and wanted to put them to death.
verses.textEnEsv: When they heard this, they were enraged and wanted to kill them.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they heard this, they were furious and plotted to kill them.
verses.textEnNlt: When they heard this, the high council was furious and decided to kill them.
verses.textEnNasb: But when they heard this, they became infuriated and nearly decided to execute them.
verses.textEn: When they heard this, they were furious and wanted to put them to death.

verses.textZh: 但有一个法利赛人，名叫迦玛列，是民众所尊敬的律法教师。他在公议会中站起来，吩咐人把使徒暂时带出去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但有一个法利赛人，名叫迦玛列，是民众所尊敬的律法教师。他在公议会中站起来，吩咐人把使徒暂时带出去，
verses.textZhCuv: 但有一个法利赛人，名叫迦玛列，是众百姓所敬重的教法师，在公会中站起来，吩咐人把使徒暂且带到外面去，
verses.textEnNiv: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a little while.
verses.textEnEsv: But a Pharisee in the council named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law held in honor by all the people, stood up and gave orders to put the men outside for a little while.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one in the council stood up, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law held in respect by all the people, and commanded them to put the apostles outside for a little while.
verses.textEnNlt: But one member, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, who was an expert in religious law and respected by all the people, stood up and ordered that the men be sent outside the council chamber for a while.
verses.textEnNasb: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the Law, respected by all the people, stood up in the Council and gave orders to put the men outside for a short time.
verses.textEn: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a little while.

verses.textZh: 然后对大家说："以色列人哪，你们应当小心处理这些人！
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后对大家说："以色列人哪，你们应当小心处理这些人！
verses.textZhCuv: 就对众人说：「以色列人哪，论到这些人，你们应当小心怎样办理。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he addressed the Sanhedrin: "Men of Israel, consider carefully what you intend to do to these men.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Men of Israel, take care what you are about to do with these men.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to them: "Men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what you intend to do regarding these men.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to his colleagues, "Men of Israel, take care what you are planning to do to these men!
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to them, "Men of Israel, be careful as to what you are about to do with these men.
verses.textEn: Then he addressed the Sanhedrin: "Men of Israel, consider carefully what you intend to do to these men.

verses.textZh: 从前有个丢大，自命不凡，附从他的人约有四百。他一被杀，跟从他的人尽都星散，一败涂地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前有个丢大，自命不凡，附从他的人约有四百。他一被杀，跟从他的人尽都星散，一败涂地。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前杜达起来，自夸为大，附从他的人约有四百，他被杀后，附从他的全都散了，归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time ago Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men rallied to him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: For before these days Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, and a number of men, about four hundred, joined him. He was killed, and all who followed him were dispersed and came to nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: For some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody. A number of men, about four hundred, joined him. He was slain, and all who obeyed him were scattered and came to nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time ago there was that fellow Theudas, who pretended to be someone great. About 400 others joined him, but he was killed, and all his followers went their various ways. The whole movement came to nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: For, some time ago Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and a group of about four hundred men joined him. But he was killed, and all who followed him were dispersed and came to nothing.
verses.textEn: Some time ago Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men rallied to him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.

verses.textZh: 这人之后，在户口登记的时候，又有一个加利利人犹大，拉拢人们来跟从他。后来他也丧命，跟从他的人也就烟消云散了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人之后，在户口登记的时候，又有一个加利利人犹大，拉拢人们来跟从他。后来他也丧命，跟从他的人也就烟消云散了。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，报名上册的时候，又有加利利的犹大起来，引诱些百姓跟从他；他也灭亡，附从他的人也都四散了。
verses.textEnNiv: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and led a band of people in revolt. He too was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
verses.textEnEsv: After him Judas the Galilean rose up in the days of the census and drew away some of the people after him. He too perished, and all who followed him were scattered.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the census, and drew away many people after him. He also perished, and all who obeyed him were dispersed.
verses.textEnNlt: After him, at the time of the census, there was Judas of Galilee. He got people to follow him, but he was killed, too, and all his followers were scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: After this man, Judas of Galilee appeared in the days of the census and drew away some people after him; he also perished, and all those who followed him were scattered.
verses.textEn: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and led a band of people in revolt. He too was killed, and all his followers were scattered.

verses.textZh: 至于目前的事，我劝你们不要管这些人，由他们吧！因为这计划或这行动，如果是出于人意，终必失败；
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于目前的事，我劝你们不要管这些人，由他们吧！因为这计划或这行动，如果是出于人意，终必失败；
verses.textZhCuv: 现在，我劝你们不要管这些人，任凭他们吧！他们所谋的、所行的，若是出于人，必要败坏；
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone! Let them go! For if their purpose or activity is of human origin, it will fail.
verses.textEnEsv: So in the present case I tell you, keep away from these men and let them alone, for if this plan or this undertaking is of man, it will fail;
verses.textEnNkjv: And now I say to you, keep away from these men and let them alone; for if this plan or this work is of men, it will come to nothing;
verses.textEnNlt: "So my advice is, leave these men alone. Let them go. If they are planning and doing these things merely on their own, it will soon be overthrown.
verses.textEnNasb: And so in the present case, I say to you, stay away from these men and leave them alone, for if the source of this plan or movement is men, it will be overthrown;
verses.textEn: Therefore, in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone! Let them go! For if their purpose or activity is of human origin, it will fail.

verses.textZh: 如果是出于神，你们就不能破坏他们，恐怕你们是与神作对了。"他们接受了他的劝告，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果是出于神，你们就不能破坏他们，恐怕你们是与神作对了。"他们接受了他的劝告，
verses.textZhCuv: 若是出于神，你们就不能败坏他们，恐怕你们倒是攻击神了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop these men; you will only find yourselves fighting against God."
verses.textEnEsv: but if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow them. You might even be found opposing God!" So they took his advice,
verses.textEnNkjv: but if it is of God, you cannot overthrow it—lest you even be found to fight against God."
verses.textEnNlt: But if it is from God, you will not be able to overthrow them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God!"
verses.textEnNasb: but if the source is God, you will not be able to overthrow them; or else you may even be found fighting against God."
verses.textEn: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop these men; you will only find yourselves fighting against God."

verses.textZh: 就传使徒进来，鞭打一顿，禁止他们奉耶稣的名传讲，就把他们释放了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就传使徒进来，鞭打一顿，禁止他们奉耶稣的名传讲，就把他们释放了。
verses.textZhCuv: 公会的人听从了他，便叫使徒来，把他们打了，又吩咐他们不可奉耶稣的名讲道，就把他们释放了。
verses.textEnNiv: His speech persuaded them. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.textEnEsv: and when they had called in the apostles, they beat them and charged them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they agreed with him, and when they had called for the apostles and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
verses.textEnNlt: The others accepted his advice. They called in the apostles and had them flogged. Then they ordered them never again to speak in the name of Jesus, and they let them go.
verses.textEnNasb: They followed his advice; and after calling the apostles in, they flogged them and ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and then released them.
verses.textEn: His speech persuaded them. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

verses.textZh: 使徒欢欢喜喜从公议会里出来，因为他们算是配得为主的名受辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒欢欢喜喜从公议会里出来，因为他们算是配得为主的名受辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们离开公会，心里欢喜，因被算是配为这名受辱。
verses.textEnNiv: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing because they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they left the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for the name.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for His name.
verses.textEnNlt: The apostles left the high council rejoicing that God had counted them worthy to suffer disgrace for the name of Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: So they went on their way from the presence of the Council, rejoicing that they had been considered worthy to suffer shame for His name.
verses.textEn: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing because they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.

verses.textZh: 他们天天在殿里并在各人的家中，不断地教导，传讲耶稣是基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们天天在殿里并在各人的家中，不断地教导，传讲耶稣是基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就每日在殿里、在家里不住地教训人，传耶稣是基督。
verses.textEnNiv: Day after day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they never stopped teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
verses.textEnEsv: And every day, in the temple and from house to house, they did not cease teaching and preaching that the Christ is Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they did not cease teaching and preaching Jesus as the Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: And every day, in the Temple and from house to house, they continued to teach and preach this message: "Jesus is the Messiah."
verses.textEnNasb: And every day, in the temple and from house to house, they did not stop teaching and preaching the good news of Jesus as the Christ.
verses.textEn: Day after day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they never stopped teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.

verses.textZh: 门徒不断增加的时候，讲希腊话的犹太人，埋怨本地的希伯来人，因为在日常的供给上，忽略了他们的寡妇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒不断增加的时候，讲希腊话的犹太人，埋怨本地的希伯来人，因为在日常的供给上，忽略了他们的寡妇。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，门徒增多，有说希腊话的犹太人向希伯来人发怨言，因为在天天的供给上忽略了他们的寡妇。
verses.textEnNiv: In those days when the number of disciples was increasing, the Hellenistic Jews among them complained against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.
verses.textEnEsv: Now in these days when the disciples were increasing in number, a complaint by the Hellenists arose against the Hebrews because their widows were being neglected in the daily distribution.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in those days, when thenumberof the disciples was multiplying, there arose a complaint against the Hebrews by the Hellenists, because their widows were neglected in the daily distribution.
verses.textEnNlt: But as the believers rapidly multiplied, there were rumblings of discontent. The Greek-speaking believers complained about the Hebrew-speaking believers, saying that their widows were being discriminated against in the daily distribution of food.
verses.textEnNasb: Now at this time, as the disciples were increasing in number, a complaint developed on the part of the Hellenistic Jews against the native Hebrews, because their widows were being overlooked in the daily serving of food.
verses.textEn: In those days when the number of disciples was increasing, the Hellenistic Jews among them complained against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.

verses.textZh: 于是十二使徒召集了众门徒，说："要我们放下神的道，去管理伙食，是不合适的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是十二使徒召集了众门徒，说："要我们放下神的道，去管理伙食，是不合适的。
verses.textZhCuv: 十二使徒叫众门徒来，对他们说：「我们撇下神的道去管理饭食，原是不合宜的。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Twelve gathered all the disciples together and said, "It would not be right for us to neglect the ministry of the word of God in order to wait on tables.
verses.textEnEsv: And the twelve summoned the full number of the disciples and said, "It is not right that we should give up preaching the word of God to serve tables.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, "It is not desirable that we should leave the word of God and serve tables.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Twelve called a meeting of all the believers. They said, "We apostles should spend our time teaching the word of God, not running a food program.
verses.textEnNasb: So the twelve summoned the congregation of the disciples and said, "It is not desirable for us to neglect the word of God in order to serve tables.
verses.textEn: So the Twelve gathered all the disciples together and said, "It would not be right for us to neglect the ministry of the word of God in order to wait on tables.

verses.textZh: 所以弟兄们，应当从你们中间选出七个有好见证、满有圣灵和智慧的人，我们就派他们负责这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以弟兄们，应当从你们中间选出七个有好见证、满有圣灵和智慧的人，我们就派他们负责这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以弟兄们，当从你们中间选出七个有好名声、被圣灵充满、智慧充足的人，我们就派他们管理这事。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, choose seven men from among you who are known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will turn this responsibility over to them
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, brothers, pick out from among you seven men of good repute, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, whom we will appoint to this duty.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, brethren, seek out from among you seven men of good reputation, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business;
verses.textEnNlt: And so, brothers, select seven men who are well respected and are full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will give them this responsibility.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, brothers and sisters, select from among you seven men of good reputation, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may put in charge of this task.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, choose seven men from among you who are known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will turn this responsibility over to them

verses.textZh: 至于我们，我们要专心祈祷、传道。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我们，我们要专心祈祷、传道。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但我们要专心以祈祷、传道为事。」
verses.textEnNiv: and will give our attention to prayer and the ministry of the word."
verses.textEnEsv: But we will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word."
verses.textEnNkjv: but we will give ourselves continually to prayer and to the ministry of the word."
verses.textEnNlt: Then we apostles can spend our time in prayer and teaching the word."
verses.textEnNasb: But we will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word."
verses.textEn: and will give our attention to prayer and the ministry of the word."

verses.textZh: 这个意见全会众都很满意，于是选出司提反，他是一位满有信心和圣灵的人，还有腓利、伯罗哥罗、尼加挪、提门、巴米拿，以及归信犹太教的安提阿人尼哥拉，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这个意见全会众都很满意，于是选出司提反，他是一位满有信心和圣灵的人，还有腓利、伯罗哥罗、尼加挪、提门、巴米拿，以及归信犹太教的安提阿人尼哥拉，
verses.textZhCuv: 大众都喜悦这话，就拣选了司提反，乃是大有信心、圣灵充满的人，又拣选腓利、伯罗哥罗、尼迦挪、提门、巴米拿，并进犹太教的安提阿人尼哥拉，
verses.textEnNiv: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit; also Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
verses.textEnEsv: And what they said pleased the whole gathering, and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the saying pleased the whole multitude. And they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, and Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas, a proselyte from Antioch,
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone liked this idea, and they chose the following: Stephen (a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit), Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas of Antioch (an earlier convert to the Jewish faith).
verses.textEnNasb: The announcement found approval with the whole congregation; and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas, a proselyte from Antioch.
verses.textEn: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit; also Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.

verses.textZh: 叫他们站在使徒面前。使徒祷告后，就为他们按手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 叫他们站在使徒面前。使徒祷告后，就为他们按手。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫他们站在使徒面前。使徒祷告了，就按手在他们头上。
verses.textEnNiv: They presented these men to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
verses.textEnEsv: These they set before the apostles, and they prayed and laid their hands on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: whom they set before the apostles; and when they had prayed, they laid hands on them.
verses.textEnNlt: These seven were presented to the apostles, who prayed for them as they laid their hands on them.
verses.textEnNasb: And they brought these men before the apostles; and after praying, they laid their hands on them.
verses.textEn: They presented these men to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.

verses.textZh: 神的道传开了；在耶路撒冷，门徒人数大大增加，有很多祭司也信从了真道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的道传开了；在耶路撒冷，门徒人数大大增加，有很多祭司也信从了真道。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的道兴旺起来；在耶路撒冷门徒数目加增的甚多，也有许多祭司信从了这道。
verses.textEnNiv: So the word of God spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem increased rapidly, and a large number of priests became obedient to the faith.
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of God continued to increase, and the number of the disciples multiplied greatly in Jerusalem, and a great many of the priests became obedient to the faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of God spread, and the number of the disciples multiplied greatly in Jerusalem, and a great many of the priests were obedient to the faith.
verses.textEnNlt: So God’s message continued to spread. The number of believers greatly increased in Jerusalem, and many of the Jewish priests were converted, too.
verses.textEnNasb: The word of God kept spreading; and the number of the disciples continued to increase greatly in Jerusalem, and a great many of the priests were becoming obedient to the faith.
verses.textEn: So the word of God spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem increased rapidly, and a large number of priests became obedient to the faith.

verses.textZh: 司提反满有恩惠能力，在民间施行大奇事和神迹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 司提反满有恩惠能力，在民间施行大奇事和神迹。
verses.textZhCuv: 司提反满得恩惠、能力，在民间行了大奇事和神迹。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Stephen, a man full of God’s grace and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And Stephen, full of grace and power, was doing great wonders and signs among the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and signs among the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Stephen, a man full of God’s grace and power, performed amazing miracles and signs among the people.
verses.textEnNasb: And Stephen, full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.
verses.textEn: Now Stephen, a man full of God’s grace and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

verses.textZh: 当时有几个称为"自由人"会堂的人，就是从古利奈和亚历山太来的人，另外还有基利家人和亚西亚人，他们出面与司提反辩论，
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时有几个称为"自由人"会堂的人，就是从古利奈和亚历山太来的人，另外还有基利家人和亚西亚人，他们出面与司提反辩论，
verses.textZhCuv: 当时有称利百地拿会堂的几个人，并有古利奈、亚历山大、基利家、亚细亚各处会堂的几个人，都起来和司提反辩论。
verses.textEnNiv: Opposition arose, however, from members of the Synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called)—Jews of Cyrene and Alexandria as well as the provinces of Cilicia and Asia—who began to argue with Stephen.
verses.textEnEsv: Then some of those who belonged to the synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called), and of the Cyrenians, and of the Alexandrians, and of those from Cilicia and Asia, rose up and disputed with Stephen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then there arose some from what is called the Synagogue of the Freedmen (Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and those from Cilicia and Asia), disputing with Stephen.
verses.textEnNlt: But one day some men from the Synagogue of Freed Slaves, as it was called, started to debate with him. They were Jews from Cyrene, Alexandria, Cilicia, and the province of Asia.
verses.textEnNasb: But some men from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, including both Cyrenians and Alexandrians, and some from Cilicia and Asia, rose up and argued with Stephen.
verses.textEn: Opposition arose, however, from members of the Synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called)—Jews of Cyrene and Alexandria as well as the provinces of Cilicia and Asia—who began to argue with Stephen.

verses.textZh: 但司提反靠着圣灵和智慧说话，他们就抵挡不住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但司提反靠着圣灵和智慧说话，他们就抵挡不住。
verses.textZhCuv: 司提反是以智慧和圣灵说话，众人敌挡不住，
verses.textEnNiv: But they could not stand up against the wisdom the Spirit gave him as he spoke.
verses.textEnEsv: But they could not withstand the wisdom and the Spirit with which he was speaking.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
verses.textEnNlt: None of them could stand against the wisdom and the Spirit with which Stephen spoke.
verses.textEnNasb: But they were unable to cope with his wisdom and the Spirit by whom he was speaking.
verses.textEn: But they could not stand up against the wisdom the Spirit gave him as he spoke.

verses.textZh: 于是他们唆使众人，说："我们听过他说谤渎摩西和神的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们唆使众人，说："我们听过他说谤渎摩西和神的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就买出人来说：「我们听见他说谤摩西和神的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they secretly persuaded some men to say, "We have heard Stephen speak blasphemous words against Moses and against God."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they secretly instigated men who said, "We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they secretly induced men to say, "We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God."
verses.textEnNlt: So they persuaded some men to lie about Stephen, saying, "We heard him blaspheme Moses, and even God."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they secretly induced men to say, "We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God."
verses.textEn: Then they secretly persuaded some men to say, "We have heard Stephen speak blasphemous words against Moses and against God."

verses.textZh: 又煽动民众、长老、经学家，这些人就来捉拿他，把他带到公议会，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又煽动民众、长老、经学家，这些人就来捉拿他，把他带到公议会，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又耸动了百姓、长老，并文士，就忽然来捉拿他，把他带到公会去，
verses.textEnNiv: So they stirred up the people and the elders and the teachers of the law. They seized Stephen and brought him before the Sanhedrin.
verses.textEnEsv: And they stirred up the people and the elders and the scribes, and they came upon him and seized him and brought him before the council,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes; and they came upon him, seized him, and brought him to the council.
verses.textEnNlt: This roused the people, the elders, and the teachers of religious law. So they arrested Stephen and brought him before the high council.
verses.textEnNasb: And they stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and they came up to him and dragged him away, and brought him before the Council.
verses.textEn: So they stirred up the people and the elders and the teachers of the law. They seized Stephen and brought him before the Sanhedrin.

verses.textZh: 并且造了假的证供说："这人不断抨击圣地和律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且造了假的证供说："这人不断抨击圣地和律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 设下假见证，说：「这个人说话，不住地糟践圣所和律法。
verses.textEnNiv: They produced false witnesses, who testified, "This fellow never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.
verses.textEnEsv: and they set up false witnesses who said, "This man never ceases to speak words against this holy place and the law,
verses.textEnNkjv: They also set up false witnesses who said, "This man does not cease to speak blasphemous words against this holy place and the law;
verses.textEnNlt: The lying witnesses said, "This man is always speaking against the holy Temple and against the law of Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: They put forward false witnesses who said, "This man does not stop speaking against this holy place and the Law;
verses.textEn: They produced false witnesses, who testified, "This fellow never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.

verses.textZh: 我们听他说过：‘这拿撒勒人耶稣要毁坏这地方，改变摩西传给我们的规例。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们听他说过：‘这拿撒勒人耶稣要毁坏这地方，改变摩西传给我们的规例。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们曾听见他说，这拿撒勒人耶稣要毁坏此地，也要改变摩西所交给我们的规条。」
verses.textEnNiv: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down to us."
verses.textEnEsv: for we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and will change the customs that Moses delivered to us."
verses.textEnNkjv: for we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs which Moses delivered to us."
verses.textEnNlt: We have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy the Temple and change the customs Moses handed down to us."
verses.textEnNasb: for we have heard him say that this Nazarene, Jesus, will destroy this place and change the customs which Moses handed down to us."
verses.textEn: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down to us."

verses.textZh: 当时，坐在公议会里的人，都注视他，见他的面貌像天使一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，坐在公议会里的人，都注视他，见他的面貌像天使一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 在公会里坐着的人都定睛看他，见他的面貌，好像天使的面貌。
verses.textEnNiv: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
verses.textEnEsv: And gazing at him, all who sat in the council saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all who sat in the council, looking steadfastly at him, saw his face as the face of an angel.
verses.textEnNlt: At this point everyone in the high council stared at Stephen, because his face became as bright as an angel’s.
verses.textEnNasb: And all who were sitting in the Council stared at him, and they saw his face, which was like the face of an angel.
verses.textEn: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.

verses.textZh: 大祭司说："真有这些事吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大祭司说："真有这些事吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 大祭司就说：「这些事果然有吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the high priest asked Stephen, "Are these charges true?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the high priest said, "Are these things so?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the high priest said, "Are these things so?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the high priest asked Stephen, "Are these accusations true?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now the high priest said, "Are these things so?"
verses.textEn: Then the high priest asked Stephen, "Are these charges true?"

verses.textZh: 司提反说："各位父老兄弟请听！我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕，在美索不达米亚，还没有住在哈兰的时候，荣耀的神向他显现，
verses.textZhCnvs: 司提反说："各位父老兄弟请听！我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕，在美索不达米亚，还没有住在哈兰的时候，荣耀的神向他显现，
verses.textZhCuv: 司提反说：「诸位父兄请听！当日我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕在美索不达米亚还未住哈兰的时候，荣耀的神向他显现，
verses.textEnNiv: To this he replied: "Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Harran.
verses.textEnEsv: And Stephen said: "Brothers and fathers, hear me. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Brethren and fathers, listen: The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Haran,
verses.textEnNlt: This was Stephen’s reply: "Brothers and fathers, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham in Mesopotamia before he settled in Haran.
verses.textEnNasb: And Stephen said, "Listen to me, brothers and fathers! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
verses.textEn: To this he replied: "Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Harran.

verses.textZh: 对他说：‘你要离开本地本族，到我指示你的地方去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他说：‘你要离开本地本族，到我指示你的地方去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：『你要离开本地和亲族，往我所要指示你的地方去。』
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Leave your country and your people,’ God said, ‘and go to the land I will show you.’
verses.textEnEsv: and said to him, ‘Go out from your land and from your kindred and go into the land that I will show you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to him, ‘Get out of your country and from your relatives, and come to a land that I will show you.’
verses.textEnNlt: God told him, ‘Leave your native land and your relatives, and come into the land that I will show you.’
verses.textEnNasb: and He said to him, ‘Go from your country and your relatives, and come to the land which I will show you.’
verses.textEn: ‘Leave your country and your people,’ God said, ‘and go to the land I will show you.’

verses.textZh: 他就离开迦勒底人的地方，住在哈兰。他父亲死后，神又叫他从那里迁到你们现在所住的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就离开迦勒底人的地方，住在哈兰。他父亲死后，神又叫他从那里迁到你们现在所住的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就离开迦勒底人之地，住在哈兰。他父亲死了以后，神使他从那里搬到你们现在所住之地。
verses.textEnNiv: "So he left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Harran. After the death of his father, God sent him to this land where you are now living.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he went out from the land of the Chaldeans and lived in Haran. And after his father died, God removed him from there into this land in which you are now living.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldeans and dwelt in Haran. And from there, when his father was dead, He moved him to this land in which you now dwell.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and lived in Haran until his father died. Then God brought him here to the land where you now live.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. And from there, after his father died, God had him move to this country in which you are now living.
verses.textEn: "So he left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Harran. After the death of his father, God sent him to this land where you are now living.

verses.textZh: 在这里神并没有赐他产业，连立足之地也没有。但神应许把这地赐给他和他的后裔为业，虽然那时他还没有儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这里神并没有赐他产业，连立足之地也没有。但神应许把这地赐给他和他的后裔为业，虽然那时他还没有儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这地方，神并没有给他产业，连立足之地也没有给他；但应许要将这地赐给他和他的后裔为业；那时他还没有儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: He gave him no inheritance here, not even enough ground to set his foot on. But God promised him that he and his descendants after him would possess the land, even though at that time Abraham had no child.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet he gave him no inheritance in it, not even a foot’s length, but promised to give it to him as a possession and to his offspring after him, though he had no child.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God gave him no inheritance in it, not even enough to set his foot on. But even when Abraham had no child, He promised to give it to him for a possession, and to his descendants after him.
verses.textEnNlt: "But God gave him no inheritance here, not even one square foot of land. God did promise, however, that eventually the whole land would belong to Abraham and his descendants—even though he had no children yet.
verses.textEnNasb: But He gave him no inheritance in it, not even a foot of ground, and yet, He promised that He would give it to him as a possession, and to his descendants after him, even though he had no child.
verses.textEn: He gave him no inheritance here, not even enough ground to set his foot on. But God promised him that he and his descendants after him would possess the land, even though at that time Abraham had no child.

verses.textZh: 神就这样说：‘你的后裔必在外地寄居，人要奴役、虐待他们四百年。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 神就这样说：‘你的后裔必在外地寄居，人要奴役、虐待他们四百年。’
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：『他的后裔必寄居外邦，那里的人要叫他们作奴仆，苦待他们四百年。』
verses.textEnNiv: God spoke to him in this way: ‘For four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated.
verses.textEnEsv: And God spoke to this effect—that his offspring would be sojourners in a land belonging to others, who would enslave them and afflict them four hundred years.
verses.textEnNkjv: But God spoke in this way: that his descendants would dwell in a foreign land, and that they would bring them into bondage and oppress them four hundred years.
verses.textEnNlt: God also told him that his descendants would live in a foreign land, where they would be oppressed as slaves for 400 years.
verses.textEnNasb: But God spoke to this effect, that his descendants would be strangers in a land that was not theirs, and they would enslave and mistreat them for four hundred years.
verses.textEn: God spoke to him in this way: ‘For four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated.

verses.textZh: 神又说：‘奴役他们的那个国家，我要亲自惩罚。以后，他们要出来，在这地方事奉我。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 神又说：‘奴役他们的那个国家，我要亲自惩罚。以后，他们要出来，在这地方事奉我。’
verses.textZhCuv: 神又说：『使他们作奴仆的那国，我要惩罚。以后他们要出来，在这地方事奉我。』
verses.textEnNiv: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come out of that country and worship me in this place.’
verses.textEnEsv: ‘But I will judge the nation that they serve,’ said God, ‘and after that they shall come out and worship me in this place.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And the nation to whom they will be in bondage I will judge,’ said God, ‘and after that they shall come out and serve Me in this place.’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and in the end they will come out and worship me here in this place.’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And whatever nation to which they are enslaved I Myself will judge,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve Me in this place.’
verses.textEn: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come out of that country and worship me in this place.’

verses.textZh: 神也赐他割礼为约。这样，亚伯拉罕生了以撒，第八天就给他行了割礼。后来，以撒生雅各，雅各生了十二位祖先。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神也赐他割礼为约。这样，亚伯拉罕生了以撒，第八天就给他行了割礼。后来，以撒生雅各，雅各生了十二位祖先。
verses.textZhCuv: 神又赐他割礼的约。于是亚伯拉罕生了以撒，第八日给他行了割礼。以撒生雅各；雅各生十二位先祖。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision. And Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him eight days after his birth. Later Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
verses.textEnEsv: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision. And so Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him on the eighth day, and Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He gave him the covenant of circumcision; and so Abraham begot Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day; and Isaac begot Jacob, and Jacob begot the twelve patriarchs.
verses.textEnNlt: "God also gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision at that time. So when Abraham became the father of Isaac, he circumcised him on the eighth day. And the practice was continued when Isaac became the father of Jacob, and when Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs of the Israelite nation.
verses.textEnNasb: And He gave him the covenant of circumcision; and so Abraham fathered Isaac, and circumcised him on the eighth day; and Isaac fathered Jacob, and Jacob, the twelve patriarchs.
verses.textEn: Then he gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision. And Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him eight days after his birth. Later Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

verses.textZh: "祖先妒忌约瑟，把他卖到埃及去，然而神与他同在，
verses.textZhCnvs: "祖先妒忌约瑟，把他卖到埃及去，然而神与他同在，
verses.textZhCuv: 「先祖嫉妒约瑟，把他卖到埃及去；神却与他同在，
verses.textEnNiv: "Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him
verses.textEnEsv: "And the patriarchs, jealous of Joseph, sold him into Egypt; but God was with him
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the patriarchs, becoming envious, sold Joseph into Egypt. But God was with him
verses.textEnNlt: "These patriarchs were jealous of their brother Joseph, and they sold him to be a slave in Egypt. But God was with him
verses.textEnNasb: "The patriarchs became jealous of Joseph and sold him into Egypt. Yet God was with him,
verses.textEn: "Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him

verses.textZh: 救他脱离一切苦难，使他在埃及王法老面前，有智慧、得恩宠。法老立他为首相，管理埃及和法老的全家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 救他脱离一切苦难，使他在埃及王法老面前，有智慧、得恩宠。法老立他为首相，管理埃及和法老的全家。
verses.textZhCuv: 救他脱离一切苦难，又使他在埃及王法老面前得恩典，有智慧。法老就派他作埃及国的宰相兼管全家。
verses.textEnNiv: and rescued him from all his troubles. He gave Joseph wisdom and enabled him to gain the goodwill of Pharaoh king of Egypt. So Pharaoh made him ruler over Egypt and all his palace.
verses.textEnEsv: and rescued him out of all his afflictions and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who made him ruler over Egypt and over all his household.
verses.textEnNkjv: and delivered him out of all his troubles, and gave him favor and wisdom in the presence of Pharaoh, king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.textEnNlt: and rescued him from all his troubles. And God gave him favor before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. God also gave Joseph unusual wisdom, so that Pharaoh appointed him governor over all of Egypt and put him in charge of the palace.
verses.textEnNasb: and rescued him from all his afflictions, and granted him favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and he made him governor over Egypt and his entire household.
verses.textEn: and rescued him from all his troubles. He gave Joseph wisdom and enabled him to gain the goodwill of Pharaoh king of Egypt. So Pharaoh made him ruler over Egypt and all his palace.

verses.textZh: 后来埃及和迦南全地遭遇饥荒、大灾难，我们的祖先找不到粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来埃及和迦南全地遭遇饥荒、大灾难，我们的祖先找不到粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来埃及和迦南全地遭遇饥荒，大受艰难，我们的祖宗就绝了粮。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then a famine struck all Egypt and Canaan, bringing great suffering, and our ancestors could not find food.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there came a famine throughout all Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction, and our fathers could find no food.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a famine and great trouble came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and our fathers found no sustenance.
verses.textEnNlt: "But a famine came upon Egypt and Canaan. There was great misery, and our ancestors ran out of food.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now a famine came over all Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction with it, and our fathers could find no food.
verses.textEn: "Then a famine struck all Egypt and Canaan, bringing great suffering, and our ancestors could not find food.

verses.textZh: 雅各听见埃及有谷粮，就派我们的祖先去，这是第一次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各听见埃及有谷粮，就派我们的祖先去，这是第一次。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各听见在埃及有粮，就打发我们的祖宗初次往那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our forefathers on their first visit.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers on their first visit.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob heard that there was still grain in Egypt, so he sent his sons—our ancestors—to buy some.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers there the first time.
verses.textEn: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our forefathers on their first visit.

verses.textZh: 第二次的时候，约瑟就向哥哥们表露自己的身世，法老才知道约瑟的家世。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二次的时候，约瑟就向哥哥们表露自己的身世，法老才知道约瑟的家世。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二次约瑟与弟兄们相认，他的亲族也被法老知道了。
verses.textEnNiv: On their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Joseph’s family.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the second visit Joseph made himself known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family became known to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family became known to the Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: The second time they went, Joseph revealed his identity to his brothers, and they were introduced to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: And on the second visit, Joseph made himself known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: On their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Joseph’s family.

verses.textZh: 约瑟就派人去把他父亲雅各和全家七十五人都接来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟就派人去把他父亲雅各和全家七十五人都接来。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟就打发弟兄请父亲雅各和全家七十五个人都来。
verses.textEnNiv: After this, Joseph sent for his father Jacob and his whole family, seventy-five in all.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his kindred, seventy-five persons in all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph sent and called his father Jacob and all his relatives to him, seventy-five people.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joseph sent for his father, Jacob, and all his relatives to come to Egypt, seventy-five persons in all.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph sent word and invited his father Jacob and all his relatives to come to him, seventy-five people in all.
verses.textEn: After this, Joseph sent for his father Jacob and his whole family, seventy-five in all.

verses.textZh: 于是雅各下了埃及。后来他和我们祖先都死了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是雅各下了埃及。后来他和我们祖先都死了，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是雅各下了埃及，后来他和我们的祖宗都死在那里；
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our ancestors died.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob went down into Egypt, and he died, he and our fathers,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob went down to Egypt; and he died, he and our fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob went to Egypt. He died there, as did our ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jacob went down to Egypt, and he and our fathers died there.
verses.textEn: Then Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our ancestors died.

verses.textZh: 运到示剑，埋葬在亚伯拉罕用银子向哈抹子孙买来的坟地里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 运到示剑，埋葬在亚伯拉罕用银子向哈抹子孙买来的坟地里。
verses.textZhCuv: 又被带到示剑，葬于亚伯拉罕在示剑用银子从哈抹子孙买来的坟墓里。
verses.textEnNiv: Their bodies were brought back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a certain sum of money.
verses.textEnEsv: and they were carried back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham had bought for a sum of silver from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were carried back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a sum of money from the sons of Hamor, thefather of Shechem.
verses.textEnNlt: Their bodies were taken to Shechem and buried in the tomb Abraham had bought for a certain price from Hamor’s sons in Shechem.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were brought back from there to Shechem and laid in the tomb which Abraham had purchased for a sum of money from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.
verses.textEn: Their bodies were brought back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a certain sum of money.

verses.textZh: "神给亚伯拉罕的应许快要实现的时候，以色列人在埃及人口繁盛增多；
verses.textZhCnvs: "神给亚伯拉罕的应许快要实现的时候，以色列人在埃及人口繁盛增多；
verses.textZhCuv: 「及至神应许亚伯拉罕的日期将到，以色列民在埃及兴盛众多，
verses.textEnNiv: "As the time drew near for God to fulfill his promise to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
verses.textEnEsv: "But as the time of the promise drew near, which God had granted to Abraham, the people increased and multiplied in Egypt
verses.textEnNkjv: "But when the time of the promise drew near which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt
verses.textEnNlt: "As the time drew near when God would fulfill his promise to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt greatly increased.
verses.textEnNasb: "But as the time of the promise which God had assured to Abraham was approaching, the people increased and multiplied in Egypt,
verses.textEn: "As the time drew near for God to fulfill his promise to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.

verses.textZh: 但是，到了另一位不认识约瑟的君王兴起统治埃及的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，到了另一位不认识约瑟的君王兴起统治埃及的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 直到有不晓得约瑟的新王兴起。
verses.textEnNiv: Then ‘a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.’
verses.textEnEsv: until there arose over Egypt another king who did not know Joseph.
verses.textEnNkjv: till another king arose who did not know Joseph.
verses.textEnNlt: But then a new king came to the throne of Egypt who knew nothing about Joseph.
verses.textEnNasb: until another king arose over Egypt who did not know Joseph.
verses.textEn: Then ‘a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.’

verses.textZh: 他就谋害我们的同胞，虐待我们的祖先，逼他们拋弃自己的婴孩，不容婴孩存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就谋害我们的同胞，虐待我们的祖先，逼他们拋弃自己的婴孩，不容婴孩存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用诡计待我们的宗族，苦害我们的祖宗，叫他们丢弃婴孩，使婴孩不能存活。
verses.textEnNiv: He dealt treacherously with our people and oppressed our ancestors by forcing them to throw out their newborn babies so that they would die.
verses.textEnEsv: He dealt shrewdly with our race and forced our fathers to expose their infants, so that they would not be kept alive.
verses.textEnNkjv: This man dealt treacherously with our people, and oppressed our forefathers, making them expose their babies, so that they might not live.
verses.textEnNlt: This king exploited our people and oppressed them, forcing parents to abandon their newborn babies so they would die.
verses.textEnNasb: It was he who shrewdly took advantage of our nation and mistreated our fathers in order that they would abandon their infants in the Nile, so that they would not survive.
verses.textEn: He dealt treacherously with our people and oppressed our ancestors by forcing them to throw out their newborn babies so that they would die.

verses.textZh: 就在那时候，摩西出生了，他非常俊美，在父亲的家中抚养了三个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那时候，摩西出生了，他非常俊美，在父亲的家中抚养了三个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，摩西生下来，俊美非凡，在他父亲家里抚养了三个月。
verses.textEnNiv: "At that time Moses was born, and he was no ordinary child. For three months he was cared for by his family.
verses.textEnEsv: At this time Moses was born; and he was beautiful in God’s sight. And he was brought up for three months in his father’s house,
verses.textEnNkjv: At this time Moses was born, and was well pleasing to God; and he was brought up in his father’s house for three months.
verses.textEnNlt: "At that time Moses was born—a beautiful child in God’s eyes. His parents cared for him at home for three months.
verses.textEnNasb: At this time Moses was born; and he was beautiful to God. He was nurtured for three months in his father’s home.
verses.textEn: "At that time Moses was born, and he was no ordinary child. For three months he was cared for by his family.

verses.textZh: 他被拋弃的时候，法老的女儿把他拾起来，当作儿子抚养。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他被拋弃的时候，法老的女儿把他拾起来，当作儿子抚养。
