verses.textZhCuv: 他被丢弃的时候，法老的女儿拾了去，养为自己的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: When he was placed outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
verses.textEnEsv: and when he was exposed, Pharaoh’s daughter adopted him and brought him up as her own son.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when he was set out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him away and brought him up as her own son.
verses.textEnNlt: When they had to abandon him, Pharaoh’s daughter adopted him and raised him as her own son.
verses.textEnNasb: And after he had been put outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him away and nurtured him as her own son.
verses.textEn: When he was placed outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.

verses.textZh: 摩西学尽了埃及人的一切学问，说话行事都有能力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西学尽了埃及人的一切学问，说话行事都有能力。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西学了埃及人一切的学问，说话行事都有才能。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was mighty in his words and deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses was taught all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was powerful in both speech and action.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was proficient in speaking and action.
verses.textEn: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.

verses.textZh: "到了四十岁，他心中起了一个念头，要去看望自己的同胞以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到了四十岁，他心中起了一个念头，要去看望自己的同胞以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他将到四十岁，心中起意去看望他的弟兄以色列人；
verses.textEnNiv: "When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his own people, the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: "When he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren, the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "One day when Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his relatives, the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: But when he was approaching the age of forty, it entered his mind to visit his countrymen, the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: "When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his own people, the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 当他看见有一个人受欺负，就去护卫，为那受屈的抱不平，打死了那个埃及人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当他看见有一个人受欺负，就去护卫，为那受屈的抱不平，打死了那个埃及人。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了那里，见他们一个人受冤屈，就护庇他，为那受欺压的人报仇，打死了那埃及人。
verses.textEnNiv: He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he went to his defense and avenged him by killing the Egyptian.
verses.textEnEsv: And seeing one of them being wronged, he defended the oppressed man and avenged him by striking down the Egyptian.
verses.textEnNkjv: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended and avenged him who was oppressed, and struck down the Egyptian.
verses.textEnNlt: He saw an Egyptian mistreating an Israelite. So Moses came to the man’s defense and avenged him, killing the Egyptian.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he saw one of them being treated unjustly, he defended and took vengeance for the oppressed man by fatally striking the Egyptian.
verses.textEn: He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he went to his defense and avenged him by killing the Egyptian.

verses.textZh: 他以为同胞们都必知道神要借着他的手拯救他们，事实上他们却不知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他以为同胞们都必知道神要借着他的手拯救他们，事实上他们却不知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 他以为弟兄必明白神是藉他的手搭救他们；他们却不明白。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses thought that his own people would realize that God was using him to rescue them, but they did not.
verses.textEnEsv: He supposed that his brothers would understand that God was giving them salvation by his hand, but they did not understand.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he supposed that his brethren would have understood that God would deliver them by his hand, but they did not understand.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses assumed his fellow Israelites would realize that God had sent him to rescue them, but they didn’t.
verses.textEnNasb: And he thought that his brothers understood that God was granting them deliverance through him; but they did not understand.
verses.textEn: Moses thought that his own people would realize that God was using him to rescue them, but they did not.

verses.textZh: 第二天，有人在打架，摩西就出面调解，说：‘你们是弟兄，为甚么彼此欺负呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，有人在打架，摩西就出面调解，说：‘你们是弟兄，为甚么彼此欺负呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，遇见两个以色列人争斗，就劝他们和睦，说：『你们二位是弟兄，为什么彼此欺负呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: The next day Moses came upon two Israelites who were fighting. He tried to reconcile them by saying, ‘Men, you are brothers; why do you want to hurt each other?’
verses.textEnEsv: And on the following day he appeared to them as they were quarreling and tried to reconcile them, saying, ‘Men, you are brothers. Why do you wrong each other?’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the next day he appeared to twoof them as they were fighting, and triedto reconcile them, saying, ‘Men, you are brethren; why do you wrong one another?’
verses.textEnNlt: "The next day he visited them again and saw two men of Israel fighting. He tried to be a peacemaker. ‘Men,’ he said, ‘you are brothers. Why are you fighting each other?’
verses.textEnNasb: And on the following day he appeared to them as they were fighting each other, and he tried to reconcile them to peace, by saying, ‘Men, you are brothers, why are you injuring each other?’
verses.textEn: The next day Moses came upon two Israelites who were fighting. He tried to reconcile them by saying, ‘Men, you are brothers; why do you want to hurt each other?’

verses.textZh: 那欺负邻舍的把他推开，说：‘谁立了你作我们的领袖和审判官呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那欺负邻舍的把他推开，说：‘谁立了你作我们的领袖和审判官呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 那欺负邻舍的把他推开，说：『谁立你作我们的首领和审判官呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "But the man who was mistreating the other pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?
verses.textEnEsv: But the man who was wronging his neighbor thrust him aside, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.textEnNlt: "But the man in the wrong pushed Moses aside. ‘Who made you a ruler and judge over us?’ he asked.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who was injuring his neighbor pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and judge over us?
verses.textEn: "But the man who was mistreating the other pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?

verses.textZh: 难道你想杀我，像昨天杀那个埃及人一样吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道你想杀我，像昨天杀那个埃及人一样吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 难道你要杀我，像昨天杀那埃及人吗？』
verses.textEnNiv: Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
verses.textEnEsv: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you want to kill me as you did the Egyptian yesterday?’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Are you going to kill me as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?’
verses.textEnNasb: You do not intend to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday, do you?’
verses.textEn: Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

verses.textZh: 摩西因为这句话，就逃到米甸地寄居，在那里生了两个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西因为这句话，就逃到米甸地寄居，在那里生了两个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西听见这话就逃走了，寄居于米甸；在那里生了两个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he settled as a foreigner and had two sons.
verses.textEnEsv: At this retort Moses fled and became an exile in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, at this saying, Moses fled and became a dweller in the land of Midian, where he had two sons.
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses heard that, he fled the country and lived as a foreigner in the land of Midian. There his two sons were born.
verses.textEnNasb: At this remark, Moses fled and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he fathered two sons.
verses.textEn: When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he settled as a foreigner and had two sons.

verses.textZh: "过了四十年，在西奈山的旷野，有一位使者，在荆棘中的火焰里，向摩西显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: "过了四十年，在西奈山的旷野，有一位使者，在荆棘中的火焰里，向摩西显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 「过了四十年，在西奈山的旷野，有一位天使从荆棘火焰中向摩西显现。
verses.textEnNiv: "After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now when forty years had passed, an angel appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And when forty years had passed, an Angel of the Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire in a bush, in the wilderness of Mount Sinai.
verses.textEnNlt: "Forty years later, in the desert near Mount Sinai, an angel appeared to Moses in the flame of a burning bush.
verses.textEnNasb: "After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in the flame of a burning thorn bush.
verses.textEn: "After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.

verses.textZh: 他见了这个异象，十分惊奇；他正上前察看的时候，就有主的声音说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他见了这个异象，十分惊奇；他正上前察看的时候，就有主的声音说：
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西见了那异象，便觉希奇，正进前观看的时候，有主的声音说：
verses.textEnNiv: When he saw this, he was amazed at the sight. As he went over to get a closer look, he heard the Lord say:
verses.textEnEsv: When Moses saw it, he was amazed at the sight, and as he drew near to look, there came the voice of the Lord:
verses.textEnNkjv: When Moses saw it, he marveled at the sight; and as he drew near to observe, the voice of the Lord came to him,
verses.textEnNlt: When Moses saw it, he was amazed at the sight. As he went to take a closer look, the voice of the Lord called out to him,
verses.textEnNasb: When Moses saw it, he was astonished at the sight; and as he approached to look more closely, the voice of the Lord came:
verses.textEn: When he saw this, he was amazed at the sight. As he went over to get a closer look, he heard the Lord say:

verses.textZh: ‘我是你祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的神。’摩西战战兢兢，不敢观看。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘我是你祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的神。’摩西战战兢兢，不敢观看。
verses.textZhCuv: 『我是你列祖的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。』摩西战战兢兢，不敢观看。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham and of Isaac and of Jacob.’ And Moses trembled and did not dare to look.
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, ‘I am the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ And Moses trembled and dared not look.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘I am the God of your ancestors—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses shook with terror and did not dare to look.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses shook with fear and did not dare to look closely.
verses.textEn: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.

verses.textZh: 主对他说：‘把你脚上的鞋脱掉，因为你所站的地方是圣地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主对他说：‘把你脚上的鞋脱掉，因为你所站的地方是圣地。
verses.textZhCuv: 主对他说：『把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站之地是圣地。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off the sandals from your feet, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Then the Lord said to him, "Take your sandals off your feet, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for you are standing on holy ground.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to him, ‘ Remove your sandals from your feet, for the place on which you are standing is holy ground.
verses.textEn: "Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.

verses.textZh: 我的子民在埃及所受的痛苦，我实在看见了；他们的叹息我也听见了，我下来是要救他们。你来，我要派你到埃及去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民在埃及所受的痛苦，我实在看见了；他们的叹息我也听见了，我下来是要救他们。你来，我要派你到埃及去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我实在看见了，他们悲叹的声音，我也听见了。我下来要救他们。你来！我要差你往埃及去。』
verses.textEnNiv: I have indeed seen the oppression of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to set them free. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’
verses.textEnEsv: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning, and I have come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send you to Egypt.’
verses.textEnNkjv: I have surely seen the oppression of My people who are in Egypt; I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send you to Egypt." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I have certainly seen the oppression of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now go, for I am sending you back to Egypt.’
verses.textEnNasb: I have certainly seen the oppression of My people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning, and I have come down to rescue them; and now come, I will send you to Egypt.’
verses.textEn: I have indeed seen the oppression of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to set them free. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’

verses.textZh: 他们拒绝了这位摩西，说：‘谁立了你作领袖和审判官呢？’但神借着在荆棘中向他显现的使者的手，派他作领袖和救赎者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们拒绝了这位摩西，说：‘谁立了你作领袖和审判官呢？’但神借着在荆棘中向他显现的使者的手，派他作领袖和救赎者。
verses.textZhCuv: 这摩西就是百姓弃绝说『谁立你作我们的首领和审判官』的；神却藉那在荆棘中显现之使者的手差派他作首领、作救赎的。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the same Moses they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ He was sent to be their ruler and deliverer by God himself, through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
verses.textEnEsv: "This Moses, whom they rejected, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—this man God sent as both ruler and redeemer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This Moses whom they rejected, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’ is the one God sent tobe a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the Angel who appeared to him in the bush.
verses.textEnNlt: "So God sent back the same man his people had previously rejected when they demanded, ‘Who made you a ruler and judge over us?’ Through the angel who appeared to him in the burning bush, God sent Moses to be their ruler and savior.
verses.textEnNasb: "This Moses whom they disowned, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’ is the one whom God sent to be both a ruler and a deliverer with the help of the angel who appeared to him in the thorn bush.
verses.textEn: "This is the same Moses they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ He was sent to be their ruler and deliverer by God himself, through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

verses.textZh: 这人领他们出来，并且在埃及地、红海和旷野，行奇事神迹四十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人领他们出来，并且在埃及地、红海和旷野，行奇事神迹四十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人领百姓出来，在埃及，在红海，在旷野，四十年间行了奇事神迹。
verses.textEnNiv: He led them out of Egypt and performed wonders and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea and for forty years in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: This man led them out, performing wonders and signs in Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the wilderness for forty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: He brought them out, after he had shown wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
verses.textEnNlt: And by means of many wonders and miraculous signs, he led them out of Egypt, through the Red Sea, and through the wilderness for forty years.
verses.textEnNasb: This man led them out, performing wonders and signs in the land of Egypt and in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
verses.textEn: He led them out of Egypt and performed wonders and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea and for forty years in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 以前那位对以色列人说‘神要从你们弟兄中间，给你们兴起一位先知像我’的，就是这摩西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以前那位对以色列人说‘神要从你们弟兄中间，给你们兴起一位先知像我’的，就是这摩西。
verses.textZhCuv: 那曾对以色列人说『神要从你们弟兄中间给你们兴起一位先知像我』的，就是这位摩西。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your own people.’
verses.textEnEsv: This is the Moses who said to the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your brothers.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from your brethren. Him you shall hear.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Moses himself told the people of Israel, ‘God will raise up for you a Prophet like me from among your own people.’
verses.textEnNasb: This is the Moses who said to the sons of Israel, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your countrymen.’
verses.textEn: "This is the Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your own people.’

verses.textZh: 那曾经在旷野的大会中，和那在西奈山上对他说话的使者同在，也与我们的祖先同在的，就是他。他领受了活的圣言，传给我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那曾经在旷野的大会中，和那在西奈山上对他说话的使者同在，也与我们的祖先同在的，就是他。他领受了活的圣言，传给我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人曾在旷野会中和西奈山上，与那对他说话的天使同在，又与我们的祖宗同在，并且领受活泼的圣言传给我们。
verses.textEnNiv: He was in the assembly in the wilderness, with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our ancestors; and he received living words to pass on to us.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the one who was in the congregation in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him at Mount Sinai, and with our fathers. He received living oracles to give to us.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is he who was in the congregation in the wilderness with the Angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, the one who received the living oracles to give to us,
verses.textEnNlt: Moses was with our ancestors, the assembly of God’s people in the wilderness, when the angel spoke to him at Mount Sinai. And there Moses received life-giving words to pass on to us.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the one who was in the assembly in the wilderness together with the angel who spoke to him at length on Mount Sinai, and who was with our fathers; and he received living words to pass on to you.
verses.textEn: He was in the assembly in the wilderness, with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our ancestors; and he received living words to pass on to us.

verses.textZh: 我们的祖先不肯听从他，反而把他推开，他们的心已经转向了埃及，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的祖先不肯听从他，反而把他推开，他们的心已经转向了埃及，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的祖宗不肯听从，反弃绝他，心里归向埃及，
verses.textEnNiv: "But our ancestors refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Our fathers refused to obey him, but thrust him aside, and in their hearts they turned to Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: whom our fathers would not obey, but rejected. And in their hearts they turned back to Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: "But our ancestors refused to listen to Moses. They rejected him and wanted to return to Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Our fathers were unwilling to be obedient to him; on the contrary they rejected him and turned back to Egypt in their hearts,
verses.textEn: "But our ancestors refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.

verses.textZh: 就对亚伦说：‘给我们做一些神像，可以走在我们前头。因为把我们从埃及地领出来的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭遇了甚么事。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 就对亚伦说：‘给我们做一些神像，可以走在我们前头。因为把我们从埃及地领出来的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭遇了甚么事。’
verses.textZhCuv: 对亚伦说：『你且为我们造些神像，在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。』
verses.textEnNiv: They told Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who led us out of Egypt—we don’t know what has happened to him!’
verses.textEnEsv: saying to Aaron, ‘Make for us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who led us out from the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods to go before us; asfor this Moses who brought us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has become of him.’
verses.textEnNlt: They told Aaron, ‘Make us some gods who can lead us, for we don’t know what has become of this Moses, who brought us out of Egypt.’
verses.textEnNasb: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us a god who will go before us; for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt—we do not know what happened to him.’
verses.textEn: They told Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who led us out of Egypt—we don’t know what has happened to him!’

verses.textZh: 在那些日子里，他们做了一个牛犊，把祭物献给那偶像，并且因自己手所做的而欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子里，他们做了一个牛犊，把祭物献给那偶像，并且因自己手所做的而欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，他们造了一个牛犊，又拿祭物献给那像，欢喜自己手中的工作。
verses.textEnNiv: That was the time they made an idol in the form of a calf. They brought sacrifices to it and reveled in what their own hands had made.
verses.textEnEsv: And they made a calf in those days, and offered a sacrifice to the idol and were rejoicing in the works of their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they made a calf in those days, offered sacrifices to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
verses.textEnNlt: So they made an idol shaped like a calf, and they sacrificed to it and celebrated over this thing they had made.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time they made a calf and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and were rejoicing in the works of their hands.
verses.textEn: That was the time they made an idol in the form of a calf. They brought sacrifices to it and reveled in what their own hands had made.

verses.textZh: 于是神转身离开，任凭他们事奉天象，正如先知书所说： ‘以色列家啊， 你们在旷野四十年， 岂是将祭牲和祭物献给我呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是神转身离开，任凭他们事奉天象，正如先知书所说： ‘以色列家啊， 你们在旷野四十年， 岂是将祭牲和祭物献给我呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 神就转脸不顾，任凭他们事奉天上的日月星辰，正如先知书上所写的说： 以色列家啊， 你们四十年间在旷野， 岂是将牺牲和祭物献给我吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the sun, moon and stars. This agrees with what is written in the book of the prophets: " ‘Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: But God turned away and gave them over to worship the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: "‘Did you bring to me slain beasts and sacrifices, during the forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God turned and gave them up to worship the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the Prophets: ‘Did you offer Me slaughtered animals and sacrifices during forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: Then God turned away from them and abandoned them to serve the stars of heaven as their gods! In the book of the prophets it is written, ‘Was it to me you were bringing sacrifices and offerings during those forty years in the wilderness, Israel?
verses.textEnNasb: But God turned away and gave them over to serve the heavenly lights; as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘You did not offer Me victims and sacrifices for forty years in the wilderness, did you, house of Israel?
verses.textEn: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the sun, moon and stars. This agrees with what is written in the book of the prophets: " ‘Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?

verses.textZh: 你们抬着摩洛的帐幕， 和理番神的星， 就是你们做来敬拜的像。 所以我要把你们放逐到巴比伦那一边去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们抬着摩洛的帐幕， 和理番神的星， 就是你们做来敬拜的像。 所以我要把你们放逐到巴比伦那一边去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们抬着摩洛的帐幕和理番神的星， 就是你们所造为要敬拜的像。 因此，我要把你们迁到巴比伦外去。
verses.textEnNiv: You have taken up the tabernacle of Molek and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile’ beyond Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: You took up the tent of Moloch and the star of your god Rephan, the images that you made to worship; and I will send you into exile beyond Babylon.’
verses.textEnNkjv: You also took up the tabernacle of Moloch, And the star of your god Remphan, Images which you made to worship; And I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
verses.textEnNlt: No, you carried your pagan gods— the shrine of Molech, the star of your god Rephan, and the images you made to worship them. So I will send you into exile as far away as Babylon.’
verses.textEnNasb: You also took along the tabernacle of Moloch and the star of your god Rompha, the images which you made to worship. I also will deport you beyond Babylon.’
verses.textEn: You have taken up the tabernacle of Molek and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile’ beyond Babylon.

verses.textZh: "我们的祖先在旷野有作证的帐幕，就是跟摩西谈话的那位指示他，依照他看见的样式做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我们的祖先在旷野有作证的帐幕，就是跟摩西谈话的那位指示他，依照他看见的样式做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我们的祖宗在旷野，有法柜的帐幕，是神吩咐摩西叫他照所看见的样式做的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Our ancestors had the tabernacle of the covenant law with them in the wilderness. It had been made as God directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.
verses.textEnEsv: "Our fathers had the tent of witness in the wilderness, just as he who spoke to Moses directed him to make it, according to the pattern that he had seen.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as He appointed, instructing Moses to make it according to the pattern that he had seen,
verses.textEnNlt: "Our ancestors carried the Tabernacle with them through the wilderness. It was constructed according to the plan God had shown to Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: "Our fathers had the tabernacle of testimony in the wilderness, just as He who spoke to Moses directed him to make it according to the pattern which he had seen.
verses.textEn: "Our ancestors had the tabernacle of the covenant law with them in the wilderness. It had been made as God directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.

verses.textZh: 我们的祖先相继承受了这帐幕，神把外族人从他们面前赶走以后，他们就同约书亚把帐幕带进所得为业的地方，直到大卫的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的祖先相继承受了这帐幕，神把外族人从他们面前赶走以后，他们就同约书亚把帐幕带进所得为业的地方，直到大卫的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 这帐幕，我们的祖宗相继承受。当神在他们面前赶出外邦人去的时候，他们同约书亚把帐幕搬进承受为业之地，直存到大卫的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: After receiving the tabernacle, our ancestors under Joshua brought it with them when they took the land from the nations God drove out before them. It remained in the land until the time of David,
verses.textEnEsv: Our fathers in turn brought it in with Joshua when they dispossessed the nations that God drove out before our fathers. So it was until the days of David,
verses.textEnNkjv: which our fathers, having received it in turn, also brought with Joshua into the land possessed by the Gentiles, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers until the days of David,
verses.textEnNlt: Years later, when Joshua led our ancestors in battle against the nations that God drove out of this land, the Tabernacle was taken with them into their new territory. And it stayed there until the time of King David.
verses.textEnNasb: Our fathers in turn received it, and they also brought it in with Joshua upon dispossessing the nations that God drove out from our fathers, until the time of David.
verses.textEn: After receiving the tabernacle, our ancestors under Joshua brought it with them when they took the land from the nations God drove out before them. It remained in the land until the time of David,

verses.textZh: 大卫在神面前蒙了恩，就求为雅各的神找个居所，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫在神面前蒙了恩，就求为雅各的神找个居所，
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫在神面前蒙恩，祈求为雅各的神预备居所；
verses.textEnNiv: who enjoyed God’s favor and asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: who found favor in the sight of God and asked to find a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: who found favor before God and asked to find a dwelling for the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: "David found favor with God and asked for the privilege of building a permanent Temple for the God of Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: David found favor in God’s sight, and asked that he might find a dwelling place for the house of Jacob.
verses.textEn: who enjoyed God’s favor and asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 而由所罗门为他建造殿宇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而由所罗门为他建造殿宇。
verses.textZhCuv: 却是所罗门为神造成殿宇。
verses.textEnNiv: But it was Solomon who built a house for him.
verses.textEnEsv: But it was Solomon who built a house for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Solomon built Him a house.
verses.textEnNlt: But it was Solomon who actually built it.
verses.textEnNasb: But it was Solomon who built a house for Him.
verses.textEn: But it was Solomon who built a house for him.

verses.textZh: 其实至高者并不住人手所造的，正如先知说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实至高者并不住人手所造的，正如先知说：
verses.textZhCuv: 其实，至高者并不住人手所造的，就如先知所言：
verses.textEnNiv: "However, the Most High does not live in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the Most High does not dwell in houses made by hands, as the prophet says,
verses.textEnNkjv: "However, the Most High does not dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says:
verses.textEnNlt: However, the Most High doesn’t live in temples made by human hands. As the prophet says,
verses.textEnNasb: However, the Most High does not dwell in houses made by human hands; as the prophet says:
verses.textEn: "However, the Most High does not live in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:

verses.textZh: ‘主说：天是我的宝座， 地是我的脚凳， 你们要为我建造怎样的殿呢？ 哪里是我安息的地方呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘主说：天是我的宝座， 地是我的脚凳， 你们要为我建造怎样的殿呢？ 哪里是我安息的地方呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 主说：天是我的座位， 地是我的脚凳； 你们要为我造何等的殿宇？ 哪里是我安息的地方呢？
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? says the Lord. Or where will my resting place be?
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me, says the Lord, or what is the place of my rest?
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Heaven is My throne, And earth is My footstool. What house will you build for Me? says the Lord, Or what is the place of My rest?
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. Could you build me a temple as good as that?’ asks the Lord . ‘Could you build me such a resting place?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Heaven is My throne, And the earth is the footstool of My feet; What kind of house will you build for Me?’ says the Lord, ‘Or what place is there for My rest?
verses.textEn: " ‘Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? says the Lord. Or where will my resting place be?

verses.textZh: 这一切不都是我手所造的吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切不都是我手所造的吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 这一切不都是我手所造的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Has not my hand made all these things?’
verses.textEnEsv: Did not my hand make all these things?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Has My hand not made all these things?’
verses.textEnNlt: Didn’t my hands make both heaven and earth?’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Was it not My hand that made all these things?’
verses.textEn: Has not my hand made all these things?’

verses.textZh: "你们颈项刚硬、心和耳都未受割礼的人哪！你们时常抗拒圣灵，你们的祖先怎样，你们也怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们颈项刚硬、心和耳都未受割礼的人哪！你们时常抗拒圣灵，你们的祖先怎样，你们也怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们这硬着颈项、心与耳未受割礼的人，常时抗拒圣灵！你们的祖宗怎样，你们也怎样。
verses.textEnNiv: "You stiff-necked people! Your hearts and ears are still uncircumcised. You are just like your ancestors: You always resist the Holy Spirit!
verses.textEnEsv: "You stiff-necked people, uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit. As your fathers did, so do you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, so do you.
verses.textEnNlt: "You stubborn people! You are heathen at heart and deaf to the truth. Must you forever resist the Holy Spirit? That’s what your ancestors did, and so do you!
verses.textEnNasb: "You men who are stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears are always resisting the Holy Spirit; you are doing just as your fathers did.
verses.textEn: "You stiff-necked people! Your hearts and ears are still uncircumcised. You are just like your ancestors: You always resist the Holy Spirit!

verses.textZh: 有哪一个先知，你们的祖先不迫害呢？你们杀了那些预先宣告那义者要来的人，现在又把那义者出卖了，杀害了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有哪一个先知，你们的祖先不迫害呢？你们杀了那些预先宣告那义者要来的人，现在又把那义者出卖了，杀害了。
verses.textZhCuv: 哪一个先知不是你们祖宗逼迫呢？他们也把预先传说那义者要来的人杀了；如今你们又把那义者卖了，杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: Was there ever a prophet your ancestors did not persecute? They even killed those who predicted the coming of the Righteous One. And now you have betrayed and murdered him—
verses.textEnEsv: Which of the prophets did your fathers not persecute? And they killed those who announced beforehand the coming of the Righteous One, whom you have now betrayed and murdered,
verses.textEnNkjv: Which of the prophets did your fathers not persecute? And they killed those who foretold the coming of the Just One, of whom you now have become the betrayers and murderers,
verses.textEnNlt: Name one prophet your ancestors didn’t persecute! They even killed the ones who predicted the coming of the Righteous One—the Messiah whom you betrayed and murdered.
verses.textEnNasb: Which one of the prophets did your fathers not persecute? They killed those who had previously announced the coming of the Righteous One, and you have now become betrayers and murderers of Him;
verses.textEn: Was there ever a prophet your ancestors did not persecute? They even killed those who predicted the coming of the Righteous One. And now you have betrayed and murdered him—

verses.textZh: 你们领受了由天使传达的律法，却不遵守。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们领受了由天使传达的律法，却不遵守。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们受了天使所传的律法，竟不遵守。」
verses.textEnNiv: you who have received the law that was given through angels but have not obeyed it."
verses.textEnEsv: you who received the law as delivered by angels and did not keep it."
verses.textEnNkjv: who have received the law by the direction of angels and have not kept it."
verses.textEnNlt: You deliberately disobeyed God’s law, even though you received it from the hands of angels."
verses.textEnNasb: you who received the Law as ordained by angels, and yet did not keep it."
verses.textEn: you who have received the law that was given through angels but have not obeyed it."

verses.textZh: 众人听了这些话，心中非常恼怒，就向着司提反咬牙切齿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人听了这些话，心中非常恼怒，就向着司提反咬牙切齿。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人听见这话就极其恼怒，向司提反咬牙切齿。
verses.textEnNiv: When the members of the Sanhedrin heard this, they were furious and gnashed their teeth at him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when they heard these things they were enraged, and they ground their teeth at him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they heard these things they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
verses.textEnNlt: The Jewish leaders were infuriated by Stephen’s accusation, and they shook their fists at him in rage.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they heard this, they were infuriated, and they began gnashing their teeth at him.
verses.textEn: When the members of the Sanhedrin heard this, they were furious and gnashed their teeth at him.

verses.textZh: 但司提反被圣灵充满，定睛望着天，看见神的荣耀，并且看见耶稣站在神的右边，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但司提反被圣灵充满，定睛望着天，看见神的荣耀，并且看见耶稣站在神的右边，
verses.textZhCuv: 但司提反被圣灵充满，定睛望天，看见神的荣耀，又看见耶稣站在神的右边，
verses.textEnNiv: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
verses.textEnEsv: But he, full of the Holy Spirit, gazed into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, gazed into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God,
verses.textEnNlt: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, gazed steadily into heaven and saw the glory of God, and he saw Jesus standing in the place of honor at God’s right hand.
verses.textEnNasb: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God;
verses.textEn: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.

verses.textZh: 就说："看哪！我看见天开了，人子站在神的右边。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就说："看哪！我看见天开了，人子站在神的右边。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就说：「我看见天开了，人子站在神的右边。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Look," he said, "I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: and said, "Look! I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!"
verses.textEnNlt: And he told them, "Look, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing in the place of honor at God’s right hand!"
verses.textEnNasb: and he said, "Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God."
verses.textEn: "Look," he said, "I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God."

verses.textZh: 众人大声喊叫，掩着耳朵，一齐向他冲过去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人大声喊叫，掩着耳朵，一齐向他冲过去，
verses.textZhCuv: 众人大声喊叫，捂着耳朵，齐心拥上前去，
verses.textEnNiv: At this they covered their ears and, yelling at the top of their voices, they all rushed at him,
verses.textEnEsv: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears and rushed together at him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they cried out with a loud voice, stopped their ears, and ran at him with one accord;
verses.textEnNlt: Then they put their hands over their ears and began shouting. They rushed at him
verses.textEnNasb: But they shouted with loud voices, and covered their ears and rushed at him with one mind.
verses.textEn: At this they covered their ears and, yelling at the top of their voices, they all rushed at him,

verses.textZh: 把他推出城外，用石头打他。那些证人把自己的衣服，放在一个名叫扫罗的青年人脚前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把他推出城外，用石头打他。那些证人把自己的衣服，放在一个名叫扫罗的青年人脚前。
verses.textZhCuv: 把他推到城外，用石头打他。作见证的人把衣裳放在一个少年人名叫扫罗的脚前。
verses.textEnNiv: dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile, the witnesses laid their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they cast him out of the city and stoned him. And the witnesses laid down their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they cast him out of the city and stoned him. And the witnesses laid down their clothes at the feet of a young man named Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: and dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. His accusers took off their coats and laid them at the feet of a young man named Saul.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had driven him out of the city, they began stoning him; and the witnesses laid aside their cloaks at the feet of a young man named Saul.
verses.textEn: dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile, the witnesses laid their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.

verses.textZh: 他们用石头打司提反的时候，他呼求说："主耶稣啊，求你接收我的灵魂！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用石头打司提反的时候，他呼求说："主耶稣啊，求你接收我的灵魂！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们正用石头打的时候，司提反呼吁主说：「求主耶稣接收我的灵魂！」
verses.textEnNiv: While they were stoning him, Stephen prayed, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were stoning Stephen, he called out, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they stoned Stephen as he was calling on God and saying, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."
verses.textEnNlt: As they stoned him, Stephen prayed, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."
verses.textEnNasb: They went on stoning Stephen as he called on the Lord and said, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!"
verses.textEn: While they were stoning him, Stephen prayed, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."

verses.textZh: 然后跪下来大声喊着说："主啊，不要把这罪归给他们！"说了这话，就睡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后跪下来大声喊着说："主啊，不要把这罪归给他们！"说了这话，就睡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又跪下大声喊着说：「主啊，不要将这罪归于他们！」说了这话，就睡了。扫罗也喜悦他被害。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he fell on his knees and cried out, "Lord, do not hold this sin against them." When he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.textEnEsv: And falling to his knees he cried out with a loud voice, "Lord, do not hold this sin against them." And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he knelt down and cried out with a loud voice, "Lord, do not charge them with this sin." And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.textEnNlt: He fell to his knees, shouting, "Lord, don’t charge them with this sin!" And with that, he died.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he fell on his knees and cried out with a loud voice, "Lord, do not hold this sin against them!" Having said this, he fell asleep.
verses.textEn: Then he fell on his knees and cried out, "Lord, do not hold this sin against them." When he had said this, he fell asleep.

verses.textZh: 司提反被害，扫罗也欣然同意。 从那天起，耶路撒冷的教会大受迫害；除了使徒以外，所有的人都分散到犹太和撒玛利亚各地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 司提反被害，扫罗也欣然同意。 从那天起，耶路撒冷的教会大受迫害；除了使徒以外，所有的人都分散到犹太和撒玛利亚各地。
verses.textZhCuv: 从这日起，耶路撒冷的教会大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，门徒都分散在犹太和撒马利亚各处。
verses.textEnNiv: And Saul approved of their killing him. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: And Saul approved of his execution. And there arose on that day a great persecution against the church in Jerusalem, and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Saul was consenting to his death. At that time a great persecution arose against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul was one of the witnesses, and he agreed completely with the killing of Stephen. A great wave of persecution began that day, sweeping over the church in Jerusalem; and all the believers except the apostles were scattered through the regions of Judea and Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Saul approved of putting Stephen to death. And on that day a great persecution began against the church in Jerusalem, and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.
verses.textEn: And Saul approved of their killing him. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.

verses.textZh: 有些虔诚的人安葬了司提反，为他大大悲痛一番。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些虔诚的人安葬了司提反，为他大大悲痛一番。
verses.textZhCuv: 有虔诚的人把司提反埋葬了，为他捶胸大哭。
verses.textEnNiv: Godly men buried Stephen and mourned deeply for him.
verses.textEnEsv: Devout men buried Stephen and made great lamentation over him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And devout men carried Stephen tohisburial, and made great lamentation over him.
verses.textEnNlt: (Some devout men came and buried Stephen with great mourning.)
verses.textEnNasb: Some devout men buried Stephen, and mourned loudly for him.
verses.textEn: Godly men buried Stephen and mourned deeply for him.

verses.textZh: 扫罗却残害教会，逐家进去，连男带女拉去坐监。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗却残害教会，逐家进去，连男带女拉去坐监。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗却残害教会，进各人的家，拉着男女下在监里。
verses.textEnNiv: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off both men and women and put them in prison.
verses.textEnEsv: But Saul was ravaging the church, and entering house after house, he dragged off men and women and committed them to prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for Saul, he made havoc of the church, entering every house, and dragging off men and women, committing them to prison.
verses.textEnNlt: But Saul was going everywhere to destroy the church. He went from house to house, dragging out both men and women to throw them into prison.
verses.textEnNasb: But Saul began ravaging the church, entering house after house; and he would drag away men and women and put them in prison.
verses.textEn: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off both men and women and put them in prison.

verses.textZh: 那些分散的人，经过各地，传扬福音真道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些分散的人，经过各地，传扬福音真道。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些分散的人往各处去传道。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.
verses.textEnEsv: Now those who were scattered went about preaching the word.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore those who were scattered went everywhere preaching the word.
verses.textEnNlt: But the believers who were scattered preached the Good News about Jesus wherever they went.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, those who had been scattered went through places preaching the word.
verses.textEn: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.

verses.textZh: 腓利下到撒玛利亚城，宣讲基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 腓利下到撒玛利亚城，宣讲基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 腓利下撒马利亚城去，宣讲基督。
verses.textEnNiv: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Messiah there.
verses.textEnEsv: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria and preached Christ to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Philip, for example, went to the city of Samaria and told the people there about the Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and began proclaiming the Christ to them.
verses.textEn: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Messiah there.

verses.textZh: 群众听了腓利所讲的，看见他所行的神迹，就同心听从了他的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众听了腓利所讲的，看见他所行的神迹，就同心听从了他的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人听见了，又看见腓利所行的神迹，就同心合意地听从他的话。
verses.textEnNiv: When the crowds heard Philip and saw the signs he performed, they all paid close attention to what he said.
verses.textEnEsv: And the crowds with one accord paid attention to what was being said by Philip, when they heard him and saw the signs that he did.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the multitudes with one accord heeded the things spoken by Philip, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
verses.textEnNlt: Crowds listened intently to Philip because they were eager to hear his message and see the miraculous signs he did.
verses.textEnNasb: The crowds were paying attention with one mind to what was being said by Philip, as they heard and saw the signs which he was performing.
verses.textEn: When the crowds heard Philip and saw the signs he performed, they all paid close attention to what he said.

verses.textZh: 许多人有污灵附在他们身上，污灵大声喊叫了之后，就出来了；还有许多瘫子瘸子都医好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 许多人有污灵附在他们身上，污灵大声喊叫了之后，就出来了；还有许多瘫子瘸子都医好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有许多人被污鬼附着，那些鬼大声呼叫，从他们身上出来；还有许多瘫痪的、瘸腿的，都得了医治。
verses.textEnNiv: For with shrieks, impure spirits came out of many, and many who were paralyzed or lame were healed.
verses.textEnEsv: For unclean spirits, crying out with a loud voice, came out of many who had them, and many who were paralyzed or lame were healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: For unclean spirits, crying with a loud voice, came out of many who were possessed; and many who were paralyzed and lame were healed.
verses.textEnNlt: Many evil spirits were cast out, screaming as they left their victims. And many who had been paralyzed or lame were healed.
verses.textEnNasb: For in the case of many who had unclean spirits, they were coming out of them shouting with a loud voice; and many who had been paralyzed or limped on crutches were healed.
verses.textEn: For with shrieks, impure spirits came out of many, and many who were paralyzed or lame were healed.

verses.textZh: 在那城里，就大有欢乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那城里，就大有欢乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那城里，就大有欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: So there was great joy in that city.
verses.textEnEsv: So there was much joy in that city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was great joy in that city.
verses.textEnNlt: So there was great joy in that city.
verses.textEnNasb: So there was much rejoicing in that city.
verses.textEn: So there was great joy in that city.

verses.textZh: 有一个人名叫西门，从前在城里行过邪术，使撒玛利亚的居民惊奇，他又自命不凡，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人名叫西门，从前在城里行过邪术，使撒玛利亚的居民惊奇，他又自命不凡，
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个人，名叫西门，向来在那城里行邪术，妄自尊大，使撒马利亚的百姓惊奇；
verses.textEnNiv: Now for some time a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and amazed all the people of Samaria. He boasted that he was someone great,
verses.textEnEsv: But there was a man named Simon, who had previously practiced magic in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, saying that he himself was somebody great.
verses.textEnNkjv: But there was a certain man called Simon, who previously practiced sorcery in the city and astonished the people of Samaria, claiming that he was someone great,
verses.textEnNlt: A man named Simon had been a sorcerer there for many years, amazing the people of Samaria and claiming to be someone great.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a man named Simon had previously been practicing magic in the city and astonishing the people of Samaria, claiming to be someone great;
verses.textEn: Now for some time a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and amazed all the people of Samaria. He boasted that he was someone great,

verses.textZh: 城里大大小小都听从他，说："这就是那称为‘神的大能’的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 城里大大小小都听从他，说："这就是那称为‘神的大能’的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 无论大小都听从他，说：「这人就是那称为神的大能者。」
verses.textEnNiv: and all the people, both high and low, gave him their attention and exclaimed, "This man is rightly called the Great Power of God."
verses.textEnEsv: They all paid attention to him, from the least to the greatest, saying, "This man is the power of God that is called Great."
verses.textEnNkjv: to whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, "This man is the great power of God."
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone, from the least to the greatest, often spoke of him as "the Great One—the Power of God."
verses.textEnNasb: and all the people, from small to great, were paying attention to him, saying, "This man is the Power of God that is called Great."
verses.textEn: and all the people, both high and low, gave him their attention and exclaimed, "This man is rightly called the Great Power of God."

verses.textZh: 他们听从他，因为他长久用邪术，使他们惊奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听从他，因为他长久用邪术，使他们惊奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们听从他，因他久用邪术，使他们惊奇。
verses.textEnNiv: They followed him because he had amazed them for a long time with his sorcery.
verses.textEnEsv: And they paid attention to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his magic.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they heeded him because he had astonished them with his sorceries for a long time.
verses.textEnNlt: They listened closely to him because for a long time he had astounded them with his magic.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were paying attention to him because for a long time he had astounded them with his magic arts.
verses.textEn: They followed him because he had amazed them for a long time with his sorcery.

verses.textZh: 等到腓利向他们传了神的国的福音，和耶稣基督的名，他们就信了腓利，连男带女都受了洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到腓利向他们传了神的国的福音，和耶稣基督的名，他们就信了腓利，连男带女都受了洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 及至他们信了腓利所传神国的福音和耶稣基督的名，连男带女就受了洗。
verses.textEnNiv: But when they believed Philip as he proclaimed the good news of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
verses.textEnEsv: But when they believed Philip as he preached good news about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they believed Philip as he preached the things concerning the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, both men and women were baptized.
verses.textEnNlt: But now the people believed Philip’s message of Good News concerning the Kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ. As a result, many men and women were baptized.
verses.textEnNasb: But when they believed Philip as he was preaching the good news about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, both men and women were being baptized.
verses.textEn: But when they believed Philip as he proclaimed the good news of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

verses.textZh: 连西门自己也信了，他受洗之后，常和腓利在一起，看见所发生的神迹和大能的事，就觉得很惊奇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 连西门自己也信了，他受洗之后，常和腓利在一起，看见所发生的神迹和大能的事，就觉得很惊奇。
verses.textZhCuv: 西门自己也信了；既受了洗，就常与腓利在一处，看见他所行的神迹和大异能，就甚惊奇。
verses.textEnNiv: Simon himself believed and was baptized. And he followed Philip everywhere, astonished by the great signs and miracles he saw.
verses.textEnEsv: Even Simon himself believed, and after being baptized he continued with Philip. And seeing signs and great miracles performed, he was amazed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Simon himself also believed; and when he was baptized he continued with Philip, and was amazed, seeing the miracles and signs which were done.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Simon himself believed and was baptized. He began following Philip wherever he went, and he was amazed by the signs and great miracles Philip performed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now even Simon himself believed; and after being baptized, he continued on with Philip, and as he observed signs and great miracles taking place, he was repeatedly amazed.
verses.textEn: Simon himself believed and was baptized. And he followed Philip everywhere, astonished by the great signs and miracles he saw.

verses.textZh: 在耶路撒冷的使徒，听见撒玛利亚居民领受了神的道，就差派彼得和约翰到他们那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶路撒冷的使徒，听见撒玛利亚居民领受了神的道，就差派彼得和约翰到他们那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒在耶路撒冷听见撒马利亚人领受了神的道，就打发彼得、约翰往他们那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had accepted the word of God, they sent Peter and John to Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the apostles at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent to them Peter and John,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
verses.textEnNlt: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that the people of Samaria had accepted God’s message, they sent Peter and John there.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent them Peter and John,
verses.textEn: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had accepted the word of God, they sent Peter and John to Samaria.

verses.textZh: 二人到了，就为大家祷告，要让他们接受圣灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 二人到了，就为大家祷告，要让他们接受圣灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 两个人到了，就为他们祷告，要叫他们受圣灵。
verses.textEnNiv: When they arrived, they prayed for the new believers there that they might receive the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnEsv: who came down and prayed for them that they might receive the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: who, when they had come down, prayed for them that they might receive the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as they arrived, they prayed for these new believers to receive the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: who came down and prayed for them that they would receive the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: When they arrived, they prayed for the new believers there that they might receive the Holy Spirit,

verses.textZh: 因为圣灵还没有降在他们任何一个身上，他们只是受了洗归入主耶稣的名下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为圣灵还没有降在他们任何一个身上，他们只是受了洗归入主耶稣的名下。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为圣灵还没有降在他们一个人身上，他们只奉主耶稣的名受了洗。
verses.textEnNiv: because the Holy Spirit had not yet come on any of them; they had simply been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: for he had not yet fallen on any of them, but they had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as yet He had fallen upon none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: The Holy Spirit had not yet come upon any of them, for they had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: (For He had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had simply been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
verses.textEn: because the Holy Spirit had not yet come on any of them; they had simply been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

verses.textZh: 于是使徒为他们按手，他们就受了圣灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是使徒为他们按手，他们就受了圣灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是使徒按手在他们头上，他们就受了圣灵。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Peter and John placed their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they laid their hands on them and they received the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they laid hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Peter and John laid their hands upon these believers, and they received the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they began laying their hands on them, and they were receiving the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: Then Peter and John placed their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 西门看见使徒一按手，就有圣灵赐下来，就拿钱给他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门看见使徒一按手，就有圣灵赐下来，就拿钱给他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 西门看见使徒按手，便有圣灵赐下，就拿钱给使徒，
verses.textEnNiv: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given at the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Simon saw that through the laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Spirit was given, he offered them money,
verses.textEnNlt: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given when the apostles laid their hands on people, he offered them money to buy this power.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
verses.textEn: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given at the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money

verses.textZh: 说："请把这权柄也给我，叫我为谁按手，谁就可以受圣灵。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："请把这权柄也给我，叫我为谁按手，谁就可以受圣灵。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「把这权柄也给我，叫我手按着谁，谁就可以受圣灵。」
verses.textEnNiv: and said, "Give me also this ability so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "Give me this power also, so that anyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "Give me this power also, that anyone on whom I lay hands may receive the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNlt: "Let me have this power, too," he exclaimed, "so that when I lay my hands on people, they will receive the Holy Spirit!"
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "Give this authority to me as well, so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEn: and said, "Give me also this ability so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit."

verses.textZh: 彼得对他说："你的银子跟你一同灭亡吧！因为你以为神的恩赐，是可以用钱买的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得对他说："你的银子跟你一同灭亡吧！因为你以为神的恩赐，是可以用钱买的。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得说：「你的银子和你一同灭亡吧！因你想神的恩赐是可以用钱买的。
verses.textEnNiv: Peter answered: "May your money perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter said to him, "May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter said to him, "Your money perish with you, because you thought that the gift of God could be purchased with money!
verses.textEnNlt: But Peter replied, "May your money be destroyed with you for thinking God’s gift can be bought!
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter said to him, "May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could acquire the gift of God with money!
verses.textEn: Peter answered: "May your money perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!

verses.textZh: 你和这件事是毫无关系的，因为你在神面前存心不正。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和这件事是毫无关系的，因为你在神面前存心不正。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在这道上无分无关；因为在神面前，你的心不正。
verses.textEnNiv: You have no part or share in this ministry, because your heart is not right before God.
verses.textEnEsv: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart is not right before God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have neither part nor portion in this matter, for your heart is not right in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNlt: You can have no part in this, for your heart is not right with God.
verses.textEnNasb: You have no part or share in this matter, for your heart is not right before God.
verses.textEn: You have no part or share in this ministry, because your heart is not right before God.

verses.textZh: 所以，你要悔改离弃这罪恶，要祈求主，也许你心中的意念可以得到赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你要悔改离弃这罪恶，要祈求主，也许你心中的意念可以得到赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当懊悔你这罪恶，祈求主，或者你心里的意念可得赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: Repent of this wickedness and pray to the Lord in the hope that he may forgive you for having such a thought in your heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Repent, therefore, of this wickedness of yours, and pray to the Lord that, if possible, the intent of your heart may be forgiven you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Repent therefore of this your wickedness, and pray God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
verses.textEnNlt: Repent of your wickedness and pray to the Lord. Perhaps he will forgive your evil thoughts,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, repent of this wickedness of yours, and pray to the Lord that, if possible, the intention of your heart will be forgiven you.
verses.textEn: Repent of this wickedness and pray to the Lord in the hope that he may forgive you for having such a thought in your heart.

verses.textZh: 我看出你正在苦胆之中，邪恶捆绑着你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看出你正在苦胆之中，邪恶捆绑着你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我看出你正在苦胆之中，被罪恶捆绑。」
verses.textEnNiv: For I see that you are full of bitterness and captive to sin."
verses.textEnEsv: For I see that you are in the gall of bitterness and in the bond of iniquity."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and bound by iniquity."
verses.textEnNlt: for I can see that you are full of bitter jealousy and are held captive by sin."
verses.textEnNasb: For I see that you are in the gall of bitterness and in the bondage of unrighteousness."
verses.textEn: For I see that you are full of bitterness and captive to sin."

verses.textZh: 西门回答："请你们为我求主，好让你们所说的，没有一样临到我身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 西门回答："请你们为我求主，好让你们所说的，没有一样临到我身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 西门说：「愿你们为我求主，叫你们所说的，没有一样临到我身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Simon answered, "Pray to the Lord for me so that nothing you have said may happen to me."
verses.textEnEsv: And Simon answered, "Pray for me to the Lord, that nothing of what you have said may come upon me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Simon answered and said, "Pray to the Lord for me, that none of the things which you have spoken may come upon me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Pray to the Lord for me," Simon exclaimed, "that these terrible things you’ve said won’t happen to me!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Simon answered and said, "Pray to the Lord for me yourselves, so that nothing of what you have said may come upon me."
verses.textEn: Then Simon answered, "Pray to the Lord for me so that nothing you have said may happen to me."

verses.textZh: 使徒作了见证，讲了主的道，就回耶路撒冷去，一路上在撒玛利亚人的许多村庄里传扬福音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒作了见证，讲了主的道，就回耶路撒冷去，一路上在撒玛利亚人的许多村庄里传扬福音。
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒既证明主道，而且传讲，就回耶路撒冷去，一路在撒马利亚好些村庄传扬福音。
verses.textEnNiv: After they had further proclaimed the word of the Lord and testified about Jesus, Peter and John returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many Samaritan villages.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel to many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.textEnNlt: After testifying and preaching the word of the Lord in Samaria, Peter and John returned to Jerusalem. And they stopped in many Samaritan villages along the way to preach the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: So, when they had solemnly testified and spoken the word of the Lord, they started back to Jerusalem, and were preaching the gospel to many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.textEn: After they had further proclaimed the word of the Lord and testified about Jesus, Peter and John returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many Samaritan villages.

verses.textZh: 有主的一位使者对腓利说："起来，向南走，往那从耶路撒冷下迦萨的路上去。"那条路在旷野里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有主的一位使者对腓利说："起来，向南走，往那从耶路撒冷下迦萨的路上去。"那条路在旷野里。
verses.textZhCuv: 有主的一个使者对腓利说：「起来！向南走，往那从耶路撒冷下迦萨的路上去。」那路是旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, "Go south to the road—the desert road—that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza."
verses.textEnEsv: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, "Rise and go toward the south to the road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza." This is a desert place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, "Arise and go toward the south along the road which goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza." This is desert.
verses.textEnNlt: As for Philip, an angel of the Lord said to him, "Go south down the desert road that runs from Jerusalem to Gaza."
verses.textEnNasb: But an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, "Get ready and go south to the road that descends from Jerusalem to Gaza." ( This is a desert road.)
verses.textEn: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, "Go south to the road—the desert road—that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza."

verses.textZh: 他就动身去了。有一个衣索匹亚人，是衣索匹亚女王干大基有权力的太监，掌管女王全部国库。他上耶路撒冷去礼拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就动身去了。有一个衣索匹亚人，是衣索匹亚女王干大基有权力的太监，掌管女王全部国库。他上耶路撒冷去礼拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 腓利就起身去了，不料，有一个衣索匹亚 人，是个有大权的太监，在衣索匹亚女王甘大基的手下总管银库，他上耶路撒冷礼拜去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, an important official in charge of all the treasury of the Kandake (which means "queen of the Ethiopians"). This man had gone to Jerusalem to worship,
verses.textEnEsv: And he rose and went. And there was an Ethiopian, a eunuch, a court official of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was in charge of all her treasure. He had come to Jerusalem to worship
verses.textEnNkjv: So he arose and went. And behold, a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace the queen of the Ethiopians, who had charge of all her treasury, and had come to Jerusalem to worship,
verses.textEnNlt: So he started out, and he met the treasurer of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under the Kandake, the queen of Ethiopia. The eunuch had gone to Jerusalem to worship,
verses.textEnNasb: So he got ready and went; and there was an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was in charge of all her treasure; and he had come to Jerusalem to worship,
verses.textEn: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, an important official in charge of all the treasury of the Kandake (which means "queen of the Ethiopians"). This man had gone to Jerusalem to worship,

verses.textZh: 他回去的时候，坐在车上读以赛亚先知的书。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回去的时候，坐在车上读以赛亚先知的书。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在回来，在车上坐着，念先知以赛亚的书。
verses.textEnNiv: and on his way home was sitting in his chariot reading the Book of Isaiah the prophet.
verses.textEnEsv: and was returning, seated in his chariot, and he was reading the prophet Isaiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: was returning. And sitting in his chariot, he was reading Isaiah the prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: and he was now returning. Seated in his carriage, he was reading aloud from the book of the prophet Isaiah.
verses.textEnNasb: and he was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading Isaiah the prophet.
verses.textEn: and on his way home was sitting in his chariot reading the Book of Isaiah the prophet.

verses.textZh: 圣灵对腓利说："你往前去，靠近那车子！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵对腓利说："你往前去，靠近那车子！"
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵对腓利说：「你去！贴近那车走。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit told Philip, "Go to that chariot and stay near it."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Spirit said to Philip, "Go over and join this chariot."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit said to Philip, "Go near and overtake this chariot."
verses.textEnNlt: The Holy Spirit said to Philip, "Go over and walk along beside the carriage."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Spirit said to Philip, "Go up and join this chariot."
verses.textEn: The Spirit told Philip, "Go to that chariot and stay near it."

verses.textZh: 腓利就跑过去，听见他读以赛亚先知的书，就问他："你所读的，你明白吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 腓利就跑过去，听见他读以赛亚先知的书，就问他："你所读的，你明白吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 腓利就跑到太监那里，听见他念先知以赛亚的书，便问他说：「你所念的，你明白吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Philip ran up to the chariot and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. "Do you understand what you are reading?" Philip asked.
verses.textEnEsv: So Philip ran to him and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet and asked, "Do you understand what you are reading?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So Philip ran to him, and heard him reading the prophet Isaiah, and said, "Do you understand what you are reading?"
verses.textEnNlt: Philip ran over and heard the man reading from the prophet Isaiah. Philip asked, "Do you understand what you are reading?"
verses.textEnNasb: Philip ran up and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, "Do you understand what you are reading?"
verses.textEn: Then Philip ran up to the chariot and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. "Do you understand what you are reading?" Philip asked.

verses.textZh: 他说："没有人指导我，怎能明白呢？"于是请腓利上车，同他坐在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："没有人指导我，怎能明白呢？"于是请腓利上车，同他坐在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「没有人指教我，怎能明白呢？」于是请腓利上车，与他同坐。
verses.textEnNiv: "How can I," he said, "unless someone explains it to me?" So he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "How can I, unless someone guides me?" And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "How can I, unless someone guides me?" And he asked Philip to come up and sit with him.
verses.textEnNlt: The man replied, "How can I, unless someone instructs me?" And he urged Philip to come up into the carriage and sit with him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Well, how could I, unless someone guides me?" And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
verses.textEn: "How can I," he said, "unless someone explains it to me?" So he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.

verses.textZh: 他所读的那段经文，就是： "他像羊被牵去宰杀， 又像羊羔在剪毛的人面前无声， 他总是这样不开口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所读的那段经文，就是： "他像羊被牵去宰杀， 又像羊羔在剪毛的人面前无声， 他总是这样不开口。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所念的那段经，说： 他像羊被牵到宰杀之地， 又像羊羔在剪毛的人手下无声； 他也是这样不开口。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the passage of Scripture the eunuch was reading: "He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before its shearer is silent, so he did not open his mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the passage of the Scripture that he was reading was this: "Like a sheep he was led to the slaughter and like a lamb before its shearer is silent, so he opens not his mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The place in the Scripture which he read was this: "He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; And as a lamb before its shearer is silent, So He opened not His mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: The passage of Scripture he had been reading was this: "He was led like a sheep to the slaughter. And as a lamb is silent before the shearers, he did not open his mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the passage of Scripture which he was reading was this: "He was led like a sheep to slaughter; And like a lamb that is silent before its shearer, So He does not open His mouth.
verses.textEn: This is the passage of Scripture the eunuch was reading: "He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before its shearer is silent, so he did not open his mouth.

verses.textZh: 他受屈辱的时候， 得不到公平的审判， 谁能说出他的身世呢？ 因为他的生命从地上被夺去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他受屈辱的时候， 得不到公平的审判， 谁能说出他的身世呢？ 因为他的生命从地上被夺去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他卑微的时候， 人不按公义审判他 ； 谁能述说他的世代？ 因为他的生命从地上夺去。
verses.textEnNiv: In his humiliation he was deprived of justice. Who can speak of his descendants? For his life was taken from the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: In his humiliation justice was denied him. Who can describe his generation? For his life is taken away from the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: In His humiliation His justice was taken away, And who will declare His generation? For His life is taken from the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: He was humiliated and received no justice. Who can speak of his descendants? For his life was taken from the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: "In humiliation His justice was taken away; Who will describe His generation? For His life is taken away from the earth."
verses.textEn: In his humiliation he was deprived of justice. Who can speak of his descendants? For his life was taken from the earth."

verses.textZh: 太监对腓利说："请问先知这话是指谁说的？指他自己呢？还是指别人？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 太监对腓利说："请问先知这话是指谁说的？指他自己呢？还是指别人？"
verses.textZhCuv: 太监对腓利说：「请问，先知说这话是指着谁？是指着自己呢？是指着别人呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The eunuch asked Philip, "Tell me, please, who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the eunuch said to Philip, "About whom, I ask you, does the prophet say this, about himself or about someone else?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the eunuch answered Philip and said, "I ask you, of whom does the prophet say this, of himself or of some other man?"
verses.textEnNlt: The eunuch asked Philip, "Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or someone else?"
verses.textEnNasb: The eunuch answered Philip and said, "Please tell me, of whom does the prophet say this? Of himself, or of someone else?"
verses.textEn: The eunuch asked Philip, "Tell me, please, who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?"

verses.textZh: 腓利就开口，从这段经文开始，向他传讲耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 腓利就开口，从这段经文开始，向他传讲耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 腓利就开口从这经上起，对他传讲耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Philip began with that very passage of Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning with this Scripture he told him the good news about Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning at this Scripture, preached Jesus to him.
verses.textEnNlt: So beginning with this same Scripture, Philip told him the Good News about Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture he preached Jesus to him.
verses.textEn: Then Philip began with that very passage of Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他们一路走，到了有水的地方，太监说："你看，这里有水，有甚么可以阻止我受洗呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们一路走，到了有水的地方，太监说："你看，这里有水，有甚么可以阻止我受洗呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 二人正往前走，到了有水的地方，太监说：「看哪，这里有水，我受洗有什么妨碍呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: As they traveled along the road, they came to some water and the eunuch said, "Look, here is water. What can stand in the way of my being baptized?"
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were going along the road they came to some water, and the eunuch said, "See, here is water! What prevents me from being baptized?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they went down the road, they came to some water. And the eunuch said, "See, hereis water. What hinders me from being baptized?"
verses.textEnNlt: As they rode along, they came to some water, and the eunuch said, "Look! There’s some water! Why can’t I be baptized?"
verses.textEnNasb: As they went along the road they came to some water; and the eunuch *said, "Look! Water! What prevents me from being baptized?"
verses.textEn: As they traveled along the road, they came to some water and the eunuch said, "Look, here is water. What can stand in the way of my being baptized?"

verses.textZh: 于是太监吩咐停车，腓利和他两人下到水中，腓利就给他施洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是太监吩咐停车，腓利和他两人下到水中，腓利就给他施洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是吩咐车站住，腓利和太监二人同下水里去，腓利就给他施洗。
verses.textEnNiv: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water and Philip baptized him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he commanded the chariot to stop, and they both went down into the water, Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Philip said, "If you believe with all your heart, you may." And he answered and said, "I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God."
verses.textEnNlt: He ordered the carriage to stop, and they went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he ordered that the chariot stop; and they both went down into the water, Philip as well as the eunuch, and he baptized him.
verses.textEn: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water and Philip baptized him.

verses.textZh: 他们从水里上来的时候，主的灵就把腓利提去了，太监再也看不见他，就欢欢喜喜地上路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从水里上来的时候，主的灵就把腓利提去了，太监再也看不见他，就欢欢喜喜地上路。
verses.textZhCuv: 从水里上来，主的灵把腓利提了去，太监也不再见他了，就欢欢喜喜地走路。
verses.textEnNiv: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away, and the eunuch did not see him again, but went on his way rejoicing.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away, and the eunuch saw him no more, and went on his way rejoicing.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he commanded the chariot to stand still. And both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and he baptized him.
verses.textEnNlt: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord snatched Philip away. The eunuch never saw him again but went on his way rejoicing.
verses.textEnNasb: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord snatched Philip away; and the eunuch no longer saw him, but went on his way rejoicing.
verses.textEn: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away, and the eunuch did not see him again, but went on his way rejoicing.

verses.textZh: 后来有人在亚锁都遇见腓利。他走遍各城，传讲福音，直到该撒利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来有人在亚锁都遇见腓利。他走遍各城，传讲福音，直到该撒利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来有人在亚锁都遇见腓利；他走遍那地方，在各城宣传福音，直到凯撒利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: Philip, however, appeared at Azotus and traveled about, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he reached Caesarea.
verses.textEnEsv: But Philip found himself at Azotus, and as he passed through he preached the gospel to all the towns until he came to Caesarea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, so that the eunuch saw him no more; and he went on his way rejoicing.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Philip found himself farther north at the town of Azotus. He preached the Good News there and in every town along the way until he came to Caesarea.
verses.textEnNasb: But Philip found himself at Azotus, and as he passed through he kept preaching the gospel to all the cities, until he came to Caesarea.
verses.textEn: Philip, however, appeared at Azotus and traveled about, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he reached Caesarea.

verses.textZh: 扫罗仍向主的门徒发恐吓凶杀的话。他到大祭司那里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗仍向主的门徒发恐吓凶杀的话。他到大祭司那里，
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗仍然向主的门徒口吐威吓凶杀的话，去见大祭司，
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the Lord’s disciples. He went to the high priest
verses.textEnEsv: But Saul, still breathing threats and murder against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul, still breathing threats and murder against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Saul was uttering threats with every breath and was eager to kill the Lord’s followers. So he went to the high priest.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Saul, still breathing threats and murder against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the Lord’s disciples. He went to the high priest

verses.textZh: 要求他发公函给大马士革各会堂，如果发现奉行这道的人，准他连男带女缉拿到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要求他发公函给大马士革各会堂，如果发现奉行这道的人，准他连男带女缉拿到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 求文书给大马士革的各会堂，若是找着信奉这道的人，无论男女，都准他捆绑带到耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: and asked him for letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any there who belonged to the Way, whether men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: and asked him for letters to the synagogues at Damascus, so that if he found any belonging to the Way, men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: and asked letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, so that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: He requested letters addressed to the synagogues in Damascus, asking for their cooperation in the arrest of any followers of the Way he found there. He wanted to bring them—both men and women—back to Jerusalem in chains.
verses.textEnNasb: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any belonging to the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them in shackles to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: and asked him for letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any there who belonged to the Way, whether men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他快到大马士革的时候，忽然有光从天上向他四面照射。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他快到大马士革的时候，忽然有光从天上向他四面照射。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗行路，将到大马士革，忽然从天上发光，四面照着他；
verses.textEnNiv: As he neared Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now as he went on his way, he approached Damascus, and suddenly a light from heaven shone around him.
verses.textEnNkjv: As he journeyed he came near Damascus, and suddenly a light shone around him from heaven.
