verses.textEnNlt: As he was approaching Damascus on this mission, a light from heaven suddenly shone down around him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as he was traveling, it happened that he was approaching Damascus, and suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him;
verses.textEn: As he neared Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.

verses.textZh: 他仆倒在地，听见有声音对他说："<red>扫罗，扫罗！你为甚么迫害我？</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他仆倒在地，听见有声音对他说："<red>扫罗，扫罗！你为甚么迫害我？</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 他就仆倒在地，听见有声音对他说：「<red>扫罗！扫罗！你为什么逼迫我？</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, <red>“Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And falling to the ground, he heard a voice saying to him, "Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he fell to the ground, and heard a voice saying to him, "Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?"
verses.textEnNlt: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to him, "Saul! Saul! Why are you persecuting me?"
verses.textEnNasb: and he fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to him, "Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?"
verses.textEn: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, <red>“Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”</red>

verses.textZh: 他说："<red>主啊，你是谁？</red>"主说："<red>我就是你所迫害的耶稣。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："<red>主啊，你是谁？</red>"主说："<red>我就是你所迫害的耶稣。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「<red>主啊！你是谁？</red>」主说：「我就是你所逼迫的耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: “Who are you, Lord?” Saul asked. <red>“Ip am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,”</red> he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Who are you, Lord?" And he said, "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Who are You, Lord?" Then the Lord said, "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.It is hard for you to kick against the goads."
verses.textEnNlt: "Who are you, lord?" Saul asked. And the voice replied, "I am Jesus, the one you are persecuting!
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Who are You, Lord?" And He said,"I am Jesus whom you are persecuting,
verses.textEn: “Who are you, Lord?” Saul asked. <red>“Ip am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,”</red> he replied.

verses.textZh: <red>起来，进城去！你应当作的事，一定有人告诉你。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>起来，进城去！你应当作的事，一定有人告诉你。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>起来！进城去，你所当做的事，必有人告诉你。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>“Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But rise and enter the city, and you will be told what you are to do."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he, trembling and astonished, said, "Lord, what do You want me to do?" Then the Lord said to him, "Arise and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do."
verses.textEnNlt: Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do."
verses.textEnNasb: but get up and enter the city, and it will be told to you what you must do."
verses.textEn: <red>“Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”</red>

verses.textZh: 同行的人，听见声音，却看不见人，只是目瞪口呆地站在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 同行的人，听见声音，却看不见人，只是目瞪口呆地站在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 同行的人站在那里，说不出话来，听见声音，却看不见人。
verses.textEnNiv: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless; they heard the sound but did not see anyone.
verses.textEnEsv: The men who were traveling with him stood speechless, hearing the voice but seeing no one.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men who journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice but seeing no one.
verses.textEnNlt: The men with Saul stood speechless, for they heard the sound of someone’s voice but saw no one!
verses.textEnNasb: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the voice but seeing no one.
verses.textEn: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless; they heard the sound but did not see anyone.

verses.textZh: 扫罗从地上爬起来，睁开眼睛，却甚么也看不见。他们牵着他的手，领他进大马士革。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗从地上爬起来，睁开眼睛，却甚么也看不见。他们牵着他的手，领他进大马士革。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗从地上起来，睁开眼睛，竟不能看见什么。有人拉他的手，领他进了大马士革；
verses.textEnNiv: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could see nothing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.
verses.textEnEsv: Saul rose from the ground, and although his eyes were opened, he saw nothing. So they led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened he saw no one. But they led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul picked himself up off the ground, but when he opened his eyes he was blind. So his companions led him by the hand to Damascus.
verses.textEnNasb: Saul got up from the ground, and though his eyes were open, he could see nothing; and leading him by the hand, they brought him into Damascus.
verses.textEn: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could see nothing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.

verses.textZh: 他三天都不能看见甚么，不吃也不喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他三天都不能看见甚么，不吃也不喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 三日不能看见，也不吃也不喝。
verses.textEnNiv: For three days he was blind, and did not eat or drink anything.
verses.textEnEsv: And for three days he was without sight, and neither ate nor drank.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither ate nor drank.
verses.textEnNlt: He remained there blind for three days and did not eat or drink.
verses.textEnNasb: And for three days he was without sight, and neither ate nor drank.
verses.textEn: For three days he was blind, and did not eat or drink anything.

verses.textZh: 在大马士革，有一个门徒名叫亚拿尼亚，主在异象中对他说："<red>亚拿尼亚！</red>"他说："<red>主啊，我在这里。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在大马士革，有一个门徒名叫亚拿尼亚，主在异象中对他说："<red>亚拿尼亚！</red>"他说："<red>主啊，我在这里。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，在大马士革有一个门徒，名叫亚拿尼亚。主在异象中对他说：「<red>亚拿尼亚。</red>」他说：「<red>主，我在这里。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord called to him in a vision, <red>“Ananias!”</red> “Yes, Lord,” he answered.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was a disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, "Ananias." And he said, "Here I am, Lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias; and to him the Lord said in a vision, "Ananias." And he said, "Here I am, Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Now there was a believer in Damascus named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, calling, "Ananias!" "Yes, Lord!" he replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a disciple in Damascus named Ananias; and the Lord said to him in a vision, "Ananias." And he said, "Here I am, Lord."
verses.textEn: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord called to him in a vision, <red>“Ananias!”</red> “Yes, Lord,” he answered.

verses.textZh: 主说："<red>起来，到那叫直街的路上去，要在犹大家里找一个大数人，名叫扫罗。你看，他正在祷告，</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 主说："<red>起来，到那叫直街的路上去，要在犹大家里找一个大数人，名叫扫罗。你看，他正在祷告，</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主对他说：「起来！往直街去，在犹大的家里，访问一个大数人，名叫扫罗。他正祷告，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord told him, <red>“Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to him, "Rise and go to the street called Straight, and at the house of Judas look for a man of Tarsus named Saul, for behold, he is praying,
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to him, "Arise and go to the street called Straight, and inquire at the house of Judas for one called Saul of Tarsus, for behold, he is praying.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said, "Go over to Straight Street, to the house of Judas. When you get there, ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul. He is praying to me right now.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to him, "Get up and go to the street called Straight, and inquire at the house of Judas for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying,
verses.textEn: The Lord told him, <red>“Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>在异象中他看见一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，进来为他按手，使他可以再看得见。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>在异象中他看见一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，进来为他按手，使他可以再看得见。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>又看见了一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，进来按手在他身上，叫他能看见。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and he has seen in a vision a man named Ananias come in and lay his hands on him so that he might regain his sight."
verses.textEnNkjv: And in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and putting his hand on him, so that he might receive his sight."
verses.textEnNlt: I have shown him a vision of a man named Ananias coming in and laying hands on him so he can see again."
verses.textEnNasb: and he has seen in a vision a man named Ananias come in and lay his hands on him, so that he might regain his sight."
verses.textEn: <red>In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”</red>

verses.textZh: 但亚拿尼亚回答："主啊，我听见许多人说起这个人，他在耶路撒冷作了许多苦害你圣徒的事；
verses.textZhCnvs: 但亚拿尼亚回答："主啊，我听见许多人说起这个人，他在耶路撒冷作了许多苦害你圣徒的事；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚拿尼亚回答说：「主啊，我听见许多人说，这人怎样在耶路撒冷多多苦害你的圣徒，
verses.textEnNiv: "Lord," Ananias answered, "I have heard many reports about this man and all the harm he has done to your holy people in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: But Ananias answered, "Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he has done to your saints at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ananias answered, "Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: "But Lord," exclaimed Ananias, "I’ve heard many people talk about the terrible things this man has done to the believers in Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNasb: But Ananias answered, "Lord, I have heard from many people about this man, how much harm he did to Your saints in Jerusalem;
verses.textEn: "Lord," Ananias answered, "I have heard many reports about this man and all the harm he has done to your holy people in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 并且他在这里得到祭司长的授权，要捆绑所有求告你名的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且他在这里得到祭司长的授权，要捆绑所有求告你名的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且他在这里有从祭司长得来的权柄捆绑一切求告你名的人。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he has come here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on your name."
verses.textEnEsv: And here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name."
verses.textEnNkjv: And here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on Your name."
verses.textEnNlt: And he is authorized by the leading priests to arrest everyone who calls upon your name."
verses.textEnNasb: and here he has authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name."
verses.textEn: And he has come here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on your name."

verses.textZh: 主对他说："<red>你去吧！这人是我拣选的器皿，为要把我的名传给外族人、君王和以色列人。</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 主对他说："<red>你去吧！这人是我拣选的器皿，为要把我的名传给外族人、君王和以色列人。</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主对亚拿尼亚说：「你只管去！他是我所拣选的器皿，要在外邦人和君王，并以色列人面前宣扬我的名。</red>
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord said to Ananias, <red>“Go! This man is my chosen instrument to proclaim my name to the Gentiles and their kings and to the people of Israel.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord said to him, "Go, for he is a chosen instrument of mine to carry my name before the Gentiles and kings and the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord said to him, "Go, for he is a chosen vessel of Mine to bear My name before Gentiles, kings, and the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said, "Go, for Saul is my chosen instrument to take my message to the Gentiles and to kings, as well as to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to him, "Go, for he is a chosen instrument of Mine, to bear My name before the Gentiles and kings and the sons of Israel;
verses.textEn: But the Lord said to Ananias, <red>“Go! This man is my chosen instrument to proclaim my name to the Gentiles and their kings and to the people of Israel.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我要指示他，为了我的名他必须受许多的苦。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我要指示他，为了我的名他必须受许多的苦。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我也要指示他，为我的名必须受许多的苦难。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>I will show him how much he must suffer for my name.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: For I will show him how much he must suffer for the sake of my name."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for My name’s sake."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will show him how much he must suffer for my name’s sake."
verses.textEnNasb: for I will show him how much he must suffer in behalf of My name."
verses.textEn: <red>I will show him how much he must suffer for my name.”</red>

verses.textZh: 亚拿尼亚就去了，进了那家，为扫罗按手，说："扫罗弟兄，在你来的路上向你显现的耶稣，就是主，差我来使你可以看见，又被圣灵充满。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚拿尼亚就去了，进了那家，为扫罗按手，说："扫罗弟兄，在你来的路上向你显现的耶稣，就是主，差我来使你可以看见，又被圣灵充满。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚拿尼亚就去了，进入那家，把手按在扫罗身上，说：「兄弟扫罗，在你来的路上向你显现的主，就是耶稣，打发我来，叫你能看见，又被圣灵充满。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Ananias went to the house and entered it. Placing his hands on Saul, he said, "Brother Saul, the Lord—Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here—has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnEsv: So Ananias departed and entered the house. And laying his hands on him he said, "Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus who appeared to you on the road by which you came has sent me so that you may regain your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ananias went his way and entered the house; and laying his hands on him he said, "Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNlt: So Ananias went and found Saul. He laid his hands on him and said, "Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road, has sent me so that you might regain your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNasb: So Ananias departed and entered the house, and after laying his hands on him said, "Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road by which you were coming, has sent me so that you may regain your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit."
verses.textEn: Then Ananias went to the house and entered it. Placing his hands on Saul, he said, "Brother Saul, the Lord—Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here—has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit."

verses.textZh: 立刻有鳞状的东西，从扫罗的眼里掉下来，他就能看见了。于是起来，受了洗，
verses.textZhCnvs: 立刻有鳞状的东西，从扫罗的眼里掉下来，他就能看见了。于是起来，受了洗，
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗的眼睛上，好像有鳞立刻掉下来，他就能看见。于是起来受了洗；
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and he could see again. He got up and was baptized,
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he regained his sight. Then he rose and was baptized;
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately there fell from his eyes something like scales, and he received his sight at once; and he arose and was baptized.
verses.textEnNlt: Instantly something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and he regained his sight. Then he got up and was baptized.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately something like fish scales fell from his eyes, and he regained his sight, and he got up and was baptized;
verses.textEn: Immediately, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and he could see again. He got up and was baptized,

verses.textZh: 吃过了饭，就有气力了。 他和大马士革的门徒一同住了几天，
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃过了饭，就有气力了。 他和大马士革的门徒一同住了几天，
verses.textZhCuv: 吃过饭就健壮了。 扫罗和大马士革的门徒同住了些日子，
verses.textEnNiv: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. Saul spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.
verses.textEnEsv: and taking food, he was strengthened. For some days he was with the disciples at Damascus.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when he had received food, he was strengthened. Then Saul spent some days with the disciples at Damascus.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward he ate some food and regained his strength. Saul stayed with the believers in Damascus for a few days.
verses.textEnNasb: and he took food and was strengthened. Now for several days he was with the disciples who were in Damascus,
verses.textEn: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. Saul spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.

verses.textZh: 随即在各会堂传讲耶稣，说他是神的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 随即在各会堂传讲耶稣，说他是神的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 就在各会堂里宣传耶稣，说他是神的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: At once he began to preach in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And immediately he proclaimed Jesus in the synagogues, saying, "He is the Son of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Immediately he preached the Christ in the synagogues, that He is the Son of God.
verses.textEnNlt: And immediately he began preaching about Jesus in the synagogues, saying, "He is indeed the Son of God!"
verses.textEnNasb: and immediately he began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, saying, "He is the Son of God."
verses.textEn: At once he began to preach in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.

verses.textZh: 听见的人都很惊奇，说："在耶路撒冷残害求告这名的，不是这个人吗？他来这里不是要缉拿他们交给祭司长吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 听见的人都很惊奇，说："在耶路撒冷残害求告这名的，不是这个人吗？他来这里不是要缉拿他们交给祭司长吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡听见的人都惊奇，说：「在耶路撒冷残害求告这名的，不是这人吗？并且他到这里来，特要捆绑他们，带到祭司长那里。」
verses.textEnNiv: All those who heard him were astonished and asked, "Isn’t he the man who raised havoc in Jerusalem among those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?"
verses.textEnEsv: And all who heard him were amazed and said, "Is not this the man who made havoc in Jerusalem of those who called upon this name? And has he not come here for this purpose, to bring them bound before the chief priests?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all who heard were amazed, and said, "Is this not he who destroyed those who called on this name in Jerusalem, and has come here for that purpose, so that he might bring them bound to the chief priests?"
verses.textEnNlt: All who heard him were amazed. "Isn’t this the same man who caused such devastation among Jesus’ followers in Jerusalem?" they asked. "And didn’t he come here to arrest them and take them in chains to the leading priests?"
verses.textEnNasb: All those hearing him continued to be amazed, and were saying, "Is this not the one who in Jerusalem destroyed those who called on this name, and had come here for the purpose of bringing them bound before the chief priests?"
verses.textEn: All those who heard him were astonished and asked, "Isn’t he the man who raised havoc in Jerusalem among those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?"

verses.textZh: 然而扫罗更加有能力，驳倒住在大马士革的犹太人，证明耶稣是基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而扫罗更加有能力，驳倒住在大马士革的犹太人，证明耶稣是基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 但扫罗越发有能力，驳倒住大马士革的犹太人，证明耶稣是基督。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet Saul grew more and more powerful and baffled the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Messiah.
verses.textEnEsv: But Saul increased all the more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived in Damascus by proving that Jesus was the Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Saul increased all the more in strength, and confounded the Jews who dwelt in Damascus, proving that this Jesus is the Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Saul’s preaching became more and more powerful, and the Jews in Damascus couldn’t refute his proofs that Jesus was indeed the Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: But Saul kept increasing in strength and confounding Jews who lived in Damascus by proving that this Jesus is the Christ.
verses.textEn: Yet Saul grew more and more powerful and baffled the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Messiah.

verses.textZh: 过了许多日子，犹太人商议要杀掉扫罗；
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了许多日子，犹太人商议要杀掉扫罗；
verses.textZhCuv: 过了好些日子，犹太人商议要杀扫罗，
verses.textEnNiv: After many days had gone by, there was a conspiracy among the Jews to kill him,
verses.textEnEsv: When many days had passed, the Jews plotted to kill him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after many days were past, the Jews plotted to kill him.
verses.textEnNlt: After a while some of the Jews plotted together to kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: When many days had elapsed, the Jews plotted together to do away with him,
verses.textEn: After many days had gone by, there was a conspiracy among the Jews to kill him,

verses.textZh: 但他们的计谋给扫罗知道了。他们就在各城门日夜把守，要杀掉他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们的计谋给扫罗知道了。他们就在各城门日夜把守，要杀掉他。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他们的计谋被扫罗知道了。他们又昼夜在城门守候，要杀他。
verses.textEnNiv: but Saul learned of their plan. Day and night they kept close watch on the city gates in order to kill him.
verses.textEnEsv: but their plot became known to Saul. They were watching the gates day and night in order to kill him,
verses.textEnNkjv: But their plot became known to Saul. And they watched the gates day and night, to kill him.
verses.textEnNlt: They were watching for him day and night at the city gate so they could murder him, but Saul was told about their plot.
verses.textEnNasb: but their plot became known to Saul. They were also closely watching the gates day and night so that they might put him to death;
verses.textEn: but Saul learned of their plan. Day and night they kept close watch on the city gates in order to kill him.

verses.textZh: 于是他的门徒就趁夜用大篮子把他从城墙上缒下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他的门徒就趁夜用大篮子把他从城墙上缒下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的门徒就在夜间用筐子把他从城墙上缒下去。
verses.textEnNiv: But his followers took him by night and lowered him in a basket through an opening in the wall.
verses.textEnEsv: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through an opening in the wall, lowering him in a basket.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall in a large basket.
verses.textEnNlt: So during the night, some of the other believers lowered him in a large basket through an opening in the city wall.
verses.textEnNasb: but his disciples took him at night and let him down through an opening in the wall, lowering him in a large basket.
verses.textEn: But his followers took him by night and lowered him in a basket through an opening in the wall.

verses.textZh: 扫罗到了耶路撒冷，想要接近门徒，但大家都怕他，不信他是个门徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗到了耶路撒冷，想要接近门徒，但大家都怕他，不信他是个门徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗到了耶路撒冷，想与门徒结交，他们却都怕他，不信他是门徒。
verses.textEnNiv: When he came to Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he really was a disciple.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had come to Jerusalem, he attempted to join the disciples. And they were all afraid of him, for they did not believe that he was a disciple.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, and did not believe that he was a disciple.
verses.textEnNlt: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to meet with the believers, but they were all afraid of him. They did not believe he had truly become a believer!
verses.textEnNasb: When he came to Jerusalem, he tried repeatedly to associate with the disciples; and yet they were all afraid of him, as they did not believe that he was a disciple.
verses.textEn: When he came to Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he really was a disciple.

verses.textZh: 只有巴拿巴接待他，带他去见使徒，把他怎样在路上看见主，主向他说话，和他怎样在大马士革奉耶稣的名放胆讲道，都讲了出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有巴拿巴接待他，带他去见使徒，把他怎样在路上看见主，主向他说话，和他怎样在大马士革奉耶稣的名放胆讲道，都讲了出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有巴拿巴接待他，领去见使徒，把他在路上怎么看见主，主怎么向他说话，他在大马士革怎么奉耶稣的名放胆传道，都述说出来。
verses.textEnNiv: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. He told them how Saul on his journey had seen the Lord and that the Lord had spoken to him, and how in Damascus he had preached fearlessly in the name of Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles and declared to them how on the road he had seen the Lord, who spoke to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. And he declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the road, and that He had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and told them how Saul had seen the Lord on the way to Damascus and how the Lord had spoken to Saul. He also told them that Saul had preached boldly in the name of Jesus in Damascus.
verses.textEnNasb: But Barnabas took hold of him and brought him to the apostles and described to them how he had seen the Lord on the road, and that He had talked to him, and how he had spoken out boldly in the name of Jesus at Damascus.
verses.textEn: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. He told them how Saul on his journey had seen the Lord and that the Lord had spoken to him, and how in Damascus he had preached fearlessly in the name of Jesus.

verses.textZh: 于是扫罗在耶路撒冷和门徒一同出入，奉主的名放胆讲道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是扫罗在耶路撒冷和门徒一同出入，奉主的名放胆讲道，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是扫罗在耶路撒冷和门徒出入来往，
verses.textEnNiv: So Saul stayed with them and moved about freely in Jerusalem, speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: So he went in and out among them at Jerusalem, preaching boldly in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he was with them at Jerusalem, coming in and going out.
verses.textEnNlt: So Saul stayed with the apostles and went all around Jerusalem with them, preaching boldly in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: And he was with them, moving about freely in Jerusalem, speaking out boldly in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: So Saul stayed with them and moved about freely in Jerusalem, speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 并且与讲希腊话的犹太人谈论辩驳，那些人却想下手杀他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且与讲希腊话的犹太人谈论辩驳，那些人却想下手杀他。
verses.textZhCuv: 奉主的名放胆传道，并与说希腊话的犹太人讲论辩驳；他们却想法子要杀他。
verses.textEnNiv: He talked and debated with the Hellenistic Jews, but they tried to kill him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he spoke and disputed against the Hellenists. But they were seeking to kill him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he spoke boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus and disputed against the Hellenists, but they attempted to kill him.
verses.textEnNlt: He debated with some Greek-speaking Jews, but they tried to murder him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he was talking and arguing with the Hellenistic Jews; but they were attempting to put him to death.
verses.textEn: He talked and debated with the Hellenistic Jews, but they tried to kill him.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们知道了，就送他到该撒利亚，差他往大数去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们知道了，就送他到该撒利亚，差他往大数去。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们知道了就送他下凯撒利亚，打发他往大数去。
verses.textEnNiv: When the believers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the brothers learned this, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the brethren found out, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him out to Tarsus.
verses.textEnNlt: When the believers heard about this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him away to Tarsus, his hometown.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the brothers learned of it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him away to Tarsus.
verses.textEn: When the believers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

verses.textZh: 那时犹太、加利利、撒玛利亚各处的教会，都得到平安，被建立起来，存着敬畏主的心过生活，并且因着圣灵的激励，人数增多起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时犹太、加利利、撒玛利亚各处的教会，都得到平安，被建立起来，存着敬畏主的心过生活，并且因着圣灵的激励，人数增多起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，犹太、加利利、撒马利亚各处的教会都得平安，被建立；凡事敬畏主，蒙圣灵的安慰，人数就增多了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace and was strengthened. Living in the fear of the Lord and encouraged by the Holy Spirit, it increased in numbers.
verses.textEnEsv: So the church throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria had peace and was being built up. And walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, it multiplied.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the churches throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were edified. And walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, they were multiplied.
verses.textEnNlt: The church then had peace throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria, and it became stronger as the believers lived in the fear of the Lord. And with the encouragement of the Holy Spirit, it also grew in numbers.
verses.textEnNasb: So the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria enjoyed peace, as it was being built up; and as it continued in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, it kept increasing.
verses.textEn: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace and was strengthened. Living in the fear of the Lord and encouraged by the Holy Spirit, it increased in numbers.

verses.textZh: 彼得周游各地的时候，也到了住在吕大的圣徒那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得周游各地的时候，也到了住在吕大的圣徒那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得周流四方的时候，也到了居住吕大的圣徒那里；
verses.textEnNiv: As Peter traveled about the country, he went to visit the Lord’s people who lived in Lydda.
verses.textEnEsv: Now as Peter went here and there among them all, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, as Peter went through all partsofthecountry, that he also came down to the saints who dwelt in Lydda.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Peter traveled from place to place, and he came down to visit the believers in the town of Lydda.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as Peter was traveling through all those regions, he also came down to the saints who lived at Lydda.
verses.textEn: As Peter traveled about the country, he went to visit the Lord’s people who lived in Lydda.

verses.textZh: 他遇见一个人，名叫以尼雅，害了瘫痪病，在床上躺卧了八年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他遇见一个人，名叫以尼雅，害了瘫痪病，在床上躺卧了八年。
verses.textZhCuv: 遇见一个人，名叫以尼雅，得了瘫痪，在褥子上躺卧八年。
verses.textEnNiv: There he found a man named Aeneas, who was paralyzed and had been bedridden for eight years.
verses.textEnEsv: There he found a man named Aeneas, bedridden for eight years, who was paralyzed.
verses.textEnNkjv: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden eight years and was paralyzed.
verses.textEnNlt: There he met a man named Aeneas, who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.
verses.textEnNasb: There he found a man named Aeneas who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.
verses.textEn: There he found a man named Aeneas, who was paralyzed and had been bedridden for eight years.

verses.textZh: 彼得对他说："以尼雅，耶稣基督医好你了！起来，收好你的褥子！"他就立刻起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得对他说："以尼雅，耶稣基督医好你了！起来，收好你的褥子！"他就立刻起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得对他说：「以尼雅，耶稣基督医好你了，起来！收拾你的褥子。」他就立刻起来了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Aeneas," Peter said to him, "Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and roll up your mat." Immediately Aeneas got up.
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter said to him, "Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you; rise and make your bed." And immediately he rose.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Peter said to him, "Aeneas, Jesus the Christ heals you. Arise and make your bed." Then he arose immediately.
verses.textEnNlt: Peter said to him, "Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you! Get up, and roll up your sleeping mat!" And he was healed instantly.
verses.textEnNasb: Peter said to him, "Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you; get up and make your own bed." Immediately he got up.
verses.textEn: "Aeneas," Peter said to him, "Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and roll up your mat." Immediately Aeneas got up.

verses.textZh: 所有住在吕大和沙仑的人，看见了他就归向主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有住在吕大和沙仑的人，看见了他就归向主。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡住吕大和沙仑的人都看见了他，就归服主。
verses.textEnNiv: All those who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the residents of Lydda and Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all who dwelt at Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the whole population of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas walking around, and they turned to the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: And all who lived at Lydda and Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
verses.textEn: All those who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.

verses.textZh: 在约帕有一个女门徒，名叫戴比莎，希腊话叫多加；她为人乐善好施。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在约帕有一个女门徒，名叫戴比莎，希腊话叫多加；她为人乐善好施。
verses.textZhCuv: 在约帕有一个女徒，名叫大比大，翻希腊话就是多加 ；她广行善事，多施周济。
verses.textEnNiv: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (in Greek her name is Dorcas); she was always doing good and helping the poor.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was in Joppa a disciple named Tabitha, which, translated, means Dorcas. She was full of good works and acts of charity.
verses.textEnNkjv: At Joppa there was a certain disciple named Tabitha, which is translated Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and charitable deeds which she did.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a believer in Joppa named Tabitha (which in Greek is Dorcas ). She was always doing kind things for others and helping the poor.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which when translated means Dorcas); this woman was excelling in acts of kindness and charity which she did habitually.
verses.textEn: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (in Greek her name is Dorcas); she was always doing good and helping the poor.

verses.textZh: 那时，她因病死了；有人把她洗净了，停放在楼上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，她因病死了；有人把她洗净了，停放在楼上。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，她患病而死，有人把她洗了，停在楼上。
verses.textEnNiv: About that time she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days she became ill and died, and when they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
verses.textEnNkjv: But it happened in those days that she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
verses.textEnNlt: About this time she became ill and died. Her body was washed for burial and laid in an upstairs room.
verses.textEnNasb: But it happened at that time that she became sick and died; and when they had washed her body, they laid it in an upstairs room.
verses.textEn: About that time she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.

verses.textZh: 吕大靠近约帕，门徒听说彼得在那边，就派两个人去求他，说："请到我们那边去，不要耽延！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 吕大靠近约帕，门徒听说彼得在那边，就派两个人去求他，说："请到我们那边去，不要耽延！"
verses.textZhCuv: 吕大原与约帕相近；门徒听见彼得在那里，就打发两个人去见他，央求他说：「快到我们那里去，不要耽延。」
verses.textEnNiv: Lydda was near Joppa; so when the disciples heard that Peter was in Lydda, they sent two men to him and urged him, "Please come at once!"
verses.textEnEsv: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, urging him, "Please come to us without delay."
verses.textEnNkjv: And since Lydda was near Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
verses.textEnNlt: But the believers had heard that Peter was nearby at Lydda, so they sent two men to beg him, "Please come as soon as possible!"
verses.textEnNasb: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, having heard that Peter was there, sent two men to him, urging him, "Do not delay in coming to us."
verses.textEn: Lydda was near Joppa; so when the disciples heard that Peter was in Lydda, they sent two men to him and urged him, "Please come at once!"

verses.textZh: 彼得就动身，跟他们一同去。到了之后，他们领他上楼。所有寡妇站在彼得旁边哭，把多加和她们在一起的时候所做的内衣外衣拿给他看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得就动身，跟他们一同去。到了之后，他们领他上楼。所有寡妇站在彼得旁边哭，把多加和她们在一起的时候所做的内衣外衣拿给他看。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得就起身和他们同去；到了，便有人领他上楼。众寡妇都站在彼得旁边哭，拿多加与她们同在时所做的里衣外衣给他看。
verses.textEnNiv: Peter went with them, and when he arrived he was taken upstairs to the room. All the widows stood around him, crying and showing him the robes and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
verses.textEnEsv: So Peter rose and went with them. And when he arrived, they took him to the upper room. All the widows stood beside him weeping and showing tunics and other garments that Dorcas made while she was with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he had come, they brought him to the upper room. And all the widows stood by him weeping, showing the tunics and garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
verses.textEnNlt: So Peter returned with them; and as soon as he arrived, they took him to the upstairs room. The room was filled with widows who were weeping and showing him the coats and other clothes Dorcas had made for them.
verses.textEnNasb: So Peter got ready and went with them. When he arrived, they brought him into the room upstairs; and all the widows stood beside him, weeping and showing all the tunics and garments that Dorcas used to make while she was with them.
verses.textEn: Peter went with them, and when he arrived he was taken upstairs to the room. All the widows stood around him, crying and showing him the robes and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.

verses.textZh: 彼得叫大家出去之后，就跪下来祷告，然后转过身来对着尸体说："戴比莎，起来！"她就睁开眼睛，一看见彼得，就坐了起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得叫大家出去之后，就跪下来祷告，然后转过身来对着尸体说："戴比莎，起来！"她就睁开眼睛，一看见彼得，就坐了起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得叫她们都出去，就跪下祷告，转身对着死人说：「大比大，起来！」她就睁开眼睛，见了彼得，便坐起来。
verses.textEnNiv: Peter sent them all out of the room; then he got down on his knees and prayed. Turning toward the dead woman, he said, "Tabitha, get up." She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter she sat up.
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter put them all outside, and knelt down and prayed; and turning to the body he said, "Tabitha, arise." And she opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter she sat up.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter put them all out, and knelt down and prayed. And turning to the body he said, "Tabitha, arise." And she opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter she sat up.
verses.textEnNlt: But Peter asked them all to leave the room; then he knelt and prayed. Turning to the body he said, "Get up, Tabitha." And she opened her eyes! When she saw Peter, she sat up!
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter sent them all out and knelt down and prayed, and turning to the body, he said, "Tabitha, arise." And she opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
verses.textEn: Peter sent them all out of the room; then he got down on his knees and prayed. Turning toward the dead woman, he said, "Tabitha, get up." She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter she sat up.

verses.textZh: 彼得伸手扶她起来，叫圣徒们和寡妇都进来，把多加活活地交给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得伸手扶她起来，叫圣徒们和寡妇都进来，把多加活活地交给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得伸手扶她起来，叫众圣徒和寡妇进去，把多加活活地交给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Then he called for the believers, especially the widows, and presented her to them alive.
verses.textEnEsv: And he gave her his hand and raised her up. Then, calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he gave her his hand and lifted her up; and when he had called the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
verses.textEnNlt: He gave her his hand and helped her up. Then he called in the widows and all the believers, and he presented her to them alive.
verses.textEnNasb: And he gave her his hand and raised her up; and calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
verses.textEn: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Then he called for the believers, especially the widows, and presented her to them alive.

verses.textZh: 这事传遍了约帕，就有很多人信了主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事传遍了约帕，就有很多人信了主。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事传遍了约帕，就有许多人信了主。
verses.textEnNiv: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: And it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed on the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The news spread through the whole town, and many believed in the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: It became known all over Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
verses.textEn: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.

verses.textZh: 此后，彼得在约帕一个制皮工人西门的家里住了许多日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此后，彼得在约帕一个制皮工人西门的家里住了许多日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，彼得在约帕一个硝皮匠西门的家里住了多日。
verses.textEnNiv: Peter stayed in Joppa for some time with a tanner named Simon.
verses.textEnEsv: And he stayed in Joppa for many days with one Simon, a tanner.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was that he stayed many days in Joppa with Simon, a tanner.
verses.textEnNlt: And Peter stayed a long time in Joppa, living with Simon, a tanner of hides.
verses.textEnNasb: And Peter stayed in Joppa many days with a tanner named Simon.
verses.textEn: Peter stayed in Joppa for some time with a tanner named Simon.

verses.textZh: 在该撒利亚有一个人，名叫哥尼流，是意大利营的百夫长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在该撒利亚有一个人，名叫哥尼流，是意大利营的百夫长。
verses.textZhCuv: 在凯撒利亚有一个人，名叫哥尼流，是「意大利营」的百夫长。
verses.textEnNiv: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was known as the Italian Regiment.
verses.textEnEsv: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion of what was known as the Italian Cohort,
verses.textEnNkjv: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
verses.textEnNlt: In Caesarea there lived a Roman army officer named Cornelius, who was a captain of the Italian Regiment.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a man in Caesarea named Cornelius, a centurion of what was called the Italian cohort,
verses.textEn: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was known as the Italian Regiment.

verses.textZh: 他是一个虔诚的人，他和全家都敬畏神，对人民行过许多善事，常常向神祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是一个虔诚的人，他和全家都敬畏神，对人民行过许多善事，常常向神祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他是个虔诚人，他和全家都敬畏神，多多周济百姓，常常祷告神。
verses.textEnNiv: He and all his family were devout and God-fearing; he gave generously to those in need and prayed to God regularly.
verses.textEnEsv: a devout man who feared God with all his household, gave alms generously to the people, and prayed continually to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: a devout man and one who feared God with all his household, who gave alms generously to the people, and prayed to God always.
verses.textEnNlt: He was a devout, God-fearing man, as was everyone in his household. He gave generously to the poor and prayed regularly to God.
verses.textEnNasb: a devout man and one who feared God with all his household, and made many charitable contributions to the Jewish people and prayed to God continually.
verses.textEn: He and all his family were devout and God-fearing; he gave generously to those in need and prayed to God regularly.

verses.textZh: 有一天，大约下午三点钟，他在异象中，清清楚楚看见神的一位天使来到他那里，对他说："哥尼流！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，大约下午三点钟，他在异象中，清清楚楚看见神的一位天使来到他那里，对他说："哥尼流！"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一天，约在申初，他在异象中明明看见神的一个使者进去，到他那里，说：「哥尼流。」
verses.textEnNiv: One day at about three in the afternoon he had a vision. He distinctly saw an angel of God, who came to him and said, "Cornelius!"
verses.textEnEsv: About the ninth hour of the day he saw clearly in a vision an angel of God come in and say to him, "Cornelius."
verses.textEnNkjv: About the ninth hour of the day he saw clearly in a vision an angel of God coming in and saying to him, "Cornelius!"
verses.textEnNlt: One afternoon about three o’clock, he had a vision in which he saw an angel of God coming toward him. "Cornelius!" the angel said.
verses.textEnNasb: About the ninth hour of the day he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God who had just come in and said to him, "Cornelius!"
verses.textEn: One day at about three in the afternoon he had a vision. He distinctly saw an angel of God, who came to him and said, "Cornelius!"

verses.textZh: 他定睛一看，害怕起来，说："主啊，甚么事？"天使说："你的祷告和善行，已经达到神面前，蒙他记念了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他定睛一看，害怕起来，说："主啊，甚么事？"天使说："你的祷告和善行，已经达到神面前，蒙他记念了。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥尼流定睛看他，惊怕说：「主啊，什么事呢？」天使说：「你的祷告和你的周济达到神面前，已蒙记念了。
verses.textEnNiv: Cornelius stared at him in fear. "What is it, Lord?" he asked. The angel answered, "Your prayers and gifts to the poor have come up as a memorial offering before God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he stared at him in terror and said, "What is it, Lord?" And he said to him, "Your prayers and your alms have ascended as a memorial before God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he observed him, he was afraid, and said, "What is it, lord?" So he said to him, "Your prayers and your alms have come up for a memorial before God.
verses.textEnNlt: Cornelius stared at him in terror. "What is it, sir?" he asked the angel. And the angel replied, "Your prayers and gifts to the poor have been received by God as an offering!
verses.textEnNasb: And he looked at him intently and became terrified, and said, "What is it, lord?" And he said to him, "Your prayers and charitable gifts have ascended as a memorial offering before God.
verses.textEn: Cornelius stared at him in fear. "What is it, Lord?" he asked. The angel answered, "Your prayers and gifts to the poor have come up as a memorial offering before God.

verses.textZh: 现在你要派人到约帕去，请那个名叫彼得的西门来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要派人到约帕去，请那个名叫彼得的西门来。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你当打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来。
verses.textEnNiv: Now send men to Joppa to bring back a man named Simon who is called Peter.
verses.textEnEsv: And now send men to Joppa and bring one Simon who is called Peter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now send men to Joppa, and send for Simon whose surname is Peter.
verses.textEnNlt: Now send some men to Joppa, and summon a man named Simon Peter.
verses.textEnNasb: Now dispatch some men to Joppa and send for a man named Simon, who is also called Peter;
verses.textEn: Now send men to Joppa to bring back a man named Simon who is called Peter.

verses.textZh: 他在一个制皮工人西门的家里作客，房子就在海边。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在一个制皮工人西门的家里作客，房子就在海边。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他住在海边一个硝皮匠西门的家里，房子在海边上。」
verses.textEnNiv: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea."
verses.textEnEsv: He is lodging with one Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the sea."
verses.textEnNkjv: He is lodging with Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the sea. He will tell you what you must do."
verses.textEnNlt: He is staying with Simon, a tanner who lives near the seashore."
verses.textEnNasb: he is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the sea."
verses.textEn: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea."

verses.textZh: 和他说话的天使走了之后，他就叫了两个家仆和侍候他的一个虔诚的士兵来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 和他说话的天使走了之后，他就叫了两个家仆和侍候他的一个虔诚的士兵来，
verses.textZhCuv: 向他说话的天使去后，哥尼流叫了两个家人和常伺候他的一个虔诚兵来，
verses.textEnNiv: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier who was one of his attendants.
verses.textEnEsv: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, he called two of his servants and a devout soldier from among those who attended him,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier from among those who waited on him continually.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as the angel was gone, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier, one of his personal attendants.
verses.textEnNasb: When the angel who *spoke to him left, he summoned two of his servants and a devout soldier from his personal attendants,
verses.textEn: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier who was one of his attendants.

verses.textZh: 把一切事向他们讲明，然后派他们到约帕去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把一切事向他们讲明，然后派他们到约帕去。
verses.textZhCuv: 把这事都述说给他们听，就打发他们往约帕去。
verses.textEnNiv: He told them everything that had happened and sent them to Joppa.
verses.textEnEsv: and having related everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when he had explained all these things to them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.textEnNlt: He told them what had happened and sent them off to Joppa.
verses.textEnNasb: and after he had explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
verses.textEn: He told them everything that had happened and sent them to Joppa.

verses.textZh: 第二天，大约正午，他们走近那座城的时候，彼得上了房顶去祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，大约正午，他们走近那座城的时候，彼得上了房顶去祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，他们行路将近那城。彼得约在午正，上房顶去祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: About noon the following day as they were on their journey and approaching the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.
verses.textEnEsv: The next day, as they were on their journey and approaching the city, Peter went up on the housetop about the sixth hour to pray.
verses.textEnNkjv: The next day, as they went on their journey and drew near the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray, about the sixth hour.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day as Cornelius’s messengers were nearing the town, Peter went up on the flat roof to pray. It was about noon,
verses.textEnNasb: On the next day, as they were on their way and approaching the city, Peter went up on the housetop about the sixth hour to pray.
verses.textEn: About noon the following day as they were on their journey and approaching the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.

verses.textZh: 那家人正在预备饭的时候，彼得觉得饿了，很想吃饭。这时候他魂游象外，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那家人正在预备饭的时候，彼得觉得饿了，很想吃饭。这时候他魂游象外，
verses.textZhCuv: 觉得饿了，想要吃。那家的人正预备饭的时候，彼得魂游象外，
verses.textEnNiv: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, and while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
verses.textEnEsv: And he became hungry and wanted something to eat, but while they were preparing it, he fell into a trance
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he became very hungry and wanted to eat; but while they made ready, he fell into a trance
verses.textEnNlt: and he was hungry. But while a meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
verses.textEnNasb: But he became hungry and wanted to eat; but while they were making preparations, he fell into a trance;
verses.textEn: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, and while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.

verses.textZh: 看见天开了，有一件东西，好象一块大布，绑着四角，降在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看见天开了，有一件东西，好象一块大布，绑着四角，降在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 看见天开了，有一物降下，好像一块大布，系着四角，缒在地上，
verses.textEnNiv: He saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.
verses.textEnEsv: and saw the heavens opened and something like a great sheet descending, being let down by its four corners upon the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: and saw heaven opened and an object like a great sheet bound at the four corners, descending to him and let down to the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: He saw the sky open, and something like a large sheet was let down by its four corners.
verses.textEnNasb: and he *saw the sky opened up, and an object like a great sheet coming down, lowered by four corners to the ground,
verses.textEn: He saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.

verses.textZh: 里面有地上的各样四足牲畜，还有昆虫和天空的飞鸟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 里面有地上的各样四足牲畜，还有昆虫和天空的飞鸟。
verses.textZhCuv: 里面有地上各样四足的走兽和昆虫，并天上的飞鸟；
verses.textEnNiv: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals, as well as reptiles and birds.
verses.textEnEsv: In it were all kinds of animals and reptiles and birds of the air.
verses.textEnNkjv: In it were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, creeping things, and birds of the air.
verses.textEnNlt: In the sheet were all sorts of animals, reptiles, and birds.
verses.textEnNasb: and on it were all kinds of four-footed animals and crawling creatures of the earth and birds of the sky.
verses.textEn: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals, as well as reptiles and birds.

verses.textZh: 有声音对他说："<red>彼得，起来，宰了吃！</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有声音对他说："<red>彼得，起来，宰了吃！</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有声音向他说：「<red>彼得，起来，宰了吃！</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: Then a voice told him, <red>“Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And there came a voice to him: "Rise, Peter; kill and eat."
verses.textEnNkjv: And a voice came to him, "Rise, Peter; kill and eat."
verses.textEnNlt: Then a voice said to him, "Get up, Peter; kill and eat them."
verses.textEnNasb: A voice came to him, "Get up, Peter, kill and eat!"
verses.textEn: Then a voice told him, <red>“Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.”</red>

verses.textZh: 彼得说："主啊，千万不可！我从来不吃俗物和不洁的东西。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得说："主啊，千万不可！我从来不吃俗物和不洁的东西。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得却说：「主啊，这是不可的！凡俗物和不洁净的物，我从来没有吃过。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Surely not, Lord!" Peter replied. "I have never eaten anything impure or unclean."
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter said, "By no means, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter said, "Not so, Lord! For I have never eaten anything common or unclean."
verses.textEnNlt: "No, Lord," Peter declared. "I have never eaten anything that our Jewish laws have declared impure and unclean. "
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter said, "By no means, Lord, for I have never eaten anything unholy and unclean."
verses.textEn: "Surely not, Lord!" Peter replied. "I have never eaten anything impure or unclean."

verses.textZh: 第二次又有声音对他说："<red>神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二次又有声音对他说："<red>神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 第二次有声音向他说：「<red>神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: The voice spoke to him a second time, <red>“Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the voice came to him again a second time, "What God has made clean, do not call common."
verses.textEnNkjv: And a voice spoke to him again the second time, "What God has cleansed you must not call common."
verses.textEnNlt: But the voice spoke again: "Do not call something unclean if God has made it clean."
verses.textEnNasb: Again a voice came to him a second time, "What God has cleansed, no longer consider unholy."
verses.textEn: The voice spoke to him a second time, <red>“Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”</red>

verses.textZh: 这样一连三次，那件东西就立刻收回天上去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样一连三次，那件东西就立刻收回天上去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样一连三次，那物随即收回天上去了。
verses.textEnNiv: This happened three times, and immediately the sheet was taken back to heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: This happened three times, and the thing was taken up at once to heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: This was done three times. And the object was taken up into heaven again.
verses.textEnNlt: The same vision was repeated three times. Then the sheet was suddenly pulled up to heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: This happened three times, and immediately the object was taken up into the sky.
verses.textEn: This happened three times, and immediately the sheet was taken back to heaven.

verses.textZh: 彼得犹豫不定，不明白所看见的异象是甚么意思，恰好哥尼流派来的人，找到西门的家，站在门口，
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得犹豫不定，不明白所看见的异象是甚么意思，恰好哥尼流派来的人，找到西门的家，站在门口，
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得心里正在猜疑之间，不知所看见的异象是什么意思。哥尼流所差来的人已经访问到西门的家，站在门外，
verses.textEnNiv: While Peter was wondering about the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found out where Simon’s house was and stopped at the gate.
verses.textEnEsv: Now while Peter was inwardly perplexed as to what the vision that he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood at the gate
verses.textEnNkjv: Now while Peter wondered within himself what this vision which he had seen meant, behold, the men who had been sent from Cornelius had made inquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: Peter was very perplexed. What could the vision mean? Just then the men sent by Cornelius found Simon’s house. Standing outside the gate,
verses.textEnNasb: Now while Peter was greatly perplexed in mind as to what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who had been sent by Cornelius had asked directions to Simon’s house, and they appeared at the gate;
verses.textEn: While Peter was wondering about the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found out where Simon’s house was and stopped at the gate.

verses.textZh: 大声问："有没有一个名叫彼得的西门在这里作客？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大声问："有没有一个名叫彼得的西门在这里作客？"
verses.textZhCuv: 喊着问：「有称呼彼得的西门住在这里没有？」
verses.textEnNiv: They called out, asking if Simon who was known as Peter was staying there.
verses.textEnEsv: and called out to ask whether Simon who was called Peter was lodging there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they called and asked whether Simon, whose surname was Peter, was lodging there.
verses.textEnNlt: they asked if a man named Simon Peter was staying there.
verses.textEnNasb: and calling out, they were asking whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was staying there.
verses.textEn: They called out, asking if Simon who was known as Peter was staying there.

verses.textZh: 彼得还在思量那异象，圣灵对他说："你看，有三个人来找你！
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得还在思量那异象，圣灵对他说："你看，有三个人来找你！
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得还思想那异象的时候，圣灵向他说：「有三个人来找你。
verses.textEnNiv: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, "Simon, three men are looking for you.
verses.textEnEsv: And while Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, "Behold, three men are looking for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: While Peter thought about the vision, the Spirit said to him, "Behold, three men are seeking you.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, as Peter was puzzling over the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, "Three men have come looking for you.
verses.textEnNasb: While Peter was reflecting on the vision, the Spirit said to him, "Behold, three men are looking for you.
verses.textEn: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, "Simon, three men are looking for you.

verses.textZh: 起来，下去吧，跟他们一起去，不要疑惑，因为是我差他们来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 起来，下去吧，跟他们一起去，不要疑惑，因为是我差他们来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 起来，下去，和他们同往，不要疑惑，因为是我差他们来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: So get up and go downstairs. Do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them."
verses.textEnEsv: Rise and go down and accompany them without hesitation, for I have sent them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise therefore, go down and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them."
verses.textEnNlt: Get up, go downstairs, and go with them without hesitation. Don’t worry, for I have sent them."
verses.textEnNasb: But get up, go downstairs and accompany them without misgivings, for I have sent them Myself."
verses.textEn: So get up and go downstairs. Do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them."

verses.textZh: 于是彼得下楼到他们那里，说："看，我就是你们所要找的人。你们是为甚么来的？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是彼得下楼到他们那里，说："看，我就是你们所要找的人。你们是为甚么来的？"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是彼得下去见那些人，说：「我就是你们所找的人。你们来是为什么缘故？」
verses.textEnNiv: Peter went down and said to the men, "I’m the one you’re looking for. Why have you come?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Peter went down to the men and said, "I am the one you are looking for. What is the reason for your coming?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter went down to the men who had been sent to him from Cornelius, and said, "Yes, I am he whom you seek. For what reason have you come?"
verses.textEnNlt: So Peter went down and said, "I’m the man you are looking for. Why have you come?"
verses.textEnNasb: Peter went down to the men and said, "Behold, I am the one you are looking for; what is the reason for which you have come?"
verses.textEn: Peter went down and said to the men, "I’m the one you’re looking for. Why have you come?"

verses.textZh: 他们说："百夫长哥尼流是个义人，敬畏神，全犹太族都称赞他。他得到一位圣天使的指示，请你到他家里，要听你的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："百夫长哥尼流是个义人，敬畏神，全犹太族都称赞他。他得到一位圣天使的指示，请你到他家里，要听你的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「百夫长哥尼流是个义人，敬畏神，为犹太通国所称赞。他蒙一位圣天使所指示，叫他请你到他家里去，听你的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: The men replied, "We have come from Cornelius the centurion. He is a righteous and God-fearing man, who is respected by all the Jewish people. A holy angel told him to ask you to come to his house so that he could hear what you have to say."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "Cornelius, a centurion, an upright and God-fearing man, who is well spoken of by the whole Jewish nation, was directed by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house and to hear what you have to say."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "Cornelius the centurion, a just man, one who fears God and has a good reputation among all the nation of the Jews, was divinely instructed by a holy angel to summon you to his house, and to hear words from you."
verses.textEnNlt: They said, "We were sent by Cornelius, a Roman officer. He is a devout and God-fearing man, well respected by all the Jews. A holy angel instructed him to summon you to his house so that he can hear your message."
verses.textEnNasb: They said, "Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous and God-fearing man well spoken of by the entire nation of the Jews, was divinely directed by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house and hear a message from you."
verses.textEn: The men replied, "We have come from Cornelius the centurion. He is a righteous and God-fearing man, who is respected by all the Jewish people. A holy angel told him to ask you to come to his house so that he could hear what you have to say."

verses.textZh: 彼得就请他们进去，留他们住下。 第二天，彼得动身跟他们一同去，另有约帕的几位弟兄同行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得就请他们进去，留他们住下。 第二天，彼得动身跟他们一同去，另有约帕的几位弟兄同行。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得就请他们进去，住了一宿。 次日，起身和他们同去，还有约帕的几个弟兄同着他去；
verses.textEnNiv: Then Peter invited the men into the house to be his guests. The next day Peter started out with them, and some of the believers from Joppa went along.
verses.textEnEsv: So he invited them in to be his guests. The next day he rose and went away with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he invited them in and lodged them. On the next day Peter went away with them, and some brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Peter invited the men to stay for the night. The next day he went with them, accompanied by some of the brothers from Joppa.
verses.textEnNasb: So he invited them in and gave them lodging. Now on the next day he got ready and went away with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.textEn: Then Peter invited the men into the house to be his guests. The next day Peter started out with them, and some of the believers from Joppa went along.

verses.textZh: 第三天，他们到了该撒利亚。哥尼流已经招聚了自己的亲戚好友在恭候他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三天，他们到了该撒利亚。哥尼流已经招聚了自己的亲戚好友在恭候他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 又次日，他们进入凯撒利亚，哥尼流已经请了他的亲属密友等候他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The following day he arrived in Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the following day they entered Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the following day they entered Caesarea. Now Cornelius was waiting for them, and had called together his relatives and close friends.
verses.textEnNlt: They arrived in Caesarea the following day. Cornelius was waiting for them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
verses.textEnNasb: On the following day he entered Caesarea. Now Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
verses.textEn: The following day he arrived in Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.

verses.textZh: 彼得一进去，哥尼流就迎接他，俯伏在他脚前叩拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得一进去，哥尼流就迎接他，俯伏在他脚前叩拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得一进去，哥尼流就迎接他，俯伏在他脚前拜他。
verses.textEnNiv: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in reverence.
verses.textEnEsv: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him and fell down at his feet and worshiped him.
verses.textEnNkjv: As Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him and fell down at his feet and worshiped him.
verses.textEnNlt: As Peter entered his home, Cornelius fell at his feet and worshiped him.
verses.textEnNasb: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, and fell at his feet and worshiped him.
verses.textEn: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in reverence.

verses.textZh: 彼得扶起他，说："起来，我也是人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得扶起他，说："起来，我也是人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得却拉他，说：「你起来，我也是人。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Peter made him get up. "Stand up," he said, "I am only a man myself."
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter lifted him up, saying, "Stand up; I too am a man."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter lifted him up, saying, "Stand up; I myself am also a man."
verses.textEnNlt: But Peter pulled him up and said, "Stand up! I’m a human being just like you!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter helped him up, saying, "Stand up; I, too, am just a man."
verses.textEn: But Peter made him get up. "Stand up," he said, "I am only a man myself."

verses.textZh: 彼得和他说了话，就进去，看见许多人聚集在那里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得和他说了话，就进去，看见许多人聚集在那里，
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得和他说着话进去，见有好些人在那里聚集，
verses.textEnNiv: While talking with him, Peter went inside and found a large gathering of people.
verses.textEnEsv: And as he talked with him, he went in and found many persons gathered.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as he talked with him, he went in and found many who had come together.
verses.textEnNlt: So they talked together and went inside, where many others were assembled.
verses.textEnNasb: As he talked with him, he entered and *found many people assembled.
verses.textEn: While talking with him, Peter went inside and found a large gathering of people.

verses.textZh: 就对他们说："你们知道，犹太人本来是不准和外国人接近来往的，但神已经指示了我，不可把任何人当作凡俗或不洁的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就对他们说："你们知道，犹太人本来是不准和外国人接近来往的，但神已经指示了我，不可把任何人当作凡俗或不洁的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就对他们说：「你们知道，犹太人和别国的人亲近来往本是不合例的，但神已经指示我，无论什么人都不可看作俗而不洁净的。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them: "You are well aware that it is against our law for a Jew to associate with or visit a Gentile. But God has shown me that I should not call anyone impure or unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "You yourselves know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with or to visit anyone of another nation, but God has shown me that I should not call any person common or unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to them, "You know how unlawful it is for a Jewish man to keep company with or go to one of another nation. But God has shown me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: Peter told them, "You know it is against our laws for a Jewish man to enter a Gentile home like this or to associate with you. But God has shown me that I should no longer think of anyone as impure or unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to them, "You yourselves know that it is forbidden for a Jewish man to associate with or visit a foreigner; and yet God has shown me that I am not to call any person unholy or unclean.
verses.textEn: He said to them: "You are well aware that it is against our law for a Jew to associate with or visit a Gentile. But God has shown me that I should not call anyone impure or unclean.

verses.textZh: 所以我一被邀请，就毫不推辞地来了。现在请问：你们请我来是为甚么事？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我一被邀请，就毫不推辞地来了。现在请问：你们请我来是为甚么事？"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我被请的时候，就不推辞而来。现在请问：你们叫我来有什么意思呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So when I was sent for, I came without raising any objection. May I ask why you sent for me?"
verses.textEnEsv: So when I was sent for, I came without objection. I ask then why you sent for me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I came without objection as soon as I was sent for. I ask, then, for what reason have you sent for me?"
verses.textEnNlt: So I came without objection as soon as I was sent for. Now tell me why you sent for me."
verses.textEnNasb: That is why I came without even raising any objection when I was sent for. So I ask, for what reason did you send for me?"
verses.textEn: So when I was sent for, I came without raising any objection. May I ask why you sent for me?"

verses.textZh: 哥尼流说："四天以前下午三点钟，我在家里祷告的时候，忽然有一位身穿光明衣服的人，站在我面前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥尼流说："四天以前下午三点钟，我在家里祷告的时候，忽然有一位身穿光明衣服的人，站在我面前，
verses.textZhCuv: 哥尼流说：「前四天，这个时候，我在家中守着申初的祷告，忽然有一个人穿着光明的衣裳，站在我面前，
verses.textEnNiv: Cornelius answered: "Three days ago I was in my house praying at this hour, at three in the afternoon. Suddenly a man in shining clothes stood before me
verses.textEnEsv: And Cornelius said, "Four days ago, about this hour, I was praying in my house at the ninth hour, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing
verses.textEnNkjv: So Cornelius said, "Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
verses.textEnNlt: Cornelius replied, "Four days ago I was praying in my house about this same time, three o’clock in the afternoon. Suddenly, a man in dazzling clothes was standing in front of me.
verses.textEnNasb: Cornelius said, "Four days ago to this hour, I was praying in my house during the ninth hour; and behold, a man stood before me in shining clothing,
verses.textEn: Cornelius answered: "Three days ago I was in my house praying at this hour, at three in the afternoon. Suddenly a man in shining clothes stood before me

verses.textZh: 说：‘哥尼流，你的祷告已蒙垂听，你的善行在神面前已蒙记念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘哥尼流，你的祷告已蒙垂听，你的善行在神面前已蒙记念。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：『哥尼流，你的祷告已蒙垂听，你的周济达到神面前已蒙记念了。
verses.textEnNiv: and said, ‘Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and remembered your gifts to the poor.
verses.textEnEsv: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard and your alms have been remembered before God.
verses.textEnNkjv: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your alms are remembered in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNlt: He told me, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your gifts to the poor have been noticed by God!
verses.textEnNasb: and he *said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard and your charitable gifts have been remembered before God.
verses.textEn: and said, ‘Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and remembered your gifts to the poor.

verses.textZh: 你要派人到约帕去，请那个名叫彼得的西门来。他在海边一个制皮工人西门的家作客。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要派人到约帕去，请那个名叫彼得的西门来。他在海边一个制皮工人西门的家作客。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你当打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来，他住在海边一个硝皮匠西门的家里。』
verses.textEnNiv: Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, who lives by the sea.’
verses.textEnEsv: Send therefore to Joppa and ask for Simon who is called Peter. He is lodging in the house of Simon, a tanner, by the sea.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Send therefore to Joppa and call Simon here, whose surname is Peter. He is lodging in the house of Simon, a tanner, by the sea. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
verses.textEnNlt: Now send messengers to Joppa, and summon a man named Simon Peter. He is staying in the home of Simon, a tanner who lives near the seashore.’
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore send some men to Joppa and invite Simon, who is also called Peter, to come to you; he is staying at the house of Simon the tanner, by the sea.’
verses.textEn: Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, who lives by the sea.’

verses.textZh: 所以我立刻派人去请你，现在你来了，好极了！我们都在神面前，要听主吩咐你的一切话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我立刻派人去请你，现在你来了，好极了！我们都在神面前，要听主吩咐你的一切话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我立时打发人去请你。你来了很好；现今我们都在神面前，要听主所吩咐你的一切话。」
verses.textEnNiv: So I sent for you immediately, and it was good of you to come. Now we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has commanded you to tell us."
verses.textEnEsv: So I sent for you at once, and you have been kind enough to come. Now therefore we are all here in the presence of God to hear all that you have been commanded by the Lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: So I sent to you immediately, and you have done well to come. Now therefore, we are all present before God, to hear all the things commanded you by God."
verses.textEnNlt: So I sent for you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now we are all here, waiting before God to hear the message the Lord has given you."
verses.textEnNasb: So I sent men to you immediately, and you have been kind enough to come. Now then, we are all here present before God to hear everything that you have been commanded by the Lord."
verses.textEn: So I sent for you immediately, and it was good of you to come. Now we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has commanded you to tell us."

verses.textZh: 彼得就开口说："我实在看出神是不偏待人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得就开口说："我实在看出神是不偏待人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得就开口说：「我真看出神是不偏待人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Peter began to speak: "I now realize how true it is that God does not show favoritism
verses.textEnEsv: So Peter opened his mouth and said: "Truly I understand that God shows no partiality,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Peter opened his mouth and said: "In truth I perceive that God shows no partiality.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Peter replied, "I see very clearly that God shows no favoritism.
verses.textEnNasb: Opening his mouth, Peter said: "I most certainly understand now that God is not one to show partiality,
verses.textEn: Then Peter began to speak: "I now realize how true it is that God does not show favoritism

verses.textZh: 原来在各民族中，凡敬畏他而行义的，都蒙他悦纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来在各民族中，凡敬畏他而行义的，都蒙他悦纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来，各国中那敬畏主、行义的人都为主所悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: but accepts from every nation the one who fears him and does what is right.
verses.textEnEsv: but in every nation anyone who fears him and does what is right is acceptable to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But in every nation whoever fears Him and works righteousness is accepted by Him.
verses.textEnNlt: In every nation he accepts those who fear him and do what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: but in every nation the one who fears Him and does what is right is acceptable to Him.
verses.textEn: but accepts from every nation the one who fears him and does what is right.

verses.textZh: 神借着耶稣基督 传和平的福音，把这道传给以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神借着耶稣基督 传和平的福音，把这道传给以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 神藉着耶稣基督（他是万有的主）传和平的福音，将这道赐给以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: You know the message God sent to the people of Israel, announcing the good news of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the word that he sent to Israel, preaching good news of peace through Jesus Christ ( he is Lord of all),
verses.textEnNkjv: The word which God sent to the children of Israel, preaching peace through Jesus Christ— He is Lord of all—
verses.textEnNlt: This is the message of Good News for the people of Israel—that there is peace with God through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.
verses.textEnNasb: The word which He sent to the sons of Israel, preaching peace through Jesus Christ (He is Lord of all)—
verses.textEn: You know the message God sent to the people of Israel, announcing the good news of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.

verses.textZh: 你们知道：在约翰传讲洗礼之后，这道从加利利传遍了犹太，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们知道：在约翰传讲洗礼之后，这道从加利利传遍了犹太，
verses.textZhCuv: 这话在约翰宣传洗礼以后，从加利利起，传遍了犹太。
verses.textEnNiv: You know what has happened throughout the province of Judea, beginning in Galilee after the baptism that John preached—
verses.textEnEsv: you yourselves know what happened throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee after the baptism that John proclaimed:
verses.textEnNkjv: that word you know, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, and began from Galilee after the baptism which John preached:
verses.textEnNlt: You know what happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee, after John began preaching his message of baptism.
verses.textEnNasb: you yourselves know the thing that happened throughout Judea, starting from Galilee, after the baptism which John proclaimed.
verses.textEn: You know what has happened throughout the province of Judea, beginning in Galilee after the baptism that John preached—

verses.textZh: 并且知道神怎样用圣灵和能力膏立拿撒勒人耶稣。他到各处行善事，医好所有被魔鬼压制的人，因为神与他同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且知道神怎样用圣灵和能力膏立拿撒勒人耶稣。他到各处行善事，医好所有被魔鬼压制的人，因为神与他同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 神怎样以圣灵和能力膏拿撒勒人耶稣，这都是你们知道的。他周流四方，行善事，医好凡被魔鬼压制的人，因为神与他同在。
verses.textEnNiv: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and power, and how he went around doing good and healing all who were under the power of the devil, because God was with him.
verses.textEnEsv: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power. He went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And you know that God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power. Then Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
verses.textEnNasb: You know of Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed Him with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how He went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with Him.
verses.textEn: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and power, and how he went around doing good and healing all who were under the power of the devil, because God was with him.

verses.textZh: 我们就是他在犹太人之地和耶路撒冷所行一切事的见证人；他们竟然把他挂在木头上，杀了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们就是他在犹太人之地和耶路撒冷所行一切事的见证人；他们竟然把他挂在木头上，杀了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在犹太人之地，并耶路撒冷所行的一切事，有我们作见证。他们竟把他挂在木头上杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: "We are witnesses of everything he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed him by hanging him on a cross,
verses.textEnEsv: And we are witnesses of all that he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They put him to death by hanging him on a tree,
verses.textEnNkjv: And we are witnesses of all things which He did both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem, whom they killed by hanging on a tree.
verses.textEnNlt: "And we apostles are witnesses of all he did throughout Judea and in Jerusalem. They put him to death by hanging him on a cross,
verses.textEnNasb: We are witnesses of all the things that He did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They also put Him to death by hanging Him on a cross.
verses.textEn: "We are witnesses of everything he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed him by hanging him on a cross,

verses.textZh: 神叫他第三天复活，并且使他显现，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神叫他第三天复活，并且使他显现，
verses.textZhCuv: 第三日，神叫他复活，显现出来；
verses.textEnNiv: but God raised him from the dead on the third day and caused him to be seen.
verses.textEnEsv: but God raised him on the third day and made him to appear,
verses.textEnNkjv: Him God raised up on the third day, and showed Him openly,
verses.textEnNlt: but God raised him to life on the third day. Then God allowed him to appear,
verses.textEnNasb: God raised Him up on the third day and granted that He be revealed,
verses.textEn: but God raised him from the dead on the third day and caused him to be seen.

verses.textZh: 不是显现给所有的人看，而是给神预先拣选的见证人看，就是我们这些在他从死人中复活之后，与他一同吃喝的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不是显现给所有的人看，而是给神预先拣选的见证人看，就是我们这些在他从死人中复活之后，与他一同吃喝的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 不是显现给众人看，乃是显现给神预先所拣选为他作见证的人看，就是我们这些在他从死里复活以后和他同吃同喝的人。
verses.textEnNiv: He was not seen by all the people, but by witnesses whom God had already chosen—by us who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: not to all the people but to us who had been chosen by God as witnesses, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: not to all the people, but to witnesses chosen before by God, even to us who ate and drank with Him after He arose from the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: not to the general public, but to us whom God had chosen in advance to be his witnesses. We were those who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: not to all the people, but to witnesses who had been chosen beforehand by God, that is, to us who ate and drank with Him after He arose from the dead.
verses.textEn: He was not seen by all the people, but by witnesses whom God had already chosen—by us who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

verses.textZh: 他吩咐我们向人民传讲，郑重证明他是神所立，审判活人死人的主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他吩咐我们向人民传讲，郑重证明他是神所立，审判活人死人的主。
verses.textZhCuv: 他吩咐我们传道给众人，证明他是神所立定的，要作审判活人、死人的主。
verses.textEnNiv: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God appointed as judge of the living and the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: And he commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one appointed by God to be judge of the living and the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He commanded us to preach to the people, and to testify that it is He who was ordained by God tobe Judge of the living and the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: And he ordered us to preach everywhere and to testify that Jesus is the one appointed by God to be the judge of all—the living and the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: And He ordered us to preach to the people, and to testify solemnly that this is the One who has been appointed by God as Judge of the living and the dead.
