verses.textEn: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God appointed as judge of the living and the dead.

verses.textZh: 所有先知都为他作见证：所有信他的，都必借着他的名，罪得赦免。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有先知都为他作见证：所有信他的，都必借着他的名，罪得赦免。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众先知也为他作见证说：『凡信他的人必因他的名得蒙赦罪。』」
verses.textEnNiv: All the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name."
verses.textEnEsv: To him all the prophets bear witness that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name."
verses.textEnNkjv: To Him all the prophets witness that, through His name, whoever believes in Him will receive remission of sins."
verses.textEnNlt: He is the one all the prophets testified about, saying that everyone who believes in him will have their sins forgiven through his name."
verses.textEnNasb: All the prophets testify of Him, that through His name everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins."
verses.textEn: All the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name."

verses.textZh: 彼得还在说话的时候，圣灵降在所有听道的人身上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得还在说话的时候，圣灵降在所有听道的人身上，
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得还说这话的时候，圣灵降在一切听道的人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit came on all who heard the message.
verses.textEnEsv: While Peter was still saying these things, the Holy Spirit fell on all who heard the word.
verses.textEnNkjv: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all those who heard the word.
verses.textEnNlt: Even as Peter was saying these things, the Holy Spirit fell upon all who were listening to the message.
verses.textEnNasb: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all those who were listening to the message.
verses.textEn: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit came on all who heard the message.

verses.textZh: 那些受了割礼、跟彼得一同来的信徒，因为圣灵的恩赐 也浇灌在外族人的身上，都很惊讶；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些受了割礼、跟彼得一同来的信徒，因为圣灵的恩赐 也浇灌在外族人的身上，都很惊讶；
verses.textZhCuv: 那些奉割礼、和彼得同来的信徒，见圣灵的恩赐也浇在外邦人身上，就都希奇；
verses.textEnNiv: The circumcised believers who had come with Peter were astonished that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on Gentiles.
verses.textEnEsv: And the believers from among the circumcised who had come with Peter were amazed, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was poured out even on the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those of the circumcision who believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out on the Gentiles also.
verses.textEnNlt: The Jewish believers who came with Peter were amazed that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out on the Gentiles, too.
verses.textEnNasb: All the Jewish believers who came with Peter were amazed, because the gift of the Holy Spirit had also been poured out on the Gentiles.
verses.textEn: The circumcised believers who had come with Peter were astonished that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on Gentiles.

verses.textZh: 原来听见他们讲方言，尊神为大。于是彼得说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来听见他们讲方言，尊神为大。于是彼得说：
verses.textZhCuv: 因听见他们说方言，称赞神为大。
verses.textEnNiv: For they heard them speaking in tongues and praising God. Then Peter said,
verses.textEnEsv: For they were hearing them speaking in tongues and extolling God. Then Peter declared,
verses.textEnNkjv: For they heard them speak with tongues and magnify God. Then Peter answered,
verses.textEnNlt: For they heard them speaking in other tongues and praising God. Then Peter asked,
verses.textEnNasb: For they were hearing them speaking with tongues and exalting God. Then Peter responded,
verses.textEn: For they heard them speaking in tongues and praising God. Then Peter said,

verses.textZh: "这些人既然领受了圣灵，跟我们一样，谁能禁止他们受水的洗礼呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "这些人既然领受了圣灵，跟我们一样，谁能禁止他们受水的洗礼呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是彼得说：「这些人既受了圣灵，与我们一样，谁能禁止用水给他们施洗呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Surely no one can stand in the way of their being baptized with water. They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have."
verses.textEnEsv: "Can anyone withhold water for baptizing these people, who have received the Holy Spirit just as we have?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Can anyone forbid water, that these should not be baptized who have received the Holy Spirit just as we have?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Can anyone object to their being baptized, now that they have received the Holy Spirit just as we did?"
verses.textEnNasb: "Surely no one can refuse the water for these to be baptized, who have received the Holy Spirit just as we did, can he?"
verses.textEn: "Surely no one can stand in the way of their being baptized with water. They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have."

verses.textZh: 就吩咐他们奉耶稣基督的名受洗。后来，他们请彼得住了几天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就吩咐他们奉耶稣基督的名受洗。后来，他们请彼得住了几天。
verses.textZhCuv: 就吩咐奉耶稣基督的名给他们施洗。他们又请彼得住了几天。
verses.textEnNiv: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked Peter to stay with them for a few days.
verses.textEnEsv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to remain for some days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then they asked him to stay a few days.
verses.textEnNlt: So he gave orders for them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Afterward Cornelius asked him to stay with them for several days.
verses.textEnNasb: And he ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay on for a few days.
verses.textEn: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked Peter to stay with them for a few days.

verses.textZh: 使徒和在犹太的弟兄们，听说外族人也接受了神的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒和在犹太的弟兄们，听说外族人也接受了神的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒和在犹太的众弟兄听说外邦人也领受了神的道。
verses.textEnNiv: The apostles and the believers throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the apostles and the brothers who were throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the apostles and brethren who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon the news reached the apostles and other believers in Judea that the Gentiles had received the word of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the apostles and the brothers and sisters who were throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
verses.textEn: The apostles and the believers throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.

verses.textZh: 彼得上到耶路撒冷的时候，那些守割礼的人与他争论，
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得上到耶路撒冷的时候，那些守割礼的人与他争论，
verses.textZhCuv: 及至彼得上了耶路撒冷，那些奉割礼的门徒和他争辩说：
verses.textEnNiv: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers criticized him
verses.textEnEsv: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcision party criticized him, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Peter came up to Jerusalem, those of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.textEnNlt: But when Peter arrived back in Jerusalem, the Jewish believers criticized him.
verses.textEnNasb: And when Peter came up to Jerusalem, the Jewish believers took issue with him,
verses.textEn: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers criticized him

verses.textZh: 说："你竟然到未受割礼的人那里，跟他们一起吃饭！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："你竟然到未受割礼的人那里，跟他们一起吃饭！"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你进入未受割礼之人的家和他们一同吃饭了。」
verses.textEnNiv: and said, "You went into the house of uncircumcised men and ate with them."
verses.textEnEsv: "You went to uncircumcised men and ate with them."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!"
verses.textEnNlt: "You entered the home of Gentiles and even ate with them!" they said.
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "You went to uncircumcised men and ate with them."
verses.textEn: and said, "You went into the house of uncircumcised men and ate with them."

verses.textZh: 彼得就按着次序向他们讲解，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得就按着次序向他们讲解，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得就开口把这事挨次给他们讲解说：
verses.textEnNiv: Starting from the beginning, Peter told them the whole story:
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter began and explained it to them in order:
verses.textEnNkjv: But Peter explained it to them in order from the beginning, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter began and explained at length to them in an orderly sequence, saying,
verses.textEn: Starting from the beginning, Peter told them the whole story:

verses.textZh: "我在约帕城祷告的时候，魂游象外，见到异象：有一件东西，好象一块大布，绑着四角，从天上降下来，一直来到我面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我在约帕城祷告的时候，魂游象外，见到异象：有一件东西，好象一块大布，绑着四角，从天上降下来，一直来到我面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我在约帕城里祷告的时候，魂游象外，看见异象，有一物降下，好像一块大布，系着四角，从天缒下，直来到我跟前。
verses.textEnNiv: "I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision. I saw something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came down to where I was.
verses.textEnEsv: "I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision, something like a great sheet descending, being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came down to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I was in the city of Joppa praying; and in a trance I saw a vision, an object descending like a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came to me.
verses.textEnNlt: "I was in the town of Joppa," he said, "and while I was praying, I went into a trance and saw a vision. Something like a large sheet was let down by its four corners from the sky. And it came right down to me.
verses.textEnNasb: "I was in the city of Joppa praying; and in a trance I saw a vision, an object coming down like a great sheet lowered by four corners from the sky; and it came to where I was,
verses.textEn: "I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision. I saw something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came down to where I was.

verses.textZh: 我定睛观察，看见里面有地上的四足牲畜、走兽，还有昆虫和天空的飞鸟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我定睛观察，看见里面有地上的四足牲畜、走兽，还有昆虫和天空的飞鸟。
verses.textZhCuv: 我定睛观看，见内中有地上四足的牲畜和野兽、昆虫，并天上的飞鸟。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked into it and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles and birds.
verses.textEnEsv: Looking at it closely, I observed animals and beasts of prey and reptiles and birds of the air.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I observed it intently and considered, I saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, creeping things, and birds of the air.
verses.textEnNlt: When I looked inside the sheet, I saw all sorts of tame and wild animals, reptiles, and birds.
verses.textEnNasb: and I stared at it and was thinking about it, and I saw the four-footed animals of the earth, the wild animals, the crawling creatures, and the birds of the sky.
verses.textEn: I looked into it and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles and birds.

verses.textZh: <red>我也听见有声音对我说：‘彼得，起来，宰了吃！’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我也听见有声音对我说：‘彼得，起来，宰了吃！’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我且听见有声音向我说：『彼得，起来，宰了吃！』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard a voice telling me, <red>‘Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter; kill and eat.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter; kill and eat.’
verses.textEnNlt: And I heard a voice say, ‘Get up, Peter; kill and eat them.’
verses.textEnNasb: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter; kill and eat.’
verses.textEn: Then I heard a voice telling me, <red>‘Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.’</red>

verses.textZh: 我说：‘主啊，千万不可，因为俗物或不洁的东西，从来没有进过我的口。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说：‘主啊，千万不可，因为俗物或不洁的东西，从来没有进过我的口。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：『主啊，这是不可的！凡俗而不洁净的物从来没有入过我的口。』
verses.textEnNiv: "I replied, ‘Surely not, Lord! Nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
verses.textEnEsv: But I said, ‘By no means, Lord; for nothing common or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord! For nothing common or unclean has at any time entered my mouth.’
verses.textEnNlt: "‘No, Lord,’ I replied. ‘I have never eaten anything that our Jewish laws have declared impure or unclean. ’
verses.textEnNasb: But I said, ‘By no means, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
verses.textEn: "I replied, ‘Surely not, Lord! Nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’

verses.textZh: <red>第二次又有声音从天上回答：‘神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>第二次又有声音从天上回答：‘神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>第二次，有声音从天上说：『神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: “The voice spoke from heaven a second time, <red>‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: But the voice answered a second time from heaven, ‘What God has made clean, do not call common.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, ‘What God has cleansed you must not call common.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But the voice from heaven spoke again: ‘Do not call something unclean if God has made it clean.’
verses.textEnNasb: But a voice from heaven answered a second time, ‘What God has cleansed, no longer consider unholy.’
verses.textEn: “The voice spoke from heaven a second time, <red>‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’</red>

verses.textZh: 这样一连三次之后，所有的东西都拉回天上去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样一连三次之后，所有的东西都拉回天上去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样一连三次，就都收回天上去了。
verses.textEnNiv: This happened three times, and then it was all pulled up to heaven again.
verses.textEnEsv: This happened three times, and all was drawn up again into heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: This happened three times before the sheet and all it contained was pulled back up to heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into the sky.
verses.textEn: This happened three times, and then it was all pulled up to heaven again.

verses.textZh: 就在那个时候，有三个从该撒利亚派到我这里来的人，站在我住的房子门前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那个时候，有三个从该撒利亚派到我这里来的人，站在我住的房子门前。
verses.textZhCuv: 正当那时，有三个人站在我们所住的房门前，是从凯撒利亚差来见我的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Right then three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, at that very moment three men arrived at the house in which we were, sent to me from Caesarea.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that very moment, three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent to me from Caesarea.
verses.textEnNlt: "Just then three men who had been sent from Caesarea arrived at the house where we were staying.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, at that moment three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea came up to the house where we were staying.
verses.textEn: "Right then three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.

verses.textZh: 圣灵吩咐我跟他们一起去，一点也不要疑惑。这六位弟兄也跟我一起去，我们就进了那人的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵吩咐我跟他们一起去，一点也不要疑惑。这六位弟兄也跟我一起去，我们就进了那人的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵吩咐我和他们同去，不要疑惑 。同着我去的，还有这六位弟兄，我们都进了那人的家。
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit told me to have no hesitation about going with them. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Spirit told me to go with them, making no distinction. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered the man’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit told me to go with them, doubting nothing. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered the man’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry that they were Gentiles. These six brothers here accompanied me, and we soon entered the home of the man who had sent for us.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Spirit told me to go with them without misgivings. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s house.
verses.textEn: The Spirit told me to have no hesitation about going with them. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s house.

verses.textZh: 他告诉我们，他怎样看见天使站在他家里说：‘派人到约帕去，请那个名叫彼得的西门来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他告诉我们，他怎样看见天使站在他家里说：‘派人到约帕去，请那个名叫彼得的西门来，
verses.textZhCuv: 那人就告诉我们，他如何看见一位天使站在他屋里，说：『你打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来，
verses.textEnNiv: He told us how he had seen an angel appear in his house and say, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.
verses.textEnEsv: And he told us how he had seen the angel stand in his house and say, ‘Send to Joppa and bring Simon who is called Peter;
verses.textEnNkjv: And he told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house, who said to him, ‘Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon whose surname is Peter,
verses.textEnNlt: He told us how an angel had appeared to him in his home and had told him, ‘Send messengers to Joppa, and summon a man named Simon Peter.
verses.textEnNasb: And he reported to us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying, ‘Send some men to Joppa and have Simon, who is also called Peter, brought here;
verses.textEn: He told us how he had seen an angel appear in his house and say, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.

verses.textZh: 他有话要告诉你，使你和你全家都可以得救。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他有话要告诉你，使你和你全家都可以得救。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他有话告诉你，可以叫你和你的全家得救。』
verses.textEnNiv: He will bring you a message through which you and all your household will be saved.’
verses.textEnEsv: he will declare to you a message by which you will be saved, you and all your household.’
verses.textEnNkjv: who will tell you words by which you and all your household will be saved.’
verses.textEnNlt: He will tell you how you and everyone in your household can be saved!’
verses.textEnNasb: and he will speak words to you by which you will be saved, you and all your household.’
verses.textEn: He will bring you a message through which you and all your household will be saved.’

verses.textZh: 我一开始讲话，圣灵就降在他们身上，正像当初降在我们身上一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我一开始讲话，圣灵就降在他们身上，正像当初降在我们身上一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我一开讲，圣灵便降在他们身上，正像当初降在我们身上一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit came on them as he had come on us at the beginning.
verses.textEnEsv: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them just as on us at the beginning.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, as upon us at the beginning.
verses.textEnNlt: "As I began to speak," Peter continued, "the Holy Spirit fell on them, just as he fell on us at the beginning.
verses.textEnNasb: And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them just as He did upon us at the beginning.
verses.textEn: "As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit came on them as he had come on us at the beginning.

verses.textZh: <red>我就想起主所说的话：‘约翰用水施洗，但你们要受圣灵的洗。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我就想起主所说的话：‘约翰用水施洗，但你们要受圣灵的洗。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我就想起主的话说：『约翰是用水施洗，但你们要受圣灵的洗。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: Then I remembered what the Lord had said: <red>‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I remembered the word of the Lord, how He said, ‘John indeed baptized with water, but you shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then I thought of the Lord’s words when he said, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
verses.textEnNasb: And I remembered the word of the Lord, how He used to say, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
verses.textEn: Then I remembered what the Lord had said: <red>‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’</red>

verses.textZh: 神既然把同样的恩赐 给他们，像给我们这些信了主耶稣基督的人一样，我是谁，我能够阻止神吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神既然把同样的恩赐 给他们，像给我们这些信了主耶稣基督的人一样，我是谁，我能够阻止神吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 神既然给他们恩赐，像在我们信主耶稣基督的时候给了我们一样；我是谁，能拦阻神呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So if God gave them the same gift he gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to think that I could stand in God’s way?"
verses.textEnEsv: If then God gave the same gift to them as he gave to us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I that I could stand in God’s way?"
verses.textEnNkjv: If therefore God gave them the same gift as Hegave us when we believed on the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I that I could withstand God?"
verses.textEnNlt: And since God gave these Gentiles the same gift he gave us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to stand in God’s way?"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, if God gave them the same gift as He also gave to us after believing in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I that I could stand in God’s way?"
verses.textEn: So if God gave them the same gift he gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to think that I could stand in God’s way?"

verses.textZh: 众人听见这些话，就默然无声，把荣耀归给神，说："这样看来，神也把悔改的心赐给外族人，使他们得生命。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人听见这些话，就默然无声，把荣耀归给神，说："这样看来，神也把悔改的心赐给外族人，使他们得生命。"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人听见这话，就不言语了，只归荣耀与神，说：「这样看来，神也赐恩给外邦人，叫他们悔改得生命了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard this, they had no further objections and praised God, saying, "So then, even to Gentiles God has granted repentance that leads to life."
verses.textEnEsv: When they heard these things they fell silent. And they glorified God, saying, "Then to the Gentiles also God has granted repentance that leads to life."
verses.textEnNkjv: When they heard these things they became silent; and they glorified God, saying, "Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life."
verses.textEnNlt: When the others heard this, they stopped objecting and began praising God. They said, "We can see that God has also given the Gentiles the privilege of repenting of their sins and receiving eternal life."
verses.textEnNasb: When they heard this, they quieted down and glorified God, saying, "Well then, God has also granted to the Gentiles the repentance that leads to life."
verses.textEn: When they heard this, they had no further objections and praised God, saying, "So then, even to Gentiles God has granted repentance that leads to life."

verses.textZh: 那些因司提反事件遭受苦难而四散的门徒，一直走到腓尼基、塞浦路斯、安提阿；他们不对别人传讲，只对犹太人传讲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些因司提反事件遭受苦难而四散的门徒，一直走到腓尼基、塞浦路斯、安提阿；他们不对别人传讲，只对犹太人传讲。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些因司提反的事遭患难四散的门徒直走到腓尼基和塞浦路斯，并安提阿；他们不向别人讲道，只向犹太人讲。
verses.textEnNiv: Now those who had been scattered by the persecution that broke out when Stephen was killed traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus and Antioch, spreading the word only among Jews.
verses.textEnEsv: Now those who were scattered because of the persecution that arose over Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia and Cyprus and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except Jews.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now those who were scattered after the persecution that arose over Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to no one but the Jews only.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the believers who had been scattered during the persecution after Stephen’s death traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch of Syria. They preached the word of God, but only to Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: So then those who were scattered because of the persecution that occurred in connection with Stephen made their way to Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews alone.
verses.textEn: Now those who had been scattered by the persecution that broke out when Stephen was killed traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus and Antioch, spreading the word only among Jews.

verses.textZh: 但其中有些塞浦路斯人和古利奈人，来到安提阿，也对希腊人传讲主耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但其中有些塞浦路斯人和古利奈人，来到安提阿，也对希腊人传讲主耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 但内中有塞浦路斯和古利奈人，他们到了安提阿也向希腊人传讲主耶稣 。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of them, however, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began to speak to Greeks also, telling them the good news about the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who on coming to Antioch spoke to the Hellenists also, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: But some of them were men from Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: However, some of the believers who went to Antioch from Cyprus and Cyrene began preaching to the Gentiles about the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who came to Antioch and began speaking to the Greeks as well, preaching the good news of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEn: Some of them, however, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began to speak to Greeks also, telling them the good news about the Lord Jesus.

verses.textZh: 主的手与他们同在，信而归主的人就多起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主的手与他们同在，信而归主的人就多起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 主与他们同在，信而归主的人就很多了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord’s hand was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: And the hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number who believed turned to the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The power of the Lord was with them, and a large number of these Gentiles believed and turned to the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: And the hand of the Lord was with them, and a large number who believed turned to the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Lord’s hand was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.

verses.textZh: 这事传到耶路撒冷教会的耳中，他们就派巴拿巴到安提阿去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事传到耶路撒冷教会的耳中，他们就派巴拿巴到安提阿去。
verses.textZhCuv: 这风声传到耶路撒冷教会人的耳中，他们就打发巴拿巴出去，走到安提阿为止。
verses.textEnNiv: News of this reached the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
verses.textEnEsv: The report of this came to the ears of the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then news of these things came to the ears of the church in Jerusalem, and they sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch.
verses.textEnNlt: When the church at Jerusalem heard what had happened, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
verses.textEnNasb: The news about them reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas off to Antioch.
verses.textEn: News of this reached the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

verses.textZh: 他到了那里，看见神所施的恩，就很欢喜，劝勉众人坚心靠主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他到了那里，看见神所施的恩，就很欢喜，劝勉众人坚心靠主。
verses.textZhCuv: 他到了那里，看见神所赐的恩就欢喜，劝勉众人，立定心志，恒久靠主。
verses.textEnNiv: When he arrived and saw what the grace of God had done, he was glad and encouraged them all to remain true to the Lord with all their hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: When he came and saw the grace of God, he was glad, and he exhorted them all to remain faithful to the Lord with steadfast purpose,
verses.textEnNkjv: When he came and had seen the grace of God, he was glad, and encouraged them all that with purpose of heart they should continue with the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When he arrived and saw this evidence of God’s blessing, he was filled with joy, and he encouraged the believers to stay true to the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Then when he arrived and witnessed the grace of God, he rejoiced and began to encourage them all with resolute heart to remain true to the Lord;
verses.textEn: When he arrived and saw what the grace of God had done, he was glad and encouraged them all to remain true to the Lord with all their hearts.

verses.textZh: 巴拿巴是个好人，满有圣灵和信心，于是许多人归了主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴拿巴是个好人，满有圣灵和信心，于是许多人归了主。
verses.textZhCuv: 这巴拿巴原是个好人，被圣灵充满，大有信心。于是有许多人归服了主。
verses.textEnNiv: He was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: for he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith. And a great many people were added to the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith. And a great many people were added to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and strong in faith. And many people were brought to the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: for he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and faith. And considerable numbers were added to the Lord.
verses.textEn: He was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.

verses.textZh: 后来他到大数去找扫罗，
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来他到大数去找扫罗，
verses.textZhCuv: 他又往大数去找扫罗，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
verses.textEnEsv: So Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Barnabas departed for Tarsus to seek Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Barnabas went on to Tarsus to look for Saul.
verses.textEnNasb: And he left for Tarsus to look for Saul;
verses.textEn: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,

verses.textZh: 找到了，就带他来安提阿。足足有一年，他们一同在教会聚集，教导了许多人。门徒称为基督徒，是从安提阿开始的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 找到了，就带他来安提阿。足足有一年，他们一同在教会聚集，教导了许多人。门徒称为基督徒，是从安提阿开始的。
verses.textZhCuv: 找着了，就带他到安提阿去。他们足有一年的工夫和教会一同聚集，教训了许多人。门徒称为「基督徒」是从安提阿起首。
verses.textEnNiv: and when he found him, he brought him to Antioch. So for a whole year Barnabas and Saul met with the church and taught great numbers of people. The disciples were called Christians first at Antioch.
verses.textEnEsv: and when he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they met with the church and taught a great many people. And in Antioch the disciples were first called Christians.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. So it was that for a whole year they assembled with the church and taught a great many people. And the disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
verses.textEnNlt: When he found him, he brought him back to Antioch. Both of them stayed there with the church for a full year, teaching large crowds of people. (It was at Antioch that the believers were first called Christians.)
verses.textEnNasb: and when he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. And for an entire year they met with the church and taught considerable numbers of people; and the disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
verses.textEn: and when he found him, he brought him to Antioch. So for a whole year Barnabas and Saul met with the church and taught great numbers of people. The disciples were called Christians first at Antioch.

verses.textZh: 那时，有几位先知从耶路撒冷下到安提阿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，有几位先知从耶路撒冷下到安提阿。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那些日子，有几位先知从耶路撒冷下到安提阿。
verses.textEnNiv: During this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
verses.textEnEsv: Now in these days prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in these days prophets came from Jerusalem to Antioch.
verses.textEnNlt: During this time some prophets traveled from Jerusalem to Antioch.
verses.textEnNasb: Now at this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
verses.textEn: During this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

verses.textZh: 其中有一个名叫亚迦布的站起来，借着圣灵指出天下将要有大饥荒；这事在革老丢时期果然发生了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中有一个名叫亚迦布的站起来，借着圣灵指出天下将要有大饥荒；这事在革老丢时期果然发生了。
verses.textZhCuv: 内中有一位，名叫亚迦布，站起来，藉着圣灵指明天下将有大饥荒。（这事到克劳第年间果然有了。）
verses.textEnNiv: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and through the Spirit predicted that a severe famine would spread over the entire Roman world. (This happened during the reign of Claudius.)
verses.textEnEsv: And one of them named Agabus stood up and foretold by the Spirit that there would be a great famine over all the world (this took place in the days of Claudius).
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one of them, named Agabus, stood up and showed by the Spirit that there was going to be a great famine throughout all the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius Caesar.
verses.textEnNlt: One of them named Agabus stood up in one of the meetings and predicted by the Spirit that a great famine was coming upon the entire Roman world. (This was fulfilled during the reign of Claudius.)
verses.textEnNasb: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there would definitely be a severe famine all over the world. And this took place in the reign of Claudius.
verses.textEn: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and through the Spirit predicted that a severe famine would spread over the entire Roman world. (This happened during the reign of Claudius.)

verses.textZh: 于是门徒决定按着各人的力量捐款，好送给住在犹太的弟兄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是门徒决定按着各人的力量捐款，好送给住在犹太的弟兄。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是门徒定意照各人的力量捐钱，送去供给住在犹太的弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: The disciples, as each one was able, decided to provide help for the brothers and sisters living in Judea.
verses.textEnEsv: So the disciples determined, every one according to his ability, to send relief to the brothers living in Judea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the disciples, each according to his ability, determined to send relief to the brethren dwelling in Judea.
verses.textEnNlt: So the believers in Antioch decided to send relief to the brothers and sisters in Judea, everyone giving as much as they could.
verses.textEnNasb: And to the extent that any of the disciples had means, each of them determined to send a contribution for the relief of the brothers and sisters living in Judea.
verses.textEn: The disciples, as each one was able, decided to provide help for the brothers and sisters living in Judea.

verses.textZh: 他们就这样行了，由巴拿巴和扫罗经手送到长老们那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就这样行了，由巴拿巴和扫罗经手送到长老们那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就这样行，把捐项托巴拿巴和扫罗送到众长老那里。
verses.textEnNiv: This they did, sending their gift to the elders by Barnabas and Saul.
verses.textEnEsv: And they did so, sending it to the elders by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: This they also did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: This they did, entrusting their gifts to Barnabas and Saul to take to the elders of the church in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And they did this, sending it with Barnabas and Saul to the elders.
verses.textEn: This they did, sending their gift to the elders by Barnabas and Saul.

verses.textZh: 那时，希律王下手苦害教会中的几个人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，希律王下手苦害教会中的几个人，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，希律王下手苦害教会中几个人，
verses.textEnNiv: It was about this time that King Herod arrested some who belonged to the church, intending to persecute them.
verses.textEnEsv: About that time Herod the king laid violent hands on some who belonged to the church.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now about that time Herod the king stretched out his hand to harass some from the church.
verses.textEnNlt: About that time King Herod Agrippa began to persecute some believers in the church.
verses.textEnNasb: Now about that time Herod the king laid hands on some who belonged to the church, to do them harm.
verses.textEn: It was about this time that King Herod arrested some who belonged to the church, intending to persecute them.

verses.textZh: 用刀杀了约翰的哥哥雅各。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用刀杀了约翰的哥哥雅各。
verses.textZhCuv: 用刀杀了约翰的哥哥雅各。
verses.textEnNiv: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: He killed James the brother of John with the sword,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: He had the apostle James (John’s brother) killed with a sword.
verses.textEnNasb: And he had James the brother of John executed with a sword.
verses.textEn: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.

verses.textZh: 他见这事博得了犹太人的欢心，就在除酵节期间，再次捉拿彼得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他见这事博得了犹太人的欢心，就在除酵节期间，再次捉拿彼得。
verses.textZhCuv: 他见犹太人喜欢这事，又去捉拿彼得。那时正是除酵的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: When he saw that this met with approval among the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This happened during the Festival of Unleavened Bread.
verses.textEnEsv: and when he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to arrest Peter also. This was during the days of Unleavened Bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: And because he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to seize Peter also. Now it was during the Days of Unleavened Bread.
verses.textEnNlt: When Herod saw how much this pleased the Jewish people, he also arrested Peter. (This took place during the Passover celebration. )
verses.textEnNasb: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to arrest Peter as well. (Now these were the days of Unleavened Bread.)
verses.textEn: When he saw that this met with approval among the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This happened during the Festival of Unleavened Bread.

verses.textZh: 捉到了，就把他关在监里，交给四班士兵看守，每班四个人，打算过了逾越节，把他提出来交给民众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 捉到了，就把他关在监里，交给四班士兵看守，每班四个人，打算过了逾越节，把他提出来交给民众。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律拿了彼得，收在监里，交付四班兵丁看守，每班四个人，意思要在逾越节后把他提出来，当着百姓办他。
verses.textEnNiv: After arresting him, he put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out for public trial after the Passover.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had seized him, he put him in prison, delivering him over to four squads of soldiers to guard him, intending after the Passover to bring him out to the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of soldiers to keep him, intending to bring him before the people after Passover.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he imprisoned him, placing him under the guard of four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring Peter out for public trial after the Passover.
verses.textEnNasb: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison, turning him over to four squads of soldiers to guard him, intending only after the Passover to bring him before the people.
verses.textEn: After arresting him, he put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out for public trial after the Passover.

verses.textZh: 彼得就这样被拘留在监里；但教会却为他迫切地祈求神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得就这样被拘留在监里；但教会却为他迫切地祈求神。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是彼得被囚在监里；教会却为他切切地祷告神。
verses.textEnNiv: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was earnestly praying to God for him.
verses.textEnEsv: So Peter was kept in prison, but earnest prayer for him was made to God by the church.
verses.textEnNkjv: Peter was therefore kept in prison, but constant prayer was offered to God for him by the church.
verses.textEnNlt: But while Peter was in prison, the church prayed very earnestly for him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Peter was kept in the prison, but prayer for him was being made to God intensely by the church.
verses.textEn: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was earnestly praying to God for him.

verses.textZh: 希律要提他出来的前一夜，彼得被两条锁炼锁住，睡在两个士兵中间，还有卫兵守在门前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律要提他出来的前一夜，彼得被两条锁炼锁住，睡在两个士兵中间，还有卫兵守在门前。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律将要提他出来的前一夜，彼得被两条铁链锁着，睡在两个兵丁当中；看守的人也在门外看守。
verses.textEnNiv: The night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and sentries stood guard at the entrance.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Herod was about to bring him out, on that very night, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and sentries before the door were guarding the prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Herod was about to bring him out, that night Peter was sleeping, bound with two chains between two soldiers; and the guards before the door were keeping the prison.
verses.textEnNlt: The night before Peter was to be placed on trial, he was asleep, fastened with two chains between two soldiers. Others stood guard at the prison gate.
verses.textEnNasb: On the very night when Herod was about to bring him forward, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and guards in front of the door were watching over the prison.
verses.textEn: The night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, and sentries stood guard at the entrance.

verses.textZh: 忽然，有主的一位使者出现，牢房里就光芒四射。天使拍拍彼得的肋旁，唤醒他，说："快起来！"他手上的锁炼就脱落了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然，有主的一位使者出现，牢房里就光芒四射。天使拍拍彼得的肋旁，唤醒他，说："快起来！"他手上的锁炼就脱落了。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然，有主的一个使者站在旁边，屋里有光照耀，天使拍彼得的肋旁，拍醒了他，说：「快快起来！」那铁链就从他手上脱落下来。
verses.textEnNiv: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up. "Quick, get up!" he said, and the chains fell off Peter’s wrists.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood next to him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him, saying, "Get up quickly." And the chains fell off his hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the prison; and he struck Peter on the side and raised him up, saying, "Arise quickly!" And his chains fell off his hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, there was a bright light in the cell, and an angel of the Lord stood before Peter. The angel struck him on the side to awaken him and said, "Quick! Get up!" And the chains fell off his wrists.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, an angel of the Lord suddenly stood near Peter, and a light shone in the cell; and he struck Peter’s side and woke him, saying, "Get up quickly." And his chains fell off his hands.
verses.textEn: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up. "Quick, get up!" he said, and the chains fell off Peter’s wrists.

verses.textZh: 天使对他说："束上带子，穿上鞋！"他就这样作了。天使又说："披上外衣，跟我走！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使对他说："束上带子，穿上鞋！"他就这样作了。天使又说："披上外衣，跟我走！"
verses.textZhCuv: 天使对他说：「束上带子，穿上鞋。」他就那样做。天使又说：「披上外衣，跟着我来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel said to him, "Put on your clothes and sandals." And Peter did so. "Wrap your cloak around you and follow me," the angel told him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel said to him, "Dress yourself and put on your sandals." And he did so. And he said to him, "Wrap your cloak around you and follow me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the angel said to him, "Gird yourself and tie on your sandals"; and so he did. And he said to him, "Put on your garment and follow me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel told him, "Get dressed and put on your sandals." And he did. "Now put on your coat and follow me," the angel ordered.
verses.textEnNasb: And the angel said to him, "Put on your belt and strap on your sandals." And he did so. And he *said to him, "Wrap your cloak around you and follow me."
verses.textEn: Then the angel said to him, "Put on your clothes and sandals." And Peter did so. "Wrap your cloak around you and follow me," the angel told him.

verses.textZh: 他就出来跟着天使走，但他不知道天使所作的事是真的，还以为是见了异象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就出来跟着天使走，但他不知道天使所作的事是真的，还以为是见了异象。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得就出来跟着他，不知道天使所做是真的，只当见了异象。
verses.textEnNiv: Peter followed him out of the prison, but he had no idea that what the angel was doing was really happening; he thought he was seeing a vision.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went out and followed him. He did not know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went out and followed him, and did not know that what was done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision.
verses.textEnNlt: So Peter left the cell, following the angel. But all the time he thought it was a vision. He didn’t realize it was actually happening.
verses.textEnNasb: And he went out and continued to follow, and yet he did not know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he was seeing a vision.
verses.textEn: Peter followed him out of the prison, but he had no idea that what the angel was doing was really happening; he thought he was seeing a vision.

verses.textZh: 他们经过第一、第二两个岗位，来到通往城内的铁门，那门自动给他们开了。他们出来，往前走了一条街，天使立刻离开了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们经过第一、第二两个岗位，来到通往城内的铁门，那门自动给他们开了。他们出来，往前走了一条街，天使立刻离开了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了第一层第二层监牢，就来到临街的铁门，那门自己开了。他们出来，走过一条街，天使便离开他去了。
verses.textEnNiv: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city. It opened for them by itself, and they went through it. When they had walked the length of one street, suddenly the angel left him.
verses.textEnEsv: When they had passed the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate leading into the city. It opened for them of its own accord, and they went out and went along one street, and immediately the angel left him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they were past the first and the second guard posts, they came to the iron gate that leads to the city, which opened to them of its own accord; and they went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
verses.textEnNlt: They passed the first and second guard posts and came to the iron gate leading to the city, and this opened for them all by itself. So they passed through and started walking down the street, and then the angel suddenly left him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they had passed the first and second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened for them by itself; and they went out and went along one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
verses.textEn: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city. It opened for them by itself, and they went through it. When they had walked the length of one street, suddenly the angel left him.

verses.textZh: 彼得清醒过来，说："现在我确实知道，主差他的天使来，救我脱离希律的手和犹太人所期望的一切。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得清醒过来，说："现在我确实知道，主差他的天使来，救我脱离希律的手和犹太人所期望的一切。"
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得醒悟过来，说：「我现在真知道主差遣他的使者，救我脱离希律的手和犹太百姓一切所盼望的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Peter came to himself and said, "Now I know without a doubt that the Lord has sent his angel and rescued me from Herod’s clutches and from everything the Jewish people were hoping would happen."
verses.textEnEsv: When Peter came to himself, he said, "Now I am sure that the Lord has sent his angel and rescued me from the hand of Herod and from all that the Jewish people were expecting."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Peter had come to himself, he said, "Now I know for certain that the Lord has sent His angel, and has delivered me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the Jewish people."
verses.textEnNlt: Peter finally came to his senses. "It’s really true!" he said. "The Lord has sent his angel and saved me from Herod and from what the Jewish leaders had planned to do to me!"
verses.textEnNasb: When Peter came to himself, he said, "Now I know for sure that the Lord has sent forth His angel and rescued me from the hand of Herod and from all that the Jewish people were expecting."
verses.textEn: Then Peter came to himself and said, "Now I know without a doubt that the Lord has sent his angel and rescued me from Herod’s clutches and from everything the Jewish people were hoping would happen."

verses.textZh: 他明白了之后，就到约翰 的母亲马利亚家里去；有许多人聚集在那里祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他明白了之后，就到约翰 的母亲马利亚家里去；有许多人聚集在那里祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 想了一想，就往那称呼马可的约翰、他母亲马利亚家去，在那里有好些人聚集祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: When this had dawned on him, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered and were praying.
verses.textEnEsv: When he realized this, he went to the house of Mary, the mother of John whose other name was Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
verses.textEnNkjv: So, when he had considered this, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John whose surname was Mark, where many were gathered together praying.
verses.textEnNlt: When he realized this, he went to the home of Mary, the mother of John Mark, where many were gathered for prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he realized this, he went to the house of Mary, the mother of John, who was also called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
verses.textEn: When this had dawned on him, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered and were praying.

verses.textZh: 彼得敲了大门，有一个名叫罗大的使女，出来应门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得敲了大门，有一个名叫罗大的使女，出来应门。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得敲外门，有一个使女，名叫罗大，出来探听，
verses.textEnNiv: Peter knocked at the outer entrance, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer the door.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he knocked at the door of the gateway, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a girl named Rhoda came to answer.
verses.textEnNlt: He knocked at the door in the gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to open it.
verses.textEnNasb: When he knocked at the door of the gate, a slave woman named Rhoda came to answer.
verses.textEn: Peter knocked at the outer entrance, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer the door.

verses.textZh: 她认出是彼得的声音，欢喜到顾不得开门，就跑进去报告，说彼得站在门外。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她认出是彼得的声音，欢喜到顾不得开门，就跑进去报告，说彼得站在门外。
verses.textZhCuv: 听得是彼得的声音，就欢喜的顾不得开门，跑进去告诉众人说：「彼得站在门外。」
verses.textEnNiv: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed she ran back without opening it and exclaimed, "Peter is at the door!"
verses.textEnEsv: Recognizing Peter’s voice, in her joy she did not open the gate but ran in and reported that Peter was standing at the gate.
verses.textEnNkjv: When she recognized Peter’s voice, because of her gladness she did not open the gate, but ran in and announced that Peter stood before the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed that, instead of opening the door, she ran back inside and told everyone, "Peter is standing at the door!"
verses.textEnNasb: When she recognized Peter’s voice, because of her joy she did not open the gate, but ran in and announced that Peter was standing in front of the gate.
verses.textEn: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed she ran back without opening it and exclaimed, "Peter is at the door!"

verses.textZh: 大家说："你疯了！"她却坚持地说这是真的。他们说："一定是他的天使。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大家说："你疯了！"她却坚持地说这是真的。他们说："一定是他的天使。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「你是疯了！」使女极力地说：「真是他！」他们说：「必是他的天使！」
verses.textEnNiv: "You’re out of your mind," they told her. When she kept insisting that it was so, they said, "It must be his angel."
verses.textEnEsv: They said to her, "You are out of your mind." But she kept insisting that it was so, and they kept saying, "It is his angel!"
verses.textEnNkjv: But they said to her, "You are beside yourself!" Yet she kept insisting that it was so. So they said, "It is his angel."
verses.textEnNlt: "You’re out of your mind!" they said. When she insisted, they decided, "It must be his angel."
verses.textEnNasb: They said to her, "You are out of your mind!" But she kept insisting that it was so. They said, "It is his angel."
verses.textEn: "You’re out of your mind," they told her. When she kept insisting that it was so, they said, "It must be his angel."

verses.textZh: 彼得继续敲门；他们打开了，一见是他，就非常惊讶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得继续敲门；他们打开了，一见是他，就非常惊讶。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得不住地敲门。他们开了门，看见他，就甚惊奇。
verses.textEnNiv: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astonished.
verses.textEnEsv: But Peter continued knocking, and when they opened, they saw him and were amazed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Peter continued knocking; and when they opened thedoor and saw him, they were astonished.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Peter continued knocking. When they finally opened the door and saw him, they were amazed.
verses.textEnNasb: But Peter continued knocking; and when they had opened the door, they saw him and were amazed.
verses.textEn: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astonished.

verses.textZh: 彼得作了一个手势，要他们安静，然后对他们述说主怎样领他出监，又说："你们把这些事告诉雅各和众弟兄。"就离开那里，到别的地方去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 彼得作了一个手势，要他们安静，然后对他们述说主怎样领他出监，又说："你们把这些事告诉雅各和众弟兄。"就离开那里，到别的地方去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼得摆手，不要他们作声，就告诉他们主怎样领他出监；又说：「你们把这事告诉雅各和众弟兄。」于是出去，往别处去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Peter motioned with his hand for them to be quiet and described how the Lord had brought him out of prison. "Tell James and the other brothers and sisters about this," he said, and then he left for another place.
verses.textEnEsv: But motioning to them with his hand to be silent, he described to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, "Tell these things to James and to the brothers." Then he departed and went to another place.
verses.textEnNkjv: But motioning to them with his hand to keep silent, he declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, "Go, tell these things to James and to the brethren." And he departed and went to another place.
verses.textEnNlt: He motioned for them to quiet down and told them how the Lord had led him out of prison. "Tell James and the other brothers what happened," he said. And then he went to another place.
verses.textEnNasb: But motioning to them with his hand to be silent, he described to them how the Lord had led him out of the prison. And he said, "Report these things to James and the brothers." Then he left and went to another place.
verses.textEn: Peter motioned with his hand for them to be quiet and described how the Lord had brought him out of prison. "Tell James and the other brothers and sisters about this," he said, and then he left for another place.

verses.textZh: 天亮的时候，士兵们非常慌乱，不知彼得出了甚么事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天亮的时候，士兵们非常慌乱，不知彼得出了甚么事。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了天亮，兵丁扰乱得很，不知道彼得往哪里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: In the morning, there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when day came, there was no little disturbance among the soldiers over what had become of Peter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
verses.textEnNlt: At dawn there was a great commotion among the soldiers about what had happened to Peter.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when day came, there was no small disturbance among the soldiers as to what could have become of Peter.
verses.textEn: In the morning, there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.

verses.textZh: 希律搜索他，却找不到，就审问卫兵，下令把他们带出去处死。后来希律离开犹太，到该撒利亚去，住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希律搜索他，却找不到，就审问卫兵，下令把他们带出去处死。后来希律离开犹太，到该撒利亚去，住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律找他，找不着，就审问看守的人，吩咐把他们拉去杀了。后来希律离开犹太，下凯撒利亚去，住在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: After Herod had a thorough search made for him and did not find him, he cross-examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then Herod went from Judea to Caesarea and stayed there.
verses.textEnEsv: And after Herod searched for him and did not find him, he examined the sentries and ordered that they should be put to death. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and spent time there.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Herod had searched for him and not found him, he examined the guards and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
verses.textEnNlt: Herod Agrippa ordered a thorough search for him. When he couldn’t be found, Herod interrogated the guards and sentenced them to death. Afterward Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while.
verses.textEnNasb: When Herod had searched for him and had not found him, he examined the guards and ordered that they be led away to execution. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and was spending time there.
verses.textEn: After Herod had a thorough search made for him and did not find him, he cross-examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then Herod went from Judea to Caesarea and stayed there.

verses.textZh: 当时希律对推罗和西顿人怀怒在心。这两地的人因为他们的地区都需要从王的领土得到粮食，就先拉拢了王的内侍臣伯拉斯都，然后同心地去见希律，要向他求和。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时希律对推罗和西顿人怀怒在心。这两地的人因为他们的地区都需要从王的领土得到粮食，就先拉拢了王的内侍臣伯拉斯都，然后同心地去见希律，要向他求和。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律恼怒泰尔、西顿的人。他们那一带地方是从王的地土得粮，因此就托了王的内侍臣伯拉斯都的情，一心来求和。
verses.textEnNiv: He had been quarreling with the people of Tyre and Sidon; they now joined together and sought an audience with him. After securing the support of Blastus, a trusted personal servant of the king, they asked for peace, because they depended on the king’s country for their food supply.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Herod was angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon, and they came to him with one accord, and having persuaded Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Herod had been very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon; but they came to him with one accord, and having made Blastus the king’s personal aide their friend, they asked for peace, because their country was supplied with food by the king’s country.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. So they sent a delegation to make peace with him because their cities were dependent upon Herod’s country for food. The delegates won the support of Blastus, Herod’s personal assistant,
verses.textEnNasb: Now he was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon; and with one mind they came to him, and having won over Blastus the king’s chamberlain, they were asking for peace, because their country was supported with grain from the king’s country.
verses.textEn: He had been quarreling with the people of Tyre and Sidon; they now joined together and sought an audience with him. After securing the support of Blastus, a trusted personal servant of the king, they asked for peace, because they depended on the king’s country for their food supply.

verses.textZh: 到了定好的日期，希律穿上王服，坐在高台上，向他们演讲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了定好的日期，希律穿上王服，坐在高台上，向他们演讲。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律在所定的日子，穿上朝服，坐在位上，对他们讲论一番。
verses.textEnNiv: On the appointed day Herod, wearing his royal robes, sat on his throne and delivered a public address to the people.
verses.textEnEsv: On an appointed day Herod put on his royal robes, took his seat upon the throne, and delivered an oration to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So on a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat on his throne and gave an oration to them.
verses.textEnNlt: and an appointment with Herod was granted. When the day arrived, Herod put on his royal robes, sat on his throne, and made a speech to them.
verses.textEnNasb: On an appointed day, after putting on his royal apparel, Herod took his seat on the rostrum and began delivering an address to them.
verses.textEn: On the appointed day Herod, wearing his royal robes, sat on his throne and delivered a public address to the people.

verses.textZh: 群众大声说："这是神的声音，不是人的声音！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众大声说："这是神的声音，不是人的声音！"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓喊着说：「这是神的声音，不是人的声音。」
verses.textEnNiv: They shouted, "This is the voice of a god, not of a man."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people were shouting, "The voice of a god, and not of a man!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people kept shouting, "The voice of a god and not of a man!"
verses.textEnNlt: The people gave him a great ovation, shouting, "It’s the voice of a god, not of a man!"
verses.textEnNasb: The people repeatedly cried out, "The voice of a god and not of a man!"
verses.textEn: They shouted, "This is the voice of a god, not of a man."

verses.textZh: 他不归荣耀给神，所以主的使者立刻击打他，他被虫咬，就断了气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不归荣耀给神，所以主的使者立刻击打他，他被虫咬，就断了气。
verses.textZhCuv: 希律不归荣耀给神，所以主的使者立刻罚他，他被虫所咬，气就绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Immediately, because Herod did not give praise to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
verses.textEnEsv: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him down, because he did not give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and breathed his last.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he did not give glory to God. And he was eaten by worms and died.
verses.textEnNlt: Instantly, an angel of the Lord struck Herod with a sickness, because he accepted the people’s worship instead of giving the glory to God. So he was consumed with worms and died.
verses.textEnNasb: And immediately an angel of the Lord struck him because he did not give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and died.
verses.textEn: Immediately, because Herod did not give praise to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.

verses.textZh: 神的道日渐兴旺，越发广传。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的道日渐兴旺，越发广传。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的道日见兴旺，越发广传。
verses.textEnNiv: But the word of God continued to spread and flourish.
verses.textEnEsv: But the word of God increased and multiplied.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the word of God continued to spread, and there were many new believers.
verses.textEnNasb: But the word of the Lord continued to grow and to be multiplied.
verses.textEn: But the word of God continued to spread and flourish.

verses.textZh: 巴拿巴和扫罗完成了送交捐项的任务，就带著名叫马可的约翰，从耶路撒冷回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴拿巴和扫罗完成了送交捐项的任务，就带著名叫马可的约翰，从耶路撒冷回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴拿巴和扫罗办完了他们供给的事，就从耶路撒冷回来，带着称呼马可的约翰同去。
verses.textEnNiv: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission, they returned from Jerusalem, taking with them John, also called Mark.
verses.textEnEsv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem when they had completed their service, bringing with them John, whose other name was Mark.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their ministry, and they also took with them John whose surname was Mark.
verses.textEnNlt: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission to Jerusalem, they returned, taking John Mark with them.
verses.textEnNasb: And Barnabas and Saul returned when they had fulfilled their mission to Jerusalem, taking along with them John, who was also called Mark.
verses.textEn: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission, they returned from Jerusalem, taking with them John, also called Mark.

verses.textZh: 安提阿教会中，有几位先知和教师，就是巴拿巴、名叫尼结的西面、古利奈人路求、与分封王希律一同长大的马念，和扫罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 安提阿教会中，有几位先知和教师，就是巴拿巴、名叫尼结的西面、古利奈人路求、与分封王希律一同长大的马念，和扫罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 在安提阿的教会中，有几位先知和教师，就是巴拿巴和称呼尼结的西面、古利奈人路求，与分封之王希律同养的马念，并扫罗。
verses.textEnNiv: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch) and Saul.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there were in the church at Antioch prophets and teachers, Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen a lifelong friend of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the church that was at Antioch there were certain prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.textEnNlt: Among the prophets and teachers of the church at Antioch of Syria were Barnabas, Simeon (called "the black man" ), Lucius (from Cyrene), Manaen (the childhood companion of King Herod Antipas ), and Saul.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there were prophets and teachers at Antioch, in the church that was there: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
verses.textEn: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch) and Saul.

verses.textZh: 他们事奉主，并且禁食的时候，圣灵说："要为我把巴拿巴和扫罗分别出来，去作我呼召他们作的工。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们事奉主，并且禁食的时候，圣灵说："要为我把巴拿巴和扫罗分别出来，去作我呼召他们作的工。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们事奉主、禁食的时候，圣灵说：「要为我分派巴拿巴和扫罗，去做我召他们所做的工。」
verses.textEnNiv: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them."
verses.textEnEsv: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them."
verses.textEnNkjv: As they ministered to the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, "Now separate to Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them."
verses.textEnNlt: One day as these men were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Appoint Barnabas and Saul for the special work to which I have called them."
verses.textEnNasb: While they were serving the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Set Barnabas and Saul apart for Me for the work to which I have called them."
verses.textEn: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them."

verses.textZh: 于是他们禁食祷告，为两人按手，就派他们去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们禁食祷告，为两人按手，就派他们去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是禁食祷告，按手在他们头上，就打发他们去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So after they had fasted and prayed, they placed their hands on them and sent them off.
verses.textEnEsv: Then after fasting and praying they laid their hands on them and sent them off.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, having fasted and prayed, and laid hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.textEnNlt: So after more fasting and prayer, the men laid their hands on them and sent them on their way.
verses.textEnNasb: Then, when they had fasted, prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
verses.textEn: So after they had fasted and prayed, they placed their hands on them and sent them off.

verses.textZh: 他们既然奉圣灵差遣，就下到西流基，从那里坐船往塞浦路斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们既然奉圣灵差遣，就下到西流基，从那里坐船往塞浦路斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们既被圣灵差遣，就下到西流基，从那里坐船往塞浦路斯去。
verses.textEnNiv: The two of them, sent on their way by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.
verses.textEnEsv: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia, and from there they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.textEnNkjv: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia, and from there they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.textEnNlt: So Barnabas and Saul were sent out by the Holy Spirit. They went down to the seaport of Seleucia and then sailed for the island of Cyprus.
verses.textEnNasb: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia and from there they sailed to Cyprus.
verses.textEn: The two of them, sent on their way by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.

verses.textZh: 他们到了撒拉米，就在犹太人的各会堂里宣讲神的道，还有约翰作他们的助手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了撒拉米，就在犹太人的各会堂里宣讲神的道，还有约翰作他们的助手。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了撒拉米，就在犹太人各会堂里传讲神的道，也有约翰作他们的帮手。
verses.textEnNiv: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. John was with them as their helper.
verses.textEnEsv: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews. And they had John to assist them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they arrived in Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews. They also had John as their assistant.
verses.textEnNlt: There, in the town of Salamis, they went to the Jewish synagogues and preached the word of God. John Mark went with them as their assistant.
verses.textEnNasb: When they reached Salamis, they began to proclaim the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews; and they also had John as their helper.
verses.textEn: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. John was with them as their helper.

verses.textZh: 他们走遍全岛，到了帕弗，遇见一个犹太人，名叫巴．耶稣，是个术士，又是个假先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们走遍全岛，到了帕弗，遇见一个犹太人，名叫巴．耶稣，是个术士，又是个假先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 经过全岛，直到帕弗，在那里遇见一个有法术、假充先知的犹太人，名叫巴‧耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: They traveled through the whole island until they came to Paphos. There they met a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,
verses.textEnEsv: When they had gone through the whole island as far as Paphos, they came upon a certain magician, a Jewish false prophet named Bar-Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar-Jesus,
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward they traveled from town to town across the entire island until finally they reached Paphos, where they met a Jewish sorcerer, a false prophet named Bar-Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had gone through the whole island as far as Paphos, they found a magician, a Jewish false prophet whose name was Bar-Jesus,
verses.textEn: They traveled through the whole island until they came to Paphos. There they met a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,

verses.textZh: 他常常和省长士求．保罗在一起；省长是个聪明人，他请了巴拿巴和扫罗来，要听听神的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他常常和省长士求．保罗在一起；省长是个聪明人，他请了巴拿巴和扫罗来，要听听神的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人常和方伯士求‧保罗同在。士求‧保罗是个通达人，他请了巴拿巴和扫罗来，要听神的道。
verses.textEnNiv: who was an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, an intelligent man, sent for Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.
verses.textEnEsv: He was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of intelligence, who summoned Barnabas and Saul and sought to hear the word of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, an intelligent man. This man called for Barnabas and Saul and sought to hear the word of God.
verses.textEnNlt: He had attached himself to the governor, Sergius Paulus, who was an intelligent man. The governor invited Barnabas and Saul to visit him, for he wanted to hear the word of God.
verses.textEnNasb: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of intelligence. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul and sought to hear the word of God.
verses.textEn: who was an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, an intelligent man, sent for Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.

verses.textZh: 但术士以吕马 与使徒作对，要使省长转离真道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但术士以吕马 与使徒作对，要使省长转离真道。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是那行法术的以吕马（这名翻出来就是行法术的意思）敌挡使徒，要叫方伯不信真道。
verses.textEnNiv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.
verses.textEnEsv: But Elymas the magician (for that is the meaning of his name) opposed them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so his name is translated) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
verses.textEnNlt: But Elymas, the sorcerer (as his name means in Greek), interfered and urged the governor to pay no attention to what Barnabas and Saul said. He was trying to keep the governor from believing.
verses.textEnNasb: But Elymas the magician (for so his name is translated) was opposing them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
verses.textEn: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.

verses.textZh: 扫罗，也就是保罗，却被圣灵充满，定睛看着他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗，也就是保罗，却被圣灵充满，定睛看着他，
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗又名保罗，被圣灵充满，定睛看他，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked straight at Elymas and said,
verses.textEnEsv: But Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked intently at him
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Saul, who also iscalled Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked intently at him
verses.textEnNlt: Saul, also known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit, and he looked the sorcerer in the eye.
verses.textEnNasb: But Saul, who was also known as Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, stared at him,
verses.textEn: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked straight at Elymas and said,

verses.textZh: 说："你这充满各样诡诈和各样奸恶的人，魔鬼的儿子，公义的仇敌！你歪曲了主的正路，还不停止吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："你这充满各样诡诈和各样奸恶的人，魔鬼的儿子，公义的仇敌！你歪曲了主的正路，还不停止吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「你这充满各样诡诈奸恶，魔鬼的儿子，众善的仇敌，你混乱主的正道还不止住吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "You are a child of the devil and an enemy of everything that is right! You are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery. Will you never stop perverting the right ways of the Lord?
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "You son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, full of all deceit and villainy, will you not stop making crooked the straight paths of the Lord?
verses.textEnNkjv: and said, "O full of all deceit and all fraud, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease perverting the straight ways of the Lord?
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "You son of the devil, full of every sort of deceit and fraud, and enemy of all that is good! Will you never stop perverting the true ways of the Lord?
verses.textEnNasb: and said, " You who are full of all deceit and fraud, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not stop making crooked the straight ways of the Lord?
verses.textEn: "You are a child of the devil and an enemy of everything that is right! You are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery. Will you never stop perverting the right ways of the Lord?

verses.textZh: 你看，现在主的手临到你，你要瞎了眼睛，暂时看不见阳光。"他就立刻被雾和黑暗笼罩着，周围找人牵他的手，给他领路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看，现在主的手临到你，你要瞎了眼睛，暂时看不见阳光。"他就立刻被雾和黑暗笼罩着，周围找人牵他的手，给他领路。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在主的手加在你身上，你要瞎眼，暂且不见日光。」他的眼睛立刻昏蒙黑暗，四下里求人拉着手领他。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the hand of the Lord is against you. You are going to be blind for a time, not even able to see the light of the sun." Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon you, and you will be blind and unable to see the sun for a time." Immediately mist and darkness fell upon him, and he went about seeking people to lead him by the hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, indeed, the hand of the Lord is upon you, and you shall be blind, not seeing the sun for a time." And immediately a dark mist fell on him, and he went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Watch now, for the Lord has laid his hand of punishment upon you, and you will be struck blind. You will not see the sunlight for some time." Instantly mist and darkness came over the man’s eyes, and he began groping around begging for someone to take his hand and lead him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon you, and you will be blind and not see the sun for a time." And immediately a mist and a darkness fell upon him, and he went about seeking those who would lead him by the hand.
verses.textEn: Now the hand of the Lord is against you. You are going to be blind for a time, not even able to see the light of the sun." Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

verses.textZh: 那时，省长看见了所发生的事，就信了，因为他惊奇主的教训。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，省长看见了所发生的事，就信了，因为他惊奇主的教训。
verses.textZhCuv: 方伯看见所做的事，很希奇主的道，就信了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the proconsul believed, when he saw what had occurred, for he was astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the proconsul believed, when he saw what had been done, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When the governor saw what had happened, he became a believer, for he was astonished at the teaching about the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the proconsul believed when he saw what had happened, being amazed at the teaching of the Lord.
verses.textEn: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.

verses.textZh: 保罗和同伴从帕弗开船，来到旁非利亚的别加，约翰却离开他们，回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗和同伴从帕弗开船，来到旁非利亚的别加，约翰却离开他们，回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗和他的同人从帕弗开船，来到旁非利亚的别加，约翰就离开他们，回耶路撒冷去。
verses.textEnNiv: From Paphos, Paul and his companions sailed to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Paul and his companions set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. And John left them and returned to Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Paul and his party set sail from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia; and John, departing from them, returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul and his companions then left Paphos by ship for Pamphylia, landing at the port town of Perga. There John Mark left them and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Paul and his companions put out to sea from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia; but John left them and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: From Paphos, Paul and his companions sailed to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他们从别加往前走，到了彼西底的安提阿，在安息日进了会堂，就坐下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从别加往前走，到了彼西底的安提阿，在安息日进了会堂，就坐下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们离了别加往前行，来到彼西底的安提阿，在安息日进会堂坐下。
verses.textEnNiv: From Perga they went on to Pisidian Antioch. On the Sabbath they entered the synagogue and sat down.
verses.textEnEsv: but they went on from Perga and came to Antioch in Pisidia. And on the Sabbath day they went into the synagogue and sat down.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.
verses.textEnNlt: But Paul and Barnabas traveled inland to Antioch of Pisidia. On the Sabbath they went to the synagogue for the services.
verses.textEnNasb: But going on from Perga, they arrived at Pisidian Antioch, and on the Sabbath day they went into the synagogue and sat down.
verses.textEn: From Perga they went on to Pisidian Antioch. On the Sabbath they entered the synagogue and sat down.

verses.textZh: 宣读了律法和先知书以后，会堂的理事们派人到他们那里来，说："弟兄们，如果有甚么劝勉众人的话，请说吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 宣读了律法和先知书以后，会堂的理事们派人到他们那里来，说："弟兄们，如果有甚么劝勉众人的话，请说吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 读完了律法和先知的书，管会堂的叫人过去，对他们说：「二位兄台，若有什么劝勉众人的话，请说。」
verses.textEnNiv: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the leaders of the synagogue sent word to them, saying, "Brothers, if you have a word of exhortation for the people, please speak."
verses.textEnEsv: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent a message to them, saying, "Brothers, if you have any word of encouragement for the people, say it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And after the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, "Men and brethren, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, say on."
verses.textEnNlt: After the usual readings from the books of Moses and the prophets, those in charge of the service sent them this message: "Brothers, if you have any word of encouragement for the people, come and give it."
verses.textEnNasb: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue officials sent word to them, saying, " Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, say it."
verses.textEn: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the leaders of the synagogue sent word to them, saying, "Brothers, if you have a word of exhortation for the people, please speak."

verses.textZh: 保罗就站起来，作了一个手势，说： "以色列人和敬畏神的人，请听！
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗就站起来，作了一个手势，说： "以色列人和敬畏神的人，请听！
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗就站起来，举手，说：「以色列人和一切敬畏神的人，请听。
verses.textEnNiv: Standing up, Paul motioned with his hand and said: "Fellow Israelites and you Gentiles who worship God, listen to me!
verses.textEnEsv: So Paul stood up, and motioning with his hand said: "Men of Israel and you who fear God, listen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul stood up, and motioning with his hand said, "Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen:
verses.textEnNlt: So Paul stood, lifted his hand to quiet them, and started speaking. "Men of Israel," he said, "and you God-fearing Gentiles, listen to me.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul stood up, and motioning with his hand said, "Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen:
verses.textEn: Standing up, Paul motioned with his hand and said: "Fellow Israelites and you Gentiles who worship God, listen to me!

verses.textZh: 以色列民的神，拣选了我们的祖先；当他们在埃及地寄居的时候，神抬举这民，用大能 的膀臂，把他们从那地领出来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列民的神，拣选了我们的祖先；当他们在埃及地寄居的时候，神抬举这民，用大能 的膀臂，把他们从那地领出来；
verses.textZhCuv: 这以色列民的神拣选了我们的祖宗，当民寄居埃及的时候抬举他们，用大能的手领他们出来；
verses.textEnNiv: The God of the people of Israel chose our ancestors; he made the people prosper during their stay in Egypt; with mighty power he led them out of that country;
verses.textEnEsv: The God of this people Israel chose our fathers and made the people great during their stay in the land of Egypt, and with uplifted arm he led them out of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The God of this people Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He brought them out of it.
