verses.textEnNlt: "The God of this nation of Israel chose our ancestors and made them multiply and grow strong during their stay in Egypt. Then with a powerful arm he led them out of their slavery.
verses.textEnNasb: The God of this people Israel chose our fathers and made the people great during their stay in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He led them out from it.
verses.textEn: The God of the people of Israel chose our ancestors; he made the people prosper during their stay in Egypt; with mighty power he led them out of that country;

verses.textZh: 又在旷野容忍 他们，约有四十年之久；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在旷野容忍 他们，约有四十年之久；
verses.textZhCuv: 又在旷野容忍 他们，约有四十年。
verses.textEnNiv: for about forty years he endured their conduct in the wilderness;
verses.textEnEsv: And for about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now for a time of about forty years He put up with their ways in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: He put up with them through forty years of wandering in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: For a period of about forty years He put up with them in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: for about forty years he endured their conduct in the wilderness;

verses.textZh: 灭了迦南地的七族之后，就把那地分给他们为业；
verses.textZhCnvs: 灭了迦南地的七族之后，就把那地分给他们为业；
verses.textZhCuv: 既灭了迦南地七族的人，就把那地分给他们为业；
verses.textEnNiv: and he overthrew seven nations in Canaan, giving their land to his people as their inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: And after destroying seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land as an inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, He distributed their land to them by allotment.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he destroyed seven nations in Canaan and gave their land to Israel as an inheritance.
verses.textEnNasb: When He had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, He distributed their land as an inheritance—all of which took about 450 years.
verses.textEn: and he overthrew seven nations in Canaan, giving their land to his people as their inheritance.

verses.textZh: 这一切历时约四百五十年。后来神赐给他们士师，直到撒母耳先知为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切历时约四百五十年。后来神赐给他们士师，直到撒母耳先知为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后给他们设立士师，约有四百五十年，直到先知撒母耳的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: All this took about 450 years. "After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.
verses.textEnEsv: All this took about 450 years. And after that he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
verses.textEnNkjv: "After that He gave them judges for about four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: All this took about 450 years. "After that, God gave them judges to rule until the time of Samuel the prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: After these things He gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
verses.textEn: All this took about 450 years. "After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.

verses.textZh: 那时，他们要求立一个王，神就把便雅悯支派中一个人，基士的儿子扫罗，赐给他们作王，共四十年之久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，他们要求立一个王，神就把便雅悯支派中一个人，基士的儿子扫罗，赐给他们作王，共四十年之久。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来他们求一个王，神就将便雅悯支派中基士的儿子扫罗，给他们作王四十年。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the people asked for a king, and he gave them Saul son of Kish, of the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled forty years.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they asked for a king, and God gave them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And afterward they asked for a king; so God gave them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people begged for a king, and God gave them Saul son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, who reigned for forty years.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they asked for a king, and God gave them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
verses.textEn: Then the people asked for a king, and he gave them Saul son of Kish, of the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled forty years.

verses.textZh: 废去扫罗之后，又为他们兴起大卫作王，并且为他作证说：‘我找到耶西的儿子大卫，他是合我心意的人，必遵行我的一切旨意。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 废去扫罗之后，又为他们兴起大卫作王，并且为他作证说：‘我找到耶西的儿子大卫，他是合我心意的人，必遵行我的一切旨意。’
verses.textZhCuv: 既废了扫罗，就选立大卫作他们的王，又为他作见证说：『我寻得耶西的儿子大卫，他是合我心意的人，凡事要遵行我的旨意。』
verses.textEnNiv: After removing Saul, he made David their king. God testified concerning him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse, a man after my own heart; he will do everything I want him to do.’
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, of whom he testified and said, ‘I have found in David the son of Jesse a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And when He had removed him, He raised up for them David as king, to whom also He gave testimony and said, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after My own heart, who will do all My will.’
verses.textEnNlt: But God removed Saul and replaced him with David, a man about whom God said, ‘I have found David son of Jesse, a man after my own heart. He will do everything I want him to do.’
verses.textEnNasb: After He had removed him, He raised up David to be their king, concerning whom He also testified and said, ‘I have found David, the son of Jesse, a man after My heart, who will do all My will.’
verses.textEn: After removing Saul, he made David their king. God testified concerning him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse, a man after my own heart; he will do everything I want him to do.’

verses.textZh: 神照着应许，已经从这人的后裔中，给以色列带来了一位救主，就是耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神照着应许，已经从这人的后裔中，给以色列带来了一位救主，就是耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 从这人的后裔中，神已经照着所应许的，为以色列人立了一位救主，就是耶稣。
verses.textEnNiv: "From this man’s descendants God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as he promised.
verses.textEnEsv: Of this man’s offspring God has brought to Israel a Savior, Jesus, as he promised.
verses.textEnNkjv: From this man’s seed, according to the promise, God raised up for Israel a Savior—Jesus—
verses.textEnNlt: "And it is one of King David’s descendants, Jesus, who is God’s promised Savior of Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: From the descendants of this man, according to promise, God has brought to Israel a Savior, Jesus,
verses.textEn: "From this man’s descendants God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as he promised.

verses.textZh: 在他来临之前，约翰早已向以色列全民宣讲悔改的洗礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他来临之前，约翰早已向以色列全民宣讲悔改的洗礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他没有出来以先，约翰向以色列众民宣讲悔改的洗礼。
verses.textEnNiv: Before the coming of Jesus, John preached repentance and baptism to all the people of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Before his coming, John had proclaimed a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: after John had first preached, before His coming, the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Before he came, John the Baptist preached that all the people of Israel needed to repent of their sins and turn to God and be baptized.
verses.textEnNasb: after John had proclaimed, before His coming, a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
verses.textEn: Before the coming of Jesus, John preached repentance and baptism to all the people of Israel.

verses.textZh: 约翰快要跑完他的路程的时候，说：‘你们以为我是谁？我不是基督。他是在我以后来的，我就是给他解脚上的鞋带也不配。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 约翰快要跑完他的路程的时候，说：‘你们以为我是谁？我不是基督。他是在我以后来的，我就是给他解脚上的鞋带也不配。’
verses.textZhCuv: 约翰将行尽他的程途说：『你们以为我是谁？我不是基督；只是有一位在我以后来的，我解他脚上的鞋带也是不配的。』
verses.textEnNiv: As John was completing his work, he said: ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not the one you are looking for. But there is one coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’
verses.textEnEsv: And as John was finishing his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. No, but behold, after me one is coming, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And as John was finishing his course, he said, ‘Who do you think I am? I am not He. But behold, there comes One after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to loose.’
verses.textEnNlt: As John was finishing his ministry he asked, ‘Do you think I am the Messiah? No, I am not! But he is coming soon—and I’m not even worthy to be his slave and untie the sandals on his feet.’
verses.textEnNasb: And while John was completing his course, he kept saying, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not He. But behold, One is coming after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
verses.textEn: As John was completing his work, he said: ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not the one you are looking for. But there is one coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’

verses.textZh: "弟兄们，亚伯拉罕的子孙，和你们中间敬畏神的人哪，这救恩之道是传给我们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "弟兄们，亚伯拉罕的子孙，和你们中间敬畏神的人哪，这救恩之道是传给我们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「弟兄们，亚伯拉罕的子孙和你们中间敬畏神的人哪，这救世的道是传给我们的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Fellow children of Abraham and you God-fearing Gentiles, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.
verses.textEnEsv: "Brothers, sons of the family of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, to us has been sent the message of this salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Men and brethren, sons of the family of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, to you the word of this salvation has been sent.
verses.textEnNlt: "Brothers—you sons of Abraham, and also you God-fearing Gentiles—this message of salvation has been sent to us!
verses.textEnNasb: " Brothers, sons of Abraham’s family, and those among you who fear God, to us the message of this salvation has been sent.
verses.textEn: "Fellow children of Abraham and you God-fearing Gentiles, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.

verses.textZh: 住在耶路撒冷的人和他们的官长，因为不认识基督，也不明白每逢安息日所读的先知的话，就把他定了罪，正好应验了先知的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在耶路撒冷的人和他们的官长，因为不认识基督，也不明白每逢安息日所读的先知的话，就把他定了罪，正好应验了先知的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷居住的人和他们的官长，因为不认识基督，也不明白每安息日所读众先知的书，就把基督定了死罪，正应了先知的预言；
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.
verses.textEnEsv: For those who live in Jerusalem and their rulers, because they did not recognize him nor understand the utterances of the prophets, which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they did not know Him, nor even the voices of the Prophets which are read every Sabbath, have fulfilled them in condemning Him.
verses.textEnNlt: The people in Jerusalem and their leaders did not recognize Jesus as the one the prophets had spoken about. Instead, they condemned him, and in doing this they fulfilled the prophets’ words that are read every Sabbath.
verses.textEnNasb: For those who live in Jerusalem, and their rulers, recognizing neither Him nor the declarations of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled these by condemning Him.
verses.textEn: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.

verses.textZh: 他们虽然找不出该死的罪状，还是要求彼拉多杀害他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们虽然找不出该死的罪状，还是要求彼拉多杀害他。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽然查不出他有当死的罪来，还是求彼拉多杀他；
verses.textEnNiv: Though they found no proper ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have him executed.
verses.textEnEsv: And though they found in him no guilt worthy of death, they asked Pilate to have him executed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And though they found no cause for death inHim, they asked Pilate that He should be put to death.
verses.textEnNlt: They found no legal reason to execute him, but they asked Pilate to have him killed anyway.
verses.textEnNasb: And though they found no grounds for putting Him to death, they asked Pilate that He be executed.
verses.textEn: Though they found no proper ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have him executed.

verses.textZh: 他们把所记载一切关于他的事作成了，就把他从木头上取下来，放在坟墓里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把所记载一切关于他的事作成了，就把他从木头上取下来，放在坟墓里。
verses.textZhCuv: 既成就了经上指着他所记的一切话，就把他从木头上取下来，放在坟墓里。
verses.textEnNiv: When they had carried out all that was written about him, they took him down from the cross and laid him in a tomb.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had carried out all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they had fulfilled all that was written concerning Him, they took Him down from the tree and laid Him in a tomb.
verses.textEnNlt: "When they had done all that the prophecies said about him, they took him down from the cross and placed him in a tomb.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had carried out everything that was written concerning Him, they took Him down from the cross and laid Him in a tomb.
verses.textEn: When they had carried out all that was written about him, they took him down from the cross and laid him in a tomb.

verses.textZh: 但神却使他从死人中复活了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但神却使他从死人中复活了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神却叫他从死里复活。
verses.textEnNiv: But God raised him from the dead,
verses.textEnEsv: But God raised him from the dead,
verses.textEnNkjv: But God raised Him from the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: But God raised him from the dead!
verses.textEnNasb: But God raised Him from the dead;
verses.textEn: But God raised him from the dead,

verses.textZh: 有许多日子，他向那些跟他一同从加利利上耶路撒冷的人显现，现在这些人在民众面前作了他的见证人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 有许多日子，他向那些跟他一同从加利利上耶路撒冷的人显现，现在这些人在民众面前作了他的见证人，
verses.textZhCuv: 那从加利利同他上耶路撒冷的人多日看见他，这些人如今在民间是他的见证。
verses.textEnNiv: and for many days he was seen by those who had traveled with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now his witnesses to our people.
verses.textEnEsv: and for many days he appeared to those who had come up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now his witnesses to the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was seen for many days by those who came up with Him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are His witnesses to the people.
verses.textEnNlt: And over a period of many days he appeared to those who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now his witnesses to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: and for many days He appeared to those who came up with Him from Galilee to Jerusalem, the very ones who are now His witnesses to the people.
verses.textEn: and for many days he was seen by those who had traveled with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now his witnesses to our people.

verses.textZh: 我们报好信息给你们：神给列祖的应许，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们报好信息给你们：神给列祖的应许，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们也报好信息给你们，就是那应许祖宗的话，
verses.textEnNiv: "We tell you the good news: What God promised our ancestors
verses.textEnEsv: And we bring you the good news that what God promised to the fathers,
verses.textEnNkjv: And we declare to you glad tidings— that promise which was made to the fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now we are here to bring you this Good News. The promise was made to our ancestors,
verses.textEnNasb: And we preach to you the good news of the promise made to the fathers,
verses.textEn: "We tell you the good news: What God promised our ancestors

verses.textZh: 借着耶稣的复活，向我们这些作子孙的应验了。就如诗篇第二篇所记的： ‘你是我的儿子， 我今日生了你。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 借着耶稣的复活，向我们这些作子孙的应验了。就如诗篇第二篇所记的： ‘你是我的儿子， 我今日生了你。’
verses.textZhCuv: 神已经向我们这作儿女的应验，叫耶稣复活了。正如诗篇第二篇上记着说： 你是我的儿子， 我今日生你。
verses.textEnNiv: he has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: " ‘You are my son; today I have become your father.’
verses.textEnEsv: this he has fulfilled to us their children by raising Jesus, as also it is written in the second Psalm, "‘You are my Son, today I have begotten you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: God has fulfilled this for us their children, in that He has raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son, Today I have begotten You.’
verses.textEnNlt: and God has now fulfilled it for us, their descendants, by raising Jesus. This is what the second psalm says about Jesus: ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your Father. ’
verses.textEnNasb: that God has fulfilled this promise to those of us who are the descendants by raising Jesus, as it is also written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son; today I have fathered You.’
verses.textEn: he has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: " ‘You are my son; today I have become your father.’

verses.textZh: 至于神使他从死人中复活，不再归于朽坏，他曾这样说： ‘我必把应许大卫的、神圣可靠的恩福赐给你们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于神使他从死人中复活，不再归于朽坏，他曾这样说： ‘我必把应许大卫的、神圣可靠的恩福赐给你们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 论到神叫他从死里复活，不再归于朽坏，就这样说： 我必将所应许大卫那圣洁、 可靠的恩典赐给你们。
verses.textEnNiv: God raised him from the dead so that he will never be subject to decay. As God has said, " ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’
verses.textEnEsv: And as for the fact that he raised him from the dead, no more to return to corruption, he has spoken in this way, "‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And that He raised Him from the dead, no more to return to corruption, He has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the sure mercies of David.’
verses.textEnNlt: For God had promised to raise him from the dead, not leaving him to rot in the grave. He said, ‘I will give you the sacred blessings I promised to David.’
verses.textEnNasb: As for the fact that He raised Him from the dead, never again to return to decay, He has spoken in this way: ‘I will give you the holy and faithful mercies of David.’
verses.textEn: God raised him from the dead so that he will never be subject to decay. As God has said, " ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’

verses.textZh: 所以他在另一篇说： ‘你必不容你的圣者见朽坏。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以他在另一篇说： ‘你必不容你的圣者见朽坏。’
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一篇上说： 你必不叫你的圣者见朽坏。
verses.textEnNiv: So it is also stated elsewhere: " ‘You will not let your holy one see decay.’
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore he says also in another psalm, "‘You will not let your Holy One see corruption.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He also says in another Psalm: ‘You will not allow Your Holy One to see corruption.’
verses.textEnNlt: Another psalm explains it more fully: ‘You will not allow your Holy One to rot in the grave.’
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, He also says in another Psalm: ‘You will not allow Your Holy One to undergo decay.’
verses.textEn: So it is also stated elsewhere: " ‘You will not let your holy one see decay.’

verses.textZh: "大卫在他自己的世代里，遵行了神的计划，就睡了，归回他列祖那里，见了朽坏。
verses.textZhCnvs: "大卫在他自己的世代里，遵行了神的计划，就睡了，归回他列祖那里，见了朽坏。
verses.textZhCuv: 「大卫在世的时候遵行了神的旨意，就睡了 ，归到他祖宗那里，已见朽坏；
verses.textEnNiv: "Now when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep; he was buried with his ancestors and his body decayed.
verses.textEnEsv: For David, after he had served the purpose of God in his own generation, fell asleep and was laid with his fathers and saw corruption,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell asleep, was buried with his fathers, and saw corruption;
verses.textEnNlt: This is not a reference to David, for after David had done the will of God in his own generation, he died and was buried with his ancestors, and his body decayed.
verses.textEnNasb: For David, after he had served God’s purpose in his own generation, fell asleep, and was buried among his fathers and underwent decay;
verses.textEn: "Now when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep; he was buried with his ancestors and his body decayed.

verses.textZh: 唯独神所复活的那一位，没有见过朽坏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯独神所复活的那一位，没有见过朽坏。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独神所复活的，他并未见朽坏。
verses.textEnNiv: But the one whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.
verses.textEnEsv: but he whom God raised up did not see corruption.
verses.textEnNkjv: but He whom God raised up saw no corruption.
verses.textEnNlt: No, it was a reference to someone else—someone whom God raised and whose body did not decay.
verses.textEnNasb: but He whom God raised did not undergo decay.
verses.textEn: But the one whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.

verses.textZh: 所以弟兄们，你们当知道，赦罪之道是由这位耶稣传给你们的。在你们靠摩西律法不能称义的一切事上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以弟兄们，你们当知道，赦罪之道是由这位耶稣传给你们的。在你们靠摩西律法不能称义的一切事上，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，弟兄们，你们当晓得：赦罪的道是由这人传给你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore, my friends, I want you to know that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Let it be known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let it be known to you, brethren, that through this Man is preached to you the forgiveness of sins;
verses.textEnNlt: "Brothers, listen! We are here to proclaim that through this man Jesus there is forgiveness for your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore let it be known to you, brothers, that through Him forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you,
verses.textEn: "Therefore, my friends, I want you to know that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.

verses.textZh: 信靠他的人就得称义了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 信靠他的人就得称义了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们靠摩西的律法，在一切不得称义的事上信靠这人，就都得称义了。
verses.textEnNiv: Through him everyone who believes is set free from every sin, a justification you were not able to obtain under the law of Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: and by him everyone who believes is freed from everything from which you could not be freed by the law of Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: and by Him everyone who believes is justified from all things from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who believes in him is made right in God’s sight—something the law of Moses could never do.
verses.textEnNasb: and through Him everyone who believes is freed from all things, from which you could not be freed through the Law of Moses.
verses.textEn: Through him everyone who believes is set free from every sin, a justification you were not able to obtain under the law of Moses.

verses.textZh: 你们要小心，免得先知书上所说的临到你们：
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要小心，免得先知书上所说的临到你们：
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们务要小心，免得先知书上所说的临到你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Take care that what the prophets have said does not happen to you:
verses.textEnEsv: Beware, therefore, lest what is said in the Prophets should come about:
verses.textEnNkjv: Beware therefore, lest what has been spoken in the prophets come upon you:
verses.textEnNlt: Be careful! Don’t let the prophets’ words apply to you. For they said,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, see that the thing spoken of in the Prophets does not come upon you:
verses.textEn: Take care that what the prophets have said does not happen to you:

verses.textZh: ‘傲慢的人哪！ 你们要看、要惊奇、要灭亡， 因为在你们的日子，我要作一件事， 就算有人告诉你们，你们总是不信。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘傲慢的人哪！ 你们要看、要惊奇、要灭亡， 因为在你们的日子，我要作一件事， 就算有人告诉你们，你们总是不信。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 主说： 你们这轻慢的人要观看，要惊奇，要灭亡； 因为在你们的时候，我行一件事， 虽有人告诉你们， 你们总是不信。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish, for I am going to do something in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "‘Look, you scoffers, be astounded and perish; for I am doing a work in your days, a work that you will not believe, even if one tells it to you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Behold, you despisers, Marvel and perish! For I work a work in your days, A work which you will by no means believe, Though one were to declare it to you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Look, you mockers, be amazed and die! For I am doing something in your own day, something you wouldn’t believe even if someone told you about it.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Look, you scoffers, and be astonished, and perish; For I am accomplishing a work in your days, A work which you will never believe, though someone should describe it to you.’ "
verses.textEn: " ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish, for I am going to do something in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.’ "

verses.textZh: 保罗和巴拿巴出来的时候，众人请求他们下一个安息日再对他们讲这些话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗和巴拿巴出来的时候，众人请求他们下一个安息日再对他们讲这些话。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们出会堂的时候，众人请他们到下安息日再讲这话给他们听。
verses.textEnNiv: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people invited them to speak further about these things on the next Sabbath.
verses.textEnEsv: As they went out, the people begged that these things might be told them the next Sabbath.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
verses.textEnNlt: As Paul and Barnabas left the synagogue that day, the people begged them to speak about these things again the next week.
verses.textEnNasb: As Paul and Barnabas were going out, the people repeatedly begged to have these things spoken to them the next Sabbath.
verses.textEn: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people invited them to speak further about these things on the next Sabbath.

verses.textZh: 散会以后，许多犹太人和归信犹太教的虔诚人，跟从了保罗和巴拿巴。两人对他们谈话，勉励他们要恒久住在神的恩典中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 散会以后，许多犹太人和归信犹太教的虔诚人，跟从了保罗和巴拿巴。两人对他们谈话，勉励他们要恒久住在神的恩典中。
verses.textZhCuv: 散会以后，犹太人和敬虔进犹太教的人多有跟从保罗、巴拿巴的。二人对他们讲道，劝他们务要恒久在神的恩中。
verses.textEnNiv: When the congregation was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who talked with them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And after the meeting of the synagogue broke up, many Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who, as they spoke with them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the congregation had broken up, many of the Jews and devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas, who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Many Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, and the two men urged them to continue to rely on the grace of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the meeting of the synagogue had broken up, many of the Jews and the God-fearing proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas, who were speaking to them and urging them to continue in the grace of God.
verses.textEn: When the congregation was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who talked with them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.

verses.textZh: 下一个安息日，几乎全城的人都聚了来，要听主的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 下一个安息日，几乎全城的人都聚了来，要听主的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 到下安息日，合城的人几乎都来聚集，要听神的道。
verses.textEnNiv: On the next Sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: The next Sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the next Sabbath almost the whole city came together to hear the word of God.
verses.textEnNlt: The following week almost the entire city turned out to hear them preach the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: The next Sabbath nearly all the city assembled to hear the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: On the next Sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 犹太人看见这么多人，就满心嫉妒，反驳保罗所讲的，并且毁谤他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人看见这么多人，就满心嫉妒，反驳保罗所讲的，并且毁谤他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 但犹太人看见人这样多，就满心嫉妒，硬驳保罗所说的话，并且毁谤。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy. They began to contradict what Paul was saying and heaped abuse on him.
verses.textEnEsv: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy and began to contradict what was spoken by Paul, reviling him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy; and contradicting and blaspheming, they opposed the things spoken by Paul.
verses.textEnNlt: But when some of the Jews saw the crowds, they were jealous; so they slandered Paul and argued against whatever he said.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy and began contradicting the things spoken by Paul, and were blaspheming.
verses.textEn: When the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy. They began to contradict what Paul was saying and heaped abuse on him.

verses.textZh: 保罗和巴拿巴却放胆说："神的道，先讲给你们听，是应该的。但因为你们弃绝这道，断定自己不配得永生，所以我们现在就转向外族人去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗和巴拿巴却放胆说："神的道，先讲给你们听，是应该的。但因为你们弃绝这道，断定自己不配得永生，所以我们现在就转向外族人去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗和巴拿巴放胆说：「神的道先讲给你们原是应当的；只因你们弃绝这道，断定自己不配得永生，我们就转向外邦人去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: "We had to speak the word of God to you first. Since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnEsv: And Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, saying, "It was necessary that the word of God be spoken first to you. Since you thrust it aside and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we are turning to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul and Barnabas grew bold and said, "It was necessary that the word of God should be spoken to you first; but since you reject it, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly and declared, "It was necessary that we first preach the word of God to you Jews. But since you have rejected it and judged yourselves unworthy of eternal life, we will offer it to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly and said, "It was necessary that the word of God be spoken to you first. Since you repudiate it and consider yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we are turning to the Gentiles.
verses.textEn: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: "We had to speak the word of God to you first. Since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.

verses.textZh: 因为主曾这样吩咐我们说： ‘我已立你作外族人的光， 使你把救恩带到地极去。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主曾这样吩咐我们说： ‘我已立你作外族人的光， 使你把救恩带到地极去。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为主曾这样吩咐我们说： 我已经立你作外邦人的光， 叫你施行救恩，直到地极。」
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: " ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For so the Lord has commanded us, saying, "‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For so the Lord has commanded us: ‘I have set you as a light to the Gentiles, That you should be for salvation to the ends of the earth.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord gave us this command when he said, ‘I have made you a light to the Gentiles, to bring salvation to the farthest corners of the earth.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: For so the Lord has commanded us, ‘I have appointed You as a light to the Gentiles, That You may bring salvation to the end of the earth.’ "
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: " ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’ "

verses.textZh: 外族人听见了就欢喜，赞美主的道，凡指定得永生的都信了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 外族人听见了就欢喜，赞美主的道，凡指定得永生的都信了。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人听见这话，就欢喜了，赞美神的道；凡预定得永生的人都信了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and honored the word of the Lord; and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Gentiles heard this, they began rejoicing and glorifying the word of the Lord, and as many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of the Lord. And as many as had been appointed to eternal life believed.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Gentiles heard this, they were very glad and thanked the Lord for his message; and all who were chosen for eternal life became believers.
verses.textEnNasb: When the Gentiles heard this, they began rejoicing and glorifying the word of the Lord; and all who had been appointed to eternal life believed.
verses.textEn: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and honored the word of the Lord; and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.

verses.textZh: 于是主的道传遍那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是主的道传遍那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是主的道传遍了那一带地方。
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord spread through the whole region.
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord was spreading throughout the whole region.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord was being spread throughout all the region.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord’s message spread throughout that region.
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord was being spread through the whole region.
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord spread through the whole region.

verses.textZh: 但犹太人唆使虔诚尊贵的妇女和城内的显要，煽动大家迫害保罗和巴拿巴，把他们驱逐出境。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但犹太人唆使虔诚尊贵的妇女和城内的显要，煽动大家迫害保罗和巴拿巴，把他们驱逐出境。
verses.textZhCuv: 但犹太人挑唆虔敬、尊贵的妇女和城内有名望的人，逼迫保罗、巴拿巴，将他们赶出境外。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Jewish leaders incited the God-fearing women of high standing and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them from their region.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Jews incited the devout women of high standing and the leading men of the city, stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and drove them out of their district.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, raised up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them from their region.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Jews stirred up the influential religious women and the leaders of the city, and they incited a mob against Paul and Barnabas and ran them out of town.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Jews incited the devout women of prominence and the leading men of the city, and instigated a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and drove them out of their region.
verses.textEn: But the Jewish leaders incited the God-fearing women of high standing and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them from their region.

verses.textZh: 两人当众跺掉脚上的尘土，往以哥念去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两人当众跺掉脚上的尘土，往以哥念去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人对着众人跺下脚上的尘土，就往以哥念去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So they shook the dust off their feet as a warning to them and went to Iconium.
verses.textEnEsv: But they shook off the dust from their feet against them and went to Iconium.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they shook off the dust from their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
verses.textEnNlt: So they shook the dust from their feet as a sign of rejection and went to the town of Iconium.
verses.textEnNasb: But they shook off the dust from their feet in protest against them and went to Iconium.
verses.textEn: So they shook the dust off their feet as a warning to them and went to Iconium.

verses.textZh: 门徒满有喜乐，又被圣灵充满。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒满有喜乐，又被圣灵充满。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒满心喜乐，又被圣灵充满。
verses.textEnNiv: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: And the believers were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: And the disciples were continually filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 保罗和巴拿巴在以哥念照样进犹太的会堂讲道，结果一大群犹太人和希腊人都信了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗和巴拿巴在以哥念照样进犹太的会堂讲道，结果一大群犹太人和希腊人都信了。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人在以哥念同进犹太人的会堂，在那里讲的，叫犹太人和希腊人信的很多。
verses.textEnNiv: At Iconium Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue. There they spoke so effectively that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed.
verses.textEnEsv: Now at Iconium they entered together into the Jewish synagogue and spoke in such a way that a great number of both Jews and Greeks believed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened in Iconium that they went together to the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of the Jews and of the Greeks believed.
verses.textEnNlt: The same thing happened in Iconium. Paul and Barnabas went to the Jewish synagogue and preached with such power that a great number of both Jews and Greeks became believers.
verses.textEnNasb: In Iconium they entered the synagogue of the Jews together, and spoke in such a way that a large number of people believed, both of Jews and of Greeks.
verses.textEn: At Iconium Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue. There they spoke so effectively that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed.

verses.textZh: 但不顺从的犹太人，煽动外族人，激起他们仇恨的心，来反对弟兄们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但不顺从的犹太人，煽动外族人，激起他们仇恨的心，来反对弟兄们。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那不顺从的犹太人耸动外邦人，叫他们心里恼恨弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Jews who refused to believe stirred up the other Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the Jews, however, spurned God’s message and poisoned the minds of the Gentiles against Paul and Barnabas.
verses.textEnNasb: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the minds of the Gentiles and embittered them against the brothers.
verses.textEn: But the Jews who refused to believe stirred up the other Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.

verses.textZh: 两人却仍住了很久，靠着主放胆讲论，主也借着他们的手行神迹奇事，证实他恩惠的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两人却仍住了很久，靠着主放胆讲论，主也借着他们的手行神迹奇事，证实他恩惠的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人在那里住了多日，倚靠主放胆讲道，主藉他们的手施行神迹奇事，证明他的恩道。
verses.textEnNiv: So Paul and Barnabas spent considerable time there, speaking boldly for the Lord, who confirmed the message of his grace by enabling them to perform signs and wonders.
verses.textEnEsv: So they remained for a long time, speaking boldly for the Lord, who bore witness to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who was bearing witness to the word of His grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: But the apostles stayed there a long time, preaching boldly about the grace of the Lord. And the Lord proved their message was true by giving them power to do miraculous signs and wonders.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore they spent a long time there speaking boldly with reliance upon the Lord, who was testifying to the word of His grace, granting that signs and wonders be performed by their hands.
verses.textEn: So Paul and Barnabas spent considerable time there, speaking boldly for the Lord, who confirmed the message of his grace by enabling them to perform signs and wonders.

verses.textZh: 城里众人就分裂了，有的附从犹太人，也有的附从使徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城里众人就分裂了，有的附从犹太人，也有的附从使徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 城里的众人就分了党，有附从犹太人的，有附从使徒的。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of the city were divided; some sided with the Jews, others with the apostles.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people of the city were divided; some sided with the Jews and some with the apostles.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the multitude of the city was divided: part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of the town were divided in their opinion about them. Some sided with the Jews, and some with the apostles.
verses.textEnNasb: But the people of the city were divided; and some sided with the Jews, while others, with the apostles.
verses.textEn: The people of the city were divided; some sided with the Jews, others with the apostles.

verses.textZh: 当时，外族人、犹太人，和他们的首领，蠢蠢欲动，想要侮辱使徒，用石头打他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，外族人、犹太人，和他们的首领，蠢蠢欲动，想要侮辱使徒，用石头打他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，外邦人和犹太人，并他们的官长，一齐拥上来，要凌辱使徒，用石头打他们。
verses.textEnNiv: There was a plot afoot among both Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, to mistreat them and stone them.
verses.textEnEsv: When an attempt was made by both Gentiles and Jews, with their rulers, to mistreat them and to stone them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when a violent attempt was made by both the Gentiles and Jews, with their rulers, to abuse and stone them,
verses.textEnNlt: Then a mob of Gentiles and Jews, along with their leaders, decided to attack and stone them.
verses.textEnNasb: And when an attempt was made by both the Gentiles and the Jews with their rulers, to treat them abusively and to stone them,
verses.textEn: There was a plot afoot among both Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, to mistreat them and stone them.

verses.textZh: 两人知道了，就逃往吕高尼的路司得和特庇两城，以及周围的地方，
verses.textZhCnvs: 两人知道了，就逃往吕高尼的路司得和特庇两城，以及周围的地方，
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒知道了，就逃往吕高尼的路司得、特庇两个城和周围地方去，
verses.textEnNiv: But they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding country,
verses.textEnEsv: they learned of it and fled to Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and to the surrounding country,
verses.textEnNkjv: they became aware of it and fled to Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and to the surrounding region.
verses.textEnNlt: When the apostles learned of it, they fled to the region of Lycaonia—to the towns of Lystra and Derbe and the surrounding area.
verses.textEnNasb: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra and Derbe, and the surrounding region;
verses.textEn: But they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding country,

verses.textZh: 在那里传福音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里传福音。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里传福音。
verses.textEnNiv: where they continued to preach the gospel.
verses.textEnEsv: and there they continued to preach the gospel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were preaching the gospel there.
verses.textEnNlt: And there they preached the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: and there they continued to preach the gospel.
verses.textEn: where they continued to preach the gospel.

verses.textZh: 路司得城有一个双脚无力的人，坐在那里。他生来就是瘸腿的，从来没有走过路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 路司得城有一个双脚无力的人，坐在那里。他生来就是瘸腿的，从来没有走过路。
verses.textZhCuv: 路司得城里坐着一个两脚无力的人，生来是瘸腿的，从来没有走过。
verses.textEnNiv: In Lystra there sat a man who was lame. He had been that way from birth and had never walked.
verses.textEnEsv: Now at Lystra there was a man sitting who could not use his feet. He was crippled from birth and had never walked.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in Lystra a certain man without strength in his feet was sitting, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who had never walked.
verses.textEnNlt: While they were at Lystra, Paul and Barnabas came upon a man with crippled feet. He had been that way from birth, so he had never walked. He was sitting
verses.textEnNasb: In Lystra a man was sitting whose feet were incapacitated. He had been disabled from his mother’s womb, and had never walked.
verses.textEn: In Lystra there sat a man who was lame. He had been that way from birth and had never walked.

verses.textZh: 他听保罗讲道；保罗注视他，见他有信心，可以治好，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他听保罗讲道；保罗注视他，见他有信心，可以治好，
verses.textZhCuv: 他听保罗讲道，保罗定睛看他，见他有信心，可得痊愈，
verses.textEnNiv: He listened to Paul as he was speaking. Paul looked directly at him, saw that he had faith to be healed
verses.textEnEsv: He listened to Paul speaking. And Paul, looking intently at him and seeing that he had faith to be made well,
verses.textEnNkjv: This man heard Paul speaking. Paul, observing him intently and seeing that he had faith to be healed,
verses.textEnNlt: and listening as Paul preached. Looking straight at him, Paul realized he had faith to be healed.
verses.textEnNasb: This man was listening to Paul as he spoke. Paul looked at him intently and saw that he had faith to be made well,
verses.textEn: He listened to Paul as he was speaking. Paul looked directly at him, saw that he had faith to be healed

verses.textZh: 就大声说："你起来，两脚站直！"他就跳起来，并且走起路来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就大声说："你起来，两脚站直！"他就跳起来，并且走起路来。
verses.textZhCuv: 就大声说：「你起来，两脚站直！」那人就跳起来，而且行走。
verses.textEnNiv: and called out, "Stand up on your feet!" At that, the man jumped up and began to walk.
verses.textEnEsv: said in a loud voice, "Stand upright on your feet." And he sprang up and began walking.
verses.textEnNkjv: said with a loud voice, "Stand up straight on your feet!" And he leaped and walked.
verses.textEnNlt: So Paul called to him in a loud voice, "Stand up!" And the man jumped to his feet and started walking.
verses.textEnNasb: and he said with a loud voice, "Stand upright on your feet!" And the man leaped up and began to walk.
verses.textEn: and called out, "Stand up on your feet!" At that, the man jumped up and began to walk.

verses.textZh: 众人看见保罗所作的事，就用吕高尼话大声说："有神明成了人形，降到我们这里来了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人看见保罗所作的事，就用吕高尼话大声说："有神明成了人形，降到我们这里来了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人看见保罗所做的事，就用吕高尼的话大声说：「有神藉着人形降临在我们中间了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they shouted in the Lycaonian language, "The gods have come down to us in human form!"
verses.textEnEsv: And when the crowds saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in Lycaonian, "The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the people saw what Paul had done, they raised their voices, saying in the Lycaonian language, "The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!"
verses.textEnNlt: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they shouted in their local dialect, "These men are gods in human form!"
verses.textEnNasb: When the crowds saw what Paul had done, they raised their voice, saying in the Lycaonian language, "The gods have become like men and have come down to us!"
verses.textEn: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they shouted in the Lycaonian language, "The gods have come down to us in human form!"

verses.textZh: 于是他们称巴拿巴为宙斯，称保罗为汉密士，因为保罗带头讲话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们称巴拿巴为宙斯，称保罗为汉密士，因为保罗带头讲话。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是称巴拿巴为宙斯，称保罗为希耳米，因为他说话领首。
verses.textEnNiv: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes because he was the chief speaker.
verses.textEnEsv: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul, Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul, Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.textEnNlt: They decided that Barnabas was the Greek god Zeus and that Paul was Hermes, since he was the chief speaker.
verses.textEnNasb: And they began calling Barnabas, Zeus, and Paul, Hermes, since he was the chief speaker.
verses.textEn: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes because he was the chief speaker.

verses.textZh: 城门前宙斯庙的祭司，牵着几头公牛，拿着一些花环来到门口，要同群众一起献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城门前宙斯庙的祭司，牵着几头公牛，拿着一些花环来到门口，要同群众一起献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 有城外宙斯庙的祭司牵着牛，拿着花圈，来到门前，要同众人向使徒献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates because he and the crowd wanted to offer sacrifices to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the priest of Zeus, whose temple was at the entrance to the city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates and wanted to offer sacrifice with the crowds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priest of Zeus, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, intending to sacrifice with the multitudes.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the temple of Zeus was located just outside the town. So the priest of the temple and the crowd brought bulls and wreaths of flowers to the town gates, and they prepared to offer sacrifices to the apostles.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and wanted to offer sacrifice with the crowds.
verses.textEn: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates because he and the crowd wanted to offer sacrifices to them.

verses.textZh: 巴拿巴和保罗两个使徒听见了，就撕裂衣服，跳进群众中间，喊着说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴拿巴和保罗两个使徒听见了，就撕裂衣服，跳进群众中间，喊着说：
verses.textZhCuv: 巴拿巴、保罗二使徒听见，就撕开衣裳，跳进众人中间，喊着说：
verses.textEnNiv: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard of this, they tore their clothes and rushed out into the crowd, shouting:
verses.textEnEsv: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard of it, they tore their garments and rushed out into the crowd, crying out,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard this, they tore their clothes and ran in among the multitude, crying out
verses.textEnNlt: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard what was happening, they tore their clothing in dismay and ran out among the people, shouting,
verses.textEnNasb: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard about it, they tore their robes and rushed out into the crowd, crying out
verses.textEn: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard of this, they tore their clothes and rushed out into the crowd, shouting:

verses.textZh: "各位，为甚么这样作呢？我们也是人，性情和你们一样，我们传福音给你们，正是要你们远离这些虚妄的事，归向永活的神，就是那创造天、地、海和其中万物的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: "各位，为甚么这样作呢？我们也是人，性情和你们一样，我们传福音给你们，正是要你们远离这些虚妄的事，归向永活的神，就是那创造天、地、海和其中万物的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 「诸君，为什么做这事呢？我们也是人，性情和你们一样。我们传福音给你们，是叫你们离弃这些虚妄，归向那创造天、地、海，和其中万物的永生神。
verses.textEnNiv: "Friends, why are you doing this? We too are only human, like you. We are bringing you good news, telling you to turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and everything in them.
verses.textEnEsv: "Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men, of like nature with you, and we bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to a living God, who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and all that is in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: and saying, "Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men with the same nature as you, and preach to you that you should turn from these useless things to the living God, who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and all things that are in them,
verses.textEnNlt: "Friends, why are you doing this? We are merely human beings—just like you! We have come to bring you the Good News that you should turn from these worthless things and turn to the living God, who made heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
verses.textEnNasb: and saying, "Men, why are you doing these things? We are also men, of the same nature as you, preaching the gospel to you, to turn from these useless things to a living God, who made the heaven and the earth and the sea, and everything that is in them.
verses.textEn: "Friends, why are you doing this? We too are only human, like you. We are bringing you good news, telling you to turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and everything in them.

verses.textZh: 在从前的世代里，他容忍万国各行其道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在从前的世代里，他容忍万国各行其道，
verses.textZhCuv: 他在从前的世代，任凭万国各行其道；
verses.textEnNiv: In the past, he let all nations go their own way.
verses.textEnEsv: In past generations he allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: who in bygone generations allowed all nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.textEnNlt: In the past he permitted all the nations to go their own ways,
verses.textEnNasb: In past generations He permitted all the nations to go their own ways;
verses.textEn: In the past, he let all nations go their own way.

verses.textZh: 然而却未尝不为自己留下明证，就如常常行善事，从天上降下雨来，常常赏赐丰年，使你们吃喝充足，满心欢乐。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而却未尝不为自己留下明证，就如常常行善事，从天上降下雨来，常常赏赐丰年，使你们吃喝充足，满心欢乐。"
verses.textZhCuv: 然而为自己未尝不显出证据来，就如常施恩惠，从天降雨，赏赐丰年，叫你们饮食饱足，满心喜乐。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yet he has not left himself without testimony: He has shown kindness by giving you rain from heaven and crops in their seasons; he provides you with plenty of food and fills your hearts with joy."
verses.textEnEsv: Yet he did not leave himself without witness, for he did good by giving you rains from heaven and fruitful seasons, satisfying your hearts with food and gladness."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless He did not leave Himself without witness, in that He did good, gave us rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness."
verses.textEnNlt: but he never left them without evidence of himself and his goodness. For instance, he sends you rain and good crops and gives you food and joyful hearts."
verses.textEnNasb: yet He did not leave Himself without witness, in that He did good and gave you rains from heaven and fruitful seasons, satisfying your hearts with food and gladness."
verses.textEn: Yet he has not left himself without testimony: He has shown kindness by giving you rain from heaven and crops in their seasons; he provides you with plenty of food and fills your hearts with joy."

verses.textZh: 两人说完了这些话，这才阻止群众，不向他们献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两人说完了这些话，这才阻止群众，不向他们献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人说了这些话，仅仅地拦住众人不献祭与他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Even with these words, they had difficulty keeping the crowd from sacrificing to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Even with these words they scarcely restrained the people from offering sacrifice to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And with these sayings they could scarcely restrain the multitudes from sacrificing to them.
verses.textEnNlt: But even with these words, Paul and Barnabas could scarcely restrain the people from sacrificing to them.
verses.textEnNasb: And even by saying these things, only with difficulty did they restrain the crowds from offering sacrifices to them.
verses.textEn: Even with these words, they had difficulty keeping the crowd from sacrificing to them.

verses.textZh: 但有些犹太人，从安提阿、以哥念来，挑唆群众，用石头打保罗，以为他死了，就拖到城外去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但有些犹太人，从安提阿、以哥念来，挑唆群众，用石头打保罗，以为他死了，就拖到城外去。
verses.textZhCuv: 但有些犹太人从安提阿和以哥念来，挑唆众人，就用石头打保罗，以为他是死了，便拖到城外。
verses.textEnNiv: Then some Jews came from Antioch and Iconium and won the crowd over. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, thinking he was dead.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jews came from Antioch and Iconium, and having persuaded the crowds, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there; and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing him to be dead.
verses.textEnNlt: Then some Jews arrived from Antioch and Iconium and won the crowds to their side. They stoned Paul and dragged him out of town, thinking he was dead.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jews came from Antioch and Iconium, and having won over the crowds, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, thinking that he was dead.
verses.textEn: Then some Jews came from Antioch and Iconium and won the crowd over. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, thinking he was dead.

verses.textZh: 门徒正围着他的时候，他竟然站起来，走进城里去了。第二天，他跟巴拿巴一同到特庇去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门徒正围着他的时候，他竟然站起来，走进城里去了。第二天，他跟巴拿巴一同到特庇去。
verses.textZhCuv: 门徒正围着他，他就起来，走进城去。 第二天，同巴拿巴往特庇去，
verses.textEnNiv: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas left for Derbe.
verses.textEnEsv: But when the disciples gathered about him, he rose up and entered the city, and on the next day he went on with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, when the disciples gathered around him, he rose up and went into the city. And the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.textEnNlt: But as the believers gathered around him, he got up and went back into the town. The next day he left with Barnabas for Derbe.
verses.textEnNasb: But while the disciples stood around him, he got up and entered the city. The next day he left with Barnabas for Derbe.
verses.textEn: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas left for Derbe.

verses.textZh: 他们在那城里传福音，使许多人作了门徒，然后回到路司得、以哥念、安提阿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在那城里传福音，使许多人作了门徒，然后回到路司得、以哥念、安提阿，
verses.textZhCuv: 对那城里的人传了福音，使好些人作门徒，就回路司得、以哥念、安提阿去，
verses.textEnNiv: They preached the gospel in that city and won a large number of disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium and Antioch,
verses.textEnEsv: When they had preached the gospel to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra and to Iconium and to Antioch,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had preached the gospel to that city and made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
verses.textEnNlt: After preaching the Good News in Derbe and making many disciples, Paul and Barnabas returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch of Pisidia,
verses.textEnNasb: And after they had preached the gospel to that city and had made a good number of disciples, they returned to Lystra, to Iconium, and to Antioch,
verses.textEn: They preached the gospel in that city and won a large number of disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium and Antioch,

verses.textZh: 坚固门徒的心，劝他们恒守所信的道，又说："我们进入神的国，必须经历许多苦难。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 坚固门徒的心，劝他们恒守所信的道，又说："我们进入神的国，必须经历许多苦难。"
verses.textZhCuv: 坚固门徒的心，劝他们恒守所信的道；又说：「我们进入神的国，必须经历许多艰难。」
verses.textEnNiv: strengthening the disciples and encouraging them to remain true to the faith. "We must go through many hardships to enter the kingdom of God," they said.
verses.textEnEsv: strengthening the souls of the disciples, encouraging them to continue in the faith, and saying that through many tribulations we must enter the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and saying, "We must through many tribulations enter the kingdom of God."
verses.textEnNlt: where they strengthened the believers. They encouraged them to continue in the faith, reminding them that we must suffer many hardships to enter the Kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNasb: strengthening the souls of the disciples, encouraging them to continue in the faith, and saying, "It is through many tribulations that we must enter the kingdom of God."
verses.textEn: strengthening the disciples and encouraging them to remain true to the faith. "We must go through many hardships to enter the kingdom of God," they said.

verses.textZh: 两人在各教会为他们指派了长老；禁食祈祷之后，就把他们交托给所信的主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两人在各教会为他们指派了长老；禁食祈祷之后，就把他们交托给所信的主。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人在各教会中选立了长老，又禁食祷告，就把他们交托所信的主。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church and, with prayer and fasting, committed them to the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had appointed elders for them in every church, with prayer and fasting they committed them to the Lord in whom they had believed.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they had appointed elders in every church, and prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord in whom they had believed.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul and Barnabas also appointed elders in every church. With prayer and fasting, they turned the elders over to the care of the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had appointed elders for them in every church, having prayed with fasting, they entrusted them to the Lord in whom they had believed.
verses.textEn: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church and, with prayer and fasting, committed them to the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.

verses.textZh: 两人经过彼西底，来到旁非利亚，
verses.textZhCnvs: 两人经过彼西底，来到旁非利亚，
verses.textZhCuv: 二人经过彼西底，来到旁非利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: After going through Pisidia, they came into Pamphylia,
verses.textEnEsv: Then they passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after they had passed through Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they traveled back through Pisidia to Pamphylia.
verses.textEnNasb: They passed through Pisidia and came into Pamphylia.
verses.textEn: After going through Pisidia, they came into Pamphylia,

verses.textZh: 在别加讲道以后，就下到亚大利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在别加讲道以后，就下到亚大利。
verses.textZhCuv: 在别加讲了道，就下亚大利去，
verses.textEnNiv: and when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
verses.textEnNlt: They preached the word in Perga, then went down to Attalia.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
verses.textEn: and when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

verses.textZh: 从那里坐船往安提阿。从前众人就是在这地方，把他们交托在神的恩典中，派他们去工作，现在他们已经完成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那里坐船往安提阿。从前众人就是在这地方，把他们交托在神的恩典中，派他们去工作，现在他们已经完成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里坐船，往安提阿去。当初，他们被众人所托、蒙神之恩、要办现在所做之工，就是在这地方。
verses.textEnNiv: From Attalia they sailed back to Antioch, where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work they had now completed.
verses.textEnEsv: and from there they sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work that they had fulfilled.
verses.textEnNkjv: From there they sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work which they had completed.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, they returned by ship to Antioch of Syria, where their journey had begun. The believers there had entrusted them to the grace of God to do the work they had now completed.
verses.textEnNasb: From there they sailed to Antioch, where they had been entrusted to the grace of God for the work that they had accomplished.
verses.textEn: From Attalia they sailed back to Antioch, where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work they had now completed.

verses.textZh: 他们到了那里，就召集了会众，报告神跟他们一起所行的一切，并且他为外族人开了信道的门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了那里，就召集了会众，报告神跟他们一起所行的一切，并且他为外族人开了信道的门。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了那里，聚集了会众，就述说神藉他们所行的一切事，并神怎样为外邦人开了信道的门。
verses.textEnNiv: On arriving there, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them and how he had opened a door of faith to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they arrived and gathered the church together, they declared all that God had done with them, and how he had opened a door of faith to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they had come and gathered the church together, they reported all that God had done with them, and that He had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: Upon arriving in Antioch, they called the church together and reported everything God had done through them and how he had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles, too.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had arrived and gathered the church together, they began to report all the things that God had done with them and how He had opened a door of faith to the Gentiles.
verses.textEn: On arriving there, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them and how he had opened a door of faith to the Gentiles.

verses.textZh: 两人同门徒住了不少日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两人同门徒住了不少日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人就在那里同门徒住了多日。
verses.textEnNiv: And they stayed there a long time with the disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: And they remained no little time with the disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they stayed there a long time with the disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: And they stayed there with the believers for a long time.
verses.textEnNasb: And they spent a long time with the disciples.
verses.textEn: And they stayed there a long time with the disciples.

verses.textZh: 有几个人从犹太下来，教导弟兄们说："你们若不照摩西的规例受割礼，就不能得救。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有几个人从犹太下来，教导弟兄们说："你们若不照摩西的规例受割礼，就不能得救。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有几个人从犹太下来，教训弟兄们说：「你们若不按摩西的规条受割礼，不能得救。」
verses.textEnNiv: Certain people came down from Judea to Antioch and were teaching the believers: "Unless you are circumcised, according to the custom taught by Moses, you cannot be saved."
verses.textEnEsv: But some men came down from Judea and were teaching the brothers, "Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved."
verses.textEnNkjv: And certain men came down from Judea and taught the brethren, "Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved."
verses.textEnNlt: While Paul and Barnabas were at Antioch of Syria, some men from Judea arrived and began to teach the believers : "Unless you are circumcised as required by the law of Moses, you cannot be saved."
verses.textEnNasb: Some men came down from Judea and began teaching the brothers, "Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved."
verses.textEn: Certain people came down from Judea to Antioch and were teaching the believers: "Unless you are circumcised, according to the custom taught by Moses, you cannot be saved."

verses.textZh: 保罗和巴拿巴，与他们大大地争执辩论起来。大家就派保罗、巴拿巴和他们中间的几个人，为这个问题上耶路撒冷去见使徒和长老。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗和巴拿巴，与他们大大地争执辩论起来。大家就派保罗、巴拿巴和他们中间的几个人，为这个问题上耶路撒冷去见使徒和长老。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗、巴拿巴与他们大大地纷争辩论；众门徒就定规，叫保罗、巴拿巴和本会中几个人，为所辩论的，上耶路撒冷去见使徒和长老。
verses.textEnNiv: This brought Paul and Barnabas into sharp dispute and debate with them. So Paul and Barnabas were appointed, along with some other believers, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.textEnEsv: And after Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and debate with them, Paul and Barnabas and some of the others were appointed to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and the elders about this question.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and dispute with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas and certain others of them should go up to Jerusalem, to the apostles and elders, about this question.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul and Barnabas disagreed with them, arguing vehemently. Finally, the church decided to send Paul and Barnabas to Jerusalem, accompanied by some local believers, to talk to the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.textEnNasb: And after Paul and Barnabas had a heated argument and debate with them, the brothers determined that Paul and Barnabas and some others of them should go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders concerning this issue.
verses.textEn: This brought Paul and Barnabas into sharp dispute and debate with them. So Paul and Barnabas were appointed, along with some other believers, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.

verses.textZh: 于是教会给他们送行，他们就经过腓尼基、撒玛利亚，述说外族人怎样归主的事，使弟兄们大大喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是教会给他们送行，他们就经过腓尼基、撒玛利亚，述说外族人怎样归主的事，使弟兄们大大喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是教会送他们起行。他们经过腓尼基、撒马利亚，随处传说外邦人归主的事，叫众弟兄都甚欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: The church sent them on their way, and as they traveled through Phoenicia and Samaria, they told how the Gentiles had been converted. This news made all the believers very glad.
verses.textEnEsv: So, being sent on their way by the church, they passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, describing in detail the conversion of the Gentiles, and brought great joy to all the brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: So, being sent on their way by the church, they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria, describing the conversion of the Gentiles; and they caused great joy to all the brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: The church sent the delegates to Jerusalem, and they stopped along the way in Phoenicia and Samaria to visit the believers. They told them—much to everyone’s joy—that the Gentiles, too, were being converted.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, after being sent on their way by the church, they were passing through both Phoenicia and Samaria, describing in detail the conversion of the Gentiles, and they were bringing great joy to all the brothers and sisters.
verses.textEn: The church sent them on their way, and as they traveled through Phoenicia and Samaria, they told how the Gentiles had been converted. This news made all the believers very glad.

verses.textZh: 到了耶路撒冷，他们受到教会、使徒和长老的接待，就报告神同他们一起所行的一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了耶路撒冷，他们受到教会、使徒和长老的接待，就报告神同他们一起所行的一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了耶路撒冷，教会和使徒并长老都接待他们，他们就述说神同他们所行的一切事。
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and the apostles and elders, to whom they reported everything God had done through them.
verses.textEnEsv: When they came to Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and the apostles and the elders, and they declared all that God had done with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the church and the apostles and the elders; and they reported all things that God had done with them.
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived in Jerusalem, Barnabas and Paul were welcomed by the whole church, including the apostles and elders. They reported everything God had done through them.
verses.textEnNasb: When they arrived in Jerusalem, they were received by the church, the apostles, and the elders, and they reported all that God had done with them.
verses.textEn: When they came to Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and the apostles and elders, to whom they reported everything God had done through them.

verses.textZh: 然而有几个法利赛派的信徒站起来，说："我们必须给外族人行割礼，吩咐他们遵守摩西的律法。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而有几个法利赛派的信徒站起来，说："我们必须给外族人行割礼，吩咐他们遵守摩西的律法。"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有几个信徒是法利赛教门的人，起来说：「必须给外邦人行割礼，吩咐他们遵守摩西的律法。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then some of the believers who belonged to the party of the Pharisees stood up and said, "The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to keep the law of Moses."
verses.textEnEsv: But some believers who belonged to the party of the Pharisees rose up and said, "It is necessary to circumcise them and to order them to keep the law of Moses."
verses.textEnNkjv: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, "It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses."
verses.textEnNlt: But then some of the believers who belonged to the sect of the Pharisees stood up and insisted, "The Gentile converts must be circumcised and required to follow the law of Moses."
verses.textEnNasb: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who had believed stood up, saying, "It is necessary to circumcise them and to direct them to keep the Law of Moses."
verses.textEn: Then some of the believers who belonged to the party of the Pharisees stood up and said, "The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to keep the law of Moses."

verses.textZh: 使徒和长老聚集在一起，商议这件事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使徒和长老聚集在一起，商议这件事。
verses.textZhCuv: 使徒和长老聚会商议这事；
verses.textEnNiv: The apostles and elders met to consider this question.
verses.textEnEsv: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to consider this matter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the apostles and elders came together to consider this matter.
verses.textEnNlt: So the apostles and elders met together to resolve this issue.
verses.textEnNasb: The apostles and the elders came together to look into this matter.
verses.textEn: The apostles and elders met to consider this question.

verses.textZh: 经过了很多的辩论，彼得站起来对他们说："弟兄们，你们知道，前些时候神在你们中间拣选了我，使外族人从我的口中听见福音的道，而且信了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 经过了很多的辩论，彼得站起来对他们说："弟兄们，你们知道，前些时候神在你们中间拣选了我，使外族人从我的口中听见福音的道，而且信了。
verses.textZhCuv: 辩论已经多了，彼得就起来，说：「诸位弟兄，你们知道神早已在你们中间拣选了我，叫外邦人从我口中得听福音之道，而且相信。
verses.textEnNiv: After much discussion, Peter got up and addressed them: "Brothers, you know that some time ago God made a choice among you that the Gentiles might hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.
verses.textEnEsv: And after there had been much debate, Peter stood up and said to them, "Brothers, you know that in the early days God made a choice among you, that by my mouth the Gentiles should hear the word of the gospel and believe.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when there had been much dispute, Peter rose up and said to them: "Men and brethren, you know that a good while ago God chose among us, that by my mouth the Gentiles should hear the word of the gospel and believe.
verses.textEnNlt: At the meeting, after a long discussion, Peter stood and addressed them as follows: "Brothers, you all know that God chose me from among you some time ago to preach to the Gentiles so that they could hear the Good News and believe.
verses.textEnNasb: After there had been much debate, Peter stood up and said to them, " Brothers, you know that in the early days God made a choice among you, that by my mouth the Gentiles would hear the word of the gospel and believe.
verses.textEn: After much discussion, Peter got up and addressed them: "Brothers, you know that some time ago God made a choice among you that the Gentiles might hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.

verses.textZh: 知道人心的神也为他们作证─赐圣灵给他们，像给我们一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 知道人心的神也为他们作证─赐圣灵给他们，像给我们一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 知道人心的神也为他们作了见证，赐圣灵给他们，正如给我们一样；
verses.textEnNiv: God, who knows the heart, showed that he accepted them by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as he did to us.
verses.textEnEsv: And God, who knows the heart, bore witness to them, by giving them the Holy Spirit just as he did to us,
verses.textEnNkjv: So God, who knows the heart, acknowledged them by giving them the Holy Spirit, just as Hedid to us,
verses.textEnNlt: God knows people’s hearts, and he confirmed that he accepts Gentiles by giving them the Holy Spirit, just as he did to us.
verses.textEnNasb: And God, who knows the heart, testified to them giving them the Holy Spirit, just as He also did to us;
verses.textEn: God, who knows the heart, showed that he accepted them by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as he did to us.

verses.textZh: 而且他待他们和我们没有分别，因为借着信，他洁净了他们的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且他待他们和我们没有分别，因为借着信，他洁净了他们的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 又藉着信洁净了他们的心，并不分他们我们。
verses.textEnNiv: He did not discriminate between us and them, for he purified their hearts by faith.
verses.textEnEsv: and he made no distinction between us and them, having cleansed their hearts by faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: and made no distinction between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
verses.textEnNlt: He made no distinction between us and them, for he cleansed their hearts through faith.
verses.textEnNasb: and He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.
verses.textEn: He did not discriminate between us and them, for he purified their hearts by faith.

verses.textZh: 现在你们为甚么试探神，把我们祖先和我们所不能负的轭，放在门徒的颈上呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们为甚么试探神，把我们祖先和我们所不能负的轭，放在门徒的颈上呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 现在为什么试探神，要把我们祖宗和我们所不能负的轭放在门徒的颈项上呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, why do you try to test God by putting on the necks of Gentiles a yoke that neither we nor our ancestors have been able to bear?
verses.textEnEsv: Now, therefore, why are you putting God to the test by placing a yoke on the neck of the disciples that neither our fathers nor we have been able to bear?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, why do you test God by putting a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.textEnNlt: So why are you now challenging God by burdening the Gentile believers with a yoke that neither we nor our ancestors were able to bear?
verses.textEnNasb: Since this is the case, why are you putting God to the test by placing upon the neck of the disciples a yoke which neither our forefathers nor we have been able to bear?
verses.textEn: Now then, why do you try to test God by putting on the necks of Gentiles a yoke that neither we nor our ancestors have been able to bear?

verses.textZh: 我们相信，我们得救是借着主耶稣的恩，和他们也是一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们相信，我们得救是借着主耶稣的恩，和他们也是一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们得救乃是因主耶稣的恩，和他们一样，这是我们所信的。」
verses.textEnNiv: No! We believe it is through the grace of our Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are."
verses.textEnEsv: But we believe that we will be saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they will."
verses.textEnNkjv: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved in the same manner as they."
verses.textEnNlt: We believe that we are all saved the same way, by the undeserved grace of the Lord Jesus."
verses.textEnNasb: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, in the same way as they also are."
verses.textEn: No! We believe it is through the grace of our Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are."

verses.textZh: 当时，使徒、长老和全教会都认为好，就从他们中间选出人来，差他们和保罗、巴拿巴一同到安提阿去，所选的就是别号巴撒巴的犹大和西拉，他们是弟兄中的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，使徒、长老和全教会都认为好，就从他们中间选出人来，差他们和保罗、巴拿巴一同到安提阿去，所选的就是别号巴撒巴的犹大和西拉，他们是弟兄中的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，使徒和长老并全教会定意从他们中间拣选人，差他们和保罗、巴拿巴同往安提阿去；所拣选的就是称呼巴撒巴的犹大和西拉。这两个人在弟兄中是作首领的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the apostles and elders, with the whole church, decided to choose some of their own men and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Judas (called Barsabbas) and Silas, men who were leaders among the believers.

verses.textEnNkjv: Then it pleased the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas, namely, Judas who was also named Barsabas, and Silas, leading men among the brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the apostles and elders together with the whole church in Jerusalem chose delegates, and they sent them to Antioch of Syria with Paul and Barnabas to report on this decision. The men chosen were two of the church leaders —Judas (also called Barsabbas) and Silas.

verses.textEn: Then the apostles and elders, with the whole church, decided to choose some of their own men and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Judas (called Barsabbas) and Silas, men who were leaders among the believers.

verses.textEn: With them they sent the following letter: The apostles and elders, your brothers, To the Gentile believers in Antioch, Syria and Cilicia: Greetings.

verses.textZhCnvs: 我们听说有人从我们这里出去，说了一些话搅扰你们，使你们心里不安，其实我们并没有吩咐他们。

verses.textEnNiv: We have heard that some went out from us without our authorization and disturbed you, troubling your minds by what they said.
verses.textEnEsv: Since we have heard that some persons have gone out from us and troubled you with words, unsettling your minds, although we gave them no instructions,

verses.textEn: We have heard that some went out from us without our authorization and disturbed you, troubling your minds by what they said.

verses.textEnNasb: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged and strengthened the brothers and sisters with a lengthy message.
verses.textEn: Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, said much to encourage and strengthen the believers.

verses.textZh: 住了一段时间，弟兄们就给他们送行，祝一路平安；他们就回到差派他们的人那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住了一段时间，弟兄们就给他们送行，祝一路平安；他们就回到差派他们的人那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 住了些日子，弟兄们打发他们平平安安地回到差遣他们的人那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: After spending some time there, they were sent off by the believers with the blessing of peace to return to those who had sent them.
verses.textEnEsv: And after they had spent some time, they were sent off in peace by the brothers to those who had sent them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after they had stayed there for a time, they were sent back with greetings from the brethren to the apostles.
verses.textEnNlt: They stayed for a while, and then the believers sent them back to the church in Jerusalem with a blessing of peace.
verses.textEnNasb: After they had spent time there, they were sent away from the brothers and sisters in peace to those who had sent them out.
verses.textEn: After spending some time there, they were sent off by the believers with the blessing of peace to return to those who had sent them.

verses.textZh: 保罗和巴拿巴却住在安提阿，跟许多别的人一同教导，传讲主的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗和巴拿巴却住在安提阿，跟许多别的人一同教导，传讲主的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 但保罗和巴拿巴仍住在安提阿，和许多别人一同教训人，传主的道。
verses.textEnNiv: But Paul and Barnabas remained in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: But Paul and Barnabas remained in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, it seemed good to Silas to remain there.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch. They and many others taught and preached the word of the Lord there.
verses.textEnNasb: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.textEn: But Paul and Barnabas remained in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached the word of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 过了一些时候，保罗对巴拿巴说："我们要回到我们传过主道的各城，探望弟兄们，好知道他们的情形怎么样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了一些时候，保罗对巴拿巴说："我们要回到我们传过主道的各城，探望弟兄们，好知道他们的情形怎么样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 过了些日子，保罗对巴拿巴说：「我们可以回到从前宣传主道的各城，看望弟兄们景况如何。」
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, "Let us go back and visit the believers in all the towns where we preached the word of the Lord and see how they are doing."
verses.textEnEsv: And after some days Paul said to Barnabas, "Let us return and visit the brothers in every city where we proclaimed the word of the Lord, and see how they are."
