verses.textEnNkjv: Paul and Barnabas also remained in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.textEnNlt: After some time Paul said to Barnabas, "Let’s go back and visit each city where we previously preached the word of the Lord, to see how the new believers are doing."
verses.textEnNasb: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, "Let’s return and visit the brothers and sisters in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, and see how they are."
verses.textEn: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, "Let us go back and visit the believers in all the towns where we preached the word of the Lord and see how they are doing."

verses.textZh: 巴拿巴有意要带别号马可的约翰一同去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴拿巴有意要带别号马可的约翰一同去，
verses.textZhCuv: 巴拿巴有意要带称呼马可的约翰同去；
verses.textEnNiv: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark, with them,
verses.textEnEsv: Now Barnabas wanted to take with them John called Mark.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then after some days Paul said to Barnabas, "Let us now go back and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, andsee how they are doing."
verses.textEnNlt: Barnabas agreed and wanted to take along John Mark.
verses.textEnNasb: Barnabas wanted to take John, called Mark, along with them also.
verses.textEn: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark, with them,

verses.textZh: 但保罗认为不应带他去，因为他从前在旁非利亚离开过他们，不跟他们一起去作工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但保罗认为不应带他去，因为他从前在旁非利亚离开过他们，不跟他们一起去作工。
verses.textZhCuv: 但保罗因为马可从前在旁非利亚离开他们，不和他们同去做工，就以为不可带他去。
verses.textEnNiv: but Paul did not think it wise to take him, because he had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not continued with them in the work.
verses.textEnEsv: But Paul thought best not to take with them one who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia and had not gone with them to the work.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Barnabas was determined to take with them John called Mark.
verses.textEnNlt: But Paul disagreed strongly, since John Mark had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not continued with them in their work.
verses.textEnNasb: But Paul was of the opinion that they should not take along with them this man who had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not gone with them to the work.
verses.textEn: but Paul did not think it wise to take him, because he had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not continued with them in the work.

verses.textZh: 他们各持己见，以致彼此分手。巴拿巴带着马可，坐船到塞浦路斯去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各持己见，以致彼此分手。巴拿巴带着马可，坐船到塞浦路斯去；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是二人起了争论，甚至彼此分开。巴拿巴带着马可，坐船往塞浦路斯去；
verses.textEnNiv: They had such a sharp disagreement that they parted company. Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus,
verses.textEnEsv: And there arose a sharp disagreement, so that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
verses.textEnNkjv: But Paul insisted that they should not take with them the one who had departed from them in Pamphylia, and had not gone with them to the work.
verses.textEnNlt: Their disagreement was so sharp that they separated. Barnabas took John Mark with him and sailed for Cyprus.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it turned into such a sharp disagreement that they separated from one another, and Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus.
verses.textEn: They had such a sharp disagreement that they parted company. Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus,

verses.textZh: 保罗却选了西拉，众弟兄把他交托在主的恩典中之后，他就出发了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗却选了西拉，众弟兄把他交托在主的恩典中之后，他就出发了。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗拣选了西拉，也出去，蒙弟兄们把他交于主的恩中。
verses.textEnNiv: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the believers to the grace of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: but Paul chose Silas and departed, having been commended by the brothers to the grace of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the contention became so sharp that they parted from one another. And so Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus;
verses.textEnNlt: Paul chose Silas, and as he left, the believers entrusted him to the Lord’s gracious care.
verses.textEnNasb: But Paul chose Silas, and left after being entrusted by the brothers to the grace of the Lord.
verses.textEn: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the believers to the grace of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 他走遍了叙利亚、基利家，坚固众教会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他走遍了叙利亚、基利家，坚固众教会。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就走遍叙利亚、基利家，坚固众教会。
verses.textEnNiv: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.
verses.textEnNkjv: but Paul chose Silas and departed, being commended by the brethren to the grace of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he traveled throughout Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches there.
verses.textEnNasb: And he was traveling through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.
verses.textEn: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.

verses.textZh: 保罗来到了特庇，又到了路司得。在那里有一个门徒，名叫提摩太，是一个信主的犹太妇人的儿子，父亲却是希腊人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗来到了特庇，又到了路司得。在那里有一个门徒，名叫提摩太，是一个信主的犹太妇人的儿子，父亲却是希腊人。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗来到特庇，又到路司得。在那里有一个门徒，名叫提摩太，是信主之犹太妇人的儿子，他父亲却是希腊人。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where a disciple named Timothy lived, whose mother was Jewish and a believer but whose father was a Greek.
verses.textEnEsv: Paul came also to Derbe and to Lystra. A disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewish woman who was a believer, but his father was a Greek.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he came to Derbe and Lystra. And behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a certain Jewish woman who believed, but his father was Greek.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul went first to Derbe and then to Lystra, where there was a young disciple named Timothy. His mother was a Jewish believer, but his father was a Greek.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Paul also came to Derbe and to Lystra. And a disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewish woman who was a believer, but his father was a Greek,
verses.textEn: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where a disciple named Timothy lived, whose mother was Jewish and a believer but whose father was a Greek.

verses.textZh: 路司得和以哥念的弟兄们都称赞他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 路司得和以哥念的弟兄们都称赞他。
verses.textZhCuv: 路司得和以哥念的弟兄都称赞他。
verses.textEnNiv: The believers at Lystra and Iconium spoke well of him.
verses.textEnEsv: He was well spoken of by the brothers at Lystra and Iconium.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was well spoken of by the brethren who were at Lystra and Iconium.
verses.textEnNlt: Timothy was well thought of by the believers in Lystra and Iconium,
verses.textEnNasb: and he was well spoken of by the brothers and sisters who were in Lystra and Iconium.
verses.textEn: The believers at Lystra and Iconium spoke well of him.

verses.textZh: 保罗有意要他一同出去，但为了那些地方的犹太人，就给他行了割礼，因为他们都知道他父亲是希腊人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗有意要他一同出去，但为了那些地方的犹太人，就给他行了割礼，因为他们都知道他父亲是希腊人。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗要带他同去，只因那些地方的犹太人都知道他父亲是希腊人，就给他行了割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul wanted to take him along on the journey, so he circumcised him because of the Jews who lived in that area, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
verses.textEnEsv: Paul wanted Timothy to accompany him, and he took him and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those places, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul wanted to have him go on with him. And he took him and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in that region, for they all knew that his father was Greek.
verses.textEnNlt: so Paul wanted him to join them on their journey. In deference to the Jews of the area, he arranged for Timothy to be circumcised before they left, for everyone knew that his father was a Greek.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul wanted this man to leave with him; and he took him and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
verses.textEn: Paul wanted to take him along on the journey, so he circumcised him because of the Jews who lived in that area, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

verses.textZh: 他们经过各城，把耶路撒冷的使徒和长老所定的规条，交给门徒遵守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们经过各城，把耶路撒冷的使徒和长老所定的规条，交给门徒遵守。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们经过各城，把耶路撒冷使徒和长老所定的条规交给门徒遵守。
verses.textEnNiv: As they traveled from town to town, they delivered the decisions reached by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem for the people to obey.
verses.textEnEsv: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered to them for observance the decisions that had been reached by the apostles and elders who were in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as they went through the cities, they delivered to them the decrees to keep, which were determined by the apostles and elders at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they went from town to town, instructing the believers to follow the decisions made by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while they were passing through the cities, they were delivering the ordinances for them to follow which had been determined by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: As they traveled from town to town, they delivered the decisions reached by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem for the people to obey.

verses.textZh: 于是众教会信心越发坚固，人数天天增加。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众教会信心越发坚固，人数天天增加。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是众教会信心越发坚固，人数天天加增。
verses.textEnNiv: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in numbers.
verses.textEnEsv: So the churches were strengthened in the faith, and they increased in numbers daily.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the churches were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.
verses.textEnNlt: So the churches were strengthened in their faith and grew larger every day.
verses.textEnNasb: So the churches were being strengthened in the faith, and were increasing in number daily.
verses.textEn: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in numbers.

verses.textZh: 圣灵既然禁止他们在亚西亚传道，他们就走遍弗吕家、加拉太地区。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵既然禁止他们在亚西亚传道，他们就走遍弗吕家、加拉太地区。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵既然禁止他们在亚细亚讲道，他们就经过弗吕家、加拉太一带地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul and his companions traveled throughout the region of Phrygia and Galatia, having been kept by the Holy Spirit from preaching the word in the province of Asia.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, having been forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they had gone through Phrygia and the region of Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to preach the word in Asia.
verses.textEnNlt: Next Paul and Silas traveled through the area of Phrygia and Galatia, because the Holy Spirit had prevented them from preaching the word in the province of Asia at that time.
verses.textEnNasb: They passed through the Phrygian and Galatian region, after being forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia;
verses.textEn: Paul and his companions traveled throughout the region of Phrygia and Galatia, having been kept by the Holy Spirit from preaching the word in the province of Asia.

verses.textZh: 他们来到每西亚边境，想要去庇推尼，耶稣的灵也不许。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来到每西亚边境，想要去庇推尼，耶稣的灵也不许。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了每西亚的边界，他们想要往庇推尼去，耶稣的灵却不许。
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to the border of Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not allow them to.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had come up to Mysia, they attempted to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus did not allow them.
verses.textEnNkjv: After they had come to Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit did not permit them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then coming to the borders of Mysia, they headed north for the province of Bithynia, but again the Spirit of Jesus did not allow them to go there.
verses.textEnNasb: and after they came to Mysia, they were trying to go into Bithynia, and the Spirit of Jesus did not allow them;
verses.textEn: When they came to the border of Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not allow them to.

verses.textZh: 他们经过每西亚，下到特罗亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们经过每西亚，下到特罗亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就越过每西亚，下到特罗亚去。
verses.textEnNiv: So they passed by Mysia and went down to Troas.
verses.textEnEsv: So, passing by Mysia, they went down to Troas.
verses.textEnNkjv: So passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.
verses.textEnNlt: So instead, they went on through Mysia to the seaport of Troas.
verses.textEnNasb: and passing by Mysia, they went down to Troas.
verses.textEn: So they passed by Mysia and went down to Troas.

verses.textZh: 夜间有一个异象向保罗显现：有一个马其顿人站着求他说："请你到马其顿来，帮助我们！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 夜间有一个异象向保罗显现：有一个马其顿人站着求他说："请你到马其顿来，帮助我们！"
verses.textZhCuv: 在夜间有异象现与保罗。有一个马其顿人站着求他说：「请你过到马其顿来帮助我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: During the night Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia standing and begging him, "Come over to Macedonia and help us."
verses.textEnEsv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night: a man of Macedonia was standing there, urging him and saying, "Come over to Macedonia and help us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night. A man of Macedonia stood and pleaded with him, saying, "Come over to Macedonia and help us."
verses.textEnNlt: That night Paul had a vision: A man from Macedonia in northern Greece was standing there, pleading with him, "Come over to Macedonia and help us!"
verses.textEnNasb: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night: a man of Macedonia was standing and pleading with him, and saying, "Come over to Macedonia and help us."
verses.textEn: During the night Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia standing and begging him, "Come over to Macedonia and help us."

verses.textZh: 保罗见了这异象，我们就认定是神呼召我们去传福音给他们，于是立刻设法前往马其顿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗见了这异象，我们就认定是神呼召我们去传福音给他们，于是立刻设法前往马其顿。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗既看见这异象，我们随即想要往马其顿去，以为神召我们传福音给那里的人听。
verses.textEnNiv: After Paul had seen the vision, we got ready at once to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Paul had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go on into Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the gospel to them.
verses.textEnNlt: So we decided to leave for Macedonia at once, having concluded that God was calling us to preach the Good News there.
verses.textEnNasb: When he had seen the vision, we immediately sought to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.
verses.textEn: After Paul had seen the vision, we got ready at once to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.

verses.textZh: 我们从特罗亚开船，直航撒摩特拉，第二天到达尼亚波利，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们从特罗亚开船，直航撒摩特拉，第二天到达尼亚波利，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是从特罗亚开船，一直行到撒摩特喇，第二天到了尼亚坡里。
verses.textEnNiv: From Troas we put out to sea and sailed straight for Samothrace, and the next day we went on to Neapolis.
verses.textEnEsv: So, setting sail from Troas, we made a direct voyage to Samothrace, and the following day to Neapolis,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, sailing from Troas, we ran a straight course to Samothrace, and the next day came to Neapolis,
verses.textEnNlt: We boarded a boat at Troas and sailed straight across to the island of Samothrace, and the next day we landed at Neapolis.
verses.textEnNasb: So after setting sail from Troas, we ran a straight course to Samothrace, and on the following day to Neapolis;
verses.textEn: From Troas we put out to sea and sailed straight for Samothrace, and the next day we went on to Neapolis.

verses.textZh: 从那里来到腓立比，就是马其顿地区的首要城市，是罗马的殖民地。我们在这城里住了几天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那里来到腓立比，就是马其顿地区的首要城市，是罗马的殖民地。我们在这城里住了几天。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里来到腓立比，就是马其顿这一方的头一个城，也是罗马的驻防城。我们在这城里住了几天。
verses.textEnNiv: From there we traveled to Philippi, a Roman colony and the leading city of that district of Macedonia. And we stayed there several days.
verses.textEnEsv: and from there to Philippi, which is a leading city of the district of Macedonia and a Roman colony. We remained in this city some days.
verses.textEnNkjv: and from there to Philippi, which is the foremost city of that part of Macedonia, a colony. And we were staying in that city for some days.
verses.textEnNlt: From there we reached Philippi, a major city of that district of Macedonia and a Roman colony. And we stayed there several days.
verses.textEnNasb: and from there to Philippi, which is a leading city of the district of Macedonia, a Roman colony; and we were spending some days in this city.
verses.textEn: From there we traveled to Philippi, a Roman colony and the leading city of that district of Macedonia. And we stayed there several days.

verses.textZh: 安息日我们出了城门，来到河边，以为那里是个祈祷的地方。我们坐下，对聚集的妇女讲论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 安息日我们出了城门，来到河边，以为那里是个祈祷的地方。我们坐下，对聚集的妇女讲论。
verses.textZhCuv: 当安息日，我们出城门，到了河边，知道那里有一个祷告的地方，我们就坐下对那聚会的妇女讲道。
verses.textEnNiv: On the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to the river, where we expected to find a place of prayer. We sat down and began to speak to the women who had gathered there.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the Sabbath day we went outside the gate to the riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the Sabbath day we went out of the city to the riverside, where prayer was customarily made; and we sat down and spoke to the women who met there.
verses.textEnNlt: On the Sabbath we went a little way outside the city to a riverbank, where we thought people would be meeting for prayer, and we sat down to speak with some women who had gathered there.
verses.textEnNasb: And on the Sabbath day we went outside the gate to a riverside, where we were thinking that there was a place of prayer; and we sat down and began speaking to the women who had assembled.
verses.textEn: On the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to the river, where we expected to find a place of prayer. We sat down and began to speak to the women who had gathered there.

verses.textZh: 有一位敬畏神的妇女，名叫吕底亚，是推雅推拉城卖紫色布的商人，她一直在听，主开启她的心，使她留心听保罗所讲的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一位敬畏神的妇女，名叫吕底亚，是推雅推拉城卖紫色布的商人，她一直在听，主开启她的心，使她留心听保罗所讲的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个卖紫色布疋的妇人，名叫吕底亚，是推雅推喇城的人，素来敬拜神。她听见了，主就开导她的心，叫她留心听保罗所讲的话。
verses.textEnNiv: One of those listening was a woman from the city of Thyatira named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth. She was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul’s message.
verses.textEnEsv: One who heard us was a woman named Lydia, from the city of Thyatira, a seller of purple goods, who was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to pay attention to what was said by Paul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain woman named Lydia heard us. She was a seller of purple from the city of Thyatira, who worshiped God. The Lord opened her heart to heed the things spoken by Paul.
verses.textEnNlt: One of them was Lydia from Thyatira, a merchant of expensive purple cloth, who worshiped God. As she listened to us, the Lord opened her heart, and she accepted what Paul was saying.
verses.textEnNasb: A woman named Lydia was listening; she was a seller of purple fabrics from the city of Thyatira, and a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to the things spoken by Paul.
verses.textEn: One of those listening was a woman from the city of Thyatira named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth. She was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul’s message.

verses.textZh: 她和她一家受了洗以后，就请求说："你们若认为我是对主忠实的，就请到我家来住。"于是她强留我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她和她一家受了洗以后，就请求说："你们若认为我是对主忠实的，就请到我家来住。"于是她强留我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 她和她一家既领了洗，便求我们说：「你们若以为我是真信主的 ，请到我家里来住」；于是强留我们。
verses.textEnNiv: When she and the members of her household were baptized, she invited us to her home. "If you consider me a believer in the Lord," she said, "come and stay at my house." And she persuaded us.
verses.textEnEsv: And after she was baptized, and her household as well, she urged us, saying, "If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come to my house and stay." And she prevailed upon us.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, "If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come to my house and stay." So she persuaded us.
verses.textEnNlt: She and her household were baptized, and she asked us to be her guests. "If you agree that I am a true believer in the Lord," she said, "come and stay at my home." And she urged us until we agreed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when she and her household had been baptized, she urged us, saying, "If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay." And she prevailed upon us.
verses.textEn: When she and the members of her household were baptized, she invited us to her home. "If you consider me a believer in the Lord," she said, "come and stay at my house." And she persuaded us.

verses.textZh: 有一次，我们到祈祷的地方去的时候，一个被巫鬼附着的婢女迎面而来；她行占卜使主人们发了大财。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次，我们到祈祷的地方去的时候，一个被巫鬼附着的婢女迎面而来；她行占卜使主人们发了大财。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来，我们往那祷告的地方去。有一个使女迎着面来，她被巫鬼所附，用法术，叫她主人们大得财利。
verses.textEnNiv: Once when we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a female slave who had a spirit by which she predicted the future. She earned a great deal of money for her owners by fortune-telling.
verses.textEnEsv: As we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl who had a spirit of divination and brought her owners much gain by fortune-telling.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, as we went to prayer, that a certain slave girl possessed with a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much profit by fortune-telling.
verses.textEnNlt: One day as we were going down to the place of prayer, we met a slave girl who had a spirit that enabled her to tell the future. She earned a lot of money for her masters by telling fortunes.
verses.textEnNasb: It happened that as we were going to the place of prayer, a slave woman who had a spirit of divination met us, who was bringing great profit to her masters by fortune-telling.
verses.textEn: Once when we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a female slave who had a spirit by which she predicted the future. She earned a great deal of money for her owners by fortune-telling.

verses.textZh: 她跟着保罗和我们，喊叫说："这些人是至高神的仆人，向你们传讲得救的道路。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她跟着保罗和我们，喊叫说："这些人是至高神的仆人，向你们传讲得救的道路。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她跟随保罗和我们，喊着说：「这些人是至高神的仆人，对你们传说救人的道。」
verses.textEnNiv: She followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, "These men are servants of the Most High God, who are telling you the way to be saved."
verses.textEnEsv: She followed Paul and us, crying out, "These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to you the way of salvation."
verses.textEnNkjv: This girl followed Paul and us, and cried out, saying, "These men are the servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us the way of salvation."
verses.textEnNlt: She followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, "These men are servants of the Most High God, and they have come to tell you how to be saved."
verses.textEnNasb: She followed Paul and us and cried out repeatedly, saying, "These men are bond-servants of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you a way of salvation."
verses.textEn: She followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, "These men are servants of the Most High God, who are telling you the way to be saved."

verses.textZh: 她一连多日这样喊叫，保罗觉得厌烦，就转身对那鬼说："我奉耶稣基督的名，命令你从她身上出来！"那鬼就立刻出来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她一连多日这样喊叫，保罗觉得厌烦，就转身对那鬼说："我奉耶稣基督的名，命令你从她身上出来！"那鬼就立刻出来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 她一连多日这样喊叫，保罗就心中厌烦，转身对那鬼说：「我奉耶稣基督的名，吩咐你从她身上出来！」那鬼当时就出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: She kept this up for many days. Finally Paul became so annoyed that he turned around and said to the spirit, "In the name of Jesus Christ I command you to come out of her!" At that moment the spirit left her.
verses.textEnEsv: And this she kept doing for many days. Paul, having become greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, "I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her." And it came out that very hour.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this she did for many days. But Paul, greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, "I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her." And he came out that very hour.
verses.textEnNlt: This went on day after day until Paul got so exasperated that he turned and said to the demon within her, "I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her." And instantly it left her.
verses.textEnNasb: Now she continued doing this for many days. But Paul was greatly annoyed, and he turned and said to the spirit, "I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!" And it came out at that very moment.
verses.textEn: She kept this up for many days. Finally Paul became so annoyed that he turned around and said to the spirit, "In the name of Jesus Christ I command you to come out of her!" At that moment the spirit left her.

verses.textZh: 她的主人们看见发财的希望完了，就揪住保罗和西拉，拉到市中心去见官长，
verses.textZhCnvs: 她的主人们看见发财的希望完了，就揪住保罗和西拉，拉到市中心去见官长，
verses.textZhCuv: 使女的主人们见得利的指望没有了，便揪住保罗和西拉，拉他们到市上去见首领；
verses.textEnNiv: When her owners realized that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace to face the authorities.
verses.textEnEsv: But when her owners saw that their hope of gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when her masters saw that their hope of profit was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace to the authorities.
verses.textEnNlt: Her masters’ hopes of wealth were now shattered, so they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them before the authorities at the marketplace.
verses.textEnNasb: But when her masters saw that their hope of profit was suddenly gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the authorities,
verses.textEn: When her owners realized that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace to face the authorities.

verses.textZh: 又带到裁判官面前，说："这些人是犹太人，扰乱我们的城市，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又带到裁判官面前，说："这些人是犹太人，扰乱我们的城市，
verses.textZhCuv: 又带到官长面前说：「这些人原是犹太人，竟骚扰我们的城，
verses.textEnNiv: They brought them before the magistrates and said, "These men are Jews, and are throwing our city into an uproar
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, "These men are Jews, and they are disturbing our city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought them to the magistrates, and said, "These men, being Jews, exceedingly trouble our city;
verses.textEnNlt: "The whole city is in an uproar because of these Jews!" they shouted to the city officials.
verses.textEnNasb: and when they had brought them to the chief magistrates, they said, "These men, Jews as they are, are causing our city trouble,
verses.textEn: They brought them before the magistrates and said, "These men are Jews, and are throwing our city into an uproar

verses.textZh: 传我们罗马人不准接受、不准实行的规例。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 传我们罗马人不准接受、不准实行的规例。"
verses.textZhCuv: 传我们罗马人所不可受不可行的规矩。」
verses.textEnNiv: by advocating customs unlawful for us Romans to accept or practice."
verses.textEnEsv: They advocate customs that are not lawful for us as Romans to accept or practice."
verses.textEnNkjv: and they teach customs which are not lawful for us, being Romans, to receive or observe."
verses.textEnNlt: "They are teaching customs that are illegal for us Romans to practice."
verses.textEnNasb: and they are proclaiming customs that are not lawful for us to accept or to practice, since we are Romans."
verses.textEn: by advocating customs unlawful for us Romans to accept or practice."

verses.textZh: 群众一齐起来攻击他们，裁判官就剥去他们的衣服，下令用棍子打他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众一齐起来攻击他们，裁判官就剥去他们的衣服，下令用棍子打他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人就一同起来攻击他们。官长吩咐剥了他们的衣裳，用棍打；
verses.textEnNiv: The crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas, and the magistrates ordered them to be stripped and beaten with rods.
verses.textEnEsv: The crowd joined in attacking them, and the magistrates tore the garments off them and gave orders to beat them with rods.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the multitude rose up together against them; and the magistrates tore off their clothes and commanded them to be beaten with rods.
verses.textEnNlt: A mob quickly formed against Paul and Silas, and the city officials ordered them stripped and beaten with wooden rods.
verses.textEnNasb: The crowd joined in an attack against them, and the chief magistrates tore their robes off them and proceeded to order them to be beaten with rods.
verses.textEn: The crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas, and the magistrates ordered them to be stripped and beaten with rods.

verses.textZh: 打了很多棍，就把他们放在监牢里，吩咐狱吏严密看守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 打了很多棍，就把他们放在监牢里，吩咐狱吏严密看守。
verses.textZhCuv: 打了许多棍，便将他们下在监里，嘱咐禁卒严紧看守。
verses.textEnNiv: After they had been severely flogged, they were thrown into prison, and the jailer was commanded to guard them carefully.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had inflicted many blows upon them, they threw them into prison, ordering the jailer to keep them safely.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, commanding the jailer to keep them securely.
verses.textEnNlt: They were severely beaten, and then they were thrown into prison. The jailer was ordered to make sure they didn’t escape.
verses.textEnNasb: When they had struck them with many blows, they threw them into prison, commanding the jailer to guard them securely;
verses.textEn: After they had been severely flogged, they were thrown into prison, and the jailer was commanded to guard them carefully.

verses.textZh: 狱吏领了命令，就把他们押入内监，两脚拴了木狗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 狱吏领了命令，就把他们押入内监，两脚拴了木狗。
verses.textZhCuv: 禁卒领了这样的命，就把他们下在内监里，两脚上了木狗。
verses.textEnNiv: When he received these orders, he put them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.
verses.textEnEsv: Having received this order, he put them into the inner prison and fastened their feet in the stocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: Having received such a charge, he put them into the inner prison and fastened their feet in the stocks.
verses.textEnNlt: So the jailer put them into the inner dungeon and clamped their feet in the stocks.
verses.textEnNasb: and he, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison and fastened their feet in the stocks.
verses.textEn: When he received these orders, he put them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.

verses.textZh: 约在半夜，保罗和西拉祈祷歌颂神，囚犯们都侧耳听着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约在半夜，保罗和西拉祈祷歌颂神，囚犯们都侧耳听着。
verses.textZhCuv: 约在半夜，保罗和西拉祷告，唱诗赞美神，众囚犯也侧耳而听。
verses.textEnNiv: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.
verses.textEnEsv: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: But at midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Around midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening.
verses.textEnNasb: Now about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns of praise to God, and the prisoners were listening to them;
verses.textEn: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.

verses.textZh: 忽然发生了大地震，以致监牢的地基都摇动起来，所有的监门立刻开了，囚犯的锁炼都松了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然发生了大地震，以致监牢的地基都摇动起来，所有的监门立刻开了，囚犯的锁炼都松了。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然，地大震动，甚至监牢的地基都摇动了，监门立刻全开，众囚犯的锁链也都松开了。
verses.textEnNiv: Suddenly there was such a violent earthquake that the foundations of the prison were shaken. At once all the prison doors flew open, and everyone’s chains came loose.
verses.textEnEsv: and suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken. And immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were unfastened.
verses.textEnNkjv: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened and everyone’s chains were loosed.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, there was a massive earthquake, and the prison was shaken to its foundations. All the doors immediately flew open, and the chains of every prisoner fell off!
verses.textEnNasb: and suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s chains were unfastened.
verses.textEn: Suddenly there was such a violent earthquake that the foundations of the prison were shaken. At once all the prison doors flew open, and everyone’s chains came loose.

verses.textZh: 狱吏醒过来，看见监门全开，以为囚犯都已经逃脱了，就拔出刀来想要自刎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 狱吏醒过来，看见监门全开，以为囚犯都已经逃脱了，就拔出刀来想要自刎。
verses.textZhCuv: 禁卒一醒，看见监门全开，以为囚犯已经逃走，就拔刀要自杀。
verses.textEnNiv: The jailer woke up, and when he saw the prison doors open, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself because he thought the prisoners had escaped.
verses.textEnEsv: When the jailer woke and saw that the prison doors were open, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the keeper of the prison, awaking from sleep and seeing the prison doors open, supposing the prisoners had fled, drew his sword and was about to kill himself.
verses.textEnNlt: The jailer woke up to see the prison doors wide open. He assumed the prisoners had escaped, so he drew his sword to kill himself.
verses.textEnNasb: When the jailer awoke and saw the prison doors opened, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself, thinking that the prisoners had escaped.
verses.textEn: The jailer woke up, and when he saw the prison doors open, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself because he thought the prisoners had escaped.

verses.textZh: 保罗大声呼叫说："不要伤害自己，我们都在这里！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗大声呼叫说："不要伤害自己，我们都在这里！"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗大声呼叫说：「不要伤害自己！我们都在这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Paul shouted, "Don’t harm yourself! We are all here!"
verses.textEnEsv: But Paul cried with a loud voice, "Do not harm yourself, for we are all here."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Paul called with a loud voice, saying, "Do yourself no harm, for we are all here."
verses.textEnNlt: But Paul shouted to him, "Stop! Don’t kill yourself! We are all here!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Paul called out with a loud voice, saying, "Do not harm yourself, for we are all here!"
verses.textEn: But Paul shouted, "Don’t harm yourself! We are all here!"

verses.textZh: 狱吏叫人拿了灯来，就冲进去，战战兢兢地俯伏在保罗和西拉面前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 狱吏叫人拿了灯来，就冲进去，战战兢兢地俯伏在保罗和西拉面前，
verses.textZhCuv: 禁卒叫人拿灯来，就跳进去，战战兢兢地俯伏在保罗、西拉面前；
verses.textEnNiv: The jailer called for lights, rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.
verses.textEnEsv: And the jailer called for lights and rushed in, and trembling with fear he fell down before Paul and Silas.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he called for a light, ran in, and fell down trembling before Paul and Silas.
verses.textEnNlt: The jailer called for lights and ran to the dungeon and fell down trembling before Paul and Silas.
verses.textEnNasb: And the jailer asked for lights and rushed in, and trembling with fear, he fell down before Paul and Silas;
verses.textEn: The jailer called for lights, rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.

verses.textZh: 随后领他们出来，说："先生，我应该作甚么才可以得救？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 随后领他们出来，说："先生，我应该作甚么才可以得救？"
verses.textZhCuv: 又领他们出来，说：「二位先生，我当怎样行才可以得救？」
verses.textEnNiv: He then brought them out and asked, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought them out and said, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought them out and said, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he brought them out and asked, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"
verses.textEnNasb: and after he brought them out, he said, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"
verses.textEn: He then brought them out and asked, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"

verses.textZh: 他们说："当信主耶稣，你和你一家人都必定得救。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："当信主耶稣，你和你一家人都必定得救。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「当信主耶稣，你和你一家都必得救。」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved, you and your household."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said, "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household."
verses.textEnNlt: They replied, "Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, along with everyone in your household."
verses.textEnNasb: They said, "Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved, you and your household."
verses.textEn: They replied, "Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household."

verses.textZh: 他们就把主的道，讲给他和所有在他家里的人听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就把主的道，讲给他和所有在他家里的人听。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就把主的道讲给他和他全家的人听。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all the others in his house.
verses.textEnEsv: And they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all who were in his house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all who were in his house.
verses.textEnNlt: And they shared the word of the Lord with him and with all who lived in his household.
verses.textEnNasb: And they spoke the word of God to him together with all who were in his house.
verses.textEn: Then they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all the others in his house.

verses.textZh: 就在当夜的那个时候，狱吏领他们去洗伤，狱吏和他家人都受了洗，
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在当夜的那个时候，狱吏领他们去洗伤，狱吏和他家人都受了洗，
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜，就在那时候，禁卒把他们带去，洗他们的伤；他和属乎他的人立时都受了洗。
verses.textEnNiv: At that hour of the night the jailer took them and washed their wounds; then immediately he and all his household were baptized.
verses.textEnEsv: And he took them the same hour of the night and washed their wounds; and he was baptized at once, he and all his family.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes. And immediately he and all his family were baptized.
verses.textEnNlt: Even at that hour of the night, the jailer cared for them and washed their wounds. Then he and everyone in his household were immediately baptized.
verses.textEnNasb: And he took them that very hour of the night and washed their wounds, and immediately he was baptized, he and all his household.
verses.textEn: At that hour of the night the jailer took them and washed their wounds; then immediately he and all his household were baptized.

verses.textZh: 就带他们到家里，摆上饭食，他和全家因信了神就大大喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就带他们到家里，摆上饭食，他和全家因信了神就大大喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是禁卒领他们上自己家里去，给他们摆上饭。他和全家，因为信了神，都很喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: The jailer brought them into his house and set a meal before them; he was filled with joy because he had come to believe in God—he and his whole household.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought them up into his house and set food before them. And he rejoiced along with his entire household that he had believed in God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when he had brought them into his house, he set food before them; and he rejoiced, having believed in God with all his household.
verses.textEnNlt: He brought them into his house and set a meal before them, and he and his entire household rejoiced because they all believed in God.
verses.textEnNasb: And he brought them into his house and set food before them, and was overjoyed, since he had become a believer in God together with his whole household.
verses.textEn: The jailer brought them into his house and set a meal before them; he was filled with joy because he had come to believe in God—he and his whole household.

verses.textZh: 到了天亮，裁判官派法警来，说："放了这些人！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了天亮，裁判官派法警来，说："放了这些人！"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了天亮，官长打发差役来，说：「释放那两个人吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: When it was daylight, the magistrates sent their officers to the jailer with the order: "Release those men."
verses.textEnEsv: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the police, saying, "Let those men go."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the officers, saying, "Let those men go."
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning the city officials sent the police to tell the jailer, "Let those men go!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when day came, the chief magistrates sent their officers, saying, "Release those men."
verses.textEn: When it was daylight, the magistrates sent their officers to the jailer with the order: "Release those men."

verses.textZh: 狱吏就把这话告诉保罗，说："裁判官派人来释放你们，现在可以出来，平平安安地去吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 狱吏就把这话告诉保罗，说："裁判官派人来释放你们，现在可以出来，平平安安地去吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 禁卒就把这话告诉保罗说：「官长打发人来叫释放你们，如今可以出监，平平安安地去吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: The jailer told Paul, "The magistrates have ordered that you and Silas be released. Now you can leave. Go in peace."
verses.textEnEsv: And the jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, "The magistrates have sent to let you go. Therefore come out now and go in peace."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the keeper of the prison reported these words to Paul, saying, "The magistrates have sent to let you go. Now therefore depart, and go in peace."
verses.textEnNlt: So the jailer told Paul, "The city officials have said you and Silas are free to leave. Go in peace."
verses.textEnNasb: And the jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, "The chief magistrates have sent word that you be released. So come out now and go in peace."
verses.textEn: The jailer told Paul, "The magistrates have ordered that you and Silas be released. Now you can leave. Go in peace."

verses.textZh: 保罗对他们说："我们是罗马人，还没有定罪，他们就公开打我们，又放在监里；现在要私下赶我们出去吗？不行！他们应当亲自来，领我们出去！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗对他们说："我们是罗马人，还没有定罪，他们就公开打我们，又放在监里；现在要私下赶我们出去吗？不行！他们应当亲自来，领我们出去！"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗却说：「我们是罗马人，并没有定罪，他们就在众人面前打了我们，又把我们下在监里，现在要私下撵我们出去吗？这是不行的。叫他们自己来领我们出去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: But Paul said to the officers: "They beat us publicly without a trial, even though we are Roman citizens, and threw us into prison. And now do they want to get rid of us quietly? No! Let them come themselves and escort us out."
verses.textEnEsv: But Paul said to them, "They have beaten us publicly, uncondemned, men who are Roman citizens, and have thrown us into prison; and do they now throw us out secretly? No! Let them come themselves and take us out."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Paul said to them, "They have beaten us openly, uncondemned Romans, and have thrown us into prison. And now do they put us out secretly? No indeed! Let them come themselves and get us out."
verses.textEnNlt: But Paul replied, "They have publicly beaten us without a trial and put us in prison—and we are Roman citizens. So now they want us to leave secretly? Certainly not! Let them come themselves to release us!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Paul said to them, "After beating us in public without due process—men who are Romans—they threw us into prison; and now they are releasing us secretly? No indeed! On the contrary, let them come in person and lead us out."
verses.textEn: But Paul said to the officers: "They beat us publicly without a trial, even though we are Roman citizens, and threw us into prison. And now do they want to get rid of us quietly? No! Let them come themselves and escort us out."

verses.textZh: 法警把这番话回报裁判官，裁判官听说他们是罗马人，就害怕起来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 法警把这番话回报裁判官，裁判官听说他们是罗马人，就害怕起来，
verses.textZhCuv: 差役把这话回禀官长。官长听见他们是罗马人，就害怕了，
verses.textEnNiv: The officers reported this to the magistrates, and when they heard that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, they were alarmed.
verses.textEnEsv: The police reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Roman citizens.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the officers told these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans.
verses.textEnNlt: When the police reported this, the city officials were alarmed to learn that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens.
verses.textEnNasb: The officers reported these words to the chief magistrates. And they became fearful when they heard that they were Romans,
verses.textEn: The officers reported this to the magistrates, and when they heard that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, they were alarmed.

verses.textZh: 于是来请求他们，领他们出监之后，就请他们离开那城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是来请求他们，领他们出监之后，就请他们离开那城。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是来劝他们，领他们出来，请他们离开那城。
verses.textEnNiv: They came to appease them and escorted them from the prison, requesting them to leave the city.
verses.textEnEsv: So they came and apologized to them. And they took them out and asked them to leave the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came and pleaded with them and brought them out, and asked them to depart from the city.
verses.textEnNlt: So they came to the jail and apologized to them. Then they brought them out and begged them to leave the city.
verses.textEnNasb: and they came and pleaded with them, and when they had led them out, they repeatedly asked them to leave the city.
verses.textEn: They came to appease them and escorted them from the prison, requesting them to leave the city.

verses.textZh: 两人出了监，就到吕底亚的家里去，见了弟兄们，劝勉他们一番，就离开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两人出了监，就到吕底亚的家里去，见了弟兄们，劝勉他们一番，就离开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人出了监，往吕底亚家里去，见了弟兄们，劝慰他们一番，就走了。
verses.textEnNiv: After Paul and Silas came out of the prison, they went to Lydia’s house, where they met with the brothers and sisters and encouraged them. Then they left.
verses.textEnEsv: So they went out of the prison and visited Lydia. And when they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them and departed.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went out of the prison and entered thehouseof Lydia; and when they had seen the brethren, they encouraged them and departed.
verses.textEnNlt: When Paul and Silas left the prison, they returned to the home of Lydia. There they met with the believers and encouraged them once more. Then they left town.
verses.textEnNasb: They left the prison and entered the house of Lydia, and when they saw the brothers and sisters, they encouraged them and departed.
verses.textEn: After Paul and Silas came out of the prison, they went to Lydia’s house, where they met with the brothers and sisters and encouraged them. Then they left.

verses.textZh: 保罗和西拉经过暗非波里、亚波罗尼亚，来到帖撒罗尼迦，在那里有犹太人的会堂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗和西拉经过暗非波里、亚波罗尼亚，来到帖撒罗尼迦，在那里有犹太人的会堂。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗和西拉经过暗妃坡里、亚波罗尼亚，来到帖撒罗尼迦，在那里有犹太人的会堂。
verses.textEnNiv: When Paul and his companions had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a synagogue of the Jews.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a synagogue of the Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul and Silas then traveled through the towns of Amphipolis and Apollonia and came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a synagogue of the Jews.
verses.textEn: When Paul and his companions had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

verses.textZh: 保罗照他的习惯进去，一连三个安息日，根据圣经与他们辩论，
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗照他的习惯进去，一连三个安息日，根据圣经与他们辩论，
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗照他素常的规矩进去，一连三个安息日，本着圣经与他们辩论，
verses.textEnNiv: As was his custom, Paul went into the synagogue, and on three Sabbath days he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
verses.textEnEsv: And Paul went in, as was his custom, and on three Sabbath days he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul, as his custom was, went in to them, and for three Sabbaths reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
verses.textEnNlt: As was Paul’s custom, he went to the synagogue service, and for three Sabbaths in a row he used the Scriptures to reason with the people.
verses.textEnNasb: And according to Paul’s custom, he visited them, and for three Sabbaths reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
verses.textEn: As was his custom, Paul went into the synagogue, and on three Sabbath days he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

verses.textZh: 讲解证明基督必须受害，从死人中复活，说："我所传给你们的这位耶稣，就是基督。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 讲解证明基督必须受害，从死人中复活，说："我所传给你们的这位耶稣，就是基督。"
verses.textZhCuv: 讲解陈明基督必须受害，从死里复活；又说：「我所传与你们的这位耶稣就是基督。」
verses.textEnNiv: explaining and proving that the Messiah had to suffer and rise from the dead. "This Jesus I am proclaiming to you is the Messiah," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: explaining and proving that it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead, and saying, "This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ."
verses.textEnNkjv: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, "This Jesus whom I preach to you is the Christ."
verses.textEnNlt: He explained the prophecies and proved that the Messiah must suffer and rise from the dead. He said, "This Jesus I’m telling you about is the Messiah."
verses.textEnNasb: explaining and giving evidence that the Christ had to suffer and rise from the dead, and saying, "This Jesus whom I am proclaiming to you is the Christ."
verses.textEn: explaining and proving that the Messiah had to suffer and rise from the dead. "This Jesus I am proclaiming to you is the Messiah," he said.

verses.textZh: 他们中间有人给说服了，就附从了保罗和西拉；还有一大群虔诚的希腊人，和不少显要的妇女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间有人给说服了，就附从了保罗和西拉；还有一大群虔诚的希腊人，和不少显要的妇女。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们中间有些人听了劝，就附从保罗和西拉，并有许多虔敬的希腊人，尊贵的妇女也不少。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, as did a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few prominent women.
verses.textEnEsv: And some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, as did a great many of the devout Greeks and not a few of the leading women.
verses.textEnNkjv: And some of them were persuaded; and a great multitude of the devout Greeks, and not a few of the leading women, joined Paul and Silas.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the Jews who listened were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, along with many God-fearing Greek men and quite a few prominent women.
verses.textEnNasb: And some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, along with a large number of the God-fearing Greeks and a significant number of the leading women.
verses.textEn: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, as did a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few prominent women.

verses.textZh: 但犹太人嫉妒起来，招聚了一些市井流氓，纠合成群，骚动全城，冲进了耶孙的家，搜索保罗和西拉，要把他们交给民众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但犹太人嫉妒起来，招聚了一些市井流氓，纠合成群，骚动全城，冲进了耶孙的家，搜索保罗和西拉，要把他们交给民众。
verses.textZhCuv: 但那不信的犹太人心里嫉妒，招聚了些市井匪类，搭伙成群，耸动合城的人闯进耶孙的家，要将保罗、西拉带到百姓那里。
verses.textEnNiv: But other Jews were jealous; so they rounded up some bad characters from the marketplace, formed a mob and started a riot in the city. They rushed to Jason’s house in search of Paul and Silas in order to bring them out to the crowd.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Jews were jealous, and taking some wicked men of the rabble, they formed a mob, set the city in an uproar, and attacked the house of Jason, seeking to bring them out to the crowd.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Jews who were not persuaded, becoming envious, took some of the evil men from the marketplace, and gathering a mob, set all the city in an uproar and attacked the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
verses.textEnNlt: But some of the Jews were jealous, so they gathered some troublemakers from the marketplace to form a mob and start a riot. They attacked the home of Jason, searching for Paul and Silas so they could drag them out to the crowd.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Jews, becoming jealous and taking along some wicked men from the marketplace, formed a mob and set the city in an uproar; and they attacked the house of Jason and were seeking to bring them out to the people.
verses.textEn: But other Jews were jealous; so they rounded up some bad characters from the marketplace, formed a mob and started a riot in the city. They rushed to Jason’s house in search of Paul and Silas in order to bring them out to the crowd.

verses.textZh: 搜索不到他们，就把耶孙和几个弟兄，拉到地方长官那里，喊叫着说："这些扰乱天下的人，也到这里来了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 搜索不到他们，就把耶孙和几个弟兄，拉到地方长官那里，喊叫着说："这些扰乱天下的人，也到这里来了，
verses.textZhCuv: 找不着他们，就把耶孙和几个弟兄拉到地方官那里，喊叫说：「那搅乱天下的也到这里来了，
verses.textEnNiv: But when they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some other believers before the city officials, shouting: "These men who have caused trouble all over the world have now come here,
verses.textEnEsv: And when they could not find them, they dragged Jason and some of the brothers before the city authorities, shouting, "These men who have turned the world upside down have come here also,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some brethren to the rulers of the city, crying out, "These who have turned the world upside down have come here too.
verses.textEnNlt: Not finding them there, they dragged out Jason and some of the other believers instead and took them before the city council. "Paul and Silas have caused trouble all over the world," they shouted, "and now they are here disturbing our city, too.
verses.textEnNasb: When they did not find them, they began dragging Jason and some brothers before the city authorities, shouting, "These men who have upset the world have come here also;
verses.textEn: But when they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some other believers before the city officials, shouting: "These men who have caused trouble all over the world have now come here,

verses.textZh: 耶孙却收留他们。这些人都违背凯撒的法令，说另外还有一个王耶稣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶孙却收留他们。这些人都违背凯撒的法令，说另外还有一个王耶稣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶孙收留他们。这些人都违背凯撒的命令，说另有一个王耶稣。」
verses.textEnNiv: and Jason has welcomed them into his house. They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, one called Jesus."
verses.textEnEsv: and Jason has received them, and they are all acting against the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jason has harbored them, and these are all acting contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying there is another king—Jesus."
verses.textEnNlt: And Jason has welcomed them into his home. They are all guilty of treason against Caesar, for they profess allegiance to another king, named Jesus."
verses.textEnNasb: and Jason has welcomed them, and they all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus."
verses.textEn: and Jason has welcomed them into his house. They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, one called Jesus."

verses.textZh: 群众和地方长官听见这话，就惊慌起来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 群众和地方长官听见这话，就惊慌起来，
verses.textZhCuv: 众人和地方官听见这话，就惊慌了；
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard this, the crowd and the city officials were thrown into turmoil.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people and the city authorities were disturbed when they heard these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they troubled the crowd and the rulers of the city when they heard these things.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of the city, as well as the city council, were thrown into turmoil by these reports.
verses.textEnNasb: They stirred up the crowd and the city authorities who heard these things.
verses.textEn: When they heard this, the crowd and the city officials were thrown into turmoil.

verses.textZh: 取得耶孙和其余的人签保后，才放了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 取得耶孙和其余的人签保后，才放了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是取了耶孙和其余之人的保状，就释放了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they made Jason and the others post bond and let them go.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had taken money as security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
verses.textEnNlt: So the officials forced Jason and the other believers to post bond, and then they released them.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they had received a pledge from Jason and the others, they released them.
verses.textEn: Then they made Jason and the others post bond and let them go.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们当夜立刻送保罗和西拉往比里亚去。二人到了，就进入犹太人的会堂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们当夜立刻送保罗和西拉往比里亚去。二人到了，就进入犹太人的会堂。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们随即在夜间打发保罗和西拉往庇哩亚去。二人到了，就进入犹太人的会堂。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as it was night, the believers sent Paul and Silas away to Berea. On arriving there, they went to the Jewish synagogue.
verses.textEnEsv: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Berea, and when they arrived they went into the Jewish synagogue.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the brethren immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Berea. When they arrived, they went into the synagogue of the Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: That very night the believers sent Paul and Silas to Berea. When they arrived there, they went to the Jewish synagogue.
verses.textEnNasb: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Berea, and when they arrived, they went into the synagogue of the Jews.
verses.textEn: As soon as it was night, the believers sent Paul and Silas away to Berea. On arriving there, they went to the Jewish synagogue.

verses.textZh: 这里的人，比帖撒罗尼迦人开明，热切接受主的道，天天考查圣经，要知道所听的是否与圣经相符。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这里的人，比帖撒罗尼迦人开明，热切接受主的道，天天考查圣经，要知道所听的是否与圣经相符。
verses.textZhCuv: 这地方的人贤于帖撒罗尼迦的人，甘心领受这道，天天考查圣经，要晓得这道是与不是。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Berean Jews were of more noble character than those in Thessalonica, for they received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures every day to see if what Paul said was true.
verses.textEnEsv: Now these Jews were more noble than those in Thessalonica; they received the word with all eagerness, examining the Scriptures daily to see if these things were so.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were more fair-minded than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness, and searched the Scriptures daily tofindout whether these things were so.
verses.textEnNlt: And the people of Berea were more open-minded than those in Thessalonica, and they listened eagerly to Paul’s message. They searched the Scriptures day after day to see if Paul and Silas were teaching the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these people were more noble-minded than those in Thessalonica, for they received the word with great eagerness, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
verses.textEn: Now the Berean Jews were of more noble character than those in Thessalonica, for they received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures every day to see if what Paul said was true.

verses.textZh: 结果他们中间有很多人信了，也有高贵的希腊妇女，男的也不少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 结果他们中间有很多人信了，也有高贵的希腊妇女，男的也不少。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以他们中间多有相信的，又有希腊尊贵的妇女，男子也不少。
verses.textEnNiv: As a result, many of them believed, as did also a number of prominent Greek women and many Greek men.
verses.textEnEsv: Many of them therefore believed, with not a few Greek women of high standing as well as men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore many of them believed, and also not a few of the Greeks, prominent women as well as men.
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, many Jews believed, as did many of the prominent Greek women and men.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, many of them believed, along with a significant number of prominent Greek women and men.
verses.textEn: As a result, many of them believed, as did also a number of prominent Greek women and many Greek men.

verses.textZh: 但帖撒罗尼迦的犹太人，知道保罗又在比里亚宣讲神的道，就到那里去，煽动挑拨群众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但帖撒罗尼迦的犹太人，知道保罗又在比里亚宣讲神的道，就到那里去，煽动挑拨群众。
verses.textZhCuv: 但帖撒罗尼迦的犹太人知道保罗又在庇哩亚传神的道，也就往那里去，耸动搅扰众人。
verses.textEnNiv: But when the Jews in Thessalonica learned that Paul was preaching the word of God at Berea, some of them went there too, agitating the crowds and stirring them up.
verses.textEnEsv: But when the Jews from Thessalonica learned that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Berea also, they came there too, agitating and stirring up the crowds.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the Jews from Thessalonica learned that the word of God was preached by Paul at Berea, they came there also and stirred up the crowds.
verses.textEnNlt: But when some Jews in Thessalonica learned that Paul was preaching the word of God in Berea, they went there and stirred up trouble.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the Jews of Thessalonica found out that the word of God had been proclaimed by Paul in Berea also, they came there as well, agitating and stirring up the crowds.
verses.textEn: But when the Jews in Thessalonica learned that Paul was preaching the word of God at Berea, some of them went there too, agitating the crowds and stirring them up.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们立刻把保罗送到海边去；西拉和提摩太仍然留在比里亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们立刻把保罗送到海边去；西拉和提摩太仍然留在比里亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时弟兄们便打发保罗往海边去，西拉和提摩太仍住在庇哩亚。
verses.textEnNiv: The believers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed at Berea.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the brothers immediately sent Paul off on his way to the sea, but Silas and Timothy remained there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then immediately the brethren sent Paul away, to go to the sea; but both Silas and Timothy remained there.
verses.textEnNlt: The believers acted at once, sending Paul on to the coast, while Silas and Timothy remained behind.
verses.textEnNasb: Then immediately the brothers sent Paul out to go as far as the sea; and Silas and Timothy remained there.
verses.textEn: The believers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed at Berea.

verses.textZh: 护送保罗的人带他到了雅典；保罗吩咐他们叫西拉和提摩太赶快去见他，于是他们就回去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 护送保罗的人带他到了雅典；保罗吩咐他们叫西拉和提摩太赶快去见他，于是他们就回去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 送保罗的人带他到了雅典，既领了保罗的命，叫西拉和提摩太速速到他这里来，就回去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who escorted Paul brought him to Athens and then left with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who conducted Paul brought him as far as Athens, and after receiving a command for Silas and Timothy to come to him as soon as possible, they departed.
verses.textEnNkjv: So those who conducted Paul brought him to Athens; and receiving a command for Silas and Timothy to come to him with all speed, they departed.
verses.textEnNlt: Those escorting Paul went with him all the way to Athens; then they returned to Berea with instructions for Silas and Timothy to hurry and join him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens; and receiving a command for Silas and Timothy to come to him as soon as possible, they left.
verses.textEn: Those who escorted Paul brought him to Athens and then left with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible.

verses.textZh: 保罗在雅典等候他们的时候，看见满城都是偶像，心灵十分忿激。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗在雅典等候他们的时候，看见满城都是偶像，心灵十分忿激。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗在雅典等候他们的时候，看见满城都是偶像，就心里着急；
verses.textEnNiv: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was greatly distressed to see that the city was full of idols.
verses.textEnEsv: Now while Paul was waiting for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw that the city was full of idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him when he saw that the city was given over to idols.
verses.textEnNlt: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was deeply troubled by all the idols he saw everywhere in the city.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while Paul was waiting for them in Athens, his spirit was being provoked within him as he observed that the city was full of idols.
verses.textEn: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was greatly distressed to see that the city was full of idols.

verses.textZh: 于是在会堂里，同犹太人和虔诚的人辩论；并且天天在市中心和所遇见的人辩论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是在会堂里，同犹太人和虔诚的人辩论；并且天天在市中心和所遇见的人辩论。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是在会堂里与犹太人和虔敬的人，并每日在市上所遇见的人，辩论。
verses.textEnNiv: So he reasoned in the synagogue with both Jews and God-fearing Greeks, as well as in the marketplace day by day with those who happened to be there.
verses.textEnEsv: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who happened to be there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and with the Gentile worshipers, and in the marketplace daily with those who happened to be there.
verses.textEnNlt: He went to the synagogue to reason with the Jews and the God-fearing Gentiles, and he spoke daily in the public square to all who happened to be there.
verses.textEnNasb: So he was reasoning in the synagogue with the Jews and the God-fearing Gentiles, and in the marketplace every day with those who happened to be present.
verses.textEn: So he reasoned in the synagogue with both Jews and God-fearing Greeks, as well as in the marketplace day by day with those who happened to be there.

verses.textZh: 还有一些伊壁鸠鲁派和斯多亚派的哲学家也同他争论，有的说："这个拾人牙慧的人要说甚么呢？"有的说："他似乎是一个宣传外地鬼神的人。"这是因为保罗传扬耶稣和复活的道理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有一些伊壁鸠鲁派和斯多亚派的哲学家也同他争论，有的说："这个拾人牙慧的人要说甚么呢？"有的说："他似乎是一个宣传外地鬼神的人。"这是因为保罗传扬耶稣和复活的道理。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有伊壁鸠鲁和斯多亚两门的学士，与他争论。有的说：「这胡言乱语的要说什么？」有的说：「他似乎是传说外邦鬼神的。」这话是因保罗传讲耶稣与复活的道。
verses.textEnNiv: A group of Epicurean and Stoic philosophers began to debate with him. Some of them asked, "What is this babbler trying to say?" Others remarked, "He seems to be advocating foreign gods." They said this because Paul was preaching the good news about Jesus and the resurrection.
verses.textEnEsv: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also conversed with him. And some said, "What does this babbler wish to say?" Others said, "He seems to be a preacher of foreign divinities"—because he was preaching Jesus and the resurrection.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then certain Epicurean and Stoic philosophers encountered him. And some said, "What does this babbler want to say?" Others said, "He seems to be a proclaimer of foreign gods," because he preached to them Jesus and the resurrection.
verses.textEnNlt: He also had a debate with some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers. When he told them about Jesus and his resurrection, they said, "What’s this babbler trying to say with these strange ideas he’s picked up?" Others said, "He seems to be preaching about some foreign gods."
verses.textEnNasb: And some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers as well were conversing with him. Some were saying, "What could this scavenger of tidbits want to say?" Others, "He seems to be a proclaimer of strange deities,"—because he was preaching Jesus and the resurrection.
verses.textEn: A group of Epicurean and Stoic philosophers began to debate with him. Some of them asked, "What is this babbler trying to say?" Others remarked, "He seems to be advocating foreign gods." They said this because Paul was preaching the good news about Jesus and the resurrection.

verses.textZh: 他们拉着保罗，把他带到亚略．巴古那里，说："你所讲的这个新道理，我们可以知道吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们拉着保罗，把他带到亚略．巴古那里，说："你所讲的这个新道理，我们可以知道吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就把他带到亚略‧巴古，说：「你所讲的这新道，我们也可以知道吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Then they took him and brought him to a meeting of the Areopagus, where they said to him, "May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?
verses.textEnEsv: And they took him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, "May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?
verses.textEnNkjv: And they took him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, "May we know what this new doctrine is of which you speak?
verses.textEnNlt: Then they took him to the high council of the city. "Come and tell us about this new teaching," they said.
verses.textEnNasb: And they took him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, "May we know what this new teaching is which you are proclaiming?
verses.textEn: Then they took him and brought him to a meeting of the Areopagus, where they said to him, "May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?

verses.textZh: 因为你把一切新奇的事，传到我们耳中，我们愿意知道这些事是甚么意思。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你把一切新奇的事，传到我们耳中，我们愿意知道这些事是甚么意思。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你有些奇怪的事传到我们耳中，我们愿意知道这些事是什么意思。」（
verses.textEnNiv: You are bringing some strange ideas to our ears, and we would like to know what they mean."
verses.textEnEsv: For you bring some strange things to our ears. We wish to know therefore what these things mean."
verses.textEnNkjv: For you are bringing some strange things to our ears. Therefore we want to know what these things mean."
verses.textEnNlt: "You are saying some rather strange things, and we want to know what it’s all about."
verses.textEnNasb: For you are bringing some strange things to our ears; so we want to know what these things mean."
verses.textEn: You are bringing some strange ideas to our ears, and we would like to know what they mean."

verses.textZh: 原来所有雅典人和外侨，专好谈论和打听新奇的事，来打发时间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来所有雅典人和外侨，专好谈论和打听新奇的事，来打发时间。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅典人和住在那里的客人都不顾别的事，只将新闻说说听听。）
verses.textEnNiv: (All the Athenians and the foreigners who lived there spent their time doing nothing but talking about and listening to the latest ideas.)
verses.textEnEsv: Now all the Athenians and the foreigners who lived there would spend their time in nothing except telling or hearing something new.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all the Athenians and the foreigners who were there spent their time in nothing else but either to tell or to hear some new thing.
verses.textEnNlt: (It should be explained that all the Athenians as well as the foreigners in Athens seemed to spend all their time discussing the latest ideas.)
verses.textEnNasb: (Now all the Athenians and the strangers visiting there used to spend their time in nothing other than telling or hearing something new.)
verses.textEn: (All the Athenians and the foreigners who lived there spent their time doing nothing but talking about and listening to the latest ideas.)

verses.textZh: 保罗站在亚略．巴古当中，说："各位雅典人，我看你们在各方面都非常敬畏鬼神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗站在亚略．巴古当中，说："各位雅典人，我看你们在各方面都非常敬畏鬼神。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗站在亚略‧巴古当中，说：「众位雅典人哪，我看你们凡事很敬畏鬼神。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul then stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and said: "People of Athens! I see that in every way you are very religious.
verses.textEnEsv: So Paul, standing in the midst of the Areopagus, said: "Men of Athens, I perceive that in every way you are very religious.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul stood in the midst of the Areopagus and said, "Men of Athens, I perceive that in all things you are very religious;
verses.textEnNlt: So Paul, standing before the council, addressed them as follows: "Men of Athens, I notice that you are very religious in every way,
verses.textEnNasb: So Paul stood in the midst of the Areopagus and said, "Men of Athens, I see that you are very religious in all respects.
verses.textEn: Paul then stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and said: "People of Athens! I see that in every way you are very religious.

verses.textZh: 我走路的时候，仔细看你们所敬拜的，发现有一座坛，上面写着‘献给不认识的神’。我现在把你们不认识而敬拜的这位神，传给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我走路的时候，仔细看你们所敬拜的，发现有一座坛，上面写着‘献给不认识的神’。我现在把你们不认识而敬拜的这位神，传给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我游行的时候，观看你们所敬拜的，遇见一座坛，上面写着『未识之神』。你们所不认识而敬拜的，我现在告诉你们。
verses.textEnNiv: For as I walked around and looked carefully at your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: to an unknown god. So you are ignorant of the very thing you worship—and this is what I am going to proclaim to you.
verses.textEnEsv: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription: ‘To the unknown god.’ What therefore you worship as unknown, this I proclaim to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: for as I was passing through and considering the objects of your worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Therefore, the One whom you worship without knowing, Him I proclaim to you:
verses.textEnNlt: for as I was walking along I saw your many shrines. And one of your altars had this inscription on it: ‘To an Unknown God.’ This God, whom you worship without knowing, is the one I’m telling you about.
verses.textEnNasb: For while I was passing through and examining the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription, ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ Therefore, what you worship in ignorance, this I proclaim to you.
verses.textEn: For as I walked around and looked carefully at your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: to an unknown god. So you are ignorant of the very thing you worship—and this is what I am going to proclaim to you.

verses.textZh: 创造宇宙和其中万有的神，既然是天地的主，就不住在人手所造的殿宇，
verses.textZhCnvs: 创造宇宙和其中万有的神，既然是天地的主，就不住在人手所造的殿宇，
verses.textZhCuv: 创造宇宙和其中万物的神，既是天地的主，就不住人手所造的殿，
verses.textEnNiv: "The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples built by human hands.
verses.textEnEsv: The God who made the world and everything in it, being Lord of heaven and earth, does not live in temples made by man,
verses.textEnNkjv: "God, who made the world and everything in it, since He is Lord of heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made with hands.
verses.textEnNlt: "He is the God who made the world and everything in it. Since he is Lord of heaven and earth, he doesn’t live in man-made temples,
verses.textEnNasb: The God who made the world and everything that is in it, since He is Lord of heaven and earth, does not dwell in temples made by hands;
verses.textEn: "The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples built by human hands.

verses.textZh: 也不受人手的服事，好象他缺少甚么；他自己反而把生命、气息和一切，赐给万人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不受人手的服事，好象他缺少甚么；他自己反而把生命、气息和一切，赐给万人。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不用人手服事，好像缺少什么；自己倒将生命、气息、万物，赐给万人。
verses.textEnNiv: And he is not served by human hands, as if he needed anything. Rather, he himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
verses.textEnEsv: nor is he served by human hands, as though he needed anything, since he himself gives to all mankind life and breath and everything.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor is He worshiped with men’s hands, as though He needed anything, since He gives to all life, breath, and all things.
verses.textEnNlt: and human hands can’t serve his needs—for he has no needs. He himself gives life and breath to everything, and he satisfies every need.
verses.textEnNasb: nor is He served by human hands, as though He needed anything, since He Himself gives to all people life and breath and all things;
verses.textEn: And he is not served by human hands, as if he needed anything. Rather, he himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.

verses.textZh: 他从一个本源造出了万族来，使他们住在整个大地上，并且定了他们的期限和居住的疆界，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从一个本源造出了万族来，使他们住在整个大地上，并且定了他们的期限和居住的疆界，
verses.textZhCuv: 他从一本 造出万族的人，住在全地上，并且预先定准他们的年限和所住的疆界，
verses.textEnNiv: From one man he made all the nations, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and he marked out their appointed times in history and the boundaries of their lands.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made from one man every nation of mankind to live on all the face of the earth, having determined allotted periods and the boundaries of their dwelling place,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He has made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the face of the earth, and has determined their preappointed times and the boundaries of their dwellings,
verses.textEnNlt: From one man he created all the nations throughout the whole earth. He decided beforehand when they should rise and fall, and he determined their boundaries.
verses.textEnNasb: and He made from one man every nation of mankind to live on all the face of the earth, having determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their habitation,
verses.textEn: From one man he made all the nations, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and he marked out their appointed times in history and the boundaries of their lands.

verses.textZh: 要他们寻求神，或者可以摸索而找到他。其实他离我们各人不远，
verses.textZhCnvs: 要他们寻求神，或者可以摸索而找到他。其实他离我们各人不远，
verses.textZhCuv: 要叫他们寻求神，或者可以揣摩而得，其实他离我们各人不远；
verses.textEnNiv: God did this so that they would seek him and perhaps reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from any one of us.
verses.textEnEsv: that they should seek God, and perhaps feel their way toward him and find him. Yet he is actually not far from each one of us,
verses.textEnNkjv: so that they should seek the Lord, in the hope that they might grope for Him and find Him, though He is not far from each one of us;
verses.textEnNlt: "His purpose was for the nations to seek after God and perhaps feel their way toward him and find him—though he is not far from any one of us.
verses.textEnNasb: that they would seek God, if perhaps they might feel around for Him and find Him, though He is not far from each one of us;
verses.textEn: God did this so that they would seek him and perhaps reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from any one of us.

verses.textZh: 因着他我们可以生存、活动、存在，就如你们有些诗人说：‘原来我们也是他的子孙。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着他我们可以生存、活动、存在，就如你们有些诗人说：‘原来我们也是他的子孙。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我们生活、动作、存留，都在乎他。就如你们作诗的，有人说：『我们也是他所生的。』
verses.textEnNiv: ‘For in him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are his offspring.’
verses.textEnEsv: for "‘In him we live and move and have our being’; as even some of your own poets have said, "‘For we are indeed his offspring.’
verses.textEnNkjv: for in Him we live and move and have our being, as also some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also His offspring.’
verses.textEnNlt: For in him we live and move and exist. As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are his offspring.’
verses.textEnNasb: for in Him we live and move and exist, as even some of your own poets have said, ‘For we also are His descendants.’
verses.textEn: ‘For in him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are his offspring.’

verses.textZh: 我们既然是神的子孙，就不应该以为他的神性是好象人用手艺、心思所雕刻的金银石头一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然是神的子孙，就不应该以为他的神性是好象人用手艺、心思所雕刻的金银石头一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既是神所生的，就不当以为神的神性像人用手艺、心思所雕刻的金、银、石。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore since we are God’s offspring, we should not think that the divine being is like gold or silver or stone—an image made by human design and skill.
verses.textEnEsv: Being then God’s offspring, we ought not to think that the divine being is like gold or silver or stone, an image formed by the art and imagination of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, since we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold or silver or stone, something shaped by art and man’s devising.
verses.textEnNlt: And since this is true, we shouldn’t think of God as an idol designed by craftsmen from gold or silver or stone.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, since we are the descendants of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold or silver or stone, an image formed by human skill and thought.
verses.textEn: "Therefore since we are God’s offspring, we should not think that the divine being is like gold or silver or stone—an image made by human design and skill.

verses.textZh: 过去那无知的时代，神不加以追究；现在，他却吩咐各处的人都要悔改，
verses.textZhCnvs: 过去那无知的时代，神不加以追究；现在，他却吩咐各处的人都要悔改，
verses.textZhCuv: 世人蒙昧无知的时候，神并不监察，如今却吩咐各处的人都要悔改。
verses.textEnNiv: In the past God overlooked such ignorance, but now he commands all people everywhere to repent.
verses.textEnEsv: The times of ignorance God overlooked, but now he commands all people everywhere to repent,
verses.textEnNkjv: Truly, these times of ignorance God overlooked, but now commands all men everywhere to repent,
verses.textEnNlt: "God overlooked people’s ignorance about these things in earlier times, but now he commands everyone everywhere to repent of their sins and turn to him.
verses.textEnNasb: So having overlooked the times of ignorance, God is now proclaiming to mankind that all people everywhere are to repent,
verses.textEn: In the past God overlooked such ignorance, but now he commands all people everywhere to repent.

verses.textZh: 因为他已经定好了日子，要借着他所立的人，按公义审判天下，并且使他从死人中复活，给万人作一个可信的凭据。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他已经定好了日子，要借着他所立的人，按公义审判天下，并且使他从死人中复活，给万人作一个可信的凭据。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他已经定了日子，要藉着他所设立的人按公义审判天下，并且叫他从死里复活，给万人作可信的凭据。」
