verses.textEnNiv: For he has set a day when he will judge the world with justice by the man he has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising him from the dead."
verses.textEnEsv: because he has fixed a day on which he will judge the world in righteousness by a man whom he has appointed; and of this he has given assurance to all by raising him from the dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: because He has appointed a day on which He will judge the world in righteousness by the Man whom He has ordained. He has given assurance of this to all by raising Him from the dead."
verses.textEnNlt: For he has set a day for judging the world with justice by the man he has appointed, and he proved to everyone who this is by raising him from the dead."
verses.textEnNasb: because He has set a day on which He will judge the world in righteousness through a Man whom He has appointed, having furnished proof to all people by raising Him from the dead."
verses.textEn: For he has set a day when he will judge the world with justice by the man he has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising him from the dead."

verses.textZh: 众人一听到死人复活的事，就讥笑他，但有的说："我们要再听听你讲这件事！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人一听到死人复活的事，就讥笑他，但有的说："我们要再听听你讲这件事！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人听见从死里复活的话，就有讥诮他的；又有人说：「我们再听你讲这个吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard about the resurrection of the dead, some of them sneered, but others said, "We want to hear you again on this subject."
verses.textEnEsv: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked. But others said, "We will hear you again about this."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked, while others said, "We will hear you again on this matter."
verses.textEnNlt: When they heard Paul speak about the resurrection of the dead, some laughed in contempt, but others said, "We want to hear more about this later."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some began to scoff, but others said, "We shall hear from you again concerning this."
verses.textEn: When they heard about the resurrection of the dead, some of them sneered, but others said, "We want to hear you again on this subject."

verses.textZh: 这样，保罗就离开他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，保罗就离开他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是保罗从他们当中出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: At that, Paul left the Council.
verses.textEnEsv: So Paul went out from their midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Paul departed from among them.
verses.textEnNlt: That ended Paul’s discussion with them,
verses.textEnNasb: So Paul went out from among them.
verses.textEn: At that, Paul left the Council.

verses.textZh: 但有几个人接近他，并且信了主，其中有亚略．巴古的议员丢尼修，一个名叫戴马里的女子，还有其他在一起的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但有几个人接近他，并且信了主，其中有亚略．巴古的议员丢尼修，一个名叫戴马里的女子，还有其他在一起的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 但有几个人贴近他，信了主，其中有亚略‧巴古的官丢尼修，并一个妇人，名叫大马哩，还有别人一同信从。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the people became followers of Paul and believed. Among them was Dionysius, a member of the Areopagus, also a woman named Damaris, and a number of others.
verses.textEnEsv: But some men joined him and believed, among whom also were Dionysius the Areopagite and a woman named Damaris and others with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, some men joined him and believed, among them Dionysius the Areopagite, a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.textEnNlt: but some joined him and became believers. Among them were Dionysius, a member of the council, a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.textEnNasb: But some men joined him and believed, among whom also were Dionysius the Areopagite and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.textEn: Some of the people became followers of Paul and believed. Among them was Dionysius, a member of the Areopagus, also a woman named Damaris, and a number of others.

verses.textZh: 此后，保罗离开雅典，来到哥林多，
verses.textZhCnvs: 此后，保罗离开雅典，来到哥林多，
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，保罗离了雅典，来到哥林多。
verses.textEnNiv: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.
verses.textEnEsv: After this Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things Paul departed from Athens and went to Corinth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.
verses.textEnNasb: After these events Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.
verses.textEn: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.

verses.textZh: 遇见一个生在本都的犹太人，名叫亚居拉。因为革老丢下令所有的犹太人都要离开罗马，所以亚居拉最近同他的妻子百基拉从意大利来了，保罗就去找他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遇见一个生在本都的犹太人，名叫亚居拉。因为革老丢下令所有的犹太人都要离开罗马，所以亚居拉最近同他的妻子百基拉从意大利来了，保罗就去找他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 遇见一个犹太人，名叫亚居拉，他生在本都；因为克劳第命犹太人都离开罗马，新近带着妻百基拉，从意大利来。保罗就投奔了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: There he met a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had ordered all Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to see them,
verses.textEnEsv: And he found a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to leave Rome. And he went to see them,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla (because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome); and he came to them.
verses.textEnNlt: There he became acquainted with a Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, who had recently arrived from Italy with his wife, Priscilla. They had left Italy when Claudius Caesar deported all Jews from Rome.
verses.textEnNasb: And he found a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus having recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to leave Rome. He came to them,
verses.textEn: There he met a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had ordered all Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to see them,

verses.textZh: 他们是以做帐棚为业的，因为是同业，保罗就与他们同住，一同工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们是以做帐棚为业的，因为是同业，保罗就与他们同住，一同工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们本是制造帐棚为业。保罗因与他们同业，就和他们同住做工。
verses.textEnNiv: and because he was a tentmaker as they were, he stayed and worked with them.
verses.textEnEsv: and because he was of the same trade he stayed with them and worked, for they were tentmakers by trade.
verses.textEnNkjv: So, because he was of the same trade, he stayed with them and worked; for by occupation they were tentmakers.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul lived and worked with them, for they were tentmakers just as he was.
verses.textEnNasb: and because he was of the same trade he stayed with them, and they worked together, for they were tent-makers by trade.
verses.textEn: and because he was a tentmaker as they were, he stayed and worked with them.

verses.textZh: 每逢安息日，保罗在会堂辩论，劝导犹太人和希腊人归主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢安息日，保罗在会堂辩论，劝导犹太人和希腊人归主。
verses.textZhCuv: 每逢安息日，保罗在会堂里辩论，劝化犹太人和希腊人。
verses.textEnNiv: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade Jews and Greeks.
verses.textEnEsv: And he reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath, and tried to persuade Jews and Greeks.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath, and persuaded both Jews and Greeks.
verses.textEnNlt: Each Sabbath found Paul at the synagogue, trying to convince the Jews and Greeks alike.
verses.textEnNasb: And Paul was reasoning in the synagogue every Sabbath and trying to persuade Jews and Greeks.
verses.textEn: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade Jews and Greeks.

verses.textZh: 西拉和提摩太从马其顿下来的时候，保罗就专心传扬主的道，向犹太人极力证明耶稣是基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西拉和提摩太从马其顿下来的时候，保罗就专心传扬主的道，向犹太人极力证明耶稣是基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 西拉和提摩太从马其顿来的时候，保罗为道迫切，向犹太人证明耶稣是基督。
verses.textEnNiv: When Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself exclusively to preaching, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Messiah.
verses.textEnEsv: When Silas and Timothy arrived from Macedonia, Paul was occupied with the word, testifying to the Jews that the Christ was Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Silas and Timothy had come from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus is the Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: And after Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul spent all his time preaching the word. He testified to the Jews that Jesus was the Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul began devoting himself completely to the word, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.
verses.textEn: When Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself exclusively to preaching, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Messiah.

verses.textZh: 但是他们抗拒、亵渎，保罗就抖着衣服，对他们说："你们的罪你们自己承担，这与我无关。从今以后，我要到外族人那里去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是他们抗拒、亵渎，保罗就抖着衣服，对他们说："你们的罪你们自己承担，这与我无关。从今以后，我要到外族人那里去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们既抗拒、毁谤，保罗就抖着衣裳，说：「你们的罪 归到你们自己头上，与我无干 。从今以后，我要往外邦人那里去。」
verses.textEnNiv: But when they opposed Paul and became abusive, he shook out his clothes in protest and said to them, "Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent of it. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."
verses.textEnEsv: And when they opposed and reviled him, he shook out his garments and said to them, "Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook his garments and said to them, "Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."
verses.textEnNlt: But when they opposed and insulted him, Paul shook the dust from his clothes and said, "Your blood is upon your own heads—I am innocent. From now on I will go preach to the Gentiles."
verses.textEnNasb: But when they resisted and blasphemed, he shook out his garments and said to them, "Your blood is on your own heads! I am clean. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."
verses.textEn: But when they opposed Paul and became abusive, he shook out his clothes in protest and said to them, "Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent of it. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."

verses.textZh: 他离开那里，到了提多．犹士都的家去。这人是敬拜神的，他的家靠近会堂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他离开那里，到了提多．犹士都的家去。这人是敬拜神的，他的家靠近会堂。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是离开那里，到了一个人的家中；这人名叫提多‧犹士都，是敬拜神的，他的家靠近会堂。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titius Justus, a worshiper of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he left there and went to the house of a man named Titius Justus, a worshiper of God. His house was next door to the synagogue.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he departed from there and entered the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he left and went to the home of Titius Justus, a Gentile who worshiped God and lived next door to the synagogue.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he left the synagogue and went to the house of a man named Titius Justus, a worshiper of God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.
verses.textEn: Then Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titius Justus, a worshiper of God.

verses.textZh: 会堂主管基利司布和他全家都信了主，许多哥林多人也听了道，信了主，而且受了洗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 会堂主管基利司布和他全家都信了主，许多哥林多人也听了道，信了主，而且受了洗。
verses.textZhCuv: 管会堂的基利司布和全家都信了主，还有许多哥林多人听了，就相信受洗。
verses.textEnNiv: Crispus, the synagogue leader, and his entire household believed in the Lord; and many of the Corinthians who heard Paul believed and were baptized.
verses.textEnEsv: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord, together with his entire household. And many of the Corinthians hearing Paul believed and were baptized.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his household. And many of the Corinthians, hearing, believed and were baptized.
verses.textEnNlt: Crispus, the leader of the synagogue, and everyone in his household believed in the Lord. Many others in Corinth also heard Paul, became believers, and were baptized.
verses.textEnNasb: Crispus, the leader of the synagogue, believed in the Lord together with his entire household; and many of the Corinthians, as they listened to Paul, were believing and being baptized.
verses.textEn: Crispus, the synagogue leader, and his entire household believed in the Lord; and many of the Corinthians who heard Paul believed and were baptized.

verses.textZh: 夜里，主借着异象对保罗说："<red>不要怕，只管讲，不要闭口！</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: 夜里，主借着异象对保罗说："<red>不要怕，只管讲，不要闭口！</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>夜间，主在异象中对保罗说：「不要怕，只管讲，不要闭口，</red>
verses.textEnNiv: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: <red>“Do not be afraid; keep on speaking, do not be silent.</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Paul one night in a vision, "Do not be afraid, but go on speaking and do not be silent,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Paul in the night by a vision, "Do not be afraid, but speak, and do not keep silent;
verses.textEnNlt: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision and told him, "Don’t be afraid! Speak out! Don’t be silent!
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to Paul by a vision at night, "Do not be afraid any longer, but go on speaking and do not be silent;
verses.textEn: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: <red>“Do not be afraid; keep on speaking, do not be silent.</red>

verses.textZh: <red>有我与你同在，必定没有人会攻击和伤害你，因为在这城里有许多属我的人。"</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>有我与你同在，必定没有人会攻击和伤害你，因为在这城里有许多属我的人。"</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>有我与你同在，必没有人下手害你，因为在这城里我有许多的百姓。」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: <red>For I am with you, and no one is going to attack and harm you, because I have many people in this city.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many in this city who are my people."
verses.textEnNkjv: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to hurt you; for I have many people in this city."
verses.textEnNlt: For I am with you, and no one will attack and harm you, for many people in this city belong to me."
verses.textEnNasb: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city."
verses.textEn: <red>For I am with you, and no one is going to attack and harm you, because I have many people in this city.”</red>

verses.textZh: 保罗在那里住了一年零六个月，把神的道教导他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗在那里住了一年零六个月，把神的道教导他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗在那里住了一年零六个月，将神的道教训他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So Paul stayed in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching them the word of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he stayed a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
verses.textEnNlt: So Paul stayed there for the next year and a half, teaching the word of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And he settled there for a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
verses.textEn: So Paul stayed in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching them the word of God.

verses.textZh: 当迦流作亚该亚省长的时候，犹太人一致起来攻击保罗，拉他到审判台前，
verses.textZhCnvs: 当迦流作亚该亚省长的时候，犹太人一致起来攻击保罗，拉他到审判台前，
verses.textZhCuv: 到迦流作亚该亚方伯的时候，犹太人同心起来攻击保罗，拉他到公堂，
verses.textEnNiv: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews of Corinth made a united attack on Paul and brought him to the place of judgment.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews made a united attack on Paul and brought him before the tribunal,
verses.textEnNkjv: When Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him to the judgment seat,
verses.textEnNlt: But when Gallio became governor of Achaia, some Jews rose up together against Paul and brought him before the governor for judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: But while Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews rose up together against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,
verses.textEn: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews of Corinth made a united attack on Paul and brought him to the place of judgment.

verses.textZh: 说："这个人劝人不照着律法去敬拜神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："这个人劝人不照着律法去敬拜神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「这个人劝人不按着律法敬拜神。」
verses.textEnNiv: "This man," they charged, "is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law."
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "This man is persuading people to worship God contrary to the law."
verses.textEnNkjv: saying, "This fellow persuades men to worship God contrary to the law."
verses.textEnNlt: They accused Paul of "persuading people to worship God in ways that are contrary to our law."
verses.textEnNasb: saying, "This man is inciting the people to worship God contrary to the law."
verses.textEn: "This man," they charged, "is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law."

verses.textZh: 保罗刚要开口，迦流就对犹太人说："犹太人啊，如果有犯法或邪恶的罪行，我当然要耐心听你们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗刚要开口，迦流就对犹太人说："犹太人啊，如果有犯法或邪恶的罪行，我当然要耐心听你们；
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗刚要开口，迦流就对犹太人说：「你们这些犹太人！如果是为冤枉或奸恶的事，我理当耐性听你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to them, "If you Jews were making a complaint about some misdemeanor or serious crime, it would be reasonable for me to listen to you.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, "If it were a matter of wrongdoing or vicious crime, O Jews, I would have reason to accept your complaint.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, "If it were a matter of wrongdoing or wicked crimes, O Jews, there would be reason why I should bear with you.
verses.textEnNlt: But just as Paul started to make his defense, Gallio turned to Paul’s accusers and said, "Listen, you Jews, if this were a case involving some wrongdoing or a serious crime, I would have a reason to accept your case.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, "If it were a matter of some crime or vicious, unscrupulous act, O Jews, it would be reasonable for me to put up with you;
verses.textEn: Just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to them, "If you Jews were making a complaint about some misdemeanor or serious crime, it would be reasonable for me to listen to you.

verses.textZh: 但所争论的若是关于字句、名称和你们的律法，你们就应当自己处理。我不愿意审判这件事！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但所争论的若是关于字句、名称和你们的律法，你们就应当自己处理。我不愿意审判这件事！"
verses.textZhCuv: 但所争论的，若是关乎言语、名目，和你们的律法，你们自己去办吧！这样的事我不愿意审问」；
verses.textEnNiv: But since it involves questions about words and names and your own law—settle the matter yourselves. I will not be a judge of such things."
verses.textEnEsv: But since it is a matter of questions about words and names and your own law, see to it yourselves. I refuse to be a judge of these things."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if it is a question of words and names and your own law, look toit yourselves; for I do not want to be a judge of such matters."
verses.textEnNlt: But since it is merely a question of words and names and your Jewish law, take care of it yourselves. I refuse to judge such matters."
verses.textEnNasb: but if there are questions about teaching and persons and your own law, see to it yourselves; I am unwilling to be a judge of these matters."
verses.textEn: But since it involves questions about words and names and your own law—settle the matter yourselves. I will not be a judge of such things."

verses.textZh: 于是就把他们从审判台前赶出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是就把他们从审判台前赶出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 就把他们撵出公堂。
verses.textEnNiv: So he drove them off.
verses.textEnEsv: And he drove them from the tribunal.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he drove them from the judgment seat.
verses.textEnNlt: And he threw them out of the courtroom.
verses.textEnNasb: And he drove them away from the judgment seat.
verses.textEn: So he drove them off.

verses.textZh: 众人揪住会堂主管苏提尼，在审判台前打他。这些事迦流一概不理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人揪住会堂主管苏提尼，在审判台前打他。这些事迦流一概不理。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人便揪住管会堂的所提尼，在堂前打他。这些事迦流都不管。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the crowd there turned on Sosthenes the synagogue leader and beat him in front of the proconsul; and Gallio showed no concern whatever.
verses.textEnEsv: And they all seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him in front of the tribunal. But Gallio paid no attention to any of this.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. But Gallio took no notice of these things.
verses.textEnNlt: The crowd then grabbed Sosthenes, the leader of the synagogue, and beat him right there in the courtroom. But Gallio paid no attention.
verses.textEnNasb: But they all took hold of Sosthenes, the leader of the synagogue, and began beating him in front of the judgment seat. And yet Gallio was not concerned about any of these things.
verses.textEn: Then the crowd there turned on Sosthenes the synagogue leader and beat him in front of the proconsul; and Gallio showed no concern whatever.

verses.textZh: 保罗住了许多日子，然后辞别弟兄们，坐船去叙利亚，同行的有百基拉和亚居拉。他因为许过愿，现在期满了，就在坚革里剃了头发。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗住了许多日子，然后辞别弟兄们，坐船去叙利亚，同行的有百基拉和亚居拉。他因为许过愿，现在期满了，就在坚革里剃了头发。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗又住了多日，就辞别了弟兄，坐船往叙利亚去；百基拉、亚居拉和他同去。他因为许过愿，就在坚革哩剪了头发。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul stayed on in Corinth for some time. Then he left the brothers and sisters and sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila. Before he sailed, he had his hair cut off at Cenchreae because of a vow he had taken.
verses.textEnEsv: After this, Paul stayed many days longer and then took leave of the brothers and set sail for Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila. At Cenchreae he had cut his hair, for he was under a vow.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Paul still remained a good while. Then he took leave of the brethren and sailed for Syria, and Priscilla and Aquila were with him. He had his hair cut off at Cenchrea, for he had taken a vow.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul stayed in Corinth for some time after that, then said good-bye to the brothers and sisters and went to nearby Cenchrea. There he shaved his head according to Jewish custom, marking the end of a vow. Then he set sail for Syria, taking Priscilla and Aquila with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Paul, when he had remained many days longer, took leave of the brothers and sisters and sailed away to Syria, and Priscilla and Aquila were with him. Paul first had his hair cut at Cenchrea, for he was keeping a vow.
verses.textEn: Paul stayed on in Corinth for some time. Then he left the brothers and sisters and sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila. Before he sailed, he had his hair cut off at Cenchreae because of a vow he had taken.

verses.textZh: 到了以弗所，保罗留他们在那里，自己却到会堂去，跟犹太人辩论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了以弗所，保罗留他们在那里，自己却到会堂去，跟犹太人辩论。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了以弗所，保罗就把他们留在那里，自己进了会堂，和犹太人辩论。
verses.textEnNiv: They arrived at Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He himself went into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came to Ephesus, and he left them there, but he himself went into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there; but he himself entered the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: They stopped first at the port of Ephesus, where Paul left the others behind. While he was there, he went to the synagogue to reason with the Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: They came to Ephesus, and he left them there. Now he himself entered the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
verses.textEn: They arrived at Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He himself went into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

verses.textZh: 众人请他多住些时候，他没有答应，
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人请他多住些时候，他没有答应，
verses.textZhCuv: 众人请他多住些日子，他却不允，
verses.textEnNiv: When they asked him to spend more time with them, he declined.
verses.textEnEsv: When they asked him to stay for a longer period, he declined.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they asked him to stay a longer time with them, he did not consent,
verses.textEnNlt: They asked him to stay longer, but he declined.
verses.textEnNasb: When they asked him to stay for a longer time, he did not consent,
verses.textEn: When they asked him to spend more time with them, he declined.

verses.textZh: 却辞别他们说："神若许可，我还要回到你们这里来。"于是从以弗所开船去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却辞别他们说："神若许可，我还要回到你们这里来。"于是从以弗所开船去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 就辞别他们，说：「神若许我，我还要回到你们这里」；于是开船离了以弗所。
verses.textEnNiv: But as he left, he promised, "I will come back if it is God’s will." Then he set sail from Ephesus.
verses.textEnEsv: But on taking leave of them he said, "I will return to you if God wills," and he set sail from Ephesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: but took leave of them, saying, "I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem; but I will return again to you, God willing." And he sailed from Ephesus.
verses.textEnNlt: As he left, however, he said, "I will come back later, God willing." Then he set sail from Ephesus.
verses.textEnNasb: but took leave of them and said, "I will return to you again if God wills," and he set sail from Ephesus.
verses.textEn: But as he left, he promised, "I will come back if it is God’s will." Then he set sail from Ephesus.

verses.textZh: 保罗在该撒利亚登岸，上耶路撒冷问候教会，然后下安提阿去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗在该撒利亚登岸，上耶路撒冷问候教会，然后下安提阿去。
verses.textZhCuv: 在凯撒利亚下了船，就上耶路撒冷去问教会安，随后下安提阿去。
verses.textEnNiv: When he landed at Caesarea, he went up to Jerusalem and greeted the church and then went down to Antioch.
verses.textEnEsv: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the church, and then went down to Antioch.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up and greeted the church, he went down to Antioch.
verses.textEnNlt: The next stop was at the port of Caesarea. From there he went up and visited the church at Jerusalem and then went back to Antioch.
verses.textEnNasb: When he had landed in Caesarea, he went up to Jerusalem and greeted the church, and went down to Antioch.
verses.textEn: When he landed at Caesarea, he went up to Jerusalem and greeted the church and then went down to Antioch.

verses.textZh: 住了一些时候，他又动身，先后经过加拉太地区和弗吕家，坚固众门徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住了一些时候，他又动身，先后经过加拉太地区和弗吕家，坚固众门徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 住了些日子，又离开那里，挨次经过加拉太和弗吕家地方，坚固众门徒。
verses.textEnNiv: After spending some time in Antioch, Paul set out from there and traveled from place to place throughout the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: After spending some time there, he departed and went from one place to the next through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he had spent some time there, he departed and went over the region of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
verses.textEnNlt: After spending some time in Antioch, Paul went back through Galatia and Phrygia, visiting and strengthening all the believers.
verses.textEnNasb: And after spending some time there, he left and passed successively through the Galatian region and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.
verses.textEn: After spending some time in Antioch, Paul set out from there and traveled from place to place throughout the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.

verses.textZh: 有一个生在亚历山太的犹太人，名叫亚波罗，来到了以弗所。他很有口才，擅长讲解圣经。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个生在亚历山太的犹太人，名叫亚波罗，来到了以弗所。他很有口才，擅长讲解圣经。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个犹太人，名叫亚波罗，来到以弗所。他生在亚历山大，是有学问 的，最能讲解圣经。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was a learned man, with a thorough knowledge of the Scriptures.
verses.textEnEsv: Now a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was an eloquent man, competent in the Scriptures.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man and mighty in the Scriptures, came to Ephesus.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, a Jew named Apollos, an eloquent speaker who knew the Scriptures well, had arrived in Ephesus from Alexandria in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by birth, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus; and he was proficient in the Scriptures.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was a learned man, with a thorough knowledge of the Scriptures.

verses.textZh: 这人在主的道上受过训练，心灵火热，很准确地讲论，并且教导人关于耶稣的事，但他只晓得约翰的洗礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人在主的道上受过训练，心灵火热，很准确地讲论，并且教导人关于耶稣的事，但他只晓得约翰的洗礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人已经在主的道上受了教训，心里火热，将耶稣的事详细讲论教训人；只是他单晓得约翰的洗礼。
verses.textEnNiv: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord, and he spoke with great fervor and taught about Jesus accurately, though he knew only the baptism of John.
verses.textEnEsv: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord. And being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, though he knew only the baptism of John.
verses.textEnNkjv: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things of the Lord, though he knew only the baptism of John.
verses.textEnNlt: He had been taught the way of the Lord, and he taught others about Jesus with an enthusiastic spirit and with accuracy. However, he knew only about John’s baptism.
verses.textEnNasb: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he was accurately speaking and teaching things about Jesus, being acquainted only with the baptism of John;
verses.textEn: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord, and he spoke with great fervor and taught about Jesus accurately, though he knew only the baptism of John.

verses.textZh: 这人在会堂里放胆讲论起来；百基拉和亚居拉听了，就把他接来，把神的道更准确地向他讲解。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人在会堂里放胆讲论起来；百基拉和亚居拉听了，就把他接来，把神的道更准确地向他讲解。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在会堂里放胆讲道；百基拉、亚居拉听见，就接他来，将神的道给他讲解更加详细。
verses.textEnNiv: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they invited him to their home and explained to him the way of God more adequately.
verses.textEnEsv: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue, but when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Aquila and Priscilla heard him, they took him aside and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
verses.textEnNlt: When Priscilla and Aquila heard him preaching boldly in the synagogue, they took him aside and explained the way of God even more accurately.
verses.textEnNasb: and he began speaking boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside and explained the way of God more accurately to him.
verses.textEn: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they invited him to their home and explained to him the way of God more adequately.

verses.textZh: 亚波罗有意要到亚该亚去，弟兄们就鼓励他，又写信请门徒接待他。他到了那里，对那些蒙恩信主的人帮助很多，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚波罗有意要到亚该亚去，弟兄们就鼓励他，又写信请门徒接待他。他到了那里，对那些蒙恩信主的人帮助很多，
verses.textZhCuv: 他想要往亚该亚去，弟兄们就勉励他，并写信请门徒接待他 。他到了那里，多帮助那蒙恩信主的人，
verses.textEnNiv: When Apollos wanted to go to Achaia, the brothers and sisters encouraged him and wrote to the disciples there to welcome him. When he arrived, he was a great help to those who by grace had believed.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he wished to cross to Achaia, the brothers encouraged him and wrote to the disciples to welcome him. When he arrived, he greatly helped those who through grace had believed,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he desired to cross to Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him; and when he arrived, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
verses.textEnNlt: Apollos had been thinking about going to Achaia, and the brothers and sisters in Ephesus encouraged him to go. They wrote to the believers in Achaia, asking them to welcome him. When he arrived there, he proved to be of great benefit to those who, by God’s grace, had believed.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he wanted to go across to Achaia, the brothers encouraged him and wrote to the disciples to welcome him; and when he had arrived, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace,
verses.textEn: When Apollos wanted to go to Achaia, the brothers and sisters encouraged him and wrote to the disciples there to welcome him. When he arrived, he was a great help to those who by grace had believed.

verses.textZh: 因为他当众有力地驳倒犹太人，引用圣经证明耶稣是基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他当众有力地驳倒犹太人，引用圣经证明耶稣是基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 在众人面前极有能力驳倒犹太人，引圣经证明耶稣是基督。
verses.textEnNiv: For he vigorously refuted his Jewish opponents in public debate, proving from the Scriptures that Jesus was the Messiah.
verses.textEnEsv: for he powerfully refuted the Jews in public, showing by the Scriptures that the Christ was Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: for he vigorously refuted the Jews publicly, showing from the Scriptures that Jesus is the Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: He refuted the Jews with powerful arguments in public debate. Using the Scriptures, he explained to them that Jesus was the Messiah.
verses.textEnNasb: for he powerfully refuted the Jews in public, demonstrating by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
verses.textEn: For he vigorously refuted his Jewish opponents in public debate, proving from the Scriptures that Jesus was the Messiah.

verses.textZh: 亚波罗在哥林多的时候，保罗经过内地一带，来到以弗所。他遇见几个门徒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚波罗在哥林多的时候，保罗经过内地一带，来到以弗所。他遇见几个门徒，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚波罗在哥林多的时候，保罗经过了上边一带地方，就来到以弗所；在那里遇见几个门徒，
verses.textEnNiv: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul took the road through the interior and arrived at Ephesus. There he found some disciples
verses.textEnEsv: And it happened that while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul passed through the inland country and came to Ephesus. There he found some disciples.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, while Apollos was at Corinth, that Paul, having passed through the upper regions, came to Ephesus. And finding some disciples
verses.textEnNlt: While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul traveled through the interior regions until he reached Ephesus, on the coast, where he found several believers.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened that while Apollos was in Corinth, Paul passed through the upper country and came to Ephesus, and found some disciples.
verses.textEn: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul took the road through the interior and arrived at Ephesus. There he found some disciples

verses.textZh: 问他们说："你们信的时候，受了圣灵没有？"他们说："没有，连圣灵赐下来这件事，我们也没有听过。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 问他们说："你们信的时候，受了圣灵没有？"他们说："没有，连圣灵赐下来这件事，我们也没有听过。"
verses.textZhCuv: 问他们说：「你们信的时候受了圣灵没有？」他们回答说：「没有，也未曾听见有圣灵赐下来。」
verses.textEnNiv: and asked them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" They answered, "No, we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" And they said, "No, we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNkjv: he said to them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" So they said to him, "We have not so much as heard whether there is a Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNlt: "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" he asked them. "No," they replied, "we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit."
verses.textEnNasb: He said to them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" And they said to him, "On the contrary, we have not even heard if there is a Holy Spirit."
verses.textEn: and asked them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" They answered, "No, we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit."

verses.textZh: 保罗问："那么你们受的是甚么洗呢？"他们说："是约翰的洗礼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗问："那么你们受的是甚么洗呢？"他们说："是约翰的洗礼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗说：「这样，你们受的是什么洗呢？」他们说：「是约翰的洗。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Paul asked, "Then what baptism did you receive?" "John’s baptism," they replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Into what then were you baptized?" They said, "Into John’s baptism."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to them, "Into what then were you baptized?" So they said, "Into John’s baptism."
verses.textEnNlt: "Then what baptism did you experience?" he asked. And they replied, "The baptism of John."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Into what then were you baptized?" And they said, "Into John’s baptism."
verses.textEn: So Paul asked, "Then what baptism did you receive?" "John’s baptism," they replied.

verses.textZh: 保罗说："约翰施的是悔改的洗礼，他告诉人民当信在他以后要来的那一位，就是耶稣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗说："约翰施的是悔改的洗礼，他告诉人民当信在他以后要来的那一位，就是耶稣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗说：「约翰所行的是悔改的洗，告诉百姓当信那在他以后要来的，就是耶稣。」
verses.textEnNiv: Paul said, "John’s baptism was a baptism of repentance. He told the people to believe in the one coming after him, that is, in Jesus."
verses.textEnEsv: And Paul said, "John baptized with the baptism of repentance, telling the people to believe in the one who was to come after him, that is, Jesus."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul said, "John indeed baptized with a baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe on Him who would come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus."
verses.textEnNlt: Paul said, "John’s baptism called for repentance from sin. But John himself told the people to believe in the one who would come later, meaning Jesus."
verses.textEnNasb: Paul said, "John baptized with a baptism of repentance, telling the people to believe in Him who was coming after him, that is, in Jesus."
verses.textEn: Paul said, "John’s baptism was a baptism of repentance. He told the people to believe in the one coming after him, that is, in Jesus."

verses.textZh: 他们听见了，就受洗归入主耶稣的名下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听见了，就受洗归入主耶稣的名下。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们听见这话，就奉主耶稣的名受洗。
verses.textEnNiv: On hearing this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: On hearing this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEn: On hearing this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

verses.textZh: 保罗为他们按手，圣灵就降在他们身上，他们就用各种的语言讲话，并且说预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗为他们按手，圣灵就降在他们身上，他们就用各种的语言讲话，并且说预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗按手在他们头上，圣灵便降在他们身上，他们就说方言，又说预言 。
verses.textEnNiv: When Paul placed his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they began speaking in tongues and prophesying.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Paul had laid hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke with tongues and prophesied.
verses.textEnNlt: Then when Paul laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke in other tongues and prophesied.
verses.textEnNasb: And when Paul had laid hands upon them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they began speaking with tongues and prophesying.
verses.textEn: When Paul placed his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.

verses.textZh: 他们一共约有十二人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们一共约有十二人。
verses.textZhCuv: 一共约有十二个人。
verses.textEnNiv: There were about twelve men in all.
verses.textEnEsv: There were about twelve men in all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the men were about twelve in all.
verses.textEnNlt: There were about twelve men in all.
verses.textEnNasb: There were about twelve men in all.
verses.textEn: There were about twelve men in all.

verses.textZh: 一连三个月，保罗都到会堂里去，放胆宣讲，辩论神的国的事，劝导人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一连三个月，保罗都到会堂里去，放胆宣讲，辩论神的国的事，劝导人。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗进会堂，放胆讲道，一连三个月，辩论神国的事，劝化众人。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul entered the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he entered the synagogue and for three months spoke boldly, reasoning and persuading them about the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he went into the synagogue and spoke boldly for three months, reasoning and persuading concerning the things of the kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Paul went to the synagogue and preached boldly for the next three months, arguing persuasively about the Kingdom of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And he entered the synagogue and continued speaking out boldly for three months, having discussions and persuading them about the kingdom of God.
verses.textEn: Paul entered the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God.

verses.textZh: 可是有些人心里刚硬，不受劝化，在群众面前毁谤这道，保罗就离开他们，也叫门徒与他们分开。他每天在推喇奴学院跟人辩论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是有些人心里刚硬，不受劝化，在群众面前毁谤这道，保罗就离开他们，也叫门徒与他们分开。他每天在推喇奴学院跟人辩论。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来，有些人心里刚硬不信，在众人面前毁谤这道，保罗就离开他们，也叫门徒与他们分离，便在推喇奴的学房天天辩论。
verses.textEnNiv: But some of them became obstinate; they refused to believe and publicly maligned the Way. So Paul left them. He took the disciples with him and had discussions daily in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.
verses.textEnEsv: But when some became stubborn and continued in unbelief, speaking evil of the Way before the congregation, he withdrew from them and took the disciples with him, reasoning daily in the hall of Tyrannus.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when some were hardened and did not believe, but spoke evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and withdrew the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
verses.textEnNlt: But some became stubborn, rejecting his message and publicly speaking against the Way. So Paul left the synagogue and took the believers with him. Then he held daily discussions at the lecture hall of Tyrannus.
verses.textEnNasb: But when some were becoming hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the people, he withdrew from them and took the disciples away with him, and had discussions daily in the school of Tyrannus.
verses.textEn: But some of them became obstinate; they refused to believe and publicly maligned the Way. So Paul left them. He took the disciples with him and had discussions daily in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.

verses.textZh: 这样过了两年，全亚西亚的居民，无论犹太人或希腊人，都听见了主的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样过了两年，全亚西亚的居民，无论犹太人或希腊人，都听见了主的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样有两年之久，叫一切住在亚细亚的，无论是犹太人，是希腊人，都听见主的道。
verses.textEnNiv: This went on for two years, so that all the Jews and Greeks who lived in the province of Asia heard the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: This continued for two years, so that all the residents of Asia heard the word of the Lord, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this continued for two years, so that all who dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.textEnNlt: This went on for the next two years, so that people throughout the province of Asia—both Jews and Greeks—heard the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: This took place for two years, so that all who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.textEn: This went on for two years, so that all the Jews and Greeks who lived in the province of Asia heard the word of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 神借着保罗的手，行了一些不平凡的神迹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神借着保罗的手，行了一些不平凡的神迹。
verses.textZhCuv: 神藉保罗的手行了些非常的奇事；
verses.textEnNiv: God did extraordinary miracles through Paul,
verses.textEnEsv: And God was doing extraordinary miracles by the hands of Paul,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now God worked unusual miracles by the hands of Paul,
verses.textEnNlt: God gave Paul the power to perform unusual miracles.
verses.textEnNasb: God was performing extraordinary miracles by the hands of Paul,
verses.textEn: God did extraordinary miracles through Paul,

verses.textZh: 甚至有人把保罗贴身的手巾围巾拿去，放在病人身上，病就好了，邪灵也出来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甚至有人把保罗贴身的手巾围巾拿去，放在病人身上，病就好了，邪灵也出来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至有人从保罗身上拿手巾或围裙放在病人身上，病就退了，恶鬼也出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and their illnesses were cured and the evil spirits left them.
verses.textEnEsv: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons that had touched his skin were carried away to the sick, and their diseases left them and the evil spirits came out of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were brought from his body to the sick, and the diseases left them and the evil spirits went out of them.
verses.textEnNlt: When handkerchiefs or aprons that had merely touched his skin were placed on sick people, they were healed of their diseases, and evil spirits were expelled.
verses.textEnNasb: so that handkerchiefs or aprons were even carried from his body to the sick, and the diseases left them and the evil spirits went out.
verses.textEn: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and their illnesses were cured and the evil spirits left them.

verses.textZh: 那时，有几个赶鬼的犹太人，周游各处，擅自用主耶稣的名，向身上有邪灵的人说："我奉保罗所传的耶稣的名，命令你们出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，有几个赶鬼的犹太人，周游各处，擅自用主耶稣的名，向身上有邪灵的人说："我奉保罗所传的耶稣的名，命令你们出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，有几个游行各处、念咒赶鬼的犹太人，向那被恶鬼附的人擅自称主耶稣的名，说：「我奉保罗所传的耶稣敕令你们出来！」
verses.textEnNiv: Some Jews who went around driving out evil spirits tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who were demon-possessed. They would say, "In the name of the Jesus whom Paul preaches, I command you to come out."
verses.textEnEsv: Then some of the itinerant Jewish exorcists undertook to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who had evil spirits, saying, "I adjure you by the Jesus whom Paul proclaims."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some of the itinerant Jewish exorcists took it upon themselves to call the name of the Lord Jesus over those who had evil spirits, saying, "We exorcise you by the Jesus whom Paul preaches."
verses.textEnNlt: A group of Jews was traveling from town to town casting out evil spirits. They tried to use the name of the Lord Jesus in their incantation, saying, "I command you in the name of Jesus, whom Paul preaches, to come out!"
verses.textEnNasb: But also some of the Jewish exorcists, who went from place to place, attempted to use the name of the Lord Jesus over those who had the evil spirits, saying, "I order you in the name of Jesus whom Paul preaches!"
verses.textEn: Some Jews who went around driving out evil spirits tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who were demon-possessed. They would say, "In the name of the Jesus whom Paul preaches, I command you to come out."

verses.textZh: 有一个犹太人士基瓦，是祭司长，他的七个儿子都作这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个犹太人士基瓦，是祭司长，他的七个儿子都作这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 做这事的，有犹太祭司长士基瓦的七个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.
verses.textEnEsv: Seven sons of a Jewish high priest named Sceva were doing this.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also there were seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did so.
verses.textEnNlt: Seven sons of Sceva, a leading priest, were doing this.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there were seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, doing this.
verses.textEn: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.

verses.textZh: 邪灵回答他们："耶稣我认识，保罗我也知道；你们是谁？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 邪灵回答他们："耶稣我认识，保罗我也知道；你们是谁？"
verses.textZhCuv: 恶鬼回答他们说：「耶稣我认识，保罗我也知道。你们却是谁呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: One day the evil spirit answered them, "Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are you?"
verses.textEnEsv: But the evil spirit answered them, "Jesus I know, and Paul I recognize, but who are you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the evil spirit answered and said, "Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are you?"
verses.textEnNlt: But one time when they tried it, the evil spirit replied, "I know Jesus, and I know Paul, but who are you?"
verses.textEnNasb: But the evil spirit responded and said to them, "I recognize Jesus, and I know of Paul, but who are you?"
verses.textEn: One day the evil spirit answered them, "Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are you?"

verses.textZh: 邪灵所附的那人就扑到他们身上，制伏了两人，胜过了他们，使他们赤着身带着伤，从那房子逃了出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 邪灵所附的那人就扑到他们身上，制伏了两人，胜过了他们，使他们赤着身带着伤，从那房子逃了出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶鬼所附的人就跳在他们身上，胜了其中二人，制伏他们，叫他们赤着身子受了伤，从那房子里逃出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man who had the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. He gave them such a beating that they ran out of the house naked and bleeding.
verses.textEnEsv: And the man in whom was the evil spirit leaped on them, mastered all of them and overpowered them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man with the evil spirit leaped on them, overpowered them, and attacked them with such violence that they fled from the house, naked and battered.
verses.textEnNasb: And the man in whom was the evil spirit, pounced on them and subdued all of them and overpowered them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.textEn: Then the man who had the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. He gave them such a beating that they ran out of the house naked and bleeding.

verses.textZh: 所有住在以弗所的犹太人和希腊人，都知道这件事；大家都惧怕，尊主耶稣的名为大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有住在以弗所的犹太人和希腊人，都知道这件事；大家都惧怕，尊主耶稣的名为大。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡住在以弗所的，无论是犹太人，是希腊人，都知道这事，也都惧怕；主耶稣的名从此就尊大了。
verses.textEnNiv: When this became known to the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, they were all seized with fear, and the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.
verses.textEnEsv: And this became known to all the residents of Ephesus, both Jews and Greeks. And fear fell upon them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was extolled.
verses.textEnNkjv: This became known both to all Jews and Greeks dwelling in Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
verses.textEnNlt: The story of what happened spread quickly all through Ephesus, to Jews and Greeks alike. A solemn fear descended on the city, and the name of the Lord Jesus was greatly honored.
verses.textEnNasb: This became known to all who lived in Ephesus, both Jews and Greeks; and fear fell upon them all and the name of the Lord Jesus was being magnified.
verses.textEn: When this became known to the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, they were all seized with fear, and the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.

verses.textZh: 也有许多信了的人，来承认和述说自己行过的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也有许多信了的人，来承认和述说自己行过的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 那已经信的，多有人来承认诉说自己所行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Many of those who believed now came and openly confessed what they had done.
verses.textEnEsv: Also many of those who were now believers came, confessing and divulging their practices.
verses.textEnNkjv: And many who had believed came confessing and telling their deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: Many who became believers confessed their sinful practices.
verses.textEnNasb: Also many of those who had believed kept coming, confessing and disclosing their practices.
verses.textEn: Many of those who believed now came and openly confessed what they had done.

verses.textZh: 又有许多行巫术的人，把他们的书堆在一起当众烧掉。他们估计书价，才知道共值五万块银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有许多行巫术的人，把他们的书堆在一起当众烧掉。他们估计书价，才知道共值五万块银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 平素行邪术的，也有许多人把书拿来，堆积在众人面前焚烧。他们算计书价，便知道共合五万块钱。
verses.textEnNiv: A number who had practiced sorcery brought their scrolls together and burned them publicly. When they calculated the value of the scrolls, the total came to fifty thousand drachmas.
verses.textEnEsv: And a number of those who had practiced magic arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. And they counted the value of them and found it came to fifty thousand pieces of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, many of those who had practiced magic brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. And they counted up the value of them, and it totaled fifty thousand pieces of silver.
verses.textEnNlt: A number of them who had been practicing sorcery brought their incantation books and burned them at a public bonfire. The value of the books was several million dollars.
verses.textEnNasb: And many of those who practiced magic brought their books together and began burning them in the sight of everyone; and they added up the prices of the books and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.
verses.textEn: A number who had practiced sorcery brought their scrolls together and burned them publicly. When they calculated the value of the scrolls, the total came to fifty thousand drachmas.

verses.textZh: 这样，主的道大有能力地兴旺起来，而且得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，主的道大有能力地兴旺起来，而且得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 主的道大大兴旺，而且得胜，就是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: In this way the word of the Lord spread widely and grew in power.
verses.textEnEsv: So the word of the Lord continued to increase and prevail mightily.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the word of the Lord grew mightily and prevailed.
verses.textEnNlt: So the message about the Lord spread widely and had a powerful effect.
verses.textEnNasb: So the word of the Lord was growing and prevailing mightily.
verses.textEn: In this way the word of the Lord spread widely and grew in power.

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，保罗心里定意要经过马其顿、亚该亚，往耶路撒冷去。他说："我到了那边以后，也该去罗马看看。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，保罗心里定意要经过马其顿、亚该亚，往耶路撒冷去。他说："我到了那边以后，也该去罗马看看。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事完了，保罗心里定意经过了马其顿、亚该亚，就往耶路撒冷去；又说：「我到了那里以后，也必须往罗马去看看。」
verses.textEnNiv: After all this had happened, Paul decided to go to Jerusalem, passing through Macedonia and Achaia. "After I have been there," he said, "I must visit Rome also."
verses.textEnEsv: Now after these events Paul resolved in the Spirit to pass through Macedonia and Achaia and go to Jerusalem, saying, "After I have been there, I must also see Rome."
verses.textEnNkjv: When these things were accomplished, Paul purposed in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, "After I have been there, I must also see Rome."
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward Paul felt compelled by the Spirit to go over to Macedonia and Achaia before going to Jerusalem. "And after that," he said, "I must go on to Rome!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now after these things were finished, Paul resolved in the Spirit to go to Jerusalem after he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, saying, "After I have been there, I must also see Rome."
verses.textEn: After all this had happened, Paul decided to go to Jerusalem, passing through Macedonia and Achaia. "After I have been there," he said, "I must visit Rome also."

verses.textZh: 于是从服事他的人中，派了提摩太和以拉都两人去马其顿，自己暂时留在亚西亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是从服事他的人中，派了提摩太和以拉都两人去马其顿，自己暂时留在亚西亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是从帮助他的人中打发提摩太、以拉都二人往马其顿去，自己暂时等在亚细亚。
verses.textEnNiv: He sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he stayed in the province of Asia a little longer.
verses.textEnEsv: And having sent into Macedonia two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he sent into Macedonia two of those who ministered to him, Timothy and Erastus, but he himself stayed in Asia for a time.
verses.textEnNlt: He sent his two assistants, Timothy and Erastus, ahead to Macedonia while he stayed awhile longer in the province of Asia.
verses.textEnNasb: And after he sent into Macedonia two of those who assisted him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
verses.textEn: He sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he stayed in the province of Asia a little longer.

verses.textZh: 那时，因这道起了大扰乱，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，因这道起了大扰乱，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，因为这道起的扰乱不小。
verses.textEnNiv: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way.
verses.textEnEsv: About that time there arose no little disturbance concerning the Way.
verses.textEnNkjv: And about that time there arose a great commotion about the Way.
verses.textEnNlt: About that time, serious trouble developed in Ephesus concerning the Way.
verses.textEnNasb: About that time a major disturbance occurred in regard to the Way.
verses.textEn: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way.

verses.textZh: 有一个银匠，名叫低米丢，是制造亚底米女神银龛的。他让技工们作了不少的生意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个银匠，名叫低米丢，是制造亚底米女神银龛的。他让技工们作了不少的生意。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个银匠，名叫底米丢，是制造亚底米神银龛的，他使这样手艺人生意发达。
verses.textEnNiv: A silversmith named Demetrius, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought in a lot of business for the craftsmen there.
verses.textEnEsv: For a man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen.
verses.textEnNkjv: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines of Diana, brought no small profit to the craftsmen.
verses.textEnNlt: It began with Demetrius, a silversmith who had a large business manufacturing silver shrines of the Greek goddess Artemis. He kept many craftsmen busy.
verses.textEnNasb: For a man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, was bringing considerable business to the craftsmen;
verses.textEn: A silversmith named Demetrius, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought in a lot of business for the craftsmen there.

verses.textZh: 他把这些人和同业的工人聚集起来，说："各位，你们知道，我们是靠这生意赚钱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把这些人和同业的工人聚集起来，说："各位，你们知道，我们是靠这生意赚钱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他聚集他们和同行的工人，说：「众位，你们知道我们是倚靠这生意发财。
verses.textEnNiv: He called them together, along with the workers in related trades, and said: "You know, my friends, that we receive a good income from this business.
verses.textEnEsv: These he gathered together, with the workmen in similar trades, and said, "Men, you know that from this business we have our wealth.
verses.textEnNkjv: He called them together with the workers of similar occupation, and said: "Men, you know that we have our prosperity by this trade.
verses.textEnNlt: He called them together, along with others employed in similar trades, and addressed them as follows: "Gentlemen, you know that our wealth comes from this business.
verses.textEnNasb: he gathered these men together with the workmen of similar trades, and said, "Men, you know that our prosperity depends upon this business.
verses.textEn: He called them together, along with the workers in related trades, and said: "You know, my friends, that we receive a good income from this business.

verses.textZh: 现在你们看见了，也听见了，这个保罗不单在以弗所，而且几乎在整个亚西亚，说服了，也带坏了许多人，说：‘人手所做的，都不是神。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们看见了，也听见了，这个保罗不单在以弗所，而且几乎在整个亚西亚，说服了，也带坏了许多人，说：‘人手所做的，都不是神。’
verses.textZhCuv: 这保罗不但在以弗所，也几乎在亚细亚全地，引诱迷惑许多人，说：『人手所做的，不是神。』这是你们所看见所听见的。
verses.textEnNiv: And you see and hear how this fellow Paul has convinced and led astray large numbers of people here in Ephesus and in practically the whole province of Asia. He says that gods made by human hands are no gods at all.
verses.textEnEsv: And you see and hear that not only in Ephesus but in almost all of Asia this Paul has persuaded and turned away a great many people, saying that gods made with hands are not gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover you see and hear that not only at Ephesus, but throughout almost all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are not gods which are made with hands.
verses.textEnNlt: But as you have seen and heard, this man Paul has persuaded many people that handmade gods aren’t really gods at all. And he’s done this not only here in Ephesus but throughout the entire province!
verses.textEnNasb: You see and hear that not only in Ephesus, but in almost all of Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away a considerable number of people, saying that gods made by hands are not gods at all.
verses.textEn: And you see and hear how this fellow Paul has convinced and led astray large numbers of people here in Ephesus and in practically the whole province of Asia. He says that gods made by human hands are no gods at all.

verses.textZh: 这样，不只我们这一行要给人鄙视，就是大女神亚底米的庙也会给人撇弃，连全亚西亚和普天下所敬拜的女神也要垮台，威荣尽都失掉了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，不只我们这一行要给人鄙视，就是大女神亚底米的庙也会给人撇弃，连全亚西亚和普天下所敬拜的女神也要垮台，威荣尽都失掉了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，不独我们这事业被人藐视，就是大女神亚底米的庙也要被人轻忽，连亚细亚全地和普天下所敬拜的大女神之威荣也要消灭了。」
verses.textEnNiv: There is danger not only that our trade will lose its good name, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited; and the goddess herself, who is worshiped throughout the province of Asia and the world, will be robbed of her divine majesty."
verses.textEnEsv: And there is danger not only that this trade of ours may come into disrepute but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis may be counted as nothing, and that she may even be deposed from her magnificence, she whom all Asia and the world worship."
verses.textEnNkjv: So not only is this trade of ours in danger of falling into disrepute, but also the temple of the great goddess Diana may be despised and her magnificence destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worship."
verses.textEnNlt: Of course, I’m not just talking about the loss of public respect for our business. I’m also concerned that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will lose its influence and that Artemis—this magnificent goddess worshiped throughout the province of Asia and all around the world—will be robbed of her great prestige!"
verses.textEnNasb: Not only is there danger that this trade of ours will fall into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be regarded as worthless, and that she whom all of Asia and the world worship will even be dethroned from her magnificence."
verses.textEn: There is danger not only that our trade will lose its good name, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited; and the goddess herself, who is worshiped throughout the province of Asia and the world, will be robbed of her divine majesty."

verses.textZh: 他们听了，怒气冲冲喊着说："以弗所人的女神，伟大的亚底米啊！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听了，怒气冲冲喊着说："以弗所人的女神，伟大的亚底米啊！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人听见，就怒气填胸，喊着说：「大哉，以弗所人的亚底米啊！」
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard this, they were furious and began shouting: "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
verses.textEnEsv: When they heard this they were enraged and were crying out, "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they heard this, they were full of wrath and cried out, saying, "Great is Diana of the Ephesians!"
verses.textEnNlt: At this their anger boiled, and they began shouting, "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
verses.textEnNasb: When they heard this and were filled with rage, they began shouting, saying, "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
verses.textEn: When they heard this, they were furious and began shouting: "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"

verses.textZh: 全城骚动起来，他们捉住了保罗的旅伴马其顿人该犹和亚里达古，齐心冲进了剧场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全城骚动起来，他们捉住了保罗的旅伴马其顿人该犹和亚里达古，齐心冲进了剧场。
verses.textZhCuv: 满城都轰动起来。众人拿住与保罗同行的马其顿人该犹和亚里达古，齐心拥进戏园里去。
verses.textEnNiv: Soon the whole city was in an uproar. The people seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Paul’s traveling companions from Macedonia, and all of them rushed into the theater together.
verses.textEnEsv: So the city was filled with the confusion, and they rushed together into the theater, dragging with them Gaius and Aristarchus, Macedonians who were Paul’s companions in travel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the whole city was filled with confusion, and rushed into the theater with one accord, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Macedonians, Paul’s travel companions.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon the whole city was filled with confusion. Everyone rushed to the amphitheater, dragging along Gaius and Aristarchus, who were Paul’s traveling companions from Macedonia.
verses.textEnNasb: The city was filled with the confusion, and they rushed together into the theater, dragging along Gaius and Aristarchus, Paul’s Macedonian traveling companions.
verses.textEn: Soon the whole city was in an uproar. The people seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Paul’s traveling companions from Macedonia, and all of them rushed into the theater together.

verses.textZh: 保罗想要到人群当中去，门徒却不许。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗想要到人群当中去，门徒却不许。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗想要进去，到百姓那里，门徒却不许他去。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul wanted to appear before the crowd, but the disciples would not let him.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Paul wished to go in among the crowd, the disciples would not let him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Paul wanted to go in to the people, the disciples would not allow him.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul wanted to go in, too, but the believers wouldn’t let him.
verses.textEnNasb: And when Paul wanted to go into the assembly, the disciples would not let him.
verses.textEn: Paul wanted to appear before the crowd, but the disciples would not let him.

verses.textZh: 还有几位亚西亚的首长，是保罗的朋友，派人来劝他，不要冒险到剧场里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有几位亚西亚的首长，是保罗的朋友，派人来劝他，不要冒险到剧场里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有亚细亚几位首领，是保罗的朋友，打发人来劝他，不要冒险到戏园里去。
verses.textEnNiv: Even some of the officials of the province, friends of Paul, sent him a message begging him not to venture into the theater.
verses.textEnEsv: And even some of the Asiarchs, who were friends of his, sent to him and were urging him not to venture into the theater.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then some of the officials of Asia, who were his friends, sent to him pleading that he would not venture into the theater.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the officials of the province, friends of Paul, also sent a message to him, begging him not to risk his life by entering the amphitheater.
verses.textEnNasb: Also some of the Asiarchs who were friends of his sent word to him and repeatedly urged him not to venture into the theater.
verses.textEn: Even some of the officials of the province, friends of Paul, sent him a message begging him not to venture into the theater.

verses.textZh: 那时大家叫这个喊那个，乱成一团，大多数的人都不知道聚集的原因。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时大家叫这个喊那个，乱成一团，大多数的人都不知道聚集的原因。
verses.textZhCuv: 聚集的人纷纷乱乱，有喊叫这个的，有喊叫那个的；大半不知道是为什么聚集。
verses.textEnNiv: The assembly was in confusion: Some were shouting one thing, some another. Most of the people did not even know why they were there.
verses.textEnEsv: Now some cried out one thing, some another, for the assembly was in confusion, and most of them did not know why they had come together.
verses.textEnNkjv: Some therefore cried one thing and some another, for the assembly was confused, and most of them did not know why they had come together.
verses.textEnNlt: Inside, the people were all shouting, some one thing and some another. Everything was in confusion. In fact, most of them didn’t even know why they were there.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, some were shouting one thing and some another, for the assembly was in confusion and the majority did not know for what reason they had come together.
verses.textEn: The assembly was in confusion: Some were shouting one thing, some another. Most of the people did not even know why they were there.

verses.textZh: 犹太人把亚历山大推到前面，群众中有人把这事的因由告诉他。亚历山大作了一个手势，要向民众申辩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人把亚历山大推到前面，群众中有人把这事的因由告诉他。亚历山大作了一个手势，要向民众申辩。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人把亚历山大从众人中带出来，犹太人推他往前，亚历山大就摆手，要向百姓分诉；
verses.textEnNiv: The Jews in the crowd pushed Alexander to the front, and they shouted instructions to him. He motioned for silence in order to make a defense before the people.
verses.textEnEsv: Some of the crowd prompted Alexander, whom the Jews had put forward. And Alexander, motioning with his hand, wanted to make a defense to the crowd.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander motioned with his hand, and wanted to make his defense to the people.
verses.textEnNlt: The Jews in the crowd pushed Alexander forward and told him to explain the situation. He motioned for silence and tried to speak.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of the crowd concluded it was Alexander, since the Jews had put him forward; and having motioned with his hand, Alexander was intending to make a defense to the assembly.
verses.textEn: The Jews in the crowd pushed Alexander to the front, and they shouted instructions to him. He motioned for silence in order to make a defense before the people.

verses.textZh: 大家一认出他是犹太人，就异口同声高呼："以弗所人的女神，伟大的亚底米啊！"喊了约有两个钟头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大家一认出他是犹太人，就异口同声高呼："以弗所人的女神，伟大的亚底米啊！"喊了约有两个钟头。
verses.textZhCuv: 只因他们认出他是犹太人，就大家同声喊着说：「大哉！以弗所人的亚底米啊。」如此约有两小时。
verses.textEnNiv: But when they realized he was a Jew, they all shouted in unison for about two hours: "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
verses.textEnEsv: But when they recognized that he was a Jew, for about two hours they all cried out with one voice, "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they found out that he was a Jew, all with one voice cried out for about two hours, "Great is Diana of the Ephesians!"
verses.textEnNlt: But when the crowd realized he was a Jew, they started shouting again and kept it up for about two hours: "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians! Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
verses.textEnNasb: But when they recognized that he was a Jew, a single outcry arose from them all as they shouted for about two hours, "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"
verses.textEn: But when they realized he was a Jew, they all shouted in unison for about two hours: "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"

verses.textZh: 后来，书记官安抚群众说："以弗所人哪！谁不知道你们的城，是看守大亚底米的庙，又是看守宙斯那里降下的神像的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，书记官安抚群众说："以弗所人哪！谁不知道你们的城，是看守大亚底米的庙，又是看守宙斯那里降下的神像的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 那城里的书记安抚了众人，就说：「以弗所人哪，谁不知道以弗所人的城是看守大亚底米的庙和从宙斯那里落下来的像呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The city clerk quieted the crowd and said: "Fellow Ephesians, doesn’t all the world know that the city of Ephesus is the guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image, which fell from heaven?
verses.textEnEsv: And when the town clerk had quieted the crowd, he said, "Men of Ephesus, who is there who does not know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great Artemis, and of the sacred stone that fell from the sky?
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the city clerk had quieted the crowd, he said: "Men of Ephesus, what man is there who does not know that the city of the Ephesians is temple guardian of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?
verses.textEnNlt: At last the mayor was able to quiet them down enough to speak. "Citizens of Ephesus," he said. "Everyone knows that Ephesus is the official guardian of the temple of the great Artemis, whose image fell down to us from heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: After quieting the crowd, the town clerk *said, "Men of Ephesus, what person is there after all who does not know that the city of the Ephesians is guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of the image which fell down from the sky?
verses.textEn: The city clerk quieted the crowd and said: "Fellow Ephesians, doesn’t all the world know that the city of Ephesus is the guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image, which fell from heaven?

verses.textZh: 这些事既然是驳不倒的，你们就应当平心静气，不可轻举妄动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事既然是驳不倒的，你们就应当平心静气，不可轻举妄动。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事既是驳不倒的，你们就当安静，不可造次。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, since these facts are undeniable, you ought to calm down and not do anything rash.
verses.textEnEsv: Seeing then that these things cannot be denied, you ought to be quiet and do nothing rash.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, since these things cannot be denied, you ought to be quiet and do nothing rashly.
verses.textEnNlt: Since this is an undeniable fact, you should stay calm and not do anything rash.
verses.textEnNasb: So, since these are undeniable facts, you ought to keep calm and to do nothing rash.
verses.textEn: Therefore, since these facts are undeniable, you ought to calm down and not do anything rash.

verses.textZh: 你们带来的这些人，既没有行劫庙宇，也没有亵渎我们的女神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们带来的这些人，既没有行劫庙宇，也没有亵渎我们的女神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们把这些人带来，他们并没有偷窃庙中之物，也没有谤我们的女神。
verses.textEnNiv: You have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed temples nor blasphemed our goddess.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have brought these men here who are neither sacrilegious nor blasphemers of our goddess.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you have brought these men here who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.
verses.textEnNlt: You have brought these men here, but they have stolen nothing from the temple and have not spoken against our goddess.
verses.textEnNasb: For you have brought these men here who are neither temple robbers nor blasphemers of our goddess.
verses.textEn: You have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed temples nor blasphemed our goddess.

verses.textZh: 如果低米丢和同他一起的技工要控告谁，大可以告上法庭，或呈交总督；让他们彼此控告好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果低米丢和同他一起的技工要控告谁，大可以告上法庭，或呈交总督；让他们彼此控告好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是底米丢和他同行的人有控告人的事，自有放告的日子 ，也有方伯可以彼此对告。
verses.textEnNiv: If, then, Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a grievance against anybody, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. They can press charges.
verses.textEnEsv: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen with him have a complaint against anyone, the courts are open, and there are proconsuls. Let them bring charges against one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, if Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a case against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them bring charges against one another.
verses.textEnNlt: "If Demetrius and the craftsmen have a case against them, the courts are in session and the officials can hear the case at once. Let them make formal charges.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, if Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a complaint against anyone, the courts are in session and proconsuls are available; have them bring charges against one another.
verses.textEn: If, then, Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a grievance against anybody, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. They can press charges.

verses.textZh: 如果还有其他的事件，可以在合法的集会里，谋求解决。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果还有其他的事件，可以在合法的集会里，谋求解决。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若问别的事，就可以照常例聚集断定。
verses.textEnNiv: If there is anything further you want to bring up, it must be settled in a legal assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you seek anything further, it shall be settled in the regular assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you have any other inquiry to make, it shall be determined in the lawful assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: And if there are complaints about other matters, they can be settled in a legal assembly.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you want anything beyond this, it shall be settled in the lawful assembly.
verses.textEn: If there is anything further you want to bring up, it must be settled in a legal assembly.

verses.textZh: 今天的动乱，本来是无缘无故的，我们可能有被控告的危险；关于这次的骚动，我们实在无法解释。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 今天的动乱，本来是无缘无故的，我们可能有被控告的危险；关于这次的骚动，我们实在无法解释。"
verses.textZhCuv: 今日的扰乱本是无缘无故，我们难免被查问。论到这样聚众，我们也说不出所以然来。」
verses.textEnNiv: As it is, we are in danger of being charged with rioting because of what happened today. In that case we would not be able to account for this commotion, since there is no reason for it."
verses.textEnEsv: For we really are in danger of being charged with rioting today, since there is no cause that we can give to justify this commotion."
verses.textEnNkjv: For we are in danger of being called in question for today’s uproar, there being no reason which we may give to account for this disorderly gathering."
verses.textEnNlt: I am afraid we are in danger of being charged with rioting by the Roman government, since there is no cause for all this commotion. And if Rome demands an explanation, we won’t know what to say."
verses.textEnNasb: For indeed, we are in danger of being accused of a riot in connection with today’s events, since there is no real reason for it, and in this connection we will be unable to account for this disorderly gathering."
verses.textEn: As it is, we are in danger of being charged with rioting because of what happened today. In that case we would not be able to account for this commotion, since there is no reason for it."

verses.textZh: 说了这些话，就把群众解散了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说了这些话，就把群众解散了。
verses.textZhCuv: 说了这话，便叫众人散去。
verses.textEnNiv: After he had said this, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had said these things, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he had said these things, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he dismissed them, and they dispersed.
verses.textEnNasb: After saying this he dismissed the assembly.
verses.textEn: After he had said this, he dismissed the assembly.

verses.textZh: 骚乱平息以后，保罗派人把门徒请了来，劝勉一番，就辞别起行，往马其顿去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 骚乱平息以后，保罗派人把门徒请了来，劝勉一番，就辞别起行，往马其顿去。
verses.textZhCuv: 乱定之后，保罗请门徒来，劝勉他们，就辞别起行，往马其顿去。
verses.textEnNiv: When the uproar had ended, Paul sent for the disciples and, after encouraging them, said goodbye and set out for Macedonia.
verses.textEnEsv: After the uproar ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, and after encouraging them, he said farewell and departed for Macedonia.
verses.textEnNkjv: After the uproar had ceased, Paul called the disciples to himself, embraced them, and departed to go to Macedonia.
verses.textEnNlt: When the uproar was over, Paul sent for the believers and encouraged them. Then he said good-bye and left for Macedonia.
verses.textEnNasb: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, and when he had encouraged them and taken his leave of them, he left to go to Macedonia.
verses.textEn: When the uproar had ended, Paul sent for the disciples and, after encouraging them, said goodbye and set out for Macedonia.

verses.textZh: 他走遍那一带地方，用许多话劝勉众人，然后来到希腊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他走遍那一带地方，用许多话劝勉众人，然后来到希腊。
verses.textZhCuv: 走遍了那一带地方，用许多话劝勉门徒 ，然后来到希腊。
verses.textEnNiv: He traveled through that area, speaking many words of encouragement to the people, and finally arrived in Greece,
verses.textEnEsv: When he had gone through those regions and had given them much encouragement, he came to Greece.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when he had gone over that region and encouraged them with many words, he came to Greece
verses.textEnNlt: While there, he encouraged the believers in all the towns he passed through. Then he traveled down to Greece,
verses.textEnNasb: When he had gone through those regions and had given them much encouragement, he came to Greece.
verses.textEn: He traveled through that area, speaking many words of encouragement to the people, and finally arrived in Greece,

verses.textZh: 他在那里住了三个月，正要坐船往叙利亚去的时候，有些犹太人设计要害他，他就决意路经马其顿回去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在那里住了三个月，正要坐船往叙利亚去的时候，有些犹太人设计要害他，他就决意路经马其顿回去。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里住了三个月，将要坐船往叙利亚去，犹太人设计要害他，他就定意从马其顿回去。
verses.textEnNiv: where he stayed three months. Because some Jews had plotted against him just as he was about to sail for Syria, he decided to go back through Macedonia.
verses.textEnEsv: There he spent three months, and when a plot was made against him by the Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he decided to return through Macedonia.
verses.textEnNkjv: and stayed three months. And when the Jews plotted against him as he was about to sail to Syria, he decided to return through Macedonia.
verses.textEnNlt: where he stayed for three months. He was preparing to sail back to Syria when he discovered a plot by some Jews against his life, so he decided to return through Macedonia.
verses.textEnNasb: And there he spent three months, and when a plot was formed against him by the Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he decided to return through Macedonia.
verses.textEn: where he stayed three months. Because some Jews had plotted against him just as he was about to sail for Syria, he decided to go back through Macedonia.

verses.textZh: 与他同行的有比里亚人毕罗斯的儿子所巴特，帖撒罗尼迦人亚里达古和西公都，特庇人该犹和提摩太，亚西亚人推基古和特罗非摩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 与他同行的有比里亚人毕罗斯的儿子所巴特，帖撒罗尼迦人亚里达古和西公都，特庇人该犹和提摩太，亚西亚人推基古和特罗非摩。
verses.textZhCuv: 同他到亚细亚去的，有庇哩亚人毕罗斯的儿子所巴特，帖撒罗尼迦人亚里达古和西公都，还有特庇人该犹，并提摩太，又有亚细亚人推基古和特罗非摩。
verses.textEnNiv: He was accompanied by Sopater son of Pyrrhus from Berea, Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, Gaius from Derbe, Timothy also, and Tychicus and Trophimus from the province of Asia.
verses.textEnEsv: Sopater the Berean, son of Pyrrhus, accompanied him; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy; and the Asians, Tychicus and Trophimus.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Sopater of Berea accompanied him to Asia—also Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.
verses.textEnNlt: Several men were traveling with him. They were Sopater son of Pyrrhus from Berea; Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica; Gaius from Derbe; Timothy; and Tychicus and Trophimus from the province of Asia.
