verses.textEnNasb: And he was accompanied by Sopater of Berea, the son of Pyrrhus, and by Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.
verses.textEn: He was accompanied by Sopater son of Pyrrhus from Berea, Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, Gaius from Derbe, Timothy also, and Tychicus and Trophimus from the province of Asia.

verses.textZh: 这些人先走，在特罗亚等候我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人先走，在特罗亚等候我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人先走，在特罗亚等候我们。
verses.textEnNiv: These men went on ahead and waited for us at Troas.
verses.textEnEsv: These went on ahead and were waiting for us at Troas,
verses.textEnNkjv: These men, going ahead, waited for us at Troas.
verses.textEnNlt: They went on ahead and waited for us at Troas.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these had gone on ahead and were waiting for us at Troas.
verses.textEn: These men went on ahead and waited for us at Troas.

verses.textZh: 至于我们，过了除酵节才从腓立比开船，五天后到特罗亚他们那里，逗留了七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我们，过了除酵节才从腓立比开船，五天后到特罗亚他们那里，逗留了七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了除酵的日子，我们从腓立比开船，五天到了特罗亚，和他们相会，在那里住了七天。
verses.textEnNiv: But we sailed from Philippi after the Festival of Unleavened Bread, and five days later joined the others at Troas, where we stayed seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: but we sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and in five days we came to them at Troas, where we stayed for seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we sailed away from Philippi after the Days of Unleavened Bread, and in five days joined them at Troas, where we stayed seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: After the Passover ended, we boarded a ship at Philippi in Macedonia and five days later joined them in Troas, where we stayed a week.
verses.textEnNasb: We sailed from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and reached them at Troas within five days; and we stayed there for seven days.
verses.textEn: But we sailed from Philippi after the Festival of Unleavened Bread, and five days later joined the others at Troas, where we stayed seven days.

verses.textZh: 礼拜日，我们聚会擘饼的时候，保罗对大家讲道，他因第二天就要起行，就一直讲到半夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 礼拜日，我们聚会擘饼的时候，保罗对大家讲道，他因第二天就要起行，就一直讲到半夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 七日的第一日，我们聚会擘饼的时候，保罗因为要次日起行，就与他们讲论，直讲到半夜。
verses.textEnNiv: On the first day of the week we came together to break bread. Paul spoke to the people and, because he intended to leave the next day, kept on talking until midnight.
verses.textEnEsv: On the first day of the week, when we were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day, and he prolonged his speech until midnight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now on the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul, ready to depart the next day, spoke to them and continued his message until midnight.
verses.textEnNlt: On the first day of the week, we gathered with the local believers to share in the Lord’s Supper. Paul was preaching to them, and since he was leaving the next day, he kept talking until midnight.
verses.textEnNasb: On the first day of the week, when we were gathered together to break bread, Paul began talking to them, intending to leave the next day, and he prolonged his message until midnight.
verses.textEn: On the first day of the week we came together to break bread. Paul spoke to the people and, because he intended to leave the next day, kept on talking until midnight.

verses.textZh: 我们聚会的那座楼上，有许多灯火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们聚会的那座楼上，有许多灯火。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们聚会的那座楼上，有好些灯烛。
verses.textEnNiv: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we were meeting.
verses.textEnEsv: There were many lamps in the upper room where we were gathered.
verses.textEnNkjv: There were many lamps in the upper room where they were gathered together.
verses.textEnNlt: The upstairs room where we met was lighted with many flickering lamps.
verses.textEnNasb: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we were gathered together.
verses.textEn: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we were meeting.

verses.textZh: 有一个少年人，名叫犹推古，坐在窗台上，因为保罗讲得很长，他很困倦，沉沉地睡着了，就从三楼跌下来；把他扶起来的时候，已经死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个少年人，名叫犹推古，坐在窗台上，因为保罗讲得很长，他很困倦，沉沉地睡着了，就从三楼跌下来；把他扶起来的时候，已经死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个少年人，名叫犹推古，坐在窗台上，困倦沉睡。保罗讲了多时，少年人睡熟了，就从三层楼上掉下去；扶起他来，已经死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Seated in a window was a young man named Eutychus, who was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell to the ground from the third story and was picked up dead.
verses.textEnEsv: And a young man named Eutychus, sitting at the window, sank into a deep sleep as Paul talked still longer. And being overcome by sleep, he fell down from the third story and was taken up dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in a window sat a certain young man named Eutychus, who was sinking into a deep sleep. He was overcome by sleep; and as Paul continued speaking, he fell down from the third story and was taken up dead.
verses.textEnNlt: As Paul spoke on and on, a young man named Eutychus, sitting on the windowsill, became very drowsy. Finally, he fell sound asleep and dropped three stories to his death below.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was a young man named Eutychus sitting on the window sill, sinking into a deep sleep; and as Paul kept on talking, Eutychus was overcome by sleep and fell down from the third floor, and was picked up dead.
verses.textEn: Seated in a window was a young man named Eutychus, who was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell to the ground from the third story and was picked up dead.

verses.textZh: 保罗走下去，伏在他身上；把他抱住，说："你们不要惊慌，他还活着。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗走下去，伏在他身上；把他抱住，说："你们不要惊慌，他还活着。"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗下去，伏在他身上，抱着他，说：「你们不要发慌，他的灵魂还在身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. "Don’t be alarmed," he said. "He’s alive!"
verses.textEnEsv: But Paul went down and bent over him, and taking him in his arms, said, "Do not be alarmed, for his life is in him."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Paul went down, fell on him, and embracing him said, "Do not trouble yourselves, for his life is in him."
verses.textEnNlt: Paul went down, bent over him, and took him into his arms. "Don’t worry," he said, "he’s alive!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Paul went down and fell upon him, and after embracing him, he said, " Do not be troubled, for he is still alive."
verses.textEn: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. "Don’t be alarmed," he said. "He’s alive!"

verses.textZh: 随即回到楼上，擘饼吃了，又讲了很久，直到天亮才走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 随即回到楼上，擘饼吃了，又讲了很久，直到天亮才走。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗又上去，擘饼，吃了，谈论许久，直到天亮，这才走了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he went upstairs again and broke bread and ate. After talking until daylight, he left.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Paul had gone up and had broken bread and eaten, he conversed with them a long while, until daybreak, and so departed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when he had come up, had broken bread and eaten, and talked a long while, even till daybreak, he departed.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they all went back upstairs, shared in the Lord’s Supper, and ate together. Paul continued talking to them until dawn, and then he left.
verses.textEnNasb: When Paul had gone back up and had broken the bread and eaten, he talked with them a long while until daybreak, and then left.
verses.textEn: Then he went upstairs again and broke bread and ate. After talking until daylight, he left.

verses.textZh: 他们把活着的孩子带走，得到很大的安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把活着的孩子带走，得到很大的安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人把那童子活活地领来，得的安慰不小。
verses.textEnNiv: The people took the young man home alive and were greatly comforted.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took the youth away alive, and were not a little comforted.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they brought the young man in alive, and they were not a little comforted.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the young man was taken home alive and well, and everyone was greatly relieved.
verses.textEnNasb: They took away the boy alive, and were greatly comforted.
verses.textEn: The people took the young man home alive and were greatly comforted.

verses.textZh: 我们先上船，开往亚朔，照着保罗的安排，要在那边接他，因为他自己要走陆路去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们先上船，开往亚朔，照着保罗的安排，要在那边接他，因为他自己要走陆路去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们先上船，开往亚朔去，意思要在那里接保罗；因为他是这样安排的，他自己打算要步行。
verses.textEnNiv: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed for Assos, where we were going to take Paul aboard. He had made this arrangement because he was going there on foot.
verses.textEnEsv: But going ahead to the ship, we set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there, for so he had arranged, intending himself to go by land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then we went ahead to the ship and sailed to Assos, there intending to take Paul on board; for so he had given orders, intending himself to go on foot.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul went by land to Assos, where he had arranged for us to join him, while we traveled by ship.
verses.textEnNasb: But we went ahead to the ship and set sail for Assos, intending from there to take Paul on board; for that was what he had arranged, intending himself to go by land.
verses.textEn: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed for Assos, where we were going to take Paul aboard. He had made this arrangement because he was going there on foot.

verses.textZh: 他在亚朔与我们会合，我们接他上船，去到米推利尼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在亚朔与我们会合，我们接他上船，去到米推利尼。
verses.textZhCuv: 他既在亚朔与我们相会，我们就接他上船，来到米推利尼。
verses.textEnNiv: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he met us at Assos, we took him on board and went to Mitylene.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he met us at Assos, we took him on board and came to Mitylene.
verses.textEnNlt: He joined us there, and we sailed together to Mitylene.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he met us at Assos, we took him on board and came to Mitylene.
verses.textEn: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.

verses.textZh: 从那里开船，第二天到了基阿对面，过了一天就在撒摩靠岸，再过一天到了米利都。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从那里开船，第二天到了基阿对面，过了一天就在撒摩靠岸，再过一天到了米利都。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里开船，次日到了基阿的对面；又次日，在撒摩靠岸；又次日，来到米利都。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day we set sail from there and arrived off Chios. The day after that we crossed over to Samos, and on the following day arrived at Miletus.
verses.textEnEsv: And sailing from there we came the following day opposite Chios; the next day we touched at Samos; and the day after that we went to Miletus.
verses.textEnNkjv: We sailed from there, and the next day came opposite Chios. The following day we arrived at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium. The next day we came to Miletus.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day we sailed past the island of Kios. The following day we crossed to the island of Samos, and a day later we arrived at Miletus.
verses.textEnNasb: Sailing from there, we arrived the following day opposite Chios; and the next day we crossed over to Samos, and on the following day we came to Miletus.
verses.textEn: The next day we set sail from there and arrived off Chios. The day after that we crossed over to Samos, and on the following day arrived at Miletus.

verses.textZh: 原来保罗决定越过以弗所，免得在亚西亚耽搁时间，因为他希望能在五旬节赶到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来保罗决定越过以弗所，免得在亚西亚耽搁时间，因为他希望能在五旬节赶到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 乃因保罗早已定意越过以弗所，免得在亚细亚耽延，他急忙前走，巴不得赶五旬节能到耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, for he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.
verses.textEnEsv: For Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus, so that he might not have to spend time in Asia, for he was hastening to be at Jerusalem, if possible, on the day of Pentecost.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus, so that he would not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hurrying to be at Jerusalem, if possible, on the Day of Pentecost.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul had decided to sail on past Ephesus, for he didn’t want to spend any more time in the province of Asia. He was hurrying to get to Jerusalem, if possible, in time for the Festival of Pentecost.
verses.textEnNasb: For Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus so that he would not have to lose time in Asia; for he was hurrying, if it might be possible for him to be in Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
verses.textEn: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, for he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.

verses.textZh: 他从米利都派人去以弗所，请教会的长老来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从米利都派人去以弗所，请教会的长老来。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗从米利都打发人往以弗所去，请教会的长老来。
verses.textEnNiv: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.
verses.textEnEsv: Now from Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called the elders of the church to come to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called for the elders of the church.
verses.textEnNlt: But when we landed at Miletus, he sent a message to the elders of the church at Ephesus, asking them to come and meet him.
verses.textEnNasb: From Miletus he sent word to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the church.
verses.textEn: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.

verses.textZh: 他们到了，保罗说："你们知道，自从我到了亚西亚的第一天，我一直怎样跟你们相处，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了，保罗说："你们知道，自从我到了亚西亚的第一天，我一直怎样跟你们相处，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来了，保罗就说：「你们知道，自从我到亚细亚的日子以来，在你们中间始终为人如何，
verses.textEnNiv: When they arrived, he said to them: "You know how I lived the whole time I was with you, from the first day I came into the province of Asia.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they came to him, he said to them: "You yourselves know how I lived among you the whole time from the first day that I set foot in Asia,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had come to him, he said to them: "You know, from the first day that I came to Asia, in what manner I always lived among you,
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived he declared, "You know that from the day I set foot in the province of Asia until now
verses.textEnNasb: And when they came to him, he said to them, "You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you the whole time,
verses.textEn: When they arrived, he said to them: "You know how I lived the whole time I was with you, from the first day I came into the province of Asia.

verses.textZh: 怎样服事主，凡事谦卑，常常流泪，忍受犹太人谋害的试炼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 怎样服事主，凡事谦卑，常常流泪，忍受犹太人谋害的试炼。
verses.textZhCuv: 服事主，凡事谦卑，眼中流泪，又因犹太人的谋害，经历试炼。
verses.textEnNiv: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears and in the midst of severe testing by the plots of my Jewish opponents.
verses.textEnEsv: serving the Lord with all humility and with tears and with trials that happened to me through the plots of the Jews;
verses.textEnNkjv: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears and trials which happened to me by the plotting of the Jews;
verses.textEnNlt: I have done the Lord’s work humbly and with many tears. I have endured the trials that came to me from the plots of the Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: serving the Lord with all humility and with tears and trials which came upon me through the plots of the Jews;
verses.textEn: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears and in the midst of severe testing by the plots of my Jewish opponents.

verses.textZh: 你们也知道，我从来没有留下一件有益的事，不在众人面前或在各人家里告诉你们，教导你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也知道，我从来没有留下一件有益的事，不在众人面前或在各人家里告诉你们，教导你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也知道，凡与你们有益的，我没有一样避讳不说的，或在众人面前，或在各人家里，我都教导你们；
verses.textEnNiv: You know that I have not hesitated to preach anything that would be helpful to you but have taught you publicly and from house to house.
verses.textEnEsv: how I did not shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, and teaching you in public and from house to house,
verses.textEnNkjv: how I kept back nothing that was helpful, but proclaimed it to you, and taught you publicly and from house to house,
verses.textEnNlt: I never shrank back from telling you what you needed to hear, either publicly or in your homes.
verses.textEnNasb: how I did not shrink from declaring to you anything that was beneficial, and teaching you publicly and from house to house,
verses.textEn: You know that I have not hesitated to preach anything that would be helpful to you but have taught you publicly and from house to house.

verses.textZh: 我对犹太人和希腊人都作过见证，要他们悔改归向神，信靠我们的主耶稣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对犹太人和希腊人都作过见证，要他们悔改归向神，信靠我们的主耶稣。
verses.textZhCuv: 又对犹太人和希腊人证明当向神悔改，信靠我主耶稣基督。
verses.textEnNiv: I have declared to both Jews and Greeks that they must turn to God in repentance and have faith in our Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks of repentance toward God and of faith in our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: testifying to Jews, and also to Greeks, repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: I have had one message for Jews and Greeks alike—the necessity of repenting from sin and turning to God, and of having faith in our Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: solemnly testifying to both Jews and Greeks of repentance toward God and faith in our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: I have declared to both Jews and Greeks that they must turn to God in repentance and have faith in our Lord Jesus.

verses.textZh: 现在，我的心灵受到催逼，要去耶路撒冷，我不知道在那里会遭遇甚么事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，我的心灵受到催逼，要去耶路撒冷，我不知道在那里会遭遇甚么事，
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我往耶路撒冷去，心甚迫切 ，不知道在那里要遇见什么事；
verses.textEnNiv: "And now, compelled by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, behold, I am going to Jerusalem, constrained by the Spirit, not knowing what will happen to me there,
verses.textEnNkjv: And see, now I go bound in the spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing the things that will happen to me there,
verses.textEnNlt: "And now I am bound by the Spirit to go to Jerusalem. I don’t know what awaits me,
verses.textEnNasb: And now, behold, bound by the Spirit, I am on my way to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there,
verses.textEn: "And now, compelled by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.

verses.textZh: 只知道在各城里圣灵都向我指明，说有捆锁和患难在等着我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只知道在各城里圣灵都向我指明，说有捆锁和患难在等着我。
verses.textZhCuv: 但知道圣灵在各城里向我指证，说有捆锁与患难等待我。
verses.textEnNiv: I only know that in every city the Holy Spirit warns me that prison and hardships are facing me.
verses.textEnEsv: except that the Holy Spirit testifies to me in every city that imprisonment and afflictions await me.
verses.textEnNkjv: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that chains and tribulations await me.
verses.textEnNlt: except that the Holy Spirit tells me in city after city that jail and suffering lie ahead.
verses.textEnNasb: except that the Holy Spirit solemnly testifies to me in every city, saying that chains and afflictions await me.
verses.textEn: I only know that in every city the Holy Spirit warns me that prison and hardships are facing me.

verses.textZh: 但我并不珍惜自己的性命，只求跑完我的路程，完成我从主耶稣所领受的职分，为神恩惠的福音作见证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我并不珍惜自己的性命，只求跑完我的路程，完成我从主耶稣所领受的职分，为神恩惠的福音作见证。
verses.textZhCuv: 我却不以性命为念，也不看为宝贵，只要行完我的路程，成就我从主耶稣所领受的职事，证明神恩惠的福音。
verses.textEnNiv: However, I consider my life worth nothing to me; my only aim is to finish the race and complete the task the Lord Jesus has given me—the task of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
verses.textEnEsv: But I do not account my life of any value nor as precious to myself, if only I may finish my course and the ministry that I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of the grace of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But none of these things move me; nor do I count my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the gospel of the grace of God.
verses.textEnNlt: But my life is worth nothing to me unless I use it for finishing the work assigned me by the Lord Jesus—the work of telling others the Good News about the wonderful grace of God.
verses.textEnNasb: But I do not consider my life of any account as dear to myself, so that I may finish my course and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify solemnly of the gospel of God’s grace.
verses.textEn: However, I consider my life worth nothing to me; my only aim is to finish the race and complete the task the Lord Jesus has given me—the task of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.

verses.textZh: "我曾在你们那里走遍各地，宣扬神的国。现在，我知道你们众人不会再见我的面了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我曾在你们那里走遍各地，宣扬神的国。现在，我知道你们众人不会再见我的面了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我素常在你们中间来往，传讲神国的道；如今我晓得，你们以后都不得再见我的面了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now I know that none of you among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom will ever see me again.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, behold, I know that none of you among whom I have gone about proclaiming the kingdom will see my face again.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And indeed, now I know that you all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, will see my face no more.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now I know that none of you to whom I have preached the Kingdom will ever see me again.
verses.textEnNasb: "And now behold, I know that all of you, among whom I went about preaching the kingdom, will no longer see my face.
verses.textEn: "Now I know that none of you among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom will ever see me again.

verses.textZh: 所以我今天向你们作证，我是清白的，与众人的罪 无关。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我今天向你们作证，我是清白的，与众人的罪 无关。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我今日向你们证明，你们中间无论何人死亡，罪不在我身上 。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, I declare to you today that I am innocent of the blood of any of you.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I testify to you this day that I am innocent of the blood of all,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I testify to you this day that I am innocent of the blood of all men.
verses.textEnNlt: I declare today that I have been faithful. If anyone suffers eternal death, it’s not my fault,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, I testify to you this day that I am innocent of the blood of all people.
verses.textEn: Therefore, I declare to you today that I am innocent of the blood of any of you.

verses.textZh: 因为神的全部计划，我已经毫无保留地传给你们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神的全部计划，我已经毫无保留地传给你们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神的旨意，我并没有一样避讳不传给你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: For I have not hesitated to proclaim to you the whole will of God.
verses.textEnEsv: for I did not shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have not shunned to declare to you the whole counsel of God.
verses.textEnNlt: for I didn’t shrink from declaring all that God wants you to know.
verses.textEnNasb: For I did not shrink from declaring to you the whole purpose of God.
verses.textEn: For I have not hesitated to proclaim to you the whole will of God.

verses.textZh: 圣灵既然立你们为全群的监督，牧养神用自己的血所赎来的教会，你们就应当为自己谨慎，也为全群谨慎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵既然立你们为全群的监督，牧养神用自己的血所赎来的教会，你们就应当为自己谨慎，也为全群谨慎。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵立你们作全群的监督，你们就当为自己谨慎，也为全群谨慎，牧养神的教会，就是他用自己血所买来的 。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep watch over yourselves and all the flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which he bought with his own blood.
verses.textEnEsv: Pay careful attention to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to care for the church of God, which he obtained with his own blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore take heed to yourselves and to all the flock, among which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the church of God which He purchased with His own blood.
verses.textEnNlt: "So guard yourselves and God’s people. Feed and shepherd God’s flock—his church, purchased with his own blood —over which the Holy Spirit has appointed you as leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: Be on guard for yourselves and for all the flock, among which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the church of God which He purchased with His own blood.
verses.textEn: Keep watch over yourselves and all the flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which he bought with his own blood.

verses.textZh: 我知道在我离开之后，必有凶暴的豺狼进入你们中间，不顾惜羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我知道在我离开之后，必有凶暴的豺狼进入你们中间，不顾惜羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 我知道，我去之后必有凶暴的豺狼进入你们中间，不爱惜羊群。
verses.textEnNiv: I know that after I leave, savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock.
verses.textEnEsv: I know that after my departure fierce wolves will come in among you, not sparing the flock;
verses.textEnNkjv: For I know this, that after my departure savage wolves will come in among you, not sparing the flock.
verses.textEnNlt: I know that false teachers, like vicious wolves, will come in among you after I leave, not sparing the flock.
verses.textEnNasb: I know that after my departure savage wolves will come in among you, not sparing the flock;
verses.textEn: I know that after I leave, savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock.

verses.textZh: 你们自己中间也必有人起来，讲些歪曲悖谬的话，引诱门徒跟从他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们自己中间也必有人起来，讲些歪曲悖谬的话，引诱门徒跟从他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是你们中间，也必有人起来说悖谬的话，要引诱门徒跟从他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Even from your own number men will arise and distort the truth in order to draw away disciples after them.
verses.textEnEsv: and from among your own selves will arise men speaking twisted things, to draw away the disciples after them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also from among yourselves men will rise up, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: Even some men from your own group will rise up and distort the truth in order to draw a following.
verses.textEnNasb: and from among your own selves men will arise, speaking perverse things to draw away the disciples after them.
verses.textEn: Even from your own number men will arise and distort the truth in order to draw away disciples after them.

verses.textZh: 所以你们应当警醒，记念我三年之久，昼夜不停地带着眼泪劝戒你们各人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们应当警醒，记念我三年之久，昼夜不停地带着眼泪劝戒你们各人。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们应当警醒，记念我三年之久昼夜不住地流泪、劝戒你们各人。
verses.textEnNiv: So be on your guard! Remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore be alert, remembering that for three years I did not cease night or day to admonish every one with tears.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore watch, and remember that for three years I did not cease to warn everyone night and day with tears.
verses.textEnNlt: Watch out! Remember the three years I was with you—my constant watch and care over you night and day, and my many tears for you.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, be on the alert, remembering that night and day for a period of three years I did not cease to admonish each one with tears.
verses.textEn: So be on your guard! Remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears.

verses.textZh: 现在我把你们交托给神和他恩惠的道；这道能建立你们，也能在所有成圣的人中赐基业给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我把你们交托给神和他恩惠的道；这道能建立你们，也能在所有成圣的人中赐基业给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今我把你们交托神和他恩惠的道；这道能建立你们，叫你们和一切成圣的人同得基业。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now I commit you to God and to the word of his grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
verses.textEnEsv: And now I commend you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So now, brethren, I commend you to God and to the word of His grace, which is able to build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now I entrust you to God and the message of his grace that is able to build you up and give you an inheritance with all those he has set apart for himself.
verses.textEnNasb: And now I entrust you to God and to the word of His grace, which is able to build you up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.
verses.textEn: "Now I commit you to God and to the word of his grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

verses.textZh: 我从来没有贪图任何人的金银或衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从来没有贪图任何人的金银或衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 我未曾贪图一个人的金、银、衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.
verses.textEnEsv: I coveted no one’s silver or gold or apparel.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have coveted no one’s silver or gold or apparel.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have never coveted anyone’s silver or gold or fine clothes.
verses.textEnNasb: I have coveted no one’s silver or gold or clothes.
verses.textEn: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.

verses.textZh: 我这两只手，供应了我和同伴的需要，这是你们自己知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这两只手，供应了我和同伴的需要，这是你们自己知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我这两只手常供给我和同人的需用，这是你们自己知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have supplied my own needs and the needs of my companions.
verses.textEnEsv: You yourselves know that these hands ministered to my necessities and to those who were with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, you yourselves know that these hands have provided for my necessities, and for those who were with me.
verses.textEnNlt: You know that these hands of mine have worked to supply my own needs and even the needs of those who were with me.
verses.textEnNasb: You yourselves know that these hands served my own needs and the men who were with me.
verses.textEn: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have supplied my own needs and the needs of my companions.

verses.textZh: 我凡事以身作则，你们必须照样辛劳，扶助软弱的人，并且记念主耶稣的话：‘施比受更为有福。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我凡事以身作则，你们必须照样辛劳，扶助软弱的人，并且记念主耶稣的话：‘施比受更为有福。’"
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我凡事给你们作榜样，叫你们知道应当这样劳苦，扶助软弱的人，又当记念主耶稣的话，说：『施比受更为有福。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: In everything I did, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words the Lord Jesus himself said: <red>‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: In all things I have shown you that by working hard in this way we must help the weak and remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: I have shown you in every way, by laboring like this, that you must support the weak. And remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that He said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And I have been a constant example of how you can help those in need by working hard. You should remember the words of the Lord Jesus: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’"
verses.textEnNasb: In everything I showed you that by working hard in this way you must help the weak and remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that He Himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ "
verses.textEn: In everything I did, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words the Lord Jesus himself said: <red>‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 他说了这些话，就跪下来同大家一起祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说了这些话，就跪下来同大家一起祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗说完了这话，就跪下同众人祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: When Paul had finished speaking, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had said these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he had said these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
verses.textEnNlt: When he had finished speaking, he knelt and prayed with them.
verses.textEnNasb: When he had said these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.
verses.textEn: When Paul had finished speaking, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.

verses.textZh: 众人都痛哭，抱着保罗，与他亲吻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人都痛哭，抱着保罗，与他亲吻。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人痛哭，抱着保罗的颈项，和他亲嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: They all wept as they embraced him and kissed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was much weeping on the part of all; they embraced Paul and kissed him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,
verses.textEnNlt: They all cried as they embraced and kissed him good-bye.
verses.textEnNasb: And they all began to weep aloud and embraced Paul, and repeatedly kissed him,
verses.textEn: They all wept as they embraced him and kissed him.

verses.textZh: 他们最伤心的，是保罗说他们不会再见他的面那句话。最后他们送他上了船。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们最伤心的，是保罗说他们不会再见他的面那句话。最后他们送他上了船。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫他们最伤心的，就是他说「以后不能再见我的面」那句话，于是送他上船去了。
verses.textEnNiv: What grieved them most was his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
verses.textEnEsv: being sorrowful most of all because of the word he had spoken, that they would not see his face again. And they accompanied him to the ship.
verses.textEnNkjv: sorrowing most of all for the words which he spoke, that they would see his face no more. And they accompanied him to the ship.
verses.textEnNlt: They were sad most of all because he had said that they would never see him again. Then they escorted him down to the ship.
verses.textEnNasb: grieving especially over the word which he had spoken, that they would not see his face again. And they were accompanying him to the ship.
verses.textEn: What grieved them most was his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

verses.textZh: 我们离别了他们以后，船就直航到了哥士，第二天到罗底，从那里开往帕大拉；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们离别了他们以后，船就直航到了哥士，第二天到罗底，从那里开往帕大拉；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们离别了众人，就开船一直行到哥士。第二天到了罗底，从那里到帕大喇，
verses.textEnNiv: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we put out to sea and sailed straight to Kos. The next day we went to Rhodes and from there to Patara.
verses.textEnEsv: And when we had parted from them and set sail, we came by a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, that when we had departed from them and set sail, running a straight course we came to Cos, the following day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
verses.textEnNlt: After saying farewell to the Ephesian elders, we sailed straight to the island of Cos. The next day we reached Rhodes and then went to Patara.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when we had parted from them and had set sail, we ran a straight course to Cos, and on the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara;
verses.textEn: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we put out to sea and sailed straight to Kos. The next day we went to Rhodes and from there to Patara.

verses.textZh: 遇见了一艘开往腓尼基的船，就上船起行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 遇见了一艘开往腓尼基的船，就上船起行。
verses.textZhCuv: 遇见一只船要往腓尼基去，就上船起行。
verses.textEnNiv: We found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, went on board and set sail.
verses.textEnEsv: And having found a ship crossing to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
verses.textEnNkjv: And finding a ship sailing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
verses.textEnNlt: There we boarded a ship sailing for Phoenicia.
verses.textEnNasb: and having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.
verses.textEn: We found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, went on board and set sail.

verses.textZh: 我们远远看见塞浦路斯，就从南边驶过，直航叙利亚，在推罗靠了岸，因为船要在那里卸货。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们远远看见塞浦路斯，就从南边驶过，直航叙利亚，在推罗靠了岸，因为船要在那里卸货。
verses.textZhCuv: 望见塞浦路斯，就从南边行过，往叙利亚去，我们就在泰尔上岸，因为船要在那里卸货。
verses.textEnNiv: After sighting Cyprus and passing to the south of it, we sailed on to Syria. We landed at Tyre, where our ship was to unload its cargo.
verses.textEnEsv: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for there the ship was to unload its cargo.
verses.textEnNkjv: When we had sighted Cyprus, we passed it on the left, sailed to Syria, and landed at Tyre; for there the ship was to unload her cargo.
verses.textEnNlt: We sighted the island of Cyprus, passed it on our left, and landed at the harbor of Tyre, in Syria, where the ship was to unload its cargo.
verses.textEnNasb: When we came in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left, we kept sailing to Syria and landed at Tyre; for the ship was to unload its cargo there.
verses.textEn: After sighting Cyprus and passing to the south of it, we sailed on to Syria. We landed at Tyre, where our ship was to unload its cargo.

verses.textZh: 我们找到了一些门徒，就在那里住了七天。他们凭着圣灵的指示告诉保罗不要上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们找到了一些门徒，就在那里住了七天。他们凭着圣灵的指示告诉保罗不要上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCuv: 找着了门徒，就在那里住了七天。他们被圣灵感动，对保罗说：「不要上耶路撒冷去。」
verses.textEnNiv: We sought out the disciples there and stayed with them seven days. Through the Spirit they urged Paul not to go on to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And having sought out the disciples, we stayed there for seven days. And through the Spirit they were telling Paul not to go on to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And finding disciples, we stayed there seven days. They told Paul through the Spirit not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: We went ashore, found the local believers, and stayed with them a week. These believers prophesied through the Holy Spirit that Paul should not go on to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: After looking up the disciples, we stayed there for seven days; and they kept telling Paul, through the Spirit, not to set foot in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: We sought out the disciples there and stayed with them seven days. Through the Spirit they urged Paul not to go on to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 过了这几天，我们就启程前行，他们众人带着妻子儿女送我们到城外。我们跪在海滩上祷告，
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了这几天，我们就启程前行，他们众人带着妻子儿女送我们到城外。我们跪在海滩上祷告，
verses.textZhCuv: 过了这几天，我们就起身前行。他们众人同妻子儿女，送我们到城外，我们都跪在岸上祷告，彼此辞别。
verses.textEnNiv: When it was time to leave, we left and continued on our way. All of them, including wives and children, accompanied us out of the city, and there on the beach we knelt to pray.
verses.textEnEsv: When our days there were ended, we departed and went on our journey, and they all, with wives and children, accompanied us until we were outside the city. And kneeling down on the beach, we prayed
verses.textEnNkjv: When we had come to the end of those days, we departed and went on our way; and they all accompanied us, with wives and children, till wewere out of the city. And we knelt down on the shore and prayed.
verses.textEnNlt: When we returned to the ship at the end of the week, the entire congregation, including women and children, left the city and came down to the shore with us. There we knelt, prayed,
verses.textEnNasb: When our days there were ended, we left and started on our journey, while they all, with wives and children, escorted us until we were out of the city. After kneeling down on the beach and praying, we said farewell to one another.
verses.textEn: When it was time to leave, we left and continued on our way. All of them, including wives and children, accompanied us out of the city, and there on the beach we knelt to pray.

verses.textZh: 互相道别。我们上了船，他们就回家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 互相道别。我们上了船，他们就回家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们上了船，他们就回家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: After saying goodbye to each other, we went aboard the ship, and they returned home.
verses.textEnEsv: and said farewell to one another. Then we went on board the ship, and they returned home.
verses.textEnNkjv: When we had taken our leave of one another, we boarded the ship, and they returned home.
verses.textEnNlt: and said our farewells. Then we went aboard, and they returned home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then we boarded the ship, and they returned home.
verses.textEn: After saying goodbye to each other, we went aboard the ship, and they returned home.

verses.textZh: 我们从推罗继续航行，到了多利买，问候那里的弟兄，与他们同住了一天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们从推罗继续航行，到了多利买，问候那里的弟兄，与他们同住了一天。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们从泰尔行尽了水路，来到多利买，就问那里的弟兄安，和他们同住了一天。
verses.textEnNiv: We continued our voyage from Tyre and landed at Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and sisters and stayed with them for a day.
verses.textEnEsv: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais, and we greeted the brothers and stayed with them for one day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when we had finished our voyage from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, greeted the brethren, and stayed with them one day.
verses.textEnNlt: The next stop after leaving Tyre was Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and sisters and stayed for one day.
verses.textEnNasb: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais, and after greeting the brothers and sisters, we stayed with them for a day.
verses.textEn: We continued our voyage from Tyre and landed at Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and sisters and stayed with them for a day.

verses.textZh: 第二天我们离开那里，来到该撒利亚，到了传福音的腓利家里，与他住在一起。他是那七位执事中的一位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天我们离开那里，来到该撒利亚，到了传福音的腓利家里，与他住在一起。他是那七位执事中的一位。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，我们离开那里，来到凯撒利亚，就进了传福音的腓利家里，和他同住。他是那七个执事里的一个。
verses.textEnNiv: Leaving the next day, we reached Caesarea and stayed at the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven.
verses.textEnEsv: On the next day we departed and came to Caesarea, and we entered the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the next day we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea, and entered the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day we went on to Caesarea and stayed at the home of Philip the Evangelist, one of the seven men who had been chosen to distribute food.
verses.textEnNasb: On the next day we left and came to Caesarea, and we entered the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
verses.textEn: Leaving the next day, we reached Caesarea and stayed at the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven.

verses.textZh: 他有四个女儿，都是童女，是会说预言的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他有四个女儿，都是童女，是会说预言的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他有四个女儿，都是处女，是说预言的。
verses.textEnNiv: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.
verses.textEnEsv: He had four unmarried daughters, who prophesied.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
verses.textEnNlt: He had four unmarried daughters who had the gift of prophecy.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this man had four virgin daughters who were prophetesses.
verses.textEn: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.

verses.textZh: 我们住了几天之后，有一位先知，名叫亚迦布，从犹太下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们住了几天之后，有一位先知，名叫亚迦布，从犹太下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在那里多住了几天，有一个先知，名叫亚迦布，从犹太下来，
verses.textEnNiv: After we had been there a number of days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
verses.textEnEsv: While we were staying for many days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as we stayed many days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
verses.textEnNlt: Several days later a man named Agabus, who also had the gift of prophecy, arrived from Judea.
verses.textEnNasb: As we were staying there for some days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
verses.textEn: After we had been there a number of days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

verses.textZh: 他来见我们，把保罗的腰带拿过来，绑住自己的手脚，说："圣灵说，犹太人在耶路撒冷要这样捆绑这腰带的主人，把他交在外族人的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他来见我们，把保罗的腰带拿过来，绑住自己的手脚，说："圣灵说，犹太人在耶路撒冷要这样捆绑这腰带的主人，把他交在外族人的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了我们这里，就拿保罗的腰带捆上自己的手脚，说：「圣灵说：犹太人在耶路撒冷，要如此捆绑这腰带的主人，把他交在外邦人手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Coming over to us, he took Paul’s belt, tied his own hands and feet with it and said, "The Holy Spirit says, ‘In this way the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and will hand him over to the Gentiles.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And coming to us, he took Paul’s belt and bound his own feet and hands and said, "Thus says the Holy Spirit, ‘This is how the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt and deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: When he had come to us, he took Paul’s belt, bound his own hands and feet, and said, "Thus says the Holy Spirit, ‘So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man who owns this belt, and deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: He came over, took Paul’s belt, and bound his own feet and hands with it. Then he said, "The Holy Spirit declares, ‘So shall the owner of this belt be bound by the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem and turned over to the Gentiles.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And he came to us and took Paul’s belt and bound his own feet and hands, and said, "This is what the Holy Spirit says: ‘In this way the Jews in Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt and hand him over to the Gentiles.’ "
verses.textEn: Coming over to us, he took Paul’s belt, tied his own hands and feet with it and said, "The Holy Spirit says, ‘In this way the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and will hand him over to the Gentiles.’ "

verses.textZh: 我们听了这些话，就和当地的人劝保罗不要去耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们听了这些话，就和当地的人劝保罗不要去耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们和那本地的人听见这话，都苦劝保罗不要上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textEnNiv: When we heard this, we and the people there pleaded with Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: When we heard this, we and the people there urged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when we heard these things, both we and those from that place pleaded with him not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: When we heard this, we and the local believers all begged Paul not to go on to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: When we had heard this, we as well as the local residents began begging him not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: When we heard this, we and the people there pleaded with Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 保罗却回答："你们为甚么哭，使我心碎呢？我为主耶稣的名，不但被捆绑，就算死在耶路撒冷我也都准备好了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗却回答："你们为甚么哭，使我心碎呢？我为主耶稣的名，不但被捆绑，就算死在耶路撒冷我也都准备好了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗说：「你们为什么这样痛哭，使我心碎呢？我为主耶稣的名，不但被人捆绑，就是死在耶路撒冷也是愿意的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Paul answered, "Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Paul answered, "What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be imprisoned but even to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul answered, "What do you mean by weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus."
verses.textEnNlt: But he said, "Why all this weeping? You are breaking my heart! I am ready not only to be jailed at Jerusalem but even to die for the sake of the Lord Jesus."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Paul replied, "What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but even to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus."
verses.textEn: Then Paul answered, "Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus."

verses.textZh: 他既然不听劝，我们只说了"愿主的旨意成就"，就不出声了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他既然不听劝，我们只说了"愿主的旨意成就"，就不出声了。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗既不听劝，我们便住了口，只说：「愿主的旨意成就」，便了。
verses.textEnNiv: When he would not be dissuaded, we gave up and said, "The Lord’s will be done."
verses.textEnEsv: And since he would not be persuaded, we ceased and said, "Let the will of the Lord be done."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, "The will of the Lord be done."
verses.textEnNlt: When it was clear that we couldn’t persuade him, we gave up and said, "The Lord’s will be done."
verses.textEnNasb: And since he would not be persuaded, we became quiet, remarking, "The will of the Lord be done!"
verses.textEn: When he would not be dissuaded, we gave up and said, "The Lord’s will be done."

verses.textZh: 过了几天，我们收拾行装，上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了几天，我们收拾行装，上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了几日，我们收拾行李上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textEnNiv: After this, we started on our way up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: After these days we got ready and went up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after those days we packed and went up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: After this we packed our things and left for Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: After these days we got ready and started on our way up to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: After this, we started on our way up to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 有该撒利亚的几个门徒同我们在一起，领我们到一个塞浦路斯人拿孙家里住宿；他作了门徒已经很久了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有该撒利亚的几个门徒同我们在一起，领我们到一个塞浦路斯人拿孙家里住宿；他作了门徒已经很久了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有凯撒利亚的几个门徒和我们同去，带我们到一个久为 门徒的家里，叫我们与他同住；他名叫拿孙，是塞浦路斯人。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us and brought us to the home of Mnason, where we were to stay. He was a man from Cyprus and one of the early disciples.
verses.textEnEsv: And some of the disciples from Caesarea went with us, bringing us to the house of Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we should lodge.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also some of the disciples from Caesarea went with us and brought with them a certain Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we were to lodge.
verses.textEnNlt: Some believers from Caesarea accompanied us, and they took us to the home of Mnason, a man originally from Cyprus and one of the early believers.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also came with us, taking us to Mnason of Cyprus, a disciple of long standing with whom we were to stay.
verses.textEn: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us and brought us to the home of Mnason, where we were to stay. He was a man from Cyprus and one of the early disciples.

verses.textZh: 我们到了耶路撒冷，弟兄们欢欢喜喜接待我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们到了耶路撒冷，弟兄们欢欢喜喜接待我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了耶路撒冷，弟兄们欢欢喜喜地接待我们。
verses.textEnNiv: When we arrived at Jerusalem, the brothers and sisters received us warmly.
verses.textEnEsv: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when we had come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
verses.textEnNlt: When we arrived, the brothers and sisters in Jerusalem welcomed us warmly.
verses.textEnNasb: After we arrived in Jerusalem, the brothers and sisters received us gladly.
verses.textEn: When we arrived at Jerusalem, the brothers and sisters received us warmly.

verses.textZh: 第二天，保罗和我们一同去见雅各，长老们也都在座。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，保罗和我们一同去见雅各，长老们也都在座。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，保罗同我们去见雅各；长老们也都在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day Paul and the rest of us went to see James, and all the elders were present.
verses.textEnEsv: On the following day Paul went in with us to James, and all the elders were present.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the following day Paul went in with us to James, and all the elders were present.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day Paul went with us to meet with James, and all the elders of the Jerusalem church were present.
verses.textEnNasb: And the following day Paul went in with us to James, and all the elders were present.
verses.textEn: The next day Paul and the rest of us went to see James, and all the elders were present.

verses.textZh: 保罗问候了他们，就把神借着他的工作在外族人中所行的事，一一述说出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗问候了他们，就把神借着他的工作在外族人中所行的事，一一述说出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗问了他们安，便将神用他传教，在外邦人中间所行之事，一一地述说了。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul greeted them and reported in detail what God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.
verses.textEnEsv: After greeting them, he related one by one the things that God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he had greeted them, he told in detail those things which God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.
verses.textEnNlt: After greeting them, Paul gave a detailed account of the things God had accomplished among the Gentiles through his ministry.
verses.textEnNasb: After he had greeted them, he began to relate one by one the things which God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.
verses.textEn: Paul greeted them and reported in detail what God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.

verses.textZh: 他们听了，就赞美神，对保罗说："弟兄，你看，犹太人中信主的有好几万，都是对律法很热心的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听了，就赞美神，对保罗说："弟兄，你看，犹太人中信主的有好几万，都是对律法很热心的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们听见，就归荣耀与神，对保罗说：「兄台，你看犹太人中信主的有多少万，并且都为律法热心。
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard this, they praised God. Then they said to Paul: "You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they heard it, they glorified God. And they said to him, "You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed. They are all zealous for the law,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord. And they said to him, "You see, brother, how many myriads of Jews there are who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law;
verses.textEnNlt: After hearing this, they praised God. And then they said, "You know, dear brother, how many thousands of Jews have also believed, and they all follow the law of Moses very seriously.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they heard about them, they began glorifying God; and they said to him, "You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the Law;
verses.textEn: When they heard this, they praised God. Then they said to Paul: "You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law.

verses.textZh: 他们听说，你教导所有在外族人中的犹太人背弃摩西，叫他们不要给孩子行割礼，也不要遵守规例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听说，你教导所有在外族人中的犹太人背弃摩西，叫他们不要给孩子行割礼，也不要遵守规例。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们听见人说，你教训一切在外邦的犹太人离弃摩西，对他们说，不要给孩子行割礼，也不要遵行条规。
verses.textEnNiv: They have been informed that you teach all the Jews who live among the Gentiles to turn away from Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or live according to our customs.
verses.textEnEsv: and they have been told about you that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or walk according to our customs.
verses.textEnNkjv: but they have been informed about you that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children nor to walk according to the customs.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Jewish believers here in Jerusalem have been told that you are teaching all the Jews who live among the Gentiles to turn their backs on the laws of Moses. They’ve heard that you teach them not to circumcise their children or follow other Jewish customs.
verses.textEnNasb: and they have been told about you, that you are teaching all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to abandon Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children nor to walk according to the customs.
verses.textEn: They have been informed that you teach all the Jews who live among the Gentiles to turn away from Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or live according to our customs.

verses.textZh: 他们总会听见你来了，那怎么办呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们总会听见你来了，那怎么办呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 众人必听见你来了，这可怎么办呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What shall we do? They will certainly hear that you have come,
verses.textEnEsv: What then is to be done? They will certainly hear that you have come.
verses.textEnNkjv: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.
verses.textEnNlt: What should we do? They will certainly hear that you have come.
verses.textEnNasb: So what is to be done? They will certainly hear that you have come.
verses.textEn: What shall we do? They will certainly hear that you have come,

verses.textZh: 你就照我们的话作吧，我们这里有四个人，都有愿在身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就照我们的话作吧，我们这里有四个人，都有愿在身。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就照着我们的话行吧！我们这里有四个人，都有愿在身。
verses.textEnNiv: so do what we tell you. There are four men with us who have made a vow.
verses.textEnEsv: Do therefore what we tell you. We have four men who are under a vow;
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do what we tell you: We have four men who have taken a vow.
verses.textEnNlt: "Here’s what we want you to do. We have four men here who have completed their vow.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, do as we tell you: we have four men who have a vow upon themselves;
verses.textEn: so do what we tell you. There are four men with us who have made a vow.

verses.textZh: 你把他们带去，和他们一同行洁净礼，并且替他们付钱，让他们剃去头发，这样大家就知道以前所听见关于你的事，都不是真实的，也知道你是遵守律法循规蹈矩而行的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把他们带去，和他们一同行洁净礼，并且替他们付钱，让他们剃去头发，这样大家就知道以前所听见关于你的事，都不是真实的，也知道你是遵守律法循规蹈矩而行的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你带他们去，与他们一同行洁净的礼，替他们拿出规费，叫他们得以剃头。这样，众人就可知道，先前所听见你的事都是虚的；并可知道，你自己为人，循规蹈矩，遵行律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Take these men, join in their purification rites and pay their expenses, so that they can have their heads shaved. Then everyone will know there is no truth in these reports about you, but that you yourself are living in obedience to the law.
verses.textEnEsv: take these men and purify yourself along with them and pay their expenses, so that they may shave their heads. Thus all will know that there is nothing in what they have been told about you, but that you yourself also live in observance of the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take them and be purified with them, and pay their expenses so that they may shave their heads, and that all may know that those things of which they were informed concerning you are nothing, but that you yourself also walk orderly and keep the law.
verses.textEnNlt: Go with them to the Temple and join them in the purification ceremony, paying for them to have their heads ritually shaved. Then everyone will know that the rumors are all false and that you yourself observe the Jewish laws.
verses.textEnNasb: take them along and purify yourself together with them, and pay their expenses so that they may shave their heads; and then everyone will know that there is nothing to what they have been told about you, but that you yourself also conform, keeping the Law.
verses.textEn: Take these men, join in their purification rites and pay their expenses, so that they can have their heads shaved. Then everyone will know there is no truth in these reports about you, but that you yourself are living in obedience to the law.

verses.textZh: 至于信主的外族人，我们已经写了信，吩咐他们要禁戒祭偶像的食物、血、勒死的牲畜和淫乱。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于信主的外族人，我们已经写了信，吩咐他们要禁戒祭偶像的食物、血、勒死的牲畜和淫乱。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于信主的外邦人，我们已经写信拟定，叫他们谨忌那祭偶像之物，和血，并勒死的牲畜，与奸淫。」
verses.textEnNiv: As for the Gentile believers, we have written to them our decision that they should abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals and from sexual immorality."
verses.textEnEsv: But as for the Gentiles who have believed, we have sent a letter with our judgment that they should abstain from what has been sacrificed to idols, and from blood, and from what has been strangled, and from sexual immorality."
verses.textEnNkjv: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written and decided that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from things offered to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality."
verses.textEnNlt: "As for the Gentile believers, they should do what we already told them in a letter: They should abstain from eating food offered to idols, from consuming blood or the meat of strangled animals, and from sexual immorality."
verses.textEnNasb: But regarding the Gentiles who have believed, we sent a letter, having decided that they should abstain from meat sacrificed to idols and from blood and what is strangled, and from sexual immorality."
verses.textEn: As for the Gentile believers, we have written to them our decision that they should abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals and from sexual immorality."

verses.textZh: 保罗就把那几个人带走了，第二天和他们一同行了洁净礼。他们进了殿，报明了他们洁净期满的日子，以及各人献祭的时间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗就把那几个人带走了，第二天和他们一同行了洁净礼。他们进了殿，报明了他们洁净期满的日子，以及各人献祭的时间。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是保罗带着那四个人，第二天与他们一同行了洁净的礼，进了殿，报明洁净的日期满足，只等祭司为他们各人献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day Paul took the men and purified himself along with them. Then he went to the temple to give notice of the date when the days of purification would end and the offering would be made for each of them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Paul took the men, and the next day he purified himself along with them and went into the temple, giving notice when the days of purification would be fulfilled and the offering presented for each one of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul took the men, and the next day, having been purified with them, entered the temple to announce the expiration of the days of purification, at which time an offering should be made for each one of them.
verses.textEnNlt: So Paul went to the Temple the next day with the other men. They had already started the purification ritual, so he publicly announced the date when their vows would end and sacrifices would be offered for each of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Paul took along the men, and the next day, after purifying himself together with them, he went into the temple giving notice of the completion of the days of purification, until the sacrifice was offered for each one of them.
verses.textEn: The next day Paul took the men and purified himself along with them. Then he went to the temple to give notice of the date when the days of purification would end and the offering would be made for each of them.

verses.textZh: 七日将完的时候，从亚西亚来的犹太人看见保罗在殿里，就煽动群众，并且捉住他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 七日将完的时候，从亚西亚来的犹太人看见保罗在殿里，就煽动群众，并且捉住他，
verses.textZhCuv: 那七日将完，从亚细亚来的犹太人看见保罗在殿里，就耸动了众人，下手拿他，
verses.textEnNiv: When the seven days were nearly over, some Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul at the temple. They stirred up the whole crowd and seized him,
verses.textEnEsv: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, seeing him in the temple, stirred up the whole crowd and laid hands on him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews from Asia, seeing him in the temple, stirred up the whole crowd and laid hands on him,
verses.textEnNlt: The seven days were almost ended when some Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul in the Temple and roused a mob against him. They grabbed him,
verses.textEnNasb: When the seven days were almost over, the Jews from Asia, upon seeing him in the temple, began to stir up all the crowd and laid hands on him,
verses.textEn: When the seven days were nearly over, some Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul at the temple. They stirred up the whole crowd and seized him,

verses.textZh: 喊叫着说："以色列人哪，快来帮忙！这个人到处教导众人反对人民，反对律法和这个地方，他甚至把希腊人也带进殿里，污秽了这圣地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 喊叫着说："以色列人哪，快来帮忙！这个人到处教导众人反对人民，反对律法和这个地方，他甚至把希腊人也带进殿里，污秽了这圣地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 喊叫说：「以色列人来帮助，这就是在各处教训众人糟践我们百姓和律法，并这地方的。他又带着希腊人进殿，污秽了这圣地。」（
verses.textEnNiv: shouting, "Fellow Israelites, help us! This is the man who teaches everyone everywhere against our people and our law and this place. And besides, he has brought Greeks into the temple and defiled this holy place."
verses.textEnEsv: crying out, "Men of Israel, help! This is the man who is teaching everyone everywhere against the people and the law and this place. Moreover, he even brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place."
verses.textEnNkjv: crying out, "Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, the law, and this place; and furthermore he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place."
verses.textEnNlt: yelling, "Men of Israel, help us! This is the man who preaches against our people everywhere and tells everybody to disobey the Jewish laws. He speaks against the Temple—and even defiles this holy place by bringing in Gentiles. "
verses.textEnNasb: crying out, "Men of Israel, help! This is the man who instructs everyone everywhere against our people and the Law and this place; and besides, he has even brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!"
verses.textEn: shouting, "Fellow Israelites, help us! This is the man who teaches everyone everywhere against our people and our law and this place. And besides, he has brought Greeks into the temple and defiled this holy place."

verses.textZh: 原来他们看见过以弗所人特罗非摩同保罗在城里，就以为保罗带他进了殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来他们看见过以弗所人特罗非摩同保罗在城里，就以为保罗带他进了殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 这话是因他们曾看见以弗所人特罗非摩同保罗在城里，以为保罗带他进了殿。）
verses.textEnNiv: (They had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian in the city with Paul and assumed that Paul had brought him into the temple.)
verses.textEnEsv: For they had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: (For they had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
verses.textEnNlt: (For earlier that day they had seen him in the city with Trophimus, a Gentile from Ephesus, and they assumed Paul had taken him into the Temple.)
verses.textEnNasb: For they had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian in the city with him, and they thought that Paul had brought him into the temple.
verses.textEn: (They had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian in the city with Paul and assumed that Paul had brought him into the temple.)

verses.textZh: 于是全城震动，民众一齐跑来，捉住保罗，拉出殿外，殿门就立刻关起来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是全城震动，民众一齐跑来，捉住保罗，拉出殿外，殿门就立刻关起来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 合城都震动，百姓一齐跑来，拿住保罗，拉他出殿，殿门立刻都关了。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole city was aroused, and the people came running from all directions. Seizing Paul, they dragged him from the temple, and immediately the gates were shut.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the city was stirred up, and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple, and at once the gates were shut.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the city was disturbed; and the people ran together, seized Paul, and dragged him out of the temple; and immediately the doors were shut.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole city was rocked by these accusations, and a great riot followed. Paul was grabbed and dragged out of the Temple, and immediately the gates were closed behind him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the whole city was provoked and the people rushed together, and taking hold of Paul they dragged him out of the temple, and immediately the doors were shut.
verses.textEn: The whole city was aroused, and the people came running from all directions. Seizing Paul, they dragged him from the temple, and immediately the gates were shut.

verses.textZh: 他们正想杀他的时候，有人报告营部的千夫长，说："整个耶路撒冷都乱了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们正想杀他的时候，有人报告营部的千夫长，说："整个耶路撒冷都乱了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们正想要杀他，有人报信给营里的千夫长说：「耶路撒冷合城都乱了。」
verses.textEnNiv: While they were trying to kill him, news reached the commander of the Roman troops that the whole city of Jerusalem was in an uproar.
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were seeking to kill him, word came to the tribune of the cohort that all Jerusalem was in confusion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as they were seeking to kill him, news came to the commander of the garrison that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
verses.textEnNlt: As they were trying to kill him, word reached the commander of the Roman regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
verses.textEnNasb: While they were intent on killing him, a report came up to the commander of the Roman cohort that all Jerusalem was in confusion.
verses.textEn: While they were trying to kill him, news reached the commander of the Roman troops that the whole city of Jerusalem was in an uproar.

verses.textZh: 千夫长立刻带着一些百夫长和士兵跑到他们那里。众人一看见千夫长和士兵，就停止殴打保罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 千夫长立刻带着一些百夫长和士兵跑到他们那里。众人一看见千夫长和士兵，就停止殴打保罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 千夫长立时带着兵丁和几个百夫长，跑下去到他们那里。他们见了千夫长和兵丁，就止住不打保罗。
verses.textEnNiv: He at once took some officers and soldiers and ran down to the crowd. When the rioters saw the commander and his soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
verses.textEnEsv: He at once took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. And when they saw the tribune and the soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
verses.textEnNkjv: He immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down to them. And when they saw the commander and the soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
verses.textEnNlt: He immediately called out his soldiers and officers and ran down among the crowd. When the mob saw the commander and the troops coming, they stopped beating Paul.
verses.textEnNasb: He immediately took along some soldiers and centurions and ran down to the crowd; and when they saw the commander and the soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
verses.textEn: He at once took some officers and soldiers and ran down to the crowd. When the rioters saw the commander and his soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.

verses.textZh: 于是千夫长上前捉住保罗，吩咐人用两条铁链捆住他，问他是甚么人，作过甚么事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是千夫长上前捉住保罗，吩咐人用两条铁链捆住他，问他是甚么人，作过甚么事。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是千夫长上前拿住他，吩咐用两条铁链捆锁；又问他是什么人，做的是什么事。
verses.textEnNiv: The commander came up and arrested him and ordered him to be bound with two chains. Then he asked who he was and what he had done.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the tribune came up and arrested him and ordered him to be bound with two chains. He inquired who he was and what he had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the commander came near and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and he asked who he was and what he had done.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the commander arrested him and ordered him bound with two chains. He asked the crowd who he was and what he had done.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the commander came up and took hold of him, and ordered that he be bound with two chains; and he began asking who he was and what he had done.
verses.textEn: The commander came up and arrested him and ordered him to be bound with two chains. Then he asked who he was and what he had done.

verses.textZh: 那时众人叫这个喊那个，吵吵闹闹，以致千夫长没有办法知道真相，只好下令把保罗带到营楼去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时众人叫这个喊那个，吵吵闹闹，以致千夫长没有办法知道真相，只好下令把保罗带到营楼去。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人有喊叫这个的，有喊叫那个的；千夫长因为这样乱嚷，得不着实情，就吩咐人将保罗带进营楼去。
verses.textEnNiv: Some in the crowd shouted one thing and some another, and since the commander could not get at the truth because of the uproar, he ordered that Paul be taken into the barracks.
verses.textEnEsv: Some in the crowd were shouting one thing, some another. And as he could not learn the facts because of the uproar, he ordered him to be brought into the barracks.
verses.textEnNkjv: And some among the multitude cried one thing and some another. So when he could not ascertain the truth because of the tumult, he commanded him to be taken into the barracks.
verses.textEnNlt: Some shouted one thing and some another. Since he couldn’t find out the truth in all the uproar and confusion, he ordered that Paul be taken to the fortress.
verses.textEnNasb: But among the crowd, some were shouting one thing and some another, and when he could not find out the facts because of the uproar, he ordered that Paul be brought into the barracks.
verses.textEn: Some in the crowd shouted one thing and some another, and since the commander could not get at the truth because of the uproar, he ordered that Paul be taken into the barracks.

verses.textZh: 保罗到了台阶下面的时候，士兵把他抬起来，因为群众猛挤，
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗到了台阶下面的时候，士兵把他抬起来，因为群众猛挤，
verses.textZhCuv: 到了台阶上，众人挤得凶猛，兵丁只得将保罗抬起来。
verses.textEnNiv: When Paul reached the steps, the violence of the mob was so great he had to be carried by the soldiers.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he came to the steps, he was actually carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd,
verses.textEnNkjv: When he reached the stairs, he had to be carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the mob.
verses.textEnNlt: As Paul reached the stairs, the mob grew so violent the soldiers had to lift him to their shoulders to protect him.
verses.textEnNasb: When Paul got to the stairs, it came about that he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the mob;
verses.textEn: When Paul reached the steps, the violence of the mob was so great he had to be carried by the soldiers.

verses.textZh: 而且有一群人跟在后面叫喊："干掉他！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且有一群人跟在后面叫喊："干掉他！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人跟在后面，喊着说：「除掉他！」
verses.textEnNiv: The crowd that followed kept shouting, "Get rid of him!"
verses.textEnEsv: for the mob of the people followed, crying out, "Away with him!"
verses.textEnNkjv: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, "Away with him!"
verses.textEnNlt: And the crowd followed behind, shouting, "Kill him, kill him!"
verses.textEnNasb: for the multitude of people kept following them, shouting, "Away with him!"
verses.textEn: The crowd that followed kept shouting, "Get rid of him!"

verses.textZh: 他们带着保罗快到营楼的时候，保罗对千夫长说："我可以跟你讲一句话吗？"千夫长说："你懂希腊话吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们带着保罗快到营楼的时候，保罗对千夫长说："我可以跟你讲一句话吗？"千夫长说："你懂希腊话吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 将要带他进营楼，保罗对千夫长说：「我对你说句话可以不可以？」他说：「你懂得希腊话吗？
verses.textEnNiv: As the soldiers were about to take Paul into the barracks, he asked the commander, "May I say something to you?" "Do you speak Greek?" he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he said to the tribune, "May I say something to you?" And he said, "Do you know Greek?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then as Paul was about to be led into the barracks, he said to the commander, "May I speak to you?" He replied, "Can you speak Greek?
verses.textEnNlt: As Paul was about to be taken inside, he said to the commander, "May I have a word with you?" "Do you know Greek?" the commander asked, surprised.
verses.textEnNasb: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he *said to the commander, "May I say something to you?" And he said, "Do you know Greek?
verses.textEn: As the soldiers were about to take Paul into the barracks, he asked the commander, "May I say something to you?" "Do you speak Greek?" he replied.

verses.textZh: 难道你不就是不久以前作乱的、带领四千个杀手到旷野去的那个埃及人吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道你不就是不久以前作乱的、带领四千个杀手到旷野去的那个埃及人吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你莫非是从前作乱、带领四千凶徒往旷野去的那埃及人吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Aren’t you the Egyptian who started a revolt and led four thousand terrorists out into the wilderness some time ago?"
verses.textEnEsv: Are you not the Egyptian, then, who recently stirred up a revolt and led the four thousand men of the Assassins out into the wilderness?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Are you not the Egyptian who some time ago stirred up a rebellion and led the four thousand assassins out into the wilderness?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Aren’t you the Egyptian who led a rebellion some time ago and took 4,000 members of the Assassins out into the desert?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then you are not the Egyptian who some time ago stirred up a revolt and led the four thousand men of the Assassins out into the wilderness?"
verses.textEn: "Aren’t you the Egyptian who started a revolt and led four thousand terrorists out into the wilderness some time ago?"

verses.textZh: 保罗说："我是犹太人，是基利家的大数人，并不是无名小城的公民，求你准我向民众讲几句话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗说："我是犹太人，是基利家的大数人，并不是无名小城的公民，求你准我向民众讲几句话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗说：「我本是犹太人，生在基利家的大数，并不是无名小城的人。求你准我对百姓说话。」
verses.textEnNiv: Paul answered, "I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. Please let me speak to the people."
verses.textEnEsv: Paul replied, "I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no obscure city. I beg you, permit me to speak to the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Paul said, "I am a Jew from Tarsus, in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city; and I implore you, permit me to speak to the people."
verses.textEnNlt: "No," Paul replied, "I am a Jew and a citizen of Tarsus in Cilicia, which is an important city. Please, let me talk to these people."
verses.textEnNasb: But Paul said, "I am a Jew of Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city; and I beg you, allow me to speak to the people."
verses.textEn: Paul answered, "I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. Please let me speak to the people."

verses.textZh: 千夫长准许了他，保罗就站在台阶上，向民众作了一个手势。大家安静下来了，保罗就用希伯来语讲话，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 千夫长准许了他，保罗就站在台阶上，向民众作了一个手势。大家安静下来了，保罗就用希伯来语讲话，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 千夫长准了。保罗就站在台阶上，向百姓摆手，他们都静默无声，保罗便用希伯来话对他们说：
verses.textEnNiv: After receiving the commander’s permission, Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the crowd. When they were all silent, he said to them in Aramaic :
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the steps, motioned with his hand to the people. And when there was a great hush, he addressed them in the Hebrew language, saying:
verses.textEnNkjv: So when he had given him permission, Paul stood on the stairs and motioned with his hand to the people. And when there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The commander agreed, so Paul stood on the stairs and motioned to the people to be quiet. Soon a deep silence enveloped the crowd, and he addressed them in their own language, Aramaic.
verses.textEnNasb: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, motioned to the people with his hand; and when there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew dialect, saying,
verses.textEn: After receiving the commander’s permission, Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the crowd. When they were all silent, he said to them in Aramaic :

verses.textZh: "各位父老弟兄，请听听我现在对你们的申辩。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "各位父老弟兄，请听听我现在对你们的申辩。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「诸位父兄请听，我现在对你们分诉。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense."
verses.textEnEsv: "Brothers and fathers, hear the defense that I now make before you."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Brethren and fathers, hear my defense before you now."
verses.textEnNlt: "Brothers and esteemed fathers," Paul said, "listen to me as I offer my defense."
verses.textEnNasb: " Brothers and fathers, hear my defense which I now offer to you."
verses.textEn: "Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense."

verses.textZh: 他们听见保罗用希伯来语说话，就更加安静了。保罗说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们听见保罗用希伯来语说话，就更加安静了。保罗说：
verses.textZhCuv: 众人听他说的是希伯来话，就更加安静了。
verses.textEnNiv: When they heard him speak to them in Aramaic, they became very quiet. Then Paul said:
verses.textEnEsv: And when they heard that he was addressing them in the Hebrew language, they became even more quiet. And he said:
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they kept all the more silent. Then he said:
verses.textEnNlt: When they heard him speaking in their own language, the silence was even greater.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they heard that he was addressing them in the Hebrew dialect, they became even more quiet; and he *said,
verses.textEn: When they heard him speak to them in Aramaic, they became very quiet. Then Paul said:

verses.textZh: "我是犹太人，生在基利家的大数，在城里长大，按照我们祖宗律法的严格要求，在迦玛列门下受教，我为神热心，好象你们大家今天一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我是犹太人，生在基利家的大数，在城里长大，按照我们祖宗律法的严格要求，在迦玛列门下受教，我为神热心，好象你们大家今天一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗说：「我原是犹太人，生在基利家的大数，长在这城里，在迦玛列门下，按着我们祖宗严紧的律法受教，热心事奉神，像你们众人今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city. I studied under Gamaliel and was thoroughly trained in the law of our ancestors. I was just as zealous for God as any of you are today.
verses.textEnEsv: "I am a Jew, born in Tarsus in Cilicia, but brought up in this city, educated at the feet of Gamaliel according to the strict manner of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God as all of you are this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, taught according to the strictness of our fathers’ law, and was zealous toward God as you all are today.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Paul said, "I am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, and I was brought up and educated here in Jerusalem under Gamaliel. As his student, I was carefully trained in our Jewish laws and customs. I became very zealous to honor God in everything I did, just like all of you today.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city, educated under Gamaliel, strictly according to the Law of our fathers, being zealous for God just as you all are today.
verses.textEn: "I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city. I studied under Gamaliel and was thoroughly trained in the law of our ancestors. I was just as zealous for God as any of you are today.

verses.textZh: 我曾经迫害信奉这道的人直至死地，把男男女女都捆绑起来，送进监狱，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾经迫害信奉这道的人直至死地，把男男女女都捆绑起来，送进监狱，
verses.textZhCuv: 我也曾逼迫奉这道的人，直到死地，无论男女都锁拿下监。
verses.textEnNiv: I persecuted the followers of this Way to their death, arresting both men and women and throwing them into prison,
