verses.textEnEsv: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering to prison both men and women,
verses.textEnNkjv: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,
verses.textEnNlt: And I persecuted the followers of the Way, hounding some to death, arresting both men and women and throwing them in prison.
verses.textEnNasb: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and putting both men and women into prisons,
verses.textEn: I persecuted the followers of this Way to their death, arresting both men and women and throwing them into prison,

verses.textZh: 这是大祭司和全公议会都可以给我作证的。我也从他们那里得到了写给众弟兄的信，就去大马士革，要把那里的人捆绑起来，带到耶路撒冷接受惩罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是大祭司和全公议会都可以给我作证的。我也从他们那里得到了写给众弟兄的信，就去大马士革，要把那里的人捆绑起来，带到耶路撒冷接受惩罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是大祭司和众长老都可以给我作见证的。我又领了他们达与弟兄的书信，往大马士革去，要把在那里奉这道的人锁拿，带到耶路撒冷受刑。」
verses.textEnNiv: as the high priest and all the Council can themselves testify. I even obtained letters from them to their associates in Damascus, and went there to bring these people as prisoners to Jerusalem to be punished.
verses.textEnEsv: as the high priest and the whole council of elders can bear me witness. From them I received letters to the brothers, and I journeyed toward Damascus to take those also who were there and bring them in bonds to Jerusalem to be punished.
verses.textEnNkjv: as also the high priest bears me witness, and all the council of the elders, from whom I also received letters to the brethren, and went to Damascus to bring in chains even those who were there to Jerusalem to be punished.
verses.textEnNlt: The high priest and the whole council of elders can testify that this is so. For I received letters from them to our Jewish brothers in Damascus, authorizing me to bring the followers of the Way from there to Jerusalem, in chains, to be punished.
verses.textEnNasb: as also the high priest and all the Council of the elders can testify. From them I also received letters to the brothers, and started off for Damascus in order to bring even those who were there to Jerusalem as prisoners to be punished.
verses.textEn: as the high priest and all the Council can themselves testify. I even obtained letters from them to their associates in Damascus, and went there to bring these people as prisoners to Jerusalem to be punished.

verses.textZh: "约在正午，当我走近大马士革的时候，忽然有大光从天上向我四面照射，
verses.textZhCnvs: "约在正午，当我走近大马士革的时候，忽然有大光从天上向我四面照射，
verses.textZhCuv: 「我将到大马士革，正走的时候，约在晌午，忽然从天上发大光，四面照着我。
verses.textEnNiv: "About noon as I came near Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me.
verses.textEnEsv: "As I was on my way and drew near to Damascus, about noon a great light from heaven suddenly shone around me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now it happened, as I journeyed and came near Damascus at about noon, suddenly a great light from heaven shone around me.
verses.textEnNlt: "As I was on the road, approaching Damascus about noon, a very bright light from heaven suddenly shone down around me.
verses.textEnNasb: "But it happened that as I was on my way, approaching Damascus at about noon, a very bright light suddenly flashed from heaven all around me,
verses.textEn: "About noon as I came near Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me.

verses.textZh: <red>我仆倒在地上，听见有声音对我说：‘扫罗，扫罗，你为甚么迫害我？’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我仆倒在地上，听见有声音对我说：‘扫罗，扫罗，你为甚么迫害我？’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我就仆倒在地，听见有声音对我说：『扫罗！扫罗！你为什么逼迫我？』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: I fell to the ground and heard a voice say to me, <red>‘Saul! Saul! Why do you persecute me?’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
verses.textEnNkjv: And I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?’
verses.textEnNlt: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
verses.textEnNasb: and I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?’
verses.textEn: I fell to the ground and heard a voice say to me, <red>‘Saul! Saul! Why do you persecute me?’</red>

verses.textZh: <red>我回答：‘主啊，你是谁？’他说：‘我就是你所迫害的拿撒勒人耶稣。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我回答：‘主啊，你是谁？’他说：‘我就是你所迫害的拿撒勒人耶稣。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我回答说：『主啊，你是谁？』他说：『我就是你所逼迫的拿撒勒人耶稣。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: “ ‘Who are you, Lord?’ I asked. <red>“‘Ip am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting,’</red> he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ And he said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting.’
verses.textEnNkjv: So I answered, ‘Who are You, Lord?’ And He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting.’
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Who are you, lord?’ I asked. "And the voice replied, ‘I am Jesus the Nazarene, the one you are persecuting.’
verses.textEnNasb: And I answered, ‘Who are You, Lord?’ And He said to me, ‘I am Jesus the Nazarene, whom you are persecuting.’
verses.textEn: “ ‘Who are you, Lord?’ I asked. <red>“‘Ip am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting,’</red> he replied.

verses.textZh: 跟我在一起的人，只看见那光，却听不清楚那位对我说话的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟我在一起的人，只看见那光，却听不清楚那位对我说话的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 与我同行的人看见了那光，却没有听明那位对我说话的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: My companions saw the light, but they did not understand the voice of him who was speaking to me.
verses.textEnEsv: Now those who were with me saw the light but did not understand the voice of the one who was speaking to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they did not hear the voice of Him who spoke to me.
verses.textEnNlt: The people with me saw the light but didn’t understand the voice speaking to me.
verses.textEnNasb: And those who were with me saw the light, but did not understand the voice of the One who was speaking to me.
verses.textEn: My companions saw the light, but they did not understand the voice of him who was speaking to me.

verses.textZh: <red>我说：‘主啊，我应当作甚么呢？’主说：‘起来，进大马士革去，在那里有人会把指定给你作的一切事告诉你。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>我说：‘主啊，我应当作甚么呢？’主说：‘起来，进大马士革去，在那里有人会把指定给你作的一切事告诉你。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>我说：『主啊，我当做什么？』主说：『起来，进大马士革去，在那里，要将所派你做的一切事告诉你。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: “ ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ I asked. <red>“‘Getp up,’</red> the Lord said, <red>‘and go into Damascus. There you will be told all that you have been assigned to do.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ And the Lord said to me, ‘Rise, and go into Damascus, and there you will be told all that is appointed for you to do.’
verses.textEnNkjv: So I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ And the Lord said to me, ‘Arise and go into Damascus, and there you will be told all things which are appointed for you to do.’
verses.textEnNlt: "I asked, ‘What should I do, Lord?’ "And the Lord told me, ‘Get up and go into Damascus, and there you will be told everything you are to do.’
verses.textEnNasb: And I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ And the Lord said to me, ‘Get up and go on into Damascus, and there you will be told about everything that has been appointed for you to do.’
verses.textEn: “ ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ I asked. <red>“‘Getp up,’</red> the Lord said, <red>‘and go into Damascus. There you will be told all that you have been assigned to do.’</red>

verses.textZh: 因为那光太强烈，我的眼睛就瞎了，跟我在一起的人就牵着我的手，进了大马士革。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那光太强烈，我的眼睛就瞎了，跟我在一起的人就牵着我的手，进了大马士革。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因那光的荣耀不能看见，同行的人就拉着我手进了大马士革。
verses.textEnNiv: My companions led me by the hand into Damascus, because the brilliance of the light had blinded me.
verses.textEnEsv: And since I could not see because of the brightness of that light, I was led by the hand by those who were with me, and came into Damascus.
verses.textEnNkjv: And since I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.
verses.textEnNlt: "I was blinded by the intense light and had to be led by the hand to Damascus by my companions.
verses.textEnNasb: But since I could not see because of the brightness of that light, I came into Damascus being led by the hand by those who were with me.
verses.textEn: My companions led me by the hand into Damascus, because the brilliance of the light had blinded me.

verses.textZh: "有一个人名叫亚拿尼亚的，他是一个虔诚而遵守律法的人，当地所有的犹太人都称赞他。
verses.textZhCnvs: "有一个人名叫亚拿尼亚的，他是一个虔诚而遵守律法的人，当地所有的犹太人都称赞他。
verses.textZhCuv: 那里有一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，按着律法是虔诚人，为一切住在那里的犹太人所称赞。
verses.textEnNiv: "A man named Ananias came to see me. He was a devout observer of the law and highly respected by all the Jews living there.
verses.textEnEsv: "And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well spoken of by all the Jews who lived there,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then a certain Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good testimony with all the Jews who dwelt there,
verses.textEnNlt: A man named Ananias lived there. He was a godly man, deeply devoted to the law, and well regarded by all the Jews of Damascus.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now a certain Ananias, a man who was devout by the standard of the Law and well spoken of by all the Jews who lived there,
verses.textEn: "A man named Ananias came to see me. He was a devout observer of the law and highly respected by all the Jews living there.

verses.textZh: 他来见我，站在我旁边，对我说：‘扫罗弟兄，你现在可以看见了。’我立刻往上一看，看见了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他来见我，站在我旁边，对我说：‘扫罗弟兄，你现在可以看见了。’我立刻往上一看，看见了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他来见我，站在旁边，对我说：『兄弟扫罗，你可以看见。』我当时往上一看，就看见了他。
verses.textEnNiv: He stood beside me and said, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ And at that very moment I was able to see him.
verses.textEnEsv: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight.’ And at that very hour I received my sight and saw him.
verses.textEnNkjv: came to me; and he stood and said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight.’ And at that same hour I looked up at him.
verses.textEnNlt: He came and stood beside me and said, ‘Brother Saul, regain your sight.’ And that very moment I could see him!
verses.textEnNasb: came to me, and standing nearby he said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ And at that very moment I looked up at him.
verses.textEn: He stood beside me and said, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ And at that very moment I was able to see him.

verses.textZh: 他又说：‘我们祖先的神选派了你，让你明白他的旨意，看见那义者，听见他口中的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又说：‘我们祖先的神选派了你，让你明白他的旨意，看见那义者，听见他口中的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又说：『我们祖宗的神拣选了你，叫你明白他的旨意，又得见那义者，听他口中所出的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then he said: ‘The God of our ancestors has chosen you to know his will and to see the Righteous One and to hear words from his mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, ‘The God of our fathers appointed you to know his will, to see the Righteous One and to hear a voice from his mouth;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, ‘The God of our fathers has chosen you that you should know His will, and see the Just One, and hear the voice of His mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then he told me, ‘The God of our ancestors has chosen you to know his will and to see the Righteous One and hear him speak.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know His will and to see the Righteous One and to hear a message from His mouth.
verses.textEn: "Then he said: ‘The God of our ancestors has chosen you to know his will and to see the Righteous One and to hear words from his mouth.

verses.textZh: 因为你要把所看见所听见的，向万人为他作见证。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你要把所看见所听见的，向万人为他作见证。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你要将所看见的，所听见的，对着万人为他作见证。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be his witness to all people of what you have seen and heard.
verses.textEnEsv: for you will be a witness for him to everyone of what you have seen and heard.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you will be His witness to all men of what you have seen and heard.
verses.textEnNlt: For you are to be his witness, telling everyone what you have seen and heard.
verses.textEnNasb: For you will be a witness for Him to all people of what you have seen and heard.
verses.textEn: You will be his witness to all people of what you have seen and heard.

verses.textZh: 现在你为甚么还耽搁呢？起来受洗，求告他的名，洗净你的罪吧。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你为甚么还耽搁呢？起来受洗，求告他的名，洗净你的罪吧。’
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你为什么耽延呢？起来，求告他的名受洗，洗去你的罪。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And now what are you waiting for? Get up, be baptized and wash your sins away, calling on his name.’
verses.textEnEsv: And now why do you wait? Rise and be baptized and wash away your sins, calling on his name.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And now why are you waiting? Arise and be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’
verses.textEnNlt: What are you waiting for? Get up and be baptized. Have your sins washed away by calling on the name of the Lord.’
verses.textEnNasb: Now why do you delay? Get up and be baptized, and wash away your sins by calling on His name.’
verses.textEn: And now what are you waiting for? Get up, be baptized and wash your sins away, calling on his name.’

verses.textZh: "后来，我回到耶路撒冷，在殿里祷告的时候，魂游象外，
verses.textZhCnvs: "后来，我回到耶路撒冷，在殿里祷告的时候，魂游象外，
verses.textZhCuv: 「后来，我回到耶路撒冷，在殿里祷告的时候，魂游象外，
verses.textEnNiv: "When I returned to Jerusalem and was praying at the temple, I fell into a trance
verses.textEnEsv: "When I had returned to Jerusalem and was praying in the temple, I fell into a trance
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now it happened, when I returned to Jerusalem and was praying in the temple, that I was in a trance
verses.textEnNlt: "After I returned to Jerusalem, I was praying in the Temple and fell into a trance.
verses.textEnNasb: "It happened when I returned to Jerusalem and was praying in the temple, that I fell into a trance,
verses.textEn: "When I returned to Jerusalem and was praying at the temple, I fell into a trance

verses.textZh: <red>看见主对我说：‘你要快快离开耶路撒冷，因为你为我作的见证，他们是不会接受的。’</red>
verses.textZhCnvs: <red>看见主对我说：‘你要快快离开耶路撒冷，因为你为我作的见证，他们是不会接受的。’</red>
verses.textZhCuv: <red>看见主向我说：『你赶紧地离开耶路撒冷，不可迟延；因你为我作的见证，这里的人必不领受。』</red>
verses.textEnNiv: and saw the Lord speaking to me. <red>‘Quick!’</red> he said. <red>‘Leave Jerusalem immediately, because the people here will not accept your testimony about me.’</red>
verses.textEnEsv: and saw him saying to me, ‘Make haste and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not accept your testimony about me.’
verses.textEnNkjv: and saw Him saying to me, ‘Make haste and get out of Jerusalem quickly, for they will not receive your testimony concerning Me.’
verses.textEnNlt: I saw a vision of Jesus saying to me, ‘Hurry! Leave Jerusalem, for the people here won’t accept your testimony about me.’
verses.textEnNasb: and I saw Him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not accept your testimony about Me.’
verses.textEn: and saw the Lord speaking to me. <red>‘Quick!’</red> he said. <red>‘Leave Jerusalem immediately, because the people here will not accept your testimony about me.’</red>

verses.textZh: 我说：‘主啊，他们知道我曾把信你的人监禁起来，又在各会堂拷打他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说：‘主啊，他们知道我曾把信你的人监禁起来，又在各会堂拷打他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 我就说：『主啊，他们知道我从前把信你的人收在监里，又在各会堂里鞭打他们。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Lord,’ I replied, ‘these people know that I went from one synagogue to another to imprison and beat those who believe in you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that in one synagogue after another I imprisoned and beat those who believed in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I said, ‘Lord, they know that in every synagogue I imprisoned and beat those who believe on You.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘But Lord,’ I argued, ‘they certainly know that in every synagogue I imprisoned and beat those who believed in you.
verses.textEnNasb: And I said, ‘Lord, they themselves understand that in one synagogue after another I used to imprison and beat those who believed in You.
verses.textEn: " ‘Lord,’ I replied, ‘these people know that I went from one synagogue to another to imprison and beat those who believe in you.

verses.textZh: 并且你的见证人司提反受害流血的时候，我也亲自在场，表示同意，并且为杀他的人看守衣服。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且你的见证人司提反受害流血的时候，我也亲自在场，表示同意，并且为杀他的人看守衣服。’
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你的见证人司提反被害流血的时候，我也站在旁边欢喜；又看守害死他之人的衣裳。』
verses.textEnNiv: And when the blood of your martyr Stephen was shed, I stood there giving my approval and guarding the clothes of those who were killing him.’
verses.textEnEsv: And when the blood of Stephen your witness was being shed, I myself was standing by and approving and watching over the garments of those who killed him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the blood of Your martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by consenting to his death, and guarding the clothes of those who were killing him.’
verses.textEnNlt: And I was in complete agreement when your witness Stephen was killed. I stood by and kept the coats they took off when they stoned him.’
verses.textEnNasb: And when the blood of Your witness Stephen was being shed, I also was standing nearby and approving, and watching over the cloaks of those who were killing him.’
verses.textEn: And when the blood of your martyr Stephen was shed, I stood there giving my approval and guarding the clothes of those who were killing him.’

verses.textZh: 他对我说：‘你走吧，我要派你到远方的外族人那里去。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说：‘你走吧，我要派你到远方的外族人那里去。’"
verses.textZhCuv: <red>主向我说：『你去吧！我要差你远远地往外邦人那里去。』」</red>
verses.textEnNiv: “Then the Lord said to me, <red>‘Go; I will send you far away to the Gentiles.’”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, ‘Go, for I will send you far away to the Gentiles.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you far from here to the Gentiles.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "But the Lord said to me, ‘Go, for I will send you far away to the Gentiles!’"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to me, ‘Go! For I will send you far away to the Gentiles.’ "
verses.textEn: “Then the Lord said to me, <red>‘Go; I will send you far away to the Gentiles.’”</red>

verses.textZh: 众人听见他说到这句话，就高声说："这样的人应该从地上除掉，不应该活着！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人听见他说到这句话，就高声说："这样的人应该从地上除掉，不应该活着！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人听他说到这句话，就高声说：「这样的人，从世上除掉他吧！他是不当活着的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The crowd listened to Paul until he said this. Then they raised their voices and shouted, "Rid the earth of him! He’s not fit to live!"
verses.textEnEsv: Up to this word they listened to him. Then they raised their voices and said, "Away with such a fellow from the earth! For he should not be allowed to live."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they listened to him until this word, and then they raised their voices and said, "Away with such a fellow from the earth, for he is not fit to live!"
verses.textEnNlt: The crowd listened until Paul said that word. Then they all began to shout, "Away with such a fellow! He isn’t fit to live!"
verses.textEnNasb: They listened to him up to this statement, and then they raised their voices and said, "Away with such a man from the earth, for he should not be allowed to live!"
verses.textEn: The crowd listened to Paul until he said this. Then they raised their voices and shouted, "Rid the earth of him! He’s not fit to live!"

verses.textZh: 大家正在喊叫着，拋掷衣服，向空中扬灰撒土的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大家正在喊叫着，拋掷衣服，向空中扬灰撒土的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 众人喧嚷，摔掉衣裳，把尘土向空中扬起来。
verses.textEnNiv: As they were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and flinging dust into the air,
verses.textEnEsv: And as they were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and flinging dust into the air,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, as they cried out and tore off their clothes and threw dust into the air,
verses.textEnNlt: They yelled, threw off their coats, and tossed handfuls of dust into the air.
verses.textEnNasb: And as they were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and tossing dust into the air,
verses.textEn: As they were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and flinging dust into the air,

verses.textZh: 千夫长下令把保罗带到营楼去，吩咐人用鞭子拷问他，要知道群众为甚么这样向他喊叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 千夫长下令把保罗带到营楼去，吩咐人用鞭子拷问他，要知道群众为甚么这样向他喊叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 千夫长就吩咐将保罗带进营楼去，叫人用鞭子拷问他，要知道他们向他这样喧嚷是为什么缘故。
verses.textEnNiv: the commander ordered that Paul be taken into the barracks. He directed that he be flogged and interrogated in order to find out why the people were shouting at him like this.
verses.textEnEsv: the tribune ordered him to be brought into the barracks, saying that he should be examined by flogging, to find out why they were shouting against him like this.
verses.textEnNkjv: the commander ordered him to be brought into the barracks, and said that he should be examined under scourging, so that he might know why they shouted so against him.
verses.textEnNlt: The commander brought Paul inside and ordered him lashed with whips to make him confess his crime. He wanted to find out why the crowd had become so furious.
verses.textEnNasb: the commander ordered that he be brought into the barracks, saying that he was to be interrogated by flogging so that he would find out the reason why they were shouting against him that way.
verses.textEn: the commander ordered that Paul be taken into the barracks. He directed that he be flogged and interrogated in order to find out why the people were shouting at him like this.

verses.textZh: 士兵正用皮带绑他的时候，保罗对站在旁边的百夫长说："你们鞭打一个还没有定罪的罗马公民，是合法的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 士兵正用皮带绑他的时候，保罗对站在旁边的百夫长说："你们鞭打一个还没有定罪的罗马公民，是合法的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 刚用皮条捆上，保罗对旁边站着的百夫长说：「人是罗马人，又没有定罪，你们就鞭打他，有这个例吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: As they stretched him out to flog him, Paul said to the centurion standing there, "Is it legal for you to flog a Roman citizen who hasn’t even been found guilty?"
verses.textEnEsv: But when they had stretched him out for the whips, Paul said to the centurion who was standing by, "Is it lawful for you to flog a man who is a Roman citizen and uncondemned?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said to the centurion who stood by, "Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and uncondemned?"
verses.textEnNlt: When they tied Paul down to lash him, Paul said to the officer standing there, "Is it legal for you to whip a Roman citizen who hasn’t even been tried?"
verses.textEnNasb: But when they stretched him out with straps, Paul said to the centurion who was standing by, "Is it lawful for you to flog a man who is a Roman and uncondemned?"
verses.textEn: As they stretched him out to flog him, Paul said to the centurion standing there, "Is it legal for you to flog a Roman citizen who hasn’t even been found guilty?"

verses.textZh: 百夫长听了，就去报告千夫长，说："这个人是罗马公民，你要怎么办呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 百夫长听了，就去报告千夫长，说："这个人是罗马公民，你要怎么办呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 百夫长听见这话，就去见千夫长，告诉他说：「你要做什么？这人是罗马人。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the centurion heard this, he went to the commander and reported it. "What are you going to do?" he asked. "This man is a Roman citizen."
verses.textEnEsv: When the centurion heard this, he went to the tribune and said to him, "What are you about to do? For this man is a Roman citizen."
verses.textEnNkjv: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the commander, saying, "Take care what you do, for this man is a Roman."
verses.textEnNlt: When the officer heard this, he went to the commander and asked, "What are you doing? This man is a Roman citizen!"
verses.textEnNasb: When the centurion heard this, he went to the commander and told him, saying, "What are you about to do? For this man is a Roman."
verses.textEn: When the centurion heard this, he went to the commander and reported it. "What are you going to do?" he asked. "This man is a Roman citizen."

verses.textZh: 千夫长就来问保罗："告诉我，你是罗马公民吗？"他说："是的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 千夫长就来问保罗："告诉我，你是罗马公民吗？"他说："是的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 千夫长就来问保罗说：「你告诉我，你是罗马人吗？」保罗说：「是。」
verses.textEnNiv: The commander went to Paul and asked, "Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?" "Yes, I am," he answered.
verses.textEnEsv: So the tribune came and said to him, "Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?" And he said, "Yes."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the commander came and said to him, "Tell me, are you a Roman?" He said, "Yes."
verses.textEnNlt: So the commander went over and asked Paul, "Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?" "Yes, I certainly am," Paul replied.
verses.textEnNasb: The commander came and said to Paul, "Tell me, are you a Roman?" And he said, "Yes."
verses.textEn: The commander went to Paul and asked, "Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?" "Yes, I am," he answered.

verses.textZh: 千夫长说："我花了一大笔钱，才取得罗马籍。"保罗说："我生下来就是罗马公民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 千夫长说："我花了一大笔钱，才取得罗马籍。"保罗说："我生下来就是罗马公民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 千夫长说：「我用许多银子才入了罗马的民籍。」保罗说：「我生来就是。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the commander said, "I had to pay a lot of money for my citizenship." "But I was born a citizen," Paul replied.
verses.textEnEsv: The tribune answered, "I bought this citizenship for a large sum." Paul said, "But I am a citizen by birth."
verses.textEnNkjv: The commander answered, "With a large sum I obtained this citizenship." And Paul said, "But I was born acitizen."
verses.textEnNlt: "I am, too," the commander muttered, "and it cost me plenty!" Paul answered, "But I am a citizen by birth!"
verses.textEnNasb: The commander answered, "I acquired this citizenship for a large sum of money." And Paul said, "But I was actually born a citizen."
verses.textEn: Then the commander said, "I had to pay a lot of money for my citizenship." "But I was born a citizen," Paul replied.

verses.textZh: 于是那些要拷问他的人，立刻离开他走了。千夫长既知道他是罗马公民，又因捆绑过他，就害怕起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是那些要拷问他的人，立刻离开他走了。千夫长既知道他是罗马公民，又因捆绑过他，就害怕起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是那些要拷问保罗的人就离开他去了。千夫长既知道他是罗马人，又因为捆绑了他，也害怕了。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who were about to interrogate him withdrew immediately. The commander himself was alarmed when he realized that he had put Paul, a Roman citizen, in chains.
verses.textEnEsv: So those who were about to examine him withdrew from him immediately, and the tribune also was afraid, for he realized that Paul was a Roman citizen and that he had bound him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then immediately those who were about to examine him withdrew from him; and the commander was also afraid after he found out that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
verses.textEnNlt: The soldiers who were about to interrogate Paul quickly withdrew when they heard he was a Roman citizen, and the commander was frightened because he had ordered him bound and whipped.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, those who were about to interrogate him immediately backed away from him; and the commander also was afraid when he found out that he was a Roman, and because he had put him in chains.
verses.textEn: Those who were about to interrogate him withdrew immediately. The commander himself was alarmed when he realized that he had put Paul, a Roman citizen, in chains.

verses.textZh: 第二天，千夫长为要知道犹太人控告保罗的真相，就解开他，召集了祭司长和公议会全体在一起，把保罗带下来，叫他站在他们面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，千夫长为要知道犹太人控告保罗的真相，就解开他，召集了祭司长和公议会全体在一起，把保罗带下来，叫他站在他们面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，千夫长为要知道犹太人控告保罗的实情，便解开他，吩咐祭司长和全公会的人都聚集，将保罗带下来，叫他站在他们面前。
verses.textEnNiv: The commander wanted to find out exactly why Paul was being accused by the Jews. So the next day he released him and ordered the chief priests and all the members of the Sanhedrin to assemble. Then he brought Paul and had him stand before them.
verses.textEnEsv: But on the next day, desiring to know the real reason why he was being accused by the Jews, he unbound him and commanded the chief priests and all the council to meet, and he brought Paul down and set him before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The next day, because he wanted to know for certain why he was accused by the Jews, he released him from his bonds, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down and set him before them.
verses.textEnNlt: The next day the commander ordered the leading priests into session with the Jewish high council. He wanted to find out what the trouble was all about, so he released Paul to have him stand before them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now on the next day, wanting to know for certain why Paul had been accused by the Jews, he released him and ordered the chief priests and all the Council to assemble, and he brought Paul down and placed him before them.
verses.textEn: The commander wanted to find out exactly why Paul was being accused by the Jews. So the next day he released him and ordered the chief priests and all the members of the Sanhedrin to assemble. Then he brought Paul and had him stand before them.

verses.textZh: 保罗定睛看着公议会的各人，说："各位弟兄，我在神面前，行事为人一向都是凭着良心的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗定睛看着公议会的各人，说："各位弟兄，我在神面前，行事为人一向都是凭着良心的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗定睛看着公会的人，说：「弟兄们，我在神面前行事为人都是凭着良心，直到今日。」
verses.textEnNiv: Paul looked straight at the Sanhedrin and said, "My brothers, I have fulfilled my duty to God in all good conscience to this day."
verses.textEnEsv: And looking intently at the council, Paul said, "Brothers, I have lived my life before God in all good conscience up to this day."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul, looking earnestly at the council, said, "Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day."
verses.textEnNlt: Gazing intently at the high council, Paul began: "Brothers, I have always lived before God with a clear conscience!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now looking intently at the Council, Paul said, " Brothers, I have lived my life with an entirely good conscience before God up to this day."
verses.textEn: Paul looked straight at the Sanhedrin and said, "My brothers, I have fulfilled my duty to God in all good conscience to this day."

verses.textZh: 大祭司亚拿尼亚就吩咐站在他旁边的人打保罗的嘴巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大祭司亚拿尼亚就吩咐站在他旁边的人打保罗的嘴巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 大祭司亚拿尼亚就吩咐旁边站着的人打他的嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: At this the high priest Ananias ordered those standing near Paul to strike him on the mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: And the high priest Ananias commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the high priest Ananias commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: Instantly Ananias the high priest commanded those close to Paul to slap him on the mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: But the high priest Ananias commanded those standing beside him to strike him on the mouth.
verses.textEn: At this the high priest Ananias ordered those standing near Paul to strike him on the mouth.

verses.textZh: 保罗对他说："你这粉饰的墙啊，神要击打你！你坐堂要按着律法审问我，现在你竟然违背律法吩咐人打我吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗对他说："你这粉饰的墙啊，神要击打你！你坐堂要按着律法审问我，现在你竟然违背律法吩咐人打我吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗对他说：「你这粉饰的墙，神要打你！你坐堂为的是按律法审问我，你竟违背律法，吩咐人打我吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Paul said to him, "God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit there to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Paul said to him, "God is going to strike you, you whitewashed wall! Are you sitting to judge me according to the law, and yet contrary to the law you order me to be struck?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul said to him, "God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! For you sit to judge me according to the law, and do you command me to be struck contrary to the law?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Paul said to him, "God will slap you, you corrupt hypocrite! What kind of judge are you to break the law yourself by ordering me struck like that?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Paul said to him, "God is going to strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to try me according to the Law, and in violation of the Law, order me to be struck?"
verses.textEn: Then Paul said to him, "God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit there to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck!"

verses.textZh: 站在旁边的人民说："你敢辱骂神的大祭司吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 站在旁边的人民说："你敢辱骂神的大祭司吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 站在旁边的人说：「你辱骂神的大祭司吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Those who were standing near Paul said, "How dare you insult God’s high priest!"
verses.textEnEsv: Those who stood by said, "Would you revile God’s high priest?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And those who stood by said, "Do you revile God’s high priest?"
verses.textEnNlt: Those standing near Paul said to him, "Do you dare to insult God’s high priest?"
verses.textEnNasb: But those present said, "Are you insulting God’s high priest?"
verses.textEn: Those who were standing near Paul said, "How dare you insult God’s high priest!"

verses.textZh: 保罗说："弟兄们，我不知道他是大祭司。经上说：‘不可咒诅你人民的领袖。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗说："弟兄们，我不知道他是大祭司。经上说：‘不可咒诅你人民的领袖。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗说：「弟兄们，我不晓得他是大祭司；经上记着说：『不可毁谤你百姓的官长。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Paul replied, "Brothers, I did not realize that he was the high priest; for it is written: ‘Do not speak evil about the ruler of your people.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And Paul said, "I did not know, brothers, that he was the high priest, for it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul said, "I did not know, brethren, that he was the high priest; for it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "I’m sorry, brothers. I didn’t realize he was the high priest," Paul replied, "for the Scriptures say, ‘You must not speak evil of any of your rulers.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: And Paul said, "I was not aware, brothers, that he is high priest; for it is written: ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’ "
verses.textEn: Paul replied, "Brothers, I did not realize that he was the high priest; for it is written: ‘Do not speak evil about the ruler of your people.’ "

verses.textZh: 保罗看出其中一部分是撒都该人，另一部分是法利赛人，就在公议会中大声说："我是法利赛人，也是法利赛人的子孙，我现在受审，是为了盼望死人复活！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗看出其中一部分是撒都该人，另一部分是法利赛人，就在公议会中大声说："我是法利赛人，也是法利赛人的子孙，我现在受审，是为了盼望死人复活！"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗看出大众一半是撒都该人，一半是法利赛人，就在公会中大声说：「弟兄们，我是法利赛人，也是法利赛人的子孙。我现在受审问，是为盼望死人复活。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Paul, knowing that some of them were Sadducees and the others Pharisees, called out in the Sanhedrin, "My brothers, I am a Pharisee, descended from Pharisees. I stand on trial because of the hope of the resurrection of the dead."
verses.textEnEsv: Now when Paul perceived that one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, "Brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. It is with respect to the hope and the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial."
verses.textEnNkjv: But when Paul perceived that one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, "Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee; concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!"
verses.textEnNlt: Paul realized that some members of the high council were Sadducees and some were Pharisees, so he shouted, "Brothers, I am a Pharisee, as were my ancestors! And I am on trial because my hope is in the resurrection of the dead!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Paul, perceiving that one group were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, began crying out in the Council, " Brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees; I am on trial for the hope and resurrection of the dead!"
verses.textEn: Then Paul, knowing that some of them were Sadducees and the others Pharisees, called out in the Sanhedrin, "My brothers, I am a Pharisee, descended from Pharisees. I stand on trial because of the hope of the resurrection of the dead."

verses.textZh: 他说了这话，法利赛人和撒都该人就起了争论，会众也分裂了，成为两派。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说了这话，法利赛人和撒都该人就起了争论，会众也分裂了，成为两派。
verses.textZhCuv: 说了这话，法利赛人和撒都该人就争论起来，会众分为两党。
verses.textEnNiv: When he said this, a dispute broke out between the Pharisees and the Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had said this, a dissension arose between the Pharisees and the Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he had said this, a dissension arose between the Pharisees and the Sadducees; and the assembly was divided.
verses.textEnNlt: This divided the council—the Pharisees against the Sadducees—
verses.textEnNasb: When he said this, a dissension occurred between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.
verses.textEn: When he said this, a dispute broke out between the Pharisees and the Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.

verses.textZh: 原来撒都该人说没有复活，没有天使，也没有鬼灵，法利赛人却认定这些都有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来撒都该人说没有复活，没有天使，也没有鬼灵，法利赛人却认定这些都有。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为撒都该人说，没有复活，也没有天使和鬼魂；法利赛人却说，两样都有。
verses.textEnNiv: (The Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, and that there are neither angels nor spirits, but the Pharisees believe all these things.)
verses.textEnEsv: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit, but the Pharisees acknowledge them all.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Sadducees say that there is no resurrection—and no angel or spirit; but the Pharisees confess both.
verses.textEnNlt: for the Sadducees say there is no resurrection or angels or spirits, but the Pharisees believe in all of these.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor an angel, nor a spirit, but the Pharisees acknowledge them all.
verses.textEn: (The Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, and that there are neither angels nor spirits, but the Pharisees believe all these things.)

verses.textZh: 于是众人大嚷大闹，有几个法利赛派的经学家站起来辩论说："我们看不出这个人作过甚么坏事；说不定有灵或天使对他说过话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是众人大嚷大闹，有几个法利赛派的经学家站起来辩论说："我们看不出这个人作过甚么坏事；说不定有灵或天使对他说过话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大大地喧嚷起来。有几个法利赛党的文士站起来争辩说：「我们看不出这人有什么恶处，倘若有鬼魂或是天使对他说过话，怎么样呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: There was a great uproar, and some of the teachers of the law who were Pharisees stood up and argued vigorously. "We find nothing wrong with this man," they said. "What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then a great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ party stood up and contended sharply, "We find nothing wrong in this man. What if a spirit or an angel spoke to him?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then there arose a loud outcry. And the scribes of the Pharisees’ party arose and protested, saying, "We find no evil in this man; but if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him, let us not fight against God."
verses.textEnNlt: So there was a great uproar. Some of the teachers of religious law who were Pharisees jumped up and began to argue forcefully. "We see nothing wrong with him," they shouted. "Perhaps a spirit or an angel spoke to him."
verses.textEnNasb: And a great uproar occurred; and some of the scribes of the Pharisaic party stood up and started arguing heatedly, saying, "We find nothing wrong with this man; suppose a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?"
verses.textEn: There was a great uproar, and some of the teachers of the law who were Pharisees stood up and argued vigorously. "We find nothing wrong with this man," they said. "What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?"

verses.textZh: 争论越来越大，千夫长怕保罗被他们撕碎了，就吩咐士兵下去，把他从人群中抢救出来，带到营楼去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 争论越来越大，千夫长怕保罗被他们撕碎了，就吩咐士兵下去，把他从人群中抢救出来，带到营楼去。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时大起争吵，千夫长恐怕保罗被他们扯碎了，就吩咐兵丁下去，把他从众人当中抢出来，带进营楼去。
verses.textEnNiv: The dispute became so violent that the commander was afraid Paul would be torn to pieces by them. He ordered the troops to go down and take him away from them by force and bring him into the barracks.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the dissension became violent, the tribune, afraid that Paul would be torn to pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him away from among them by force and bring him into the barracks.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when there arose a great dissension, the commander, fearing lest Paul might be pulled to pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them, and bring him into the barracks.
verses.textEnNlt: As the conflict grew more violent, the commander was afraid they would tear Paul apart. So he ordered his soldiers to go and rescue him by force and take him back to the fortress.
verses.textEnNasb: And when a great dissension occurred, the commander was afraid that Paul would be torn to pieces by them, and he ordered the troops to go down and take him away from them by force, and bring him into the barracks.
verses.textEn: The dispute became so violent that the commander was afraid Paul would be torn to pieces by them. He ordered the troops to go down and take him away from them by force and bring him into the barracks.

verses.textZh: 当天晚上，主站在保罗身边，说："<red>你要壮起胆来，你怎样在耶路撒冷作见证，也必照样在罗马为我作见证。</red>"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当天晚上，主站在保罗身边，说："<red>你要壮起胆来，你怎样在耶路撒冷作见证，也必照样在罗马为我作见证。</red>"
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜，主站在保罗旁边，说：「<red>放心吧！你怎样在耶路撒冷为我作见证，也必怎样在罗马为我作见证。</red>」
verses.textEnNiv: The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, <red>“Take courage! As you have testified about me in Jerusalem, so you must also testify in Rome.”</red>
verses.textEnEsv: The following night the Lord stood by him and said, "Take courage, for as you have testified to the facts about me in Jerusalem, so you must testify also in Rome."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the following night the Lord stood by him and said, "Be of good cheer, Paul; for as you have testified for Me in Jerusalem, so you must also bear witness at Rome."
verses.textEnNlt: That night the Lord appeared to Paul and said, "Be encouraged, Paul. Just as you have been a witness to me here in Jerusalem, you must preach the Good News in Rome as well."
verses.textEnNasb: But on the following night, the Lord stood near him and said, "Be courageous! For as you have testified to the truth about Me in Jerusalem, so you must testify in Rome also."
verses.textEn: The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, <red>“Take courage! As you have testified about me in Jerusalem, so you must also testify in Rome.”</red>

verses.textZh: 到了天亮，犹太人在一起秘密计谋，并且发誓说，不杀保罗，就不吃不喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了天亮，犹太人在一起秘密计谋，并且发誓说，不杀保罗，就不吃不喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了天亮，犹太人同谋起誓，说：「若不先杀保罗就不吃不喝。」
verses.textEnNiv: The next morning some Jews formed a conspiracy and bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they had killed Paul.
verses.textEnEsv: When it was day, the Jews made a plot and bound themselves by an oath neither to eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under an oath, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning a group of Jews got together and bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they had killed Paul.
verses.textEnNasb: When it was day, the Jews formed a conspiracy and put themselves under an oath, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.
verses.textEn: The next morning some Jews formed a conspiracy and bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they had killed Paul.

verses.textZh: 一同策划这项阴谋的有四十多人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一同策划这项阴谋的有四十多人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样同心起誓的有四十多人。
verses.textEnNiv: More than forty men were involved in this plot.
verses.textEnEsv: There were more than forty who made this conspiracy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there were more than forty who had formed this conspiracy.
verses.textEnNlt: There were more than forty of them in the conspiracy.
verses.textEnNasb: There were more than forty who formed this plot.
verses.textEn: More than forty men were involved in this plot.

verses.textZh: 他们来见众祭司长和长老，说："我们已经发了誓，不杀保罗，就不吃东西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们来见众祭司长和长老，说："我们已经发了誓，不杀保罗，就不吃东西。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来见祭司长和长老，说：「我们已经起了一个大誓，若不先杀保罗就不吃什么。
verses.textEnNiv: They went to the chief priests and the elders and said, "We have taken a solemn oath not to eat anything until we have killed Paul.
verses.textEnEsv: They went to the chief priests and elders and said, "We have strictly bound ourselves by an oath to taste no food till we have killed Paul.
verses.textEnNkjv: They came to the chief priests and elders, and said, "We have bound ourselves under a great oath that we will eat nothing until we have killed Paul.
verses.textEnNlt: They went to the leading priests and elders and told them, "We have bound ourselves with an oath to eat nothing until we have killed Paul.
verses.textEnNasb: They came to the chief priests and the elders and said, "We have put ourselves under an oath to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.
verses.textEn: They went to the chief priests and the elders and said, "We have taken a solemn oath not to eat anything until we have killed Paul.

verses.textZh: 现在你们和公议会要通知千夫长，带保罗到你们这里来，装作要详细审查他。我们已经预备好了，不等他走近，就把他杀了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们和公议会要通知千夫长，带保罗到你们这里来，装作要详细审查他。我们已经预备好了，不等他走近，就把他杀了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们和公会要知会千夫长，叫他带下保罗到你们这里来，假作要详细察考他的事；我们已经预备好了，不等他来到跟前就杀他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him before you on the pretext of wanting more accurate information about his case. We are ready to kill him before he gets here."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore you, along with the council, give notice to the tribune to bring him down to you, as though you were going to determine his case more exactly. And we are ready to kill him before he comes near."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now you, therefore, together with the council, suggest to the commander that he be brought down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to make further inquiries concerning him; but we are ready to kill him before he comes near."
verses.textEnNlt: So you and the high council should ask the commander to bring Paul back to the council again. Pretend you want to examine his case more fully. We will kill him on the way."
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, you and the Council notify the commander to bring him down to you, as though you were going to investigate his case more thoroughly; and as for us, we are ready to kill him before he comes near the place."
verses.textEn: Now then, you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him before you on the pretext of wanting more accurate information about his case. We are ready to kill him before he gets here."

verses.textZh: 但保罗的外甥听见这项埋伏的诡计，就到营楼去，告诉保罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但保罗的外甥听见这项埋伏的诡计，就到营楼去，告诉保罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗的外甥听见他们设下埋伏，就来到营楼里告诉保罗。
verses.textEnNiv: But when the son of Paul’s sister heard of this plot, he went into the barracks and told Paul.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the son of Paul’s sister heard of their ambush, so he went and entered the barracks and told Paul.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Paul’s sister’s son heard of their ambush, he went and entered the barracks and told Paul.
verses.textEnNlt: But Paul’s nephew—his sister’s son—heard of their plan and went to the fortress and told Paul.
verses.textEnNasb: But the son of Paul’s sister heard about their ambush, and he came and entered the barracks and told Paul.
verses.textEn: But when the son of Paul’s sister heard of this plot, he went into the barracks and told Paul.

verses.textZh: 保罗请了一个百夫长来，说："请你带这个青年人去见千夫长，他有事要报告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗请了一个百夫长来，说："请你带这个青年人去见千夫长，他有事要报告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗请一个百夫长来，说：「你领这少年人去见千夫长，他有事告诉他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Paul called one of the centurions and said, "Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him."
verses.textEnEsv: Paul called one of the centurions and said, "Take this young man to the tribune, for he has something to tell him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul called one of the centurions to him and said, "Take this young man to the commander, for he has something to tell him."
verses.textEnNlt: Paul called for one of the Roman officers and said, "Take this young man to the commander. He has something important to tell him."
verses.textEnNasb: Paul called one of the centurions to himself and said, "Take this young man to the commander, for he has something to report to him."
verses.textEn: Then Paul called one of the centurions and said, "Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him."

verses.textZh: 百夫长就带保罗的外甥去见千夫长，说："囚犯保罗请了我去，求我带这个青年人来见你，他有事要向你报告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 百夫长就带保罗的外甥去见千夫长，说："囚犯保罗请了我去，求我带这个青年人来见你，他有事要向你报告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是把他领去见千夫长，说：「被囚的保罗请我到他那里，求我领这少年人来见你；他有事告诉你。」
verses.textEnNiv: So he took him to the commander. The centurion said, "Paul, the prisoner, sent for me and asked me to bring this young man to you because he has something to tell you."
verses.textEnEsv: So he took him and brought him to the tribune and said, "Paul the prisoner called me and asked me to bring this young man to you, as he has something to say to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he took him and brought him to the commander and said, "Paul the prisoner called me to him and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to say to you."
verses.textEnNlt: So the officer did, explaining, "Paul, the prisoner, called me over and asked me to bring this young man to you because he has something to tell you."
verses.textEnNasb: So he took him and led him to the commander and *said, "Paul the prisoner called me over to him and asked me to bring this young man to you because he has something to tell you."
verses.textEn: So he took him to the commander. The centurion said, "Paul, the prisoner, sent for me and asked me to bring this young man to you because he has something to tell you."

verses.textZh: 千夫长拉着他的手，走到一边，私下问他："你有甚么事要向我报告？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 千夫长拉着他的手，走到一边，私下问他："你有甚么事要向我报告？"
verses.textZhCuv: 千夫长就拉着他的手，走到一旁，私下问他说：「你有什么事告诉我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The commander took the young man by the hand, drew him aside and asked, "What is it you want to tell me?"
verses.textEnEsv: The tribune took him by the hand, and going aside asked him privately, "What is it that you have to tell me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the commander took him by the hand, went aside, and asked privately, "What is it that you have to tell me?"
verses.textEnNlt: The commander took his hand, led him aside, and asked, "What is it you want to tell me?"
verses.textEnNasb: The commander took him by the hand, and stepping aside, began to inquire of him privately, "What is it that you have to report to me?"
verses.textEn: The commander took the young man by the hand, drew him aside and asked, "What is it you want to tell me?"

verses.textZh: 他说："犹太人已经约好了，要求你明天把保罗带到公议会里去，装作要详细审查他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："犹太人已经约好了，要求你明天把保罗带到公议会里去，装作要详细审查他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「犹太人已经约定，要求你明天带下保罗到公会里去，假作要详细查问他的事。
verses.textEnNiv: He said: "Some Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul before the Sanhedrin tomorrow on the pretext of wanting more accurate information about him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though they were going to inquire somewhat more closely about him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "The Jews have agreed to ask that you bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though they were going to inquire more fully about him.
verses.textEnNlt: Paul’s nephew told him, "Some Jews are going to ask you to bring Paul before the high council tomorrow, pretending they want to get some more information.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down tomorrow to the Council, as though they were going to inquire somewhat more thoroughly about him.
verses.textEn: He said: "Some Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul before the Sanhedrin tomorrow on the pretext of wanting more accurate information about him.

verses.textZh: 你不要听他们，因为他们有四十多人正在埋伏起来等着保罗；他们发了誓，不杀保罗，就不吃不喝。现在他们已经准备好了，只等你答应。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要听他们，因为他们有四十多人正在埋伏起来等着保罗；他们发了誓，不杀保罗，就不吃不喝。现在他们已经准备好了，只等你答应。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你切不要随从他们；因为他们有四十多人埋伏，已经起誓说，若不先杀保罗就不吃不喝。现在预备好了，只等你应允。」
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t give in to them, because more than forty of them are waiting in ambush for him. They have taken an oath not to eat or drink until they have killed him. They are ready now, waiting for your consent to their request."
verses.textEnEsv: But do not be persuaded by them, for more than forty of their men are lying in ambush for him, who have bound themselves by an oath neither to eat nor drink till they have killed him. And now they are ready, waiting for your consent."
verses.textEnNkjv: But do not yield to them, for more than forty of them lie in wait for him, men who have bound themselves by an oath that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him; and now they are ready, waiting for the promise from you."
verses.textEnNlt: But don’t do it! There are more than forty men hiding along the way ready to ambush him. They have vowed not to eat or drink anything until they have killed him. They are ready now, just waiting for your consent."
verses.textEnNasb: So do not listen to them, for more than forty of them are in hiding to ambush him, and these men have put themselves under an oath not to eat or drink until they kill him; and now they are ready and waiting for assurance from you."
verses.textEn: Don’t give in to them, because more than forty of them are waiting in ambush for him. They have taken an oath not to eat or drink until they have killed him. They are ready now, waiting for your consent to their request."

verses.textZh: 千夫长嘱咐那青年人："不要告诉人你把这事告诉了我。"然后就打发他走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 千夫长嘱咐那青年人："不要告诉人你把这事告诉了我。"然后就打发他走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是千夫长打发少年人走，嘱咐他说：「不要告诉人你将这事报给我了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The commander dismissed the young man with this warning: "Don’t tell anyone that you have reported this to me."
verses.textEnEsv: So the tribune dismissed the young man, charging him, "Tell no one that you have informed me of these things."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the commander let the young man depart, and commanded him, "Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t let anyone know you told me this," the commander warned the young man.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the commander let the young man go, instructing him, "Tell no one that you have notified me of these things."
verses.textEn: The commander dismissed the young man with this warning: "Don’t tell anyone that you have reported this to me."

verses.textZh: 千夫长叫了两个百夫长来，说："预备两百个步兵，七十个骑兵、两百个长枪手，晚上九点钟往该撒利亚去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 千夫长叫了两个百夫长来，说："预备两百个步兵，七十个骑兵、两百个长枪手，晚上九点钟往该撒利亚去。
verses.textZhCuv: 千夫长便叫了两个百夫长来，说：「预备步兵二百，马兵七十，长枪手二百，今夜亥初往凯撒利亚去；
verses.textEnNiv: Then he called two of his centurions and ordered them, "Get ready a detachment of two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen to go to Caesarea at nine tonight.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he called two of the centurions and said, "Get ready two hundred soldiers, with seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen to go as far as Caesarea at the third hour of the night.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he called for two centurions, saying, "Prepare two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen, and two hundred spearmen to go to Caesarea at the third hour of the night;
verses.textEnNlt: Then the commander called two of his officers and ordered, "Get 200 soldiers ready to leave for Caesarea at nine o’clock tonight. Also take 200 spearmen and 70 mounted troops.
verses.textEnNasb: And he called to him two of the centurions and said, "Get two hundred soldiers ready by the third hour of the night to proceed to Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen."
verses.textEn: Then he called two of his centurions and ordered them, "Get ready a detachment of two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen to go to Caesarea at nine tonight.

verses.textZh: 也要预备好牲口，好让保罗骑上，护送他安全到达腓力斯总督那里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要预备好牲口，好让保罗骑上，护送他安全到达腓力斯总督那里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 也要预备牲口叫保罗骑上，护送到巡抚腓力斯那里去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Provide horses for Paul so that he may be taken safely to Governor Felix."
verses.textEnEsv: Also provide mounts for Paul to ride and bring him safely to Felix the governor."
verses.textEnNkjv: and provide mounts to set Paul on, and bring him safely to Felix the governor."
verses.textEnNlt: Provide horses for Paul to ride, and get him safely to Governor Felix."
verses.textEnNasb: They were also to provide mounts to put Paul on and bring him safely to Felix the governor.
verses.textEn: Provide horses for Paul so that he may be taken safely to Governor Felix."

verses.textZh: 千夫长写了一封信，大意如下：
verses.textZhCnvs: 千夫长写了一封信，大意如下：
verses.textZhCuv: 千夫长又写了文书，
verses.textEnNiv: He wrote a letter as follows:
verses.textEnEsv: And he wrote a letter to this effect:
verses.textEnNkjv: He wrote a letter in the following manner:
verses.textEnNlt: Then he wrote this letter to the governor:
verses.textEnNasb: And he wrote a letter with the following content:
verses.textEn: He wrote a letter as follows:

verses.textZh: "革老丢．吕西亚问候总督腓力斯大人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "革老丢．吕西亚问候总督腓力斯大人。
verses.textZhCuv: 大略说：「克劳第‧吕西亚，请巡抚腓力斯大人安。
verses.textEnNiv: Claudius Lysias, To His Excellency, Governor Felix: Greetings.
verses.textEnEsv: "Claudius Lysias, to his Excellency the governor Felix, greetings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Claudius Lysias, To the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.
verses.textEnNlt: "From Claudius Lysias, to his Excellency, Governor Felix: Greetings!
verses.textEnNasb: "Claudius Lysias, to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.
verses.textEn: Claudius Lysias, To His Excellency, Governor Felix: Greetings.

verses.textZh: 这个人被犹太人捉住，快要遭害的时候，我听说他是罗马公民，就带兵去把他救出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这个人被犹太人捉住，快要遭害的时候，我听说他是罗马公民，就带兵去把他救出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人被犹太人拿住，将要杀害，我得知他是罗马人，就带兵丁下去救他出来。
verses.textEnNiv: This man was seized by the Jews and they were about to kill him, but I came with my troops and rescued him, for I had learned that he is a Roman citizen.
verses.textEnEsv: This man was seized by the Jews and was about to be killed by them when I came upon them with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman citizen.
verses.textEnNkjv: This man was seized by the Jews and was about to be killed by them. Coming with the troops I rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.
verses.textEnNlt: "This man was seized by some Jews, and they were about to kill him when I arrived with the troops. When I learned that he was a Roman citizen, I removed him to safety.
verses.textEnNasb: When this man was seized by the Jews and was about to be killed by them, I came up to them with the troops and rescued him, after learning that he was a Roman.
verses.textEn: This man was seized by the Jews and they were about to kill him, but I came with my troops and rescued him, for I had learned that he is a Roman citizen.

verses.textZh: 为要知道犹太人控告他的原因，我就带他到他们的公议会那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为要知道犹太人控告他的原因，我就带他到他们的公议会那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 因要知道他们告他的缘故，我就带他下到他们的公会去，
verses.textEnNiv: I wanted to know why they were accusing him, so I brought him to their Sanhedrin.
verses.textEnEsv: And desiring to know the charge for which they were accusing him, I brought him down to their council.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when I wanted to know the reason they accused him, I brought him before their council.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I took him to their high council to try to learn the basis of the accusations against him.
verses.textEnNasb: And wanting to ascertain the basis for the charges they were bringing against him, I brought him down to their Council;
verses.textEn: I wanted to know why they were accusing him, so I brought him to their Sanhedrin.

verses.textZh: 我发现他被控告，是为了他们律法上的问题，并没有甚么该死该绑的罪名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我发现他被控告，是为了他们律法上的问题，并没有甚么该死该绑的罪名。
verses.textZhCuv: 便查知他被告是因他们律法的辩论，并没有什么该死该绑的罪名。
verses.textEnNiv: I found that the accusation had to do with questions about their law, but there was no charge against him that deserved death or imprisonment.
verses.textEnEsv: I found that he was being accused about questions of their law, but charged with nothing deserving death or imprisonment.
verses.textEnNkjv: I found out that he was accused concerning questions of their law, but had nothing charged against him deserving of death or chains.
verses.textEnNlt: I soon discovered the charge was something regarding their religious law—certainly nothing worthy of imprisonment or death.
verses.textEnNasb: and I found that he was being accused regarding questions in their Law, but was not charged with anything deserving death or imprisonment.
verses.textEn: I found that the accusation had to do with questions about their law, but there was no charge against him that deserved death or imprisonment.

verses.textZh: 后来我接到密报，得知害他的阴谋，就立刻把他送到你那里去，并且吩咐原告到你面前来控告他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来我接到密报，得知害他的阴谋，就立刻把他送到你那里去，并且吩咐原告到你面前来控告他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 后来有人把要害他的计谋告诉我，我就立时解他到你那里去，又吩咐告他的人在你面前告他。 」
verses.textEnNiv: When I was informed of a plot to be carried out against the man, I sent him to you at once. I also ordered his accusers to present to you their case against him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when it was disclosed to me that there would be a plot against the man, I sent him to you at once, ordering his accusers also to state before you what they have against him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when it was told me that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him immediately to you, and also commanded his accusers to state before you the charges against him. Farewell.
verses.textEnNlt: But when I was informed of a plot to kill him, I immediately sent him on to you. I have told his accusers to bring their charges before you."
verses.textEnNasb: When I was informed that there would be a plot against the man, I sent him to you at once, also instructing his accusers to bring charges against him before you."
verses.textEn: When I was informed of a plot to be carried out against the man, I sent him to you at once. I also ordered his accusers to present to you their case against him.

verses.textZh: 于是士兵照着吩咐，把保罗提出来，连夜带到安提帕底。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是士兵照着吩咐，把保罗提出来，连夜带到安提帕底。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，兵丁照所吩咐他们的，将保罗夜里带到安提帕底。
verses.textEnNiv: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul with them during the night and brought him as far as Antipatris.
verses.textEnEsv: So the soldiers, according to their instructions, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the soldiers, as they were commanded, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.
verses.textEnNlt: So that night, as ordered, the soldiers took Paul as far as Antipatris.
verses.textEnNasb: So the soldiers, in accordance with their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.
verses.textEn: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul with them during the night and brought him as far as Antipatris.

verses.textZh: 第二天，他们把保罗交给骑兵队护送，就回营楼去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，他们把保罗交给骑兵队护送，就回营楼去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，让马兵护送，他们就回营楼去。
verses.textEnNiv: The next day they let the cavalry go on with him, while they returned to the barracks.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the next day they returned to the barracks, letting the horsemen go on with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: The next day they left the horsemen to go on with him, and returned to the barracks.
verses.textEnNlt: They returned to the fortress the next morning, while the mounted troops took him on to Caesarea.
verses.textEnNasb: But on the next day they let the horsemen go on with him, and they returned to the barracks.
verses.textEn: The next day they let the cavalry go on with him, while they returned to the barracks.

verses.textZh: 骑兵到了该撒利亚，把信呈上总督，同时把保罗也交给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 骑兵到了该撒利亚，把信呈上总督，同时把保罗也交给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 马兵来到凯撒利亚，把文书呈给巡抚，便叫保罗站在他面前。
verses.textEnNiv: When the cavalry arrived in Caesarea, they delivered the letter to the governor and handed Paul over to him.
verses.textEnEsv: When they had come to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they presented Paul also before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they came to Caesarea and had delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived in Caesarea, they presented Paul and the letter to Governor Felix.
verses.textEnNasb: When these horsemen had come to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.
verses.textEn: When the cavalry arrived in Caesarea, they delivered the letter to the governor and handed Paul over to him.

verses.textZh: 总督读了信，就问保罗是哪一省的人；知道了他是基利家人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 总督读了信，就问保罗是哪一省的人；知道了他是基利家人，
verses.textZhCuv: 巡抚看了文书，问保罗是哪省的人，既晓得他是基利家人，
verses.textEnNiv: The governor read the letter and asked what province he was from. Learning that he was from Cilicia,
verses.textEnEsv: On reading the letter, he asked what province he was from. And when he learned that he was from Cilicia,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. And when he understood that hewas from Cilicia,
verses.textEnNlt: He read it and then asked Paul what province he was from. "Cilicia," Paul answered.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when he had read it, he also asked from what province Paul was, and when he learned that he was from Cilicia,
verses.textEn: The governor read the letter and asked what province he was from. Learning that he was from Cilicia,

verses.textZh: 就说："等到原告也来了，我才审问你。"于是吩咐人把他拘留在希律的王府里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就说："等到原告也来了，我才审问你。"于是吩咐人把他拘留在希律的王府里。
verses.textZhCuv: 就说：「等告你的人来到，我要细听你的事」；便吩咐人把他看守在希律的衙门里。
verses.textEnNiv: he said, "I will hear your case when your accusers get here." Then he ordered that Paul be kept under guard in Herod’s palace.
verses.textEnEsv: he said, "I will give you a hearing when your accusers arrive." And he commanded him to be guarded in Herod’s praetorium.
verses.textEnNkjv: he said, "I will hear you when your accusers also have come." And he commanded him to be kept in Herod’s Praetorium.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will hear your case myself when your accusers arrive," the governor told him. Then the governor ordered him kept in the prison at Herod’s headquarters.
verses.textEnNasb: he said, "I will give you a hearing when your accusers arrive as well," giving orders for Paul to be kept in Herod’s Praetorium.
verses.textEn: he said, "I will hear your case when your accusers get here." Then he ordered that Paul be kept under guard in Herod’s palace.

verses.textZh: 过了五天，大祭司亚拿尼亚同几个长老，和一个律师帖土罗来了，他们向总督控告保罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了五天，大祭司亚拿尼亚同几个长老，和一个律师帖土罗来了，他们向总督控告保罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了五天，大祭司亚拿尼亚同几个长老，和一个辩士帖土罗下来，向巡抚控告保罗。
verses.textEnNiv: Five days later the high priest Ananias went down to Caesarea with some of the elders and a lawyer named Tertullus, and they brought their charges against Paul before the governor.
verses.textEnEsv: And after five days the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a spokesman, one Tertullus. They laid before the governor their case against Paul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now after five days Ananias the high priest came down with the elders and a certain orator named Tertullus. These gave evidence to the governor against Paul.
verses.textEnNlt: Five days later Ananias, the high priest, arrived with some of the Jewish elders and the lawyer Tertullus, to present their case against Paul to the governor.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after five days the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and an attorney named Tertullus, and they brought charges against Paul to the governor.
verses.textEn: Five days later the high priest Ananias went down to Caesarea with some of the elders and a lawyer named Tertullus, and they brought their charges against Paul before the governor.

verses.textZh: 保罗传来了之后，帖土罗就控诉他说："腓力斯大人，因着你的缘故，我们大大地享受着太平；因着你的远见，本国大事改革；
verses.textZhCnvs: 保罗传来了之后，帖土罗就控诉他说："腓力斯大人，因着你的缘故，我们大大地享受着太平；因着你的远见，本国大事改革；
verses.textZhCuv: 保罗被提了来，帖土罗就告他说：
verses.textEnNiv: When Paul was called in, Tertullus presented his case before Felix: "We have enjoyed a long period of peace under you, and your foresight has brought about reforms in this nation.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had been summoned, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying: "Since through you we enjoy much peace, and since by your foresight, most excellent Felix, reforms are being made for this nation,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he was called upon, Tertullus began his accusation, saying: "Seeing that through you we enjoy great peace, and prosperity is being brought to this nation by your foresight,
verses.textEnNlt: When Paul was called in, Tertullus presented the charges against Paul in the following address to the governor: "You have provided a long period of peace for us Jews and with foresight have enacted reforms for us.
verses.textEnNasb: After Paul had been summoned, Tertullus began accusing him, saying to the governor, "Since we have attained great peace through you, and since reforms are being carried out for this nation by your foresight,
verses.textEn: When Paul was called in, Tertullus presented his case before Felix: "We have enjoyed a long period of peace under you, and your foresight has brought about reforms in this nation.

verses.textZh: 我们随时随地感激不尽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们随时随地感激不尽。
verses.textZhCuv: 「腓力斯大人，我们因你得以大享太平，并且这一国的弊病，因着你的先见得以更正了；我们随时随地满心感谢不尽。
verses.textEnNiv: Everywhere and in every way, most excellent Felix, we acknowledge this with profound gratitude.
verses.textEnEsv: in every way and everywhere we accept this with all gratitude.
verses.textEnNkjv: we accept it always and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.
verses.textEnNlt: For all of this, Your Excellency, we are very grateful to you.
verses.textEnNasb: we acknowledge this in every way and everywhere, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.
verses.textEn: Everywhere and in every way, most excellent Felix, we acknowledge this with profound gratitude.

verses.textZh: 现在我不想多烦扰你，只求你宽容一下，听我们讲几句话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我不想多烦扰你，只求你宽容一下，听我们讲几句话。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟恐多说，你嫌烦絮，只求你宽容听我们说几句话。
verses.textEnNiv: But in order not to weary you further, I would request that you be kind enough to hear us briefly.
verses.textEnEsv: But, to detain you no further, I beg you in your kindness to hear us briefly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless, not to be tedious to you any further, I beg you to hear, by your courtesy, a few words from us.
verses.textEnNlt: But I don’t want to bore you, so please give me your attention for only a moment.
verses.textEnNasb: But, that I may not weary you further, I beg you to grant us a brief hearing, by your kindness.
verses.textEn: But in order not to weary you further, I would request that you be kind enough to hear us briefly.

verses.textZh: 我们看这个人就像瘟疫一样，是煽动普天下犹太人生乱的人，又是拿撒勒派的首领。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们看这个人就像瘟疫一样，是煽动普天下犹太人生乱的人，又是拿撒勒派的首领。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们看这个人，如同瘟疫一般，是鼓动普天下众犹太人生乱的，又是拿撒勒教党里的一个头目，
verses.textEnNiv: "We have found this man to be a troublemaker, stirring up riots among the Jews all over the world. He is a ringleader of the Nazarene sect
verses.textEnEsv: For we have found this man a plague, one who stirs up riots among all the Jews throughout the world and is a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we have found this man a plague, a creator of dissension among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.
verses.textEnNlt: We have found this man to be a troublemaker who is constantly stirring up riots among the Jews all over the world. He is a ringleader of the cult known as the Nazarenes.
verses.textEnNasb: For we have found this man a public menace and one who stirs up dissensions among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.
verses.textEn: "We have found this man to be a troublemaker, stirring up riots among the Jews all over the world. He is a ringleader of the Nazarene sect

verses.textZh: 他还意图污秽圣殿，我们就把他捉住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他还意图污秽圣殿，我们就把他捉住。
verses.textZhCuv: 连圣殿他也想要污秽；我们把他捉住了。
verses.textEnNiv: and even tried to desecrate the temple; so we seized him.
verses.textEnEsv: He even tried to profane the temple, but we seized him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He even tried to profane the temple, and we seized him, and wanted to judge him according to our law.
verses.textEnNlt: Furthermore, he was trying to desecrate the Temple when we arrested him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he even tried to desecrate the temple, so indeed we arrested him.
verses.textEn: and even tried to desecrate the temple; so we seized him.

verses.textZh: 你亲自审问之后，就必清楚知道我们告他的一切事了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你亲自审问之后，就必清楚知道我们告他的一切事了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你自己究问他，就可以知道我们告他的一切事了。」
verses.textEnNiv: By examining him yourself you will be able to learn the truth about all these charges we are bringing against him."
verses.textEnEsv: By examining him yourself you will be able to find out from him about everything of which we accuse him."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the commander Lysias came by and with great violence took him out of our hands,
verses.textEnNlt: You can find out the truth of our accusations by examining him yourself."
verses.textEnNasb: By interrogating him yourself concerning all these matters, you will be able to ascertain the things of which we are accusing him."
verses.textEn: By examining him yourself you will be able to learn the truth about all these charges we are bringing against him."

verses.textZh: 犹太人也都跟他一同控告保罗，证实事情确是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹太人也都跟他一同控告保罗，证实事情确是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 众犹太人也随着告他说：「事情诚然是这样。」
verses.textEnNiv: The other Jews joined in the accusation, asserting that these things were true.
verses.textEnEsv: The Jews also joined in the charge, affirming that all these things were so.
verses.textEnNkjv: commanding his accusers to come to you. By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the other Jews chimed in, declaring that everything Tertullus said was true.
verses.textEnNasb: The Jews also joined in the attack, asserting that these things were so.
verses.textEn: The other Jews joined in the accusation, asserting that these things were true.

verses.textZh: 总督向保罗示意，叫他说话，他就说："我知道你在本国审案多年，所以乐意为自己申辩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 总督向保罗示意，叫他说话，他就说："我知道你在本国审案多年，所以乐意为自己申辩。
verses.textZhCuv: 巡抚点头叫保罗说话。他就说：「我知道你在这国里断事多年，所以我乐意为自己分诉。
verses.textEnNiv: When the governor motioned for him to speak, Paul replied: "I know that for a number of years you have been a judge over this nation; so I gladly make my defense.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the governor had nodded to him to speak, Paul replied: "Knowing that for many years you have been a judge over this nation, I cheerfully make my defense.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Jews also assented, maintaining that these things were so.
verses.textEnNlt: The governor then motioned for Paul to speak. Paul said, "I know, sir, that you have been a judge of Jewish affairs for many years, so I gladly present my defense before you.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the governor had nodded for him to speak, Paul responded: "Knowing that for many years you have been a judge to this nation, I cheerfully make my defense,
verses.textEn: When the governor motioned for him to speak, Paul replied: "I know that for a number of years you have been a judge over this nation; so I gladly make my defense.

verses.textZh: 你清楚知道，自从我上耶路撒冷去礼拜，到现在还没有十二天；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你清楚知道，自从我上耶路撒冷去礼拜，到现在还没有十二天；
verses.textZhCuv: 你查问就可以知道，从我上耶路撒冷礼拜到今日不过有十二天。
verses.textEnNiv: You can easily verify that no more than twelve days ago I went up to Jerusalem to worship.
verses.textEnEsv: You can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Paul, after the governor had nodded to him to speak, answered: "Inasmuch as I know that you have been for many years a judge of this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself,
verses.textEnNlt: You can quickly discover that I arrived in Jerusalem no more than twelve days ago to worship at the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: since you can take note of the fact that no more than twelve days ago I went up to Jerusalem to worship.
verses.textEn: You can easily verify that no more than twelve days ago I went up to Jerusalem to worship.

verses.textZh: 无论在殿里、会堂中或城里，他们都没有看见我跟人辩论，或煽动群众作乱，
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论在殿里、会堂中或城里，他们都没有看见我跟人辩论，或煽动群众作乱，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们并没有看见我在殿里，或是在会堂里，或是在城里，和人辩论，耸动众人。
verses.textEnNiv: My accusers did not find me arguing with anyone at the temple, or stirring up a crowd in the synagogues or anywhere else in the city.
verses.textEnEsv: and they did not find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the temple or in the synagogues or in the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: because you may ascertain that it is no more than twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem to worship.
verses.textEnNlt: My accusers never found me arguing with anyone in the Temple, nor stirring up a riot in any synagogue or on the streets of the city.
verses.textEnNasb: And neither in the temple did they find me carrying on a discussion with anyone or causing a riot, nor in the synagogues, nor in the city itself.
verses.textEn: My accusers did not find me arguing with anyone at the temple, or stirring up a crowd in the synagogues or anywhere else in the city.

verses.textZh: 也不能向你证明他们现在控告我的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不能向你证明他们现在控告我的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们现在所告我的事并不能对你证实了。
verses.textEnNiv: And they cannot prove to you the charges they are now making against me.
verses.textEnEsv: Neither can they prove to you what they now bring up against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with anyone nor inciting the crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.
verses.textEnNlt: These men cannot prove the things they accuse me of doing.
verses.textEnNasb: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.
verses.textEn: And they cannot prove to you the charges they are now making against me.

verses.textZh: 但有一件事我要向你承认，他们所称为异端的这道，我正是根据这道来敬拜我祖先的神的。一切律法和先知所记的，我都相信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但有一件事我要向你承认，他们所称为异端的这道，我正是根据这道来敬拜我祖先的神的。一切律法和先知所记的，我都相信。
verses.textZhCuv: 但有一件事，我向你承认，就是他们所称为异端的道，我正按着那道事奉我祖宗的神，又信合乎律法的和先知书上一切所记载的，
verses.textEnNiv: However, I admit that I worship the God of our ancestors as a follower of the Way, which they call a sect. I believe everything that is in accordance with the Law and that is written in the Prophets,
verses.textEnEsv: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, I worship the God of our fathers, believing everything laid down by the Law and written in the Prophets,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor can they prove the things of which they now accuse me.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I admit that I follow the Way, which they call a cult. I worship the God of our ancestors, and I firmly believe the Jewish law and everything written in the prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: But I confess this to you, that in accordance with the Way, which they call a sect, I do serve the God of our fathers, believing everything that is in accordance with the Law and is written in the Prophets;
verses.textEn: However, I admit that I worship the God of our ancestors as a follower of the Way, which they call a sect. I believe everything that is in accordance with the Law and that is written in the Prophets,

verses.textZh: 我靠着神所存的盼望，也是他们自己所期待的，就是义人和不义的人都要复活；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我靠着神所存的盼望，也是他们自己所期待的，就是义人和不义的人都要复活；
verses.textZhCuv: 并且靠着神，盼望死人，无论善恶，都要复活，就是他们自己也有这个盼望。
verses.textEnNiv: and I have the same hope in God as these men themselves have, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: having a hope in God, which these men themselves accept, that there will be a resurrection of both the just and the unjust.
verses.textEnNkjv: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way which they call a sect, so I worship the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the Law and in the Prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: I have the same hope in God that these men have, that he will raise both the righteous and the unrighteous.
verses.textEnNasb: having a hope in God, which these men cherish themselves, that there shall certainly be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.
verses.textEn: and I have the same hope in God as these men themselves have, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.

verses.textZh: 因此，我常常勉励自己，对神对人要常存无亏的良心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我常常勉励自己，对神对人要常存无亏的良心。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因此自己勉励，对神对人，常存无亏的良心。
verses.textEnNiv: So I strive always to keep my conscience clear before God and man.
verses.textEnEsv: So I always take pains to have a clear conscience toward both God and man.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have hope in God, which they themselves also accept, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and the unjust.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of this, I always try to maintain a clear conscience before God and all people.
